examples.en: The storm caused minimal damage to the coastal town.
examples.zh: 這場風暴對沿海城鎮造成的損害極小。

examples.en: He prefers a minimal lifestyle with only essential possessions.
examples.zh: 他偏好極簡的生活方式，只擁有必需品。

examples.en: Police found a small amount of cocaine hidden in his car.
examples.zh: 警方在他車裡發現少量藏匿的古柯鹼。

examples.en: Cocaine is a highly addictive drug that is illegal in most countries.
examples.zh: 古柯鹼是一種高度成癮的毒品，在大多數國家都是非法的。

examples.en: He is socially active and enjoys attending parties and events.
examples.zh: 他在社交上很活躍，喜歡參加派對和活動。

examples.en: The program aims to help socially disadvantaged children succeed in school.
examples.zh: 該計畫旨在幫助社會弱勢兒童在學業上取得成功。

examples.en: The ceremony will commence at ten o'clock sharp.
examples.zh: 典禮將於十點整開始。

examples.en: Before you commence the experiment, read all the safety instructions carefully.
examples.zh: 在開始實驗之前，請仔細閱讀所有安全說明。

examples.en: Smoking is a serious health hazard that affects both smokers and non-smokers.
examples.zh: 吸菸是嚴重的健康危害，影響吸菸者和非吸菸者。

examples.en: The icy road was a hazard to drivers, so the police closed it.
examples.zh: 結冰的道路對駕駛人構成危險，因此警方封閉了它。

examples.en: The teacher prepared instructional materials for the new science unit.
examples.zh: 老師為新的科學單元準備了教學材料。

examples.en: This video provides instructional guidance on how to assemble the furniture.
examples.zh: 這部影片提供了如何組裝家具的教學指導。

examples.en: They spent the evening playing blackjack at the casino.
examples.zh: 他們在賭場玩二十一點度過了晚上。

examples.en: The new casino resort includes a hotel, restaurants, and a theater.
examples.zh: 新的賭場度假村包括飯店、餐廳和劇院。

examples.en: He showed great maturity by admitting his mistake and apologizing.
examples.zh: 他承認錯誤並道歉，展現了極大的成熟度。

examples.en: The bond will reach maturity in five years, and then you can collect your investment.
examples.zh: 這筆債券將在五年後到期，屆時你可以取回投資。

examples.en: The banker advised her to diversify her investments to reduce risk.
examples.zh: 銀行家建議她分散投資以降低風險。

examples.en: As the banker in the poker game, he was responsible for dealing the cards.
examples.zh: 作為撲克牌遊戲中的莊家，他負責發牌。

examples.en: The campaign is gaining momentum as more people join the cause.
examples.zh: 隨著更多人加入這項事業，活動的聲勢越來越大。

examples.en: The car's momentum carried it forward even after the brakes were applied.
examples.zh: 即使踩了煞車，車子的動量仍使它向前滑行。

examples.en: The tailor made a few alterations to the dress so it would fit perfectly.
examples.zh: 裁縫對這件洋裝做了幾處修改，使其完全合身。

examples.en: Any alteration to the contract must be approved by both parties.
examples.zh: 合約的任何變更都必須經雙方同意。

examples.en: The suspension of the bridge allows it to move slightly during earthquakes.
examples.zh: 橋樑的懸吊系統讓它在這段地震中能輕微移動。

examples.en: The player received a three-game suspension for his behavior.
examples.zh: 這名球員因行為不當被禁賽三場。

examples.en: More than a thousand residents signed the petition against the new highway.
examples.zh: 超過一千名居民簽署請願書反對新高速公路。

examples.en: She decided to petition the court for a change in the custody agreement.
examples.zh: 她決定向法院請願，要求變更監護協議。

examples.en: He bought a fast-food franchise and opened his first restaurant last year.
examples.zh: 他買下了一家速食連鎖店的經營權，去年開了他的第一家餐廳。

examples.en: The franchise gives the owner the right to use the company's brand and products.
examples.zh: 特許經營權賦予所有者使用公司品牌和產品的權利。

examples.en: The state legislature passed a new law to improve public education.
examples.zh: 州立法機關通過了一項改善公共教育的新法律。

examples.en: Members of the legislature debated the budget for several hours.
examples.zh: 立法機關成員就預算辯論了數小時。

examples.en: The legislator proposed a new bill to improve public transportation.
examples.zh: 這位立法委員提出了一項新法案，以改善公共運輸。

examples.en: As a legislator, she focuses on education and healthcare reform.
examples.zh: 身為立法者，她專注於教育和醫療改革。

examples.en: A small faction within the party opposed the new policy.
examples.zh: 黨內的一個小派系反對這項新政策。

examples.en: The organization split into two rival factions after the dispute.
examples.zh: 爭議過後，該組織分裂成兩個對立的派系。

examples.en: The corresponding chapters in the two books cover similar topics.
examples.zh: 這兩本書中對應的章節涵蓋相似的主題。

examples.en: Please fill in the corresponding fields on the form.
examples.zh: 請填寫表格上相應的欄位。

examples.en: The valuation of the house was higher than we expected.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的估價比我們預期的還要高。

examples.en: Experts carried out a valuation of the company's assets.
examples.zh: 專家對該公司的資產進行了估價。

examples.en: The librarian helped me find a rare book in the archive.
examples.zh: 圖書館員幫我在檔案館裡找到一本珍本書。

examples.en: She works as a librarian at the city's central library.
examples.zh: 她在市立中央圖書館擔任圖書館員。

examples.en: The feminist movement has fought for equal pay and opportunities.
examples.zh: 女性主義運動為同工同酬和平等機會而奮鬥。

examples.en: As a feminist, she advocates for women's rights in the workplace.
examples.zh: 作為一名女性主義者，她倡導職場中的女性權益。

examples.en: She was emotionally exhausted after the long negotiation.
examples.zh: 經過漫長的談判，她情緒上疲憊不堪。

examples.en: He spoke emotionally about his childhood memories.
examples.zh: 他充滿感情地談論他的童年回憶。

examples.en: The company allegedly violated safety regulations last year.
examples.zh: 該公司據稱去年違反了安全法規。

examples.en: He allegedly stole money from the charity fund.
examples.zh: 他據稱從慈善基金中偷了錢。

examples.en: The two countries signed a covenant to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署了一項保護環境的盟約。

examples.en: They covenanted to share the profits equally.
examples.zh: 他們立約均分利潤。

examples.en: The batsman was out after the ball hit the wicket.
examples.zh: 球擊中三柱門後，擊球手出局了。

examples.en: Please enter through the wicket on the left side of the building.
examples.zh: 請從建築物左側的小門進入。

examples.en: The museum's patron donated a large sum to support the new exhibit.
examples.zh: 博物館的贊助人捐贈了一大筆錢來支持新展覽。

examples.en: As a regular patron, he always orders the same coffee.
examples.zh: 作為常客，他總是點同樣的咖啡。

examples.en: The municipal government announced a new recycling program.
examples.zh: 市政府宣布了一項新的回收計畫。

examples.en: Municipal elections will be held next month.
examples.zh: 市政選舉將於下個月舉行。

examples.en: A teacher will supervise the students during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間會有老師監督學生。

examples.en: He was hired to supervise the construction project.
examples.zh: 他被聘用來監督這個建設計畫。

examples.en: The fringe of the rug was damaged by the vacuum cleaner.
examples.zh: 地毯的流蘇被吸塵器弄壞了。

examples.en: They live on the fringe of the city, far from the center.
examples.zh: 他們住在城市的邊緣，遠離市中心。

examples.en: She is inclined to agree with your proposal.
examples.zh: 她傾向於同意你的提案。

examples.en: The roof is inclined at a steep angle.
examples.zh: 這個屋頂以陡峭的角度傾斜。

examples.en: The lawmaker introduced a bill to raise the minimum wage.
examples.zh: 這位立法者提出了一項提高最低工資的法案。

examples.en: Lawmakers debated the new tax policy for hours.
examples.zh: 立法者們針對新稅收政策辯論了好幾個小時。

examples.en: The film screening will be held in the auditorium at 7 p.m.
examples.zh: 電影放映將於晚上七點在禮堂舉行。

examples.en: Regular screening can help detect diseases early.
examples.zh: 定期篩檢有助於早期發現疾病。

examples.en: She responded positively to the job offer.
examples.zh: 她對這份工作邀約做出了正面的回應。

examples.en: The new policy will positively affect small businesses.
examples.zh: 新政策將對小型企業產生積極的影響。

examples.en: The government enacted a law to reduce air pollution.
examples.zh: 政府制定了一項減少空氣污染的法律。

examples.en: The actors enacted the final scene with great emotion.
examples.zh: 演員們充滿感情地演出了最後一幕。

examples.en: Leafy greens are rich in nutrients that support overall health.
examples.zh: 綠葉蔬菜富含支持整體健康的營養素。

examples.en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil through their roots.
examples.zh: 植物透過根部從土壤中吸收營養素。

examples.en: She applied for citizenship after living in the country for ten years.
examples.zh: 她在該國居住十年後申請了公民身分。

examples.en: Good citizenship involves voting and helping your community.
examples.zh: 良好的公民素養包括投票和幫助社區。

examples.en: The exploitation of natural resources must be balanced with environmental protection.
examples.zh: 自然資源的開發必須與環境保護取得平衡。

examples.en: The company was accused of the exploitation of its workers.
examples.zh: 該公司被指控剝削員工。

examples.en: His dependence on painkillers became a serious problem.
examples.zh: 他對止痛藥的依賴成了嚴重的問題。

examples.en: The country's dependence on imported oil makes it vulnerable.
examples.zh: 該國對進口石油的依賴使其變得脆弱。

examples.en: Joyce is my neighbor who loves gardening.
examples.zh: 喬伊斯是我的鄰居，她熱愛園藝。

examples.en: I met Joyce at the bookstore yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在書店遇到喬伊斯。

examples.en: He wore a black derby to the formal event.
examples.zh: 他戴著一頂黑色圓頂禮帽去參加正式活動。

examples.en: The annual derby attracted thousands of spectators.
examples.zh: 一年一度的德比大賽吸引了數千名觀眾。

examples.en: The goods were damaged in transit.
examples.zh: 貨物在運輸途中損壞了。

examples.en: We transited through Tokyo on our way to New York.
examples.zh: 我們在前往紐約的途中經由東京轉機。

examples.en: The maxwell is a unit of magnetic flux.
examples.zh: 麥克斯韋是磁通量的單位。

examples.en: Scientists used maxwells to measure the magnetic field.
examples.zh: 科學家使用麥克斯韋來測量磁場。

examples.en: The configuration of the new software is easy to customize.
examples.zh: 新軟體的配置很容易自訂。

examples.en: The seating configuration in the hall can be changed for different events.
examples.zh: 大廳的座位配置可以因應不同活動而改變。

examples.en: The support group helps sufferers cope with chronic pain.
examples.zh: 這個支持團體幫助患者應對慢性疼痛。

examples.en: She is a long-term sufferer of allergies.
examples.zh: 她是長期過敏患者。

examples.en: The forest was so dense that sunlight barely reached the ground.
examples.zh: 森林非常茂密，陽光幾乎照不到地面。

examples.en: This material is dense and heavy.
examples.zh: 這種材料密度高且沉重。

examples.en: She softened her voice when speaking to the child.
examples.zh: 她對孩子說話時放柔了聲音。

examples.en: The butter will soften if you leave it at room temperature.
examples.zh: 如果你把奶油放在室溫下，它會變軟。

examples.en: The actor waited for his cue to enter the stage.
examples.zh: 那位演員等待他的提示上場。

examples.en: She gave me a cue to start the presentation.
examples.zh: 她給我暗示開始簡報。

examples.en: I read a biography of a famous scientist last week.
examples.zh: 我上週讀了一本著名科學家的傳記。

examples.en: The biography covers his early life and career.
examples.zh: 這本傳記涵蓋了他的早年生活和職業生涯。

examples.en: The rover traveled across the desert alone.
examples.zh: 流浪者獨自穿越沙漠。

examples.en: As a rover, he never stayed in one place for long.
examples.zh: 作為一個漂泊者，他從不在一個地方待太久。

examples.en: The lawyer presented a compelling argument that convinced the jury.
examples.zh: 律師提出了令人信服的論點，說服了陪審團。

examples.en: The documentary was so compelling that I watched it twice.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片非常引人入勝，我看了兩遍。

examples.en: The cell membrane controls what enters and exits the cell.
examples.zh: 細胞膜控制物質進出細胞。

examples.en: A thin membrane covers the surface of the egg.
examples.zh: 一層薄膜覆蓋在蛋的表面。

examples.en: Coastal erosion is a growing problem in many areas.
examples.zh: 海岸侵蝕在許多地區是日益嚴重的問題。

examples.en: The erosion of trust between them was gradual.
examples.zh: 他們之間的信任逐漸侵蝕。

examples.en: The title of lordship was passed down through generations.
examples.zh: 貴族身分代代相傳。

examples.en: He was granted lordship over the region.
examples.zh: 他被授予該地區的管轄權。

examples.en: His utterance was so quiet that no one heard it.
examples.zh: 他的話語如此輕柔，以至於沒有人聽到。

examples.en: The utterance of the oath marked the beginning of his term.
examples.zh: 宣誓的發聲標誌著他任期的開始。

examples.en: The farmer raised Devon cattle for both milk and beef.
examples.zh: 那位農夫飼養德文牛，以取得牛奶和牛肉。

examples.en: Devon is known for its beautiful countryside and coastal towns.
examples.zh: 德文郡以其美麗的鄉村和沿海城鎮而聞名。

examples.en: The infantry brigade was ordered to advance at dawn.
examples.zh: 步兵旅奉命在黎明時推進。

examples.en: Volunteers brigaded together to clean up the beach.
examples.zh: 志工們組成隊伍一起清理海灘。

examples.en: After the accident, he underwent months of rehabilitation to walk again.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，他接受了數個月的復健才能再次行走。

examples.en: The rehabilitation of the old factory into apartments took two years.
examples.zh: 將舊工廠改建為公寓的工程花了兩年時間。

examples.en: The mistress of the house greeted each guest warmly.
examples.zh: 女主人熱情地迎接每位客人。

examples.en: She was known as a strict mistress who demanded perfect grammar.
examples.zh: 她是一位嚴格的女教師，要求文法完美。

examples.en: The reproduction of these rare plants requires specific conditions.
examples.zh: 這些稀有植物的繁殖需要特定條件。

examples.en: This painting is a reproduction, not the original.
examples.zh: 這幅畫是複製品，不是原作。

examples.en: They spread gravel on the driveway to improve traction.
examples.zh: 他們在車道上鋪碎石以增加摩擦力。

examples.en: The constant noise from the construction site graveled him.
examples.zh: 工地傳來的持續噪音讓他心煩。

examples.en: The old quarry has been turned into a beautiful lake.
examples.zh: 那座舊採石場已變成美麗的湖泊。

examples.en: The detective quarried through old records to find the truth.
examples.zh: 偵探費力地翻查舊記錄以找出真相。

examples.en: Ironically, the fire station burned down last night.
examples.zh: 諷刺的是，消防局昨晚燒毀了。

examples.en: She ironically praised his punctuality when he arrived an hour late.
examples.zh: 當他遲到一小時時，她諷刺地稱讚他的準時。

examples.en: The runner placed a marker at the halfway point of the trail.
examples.zh: 跑者在步道的中點放置了一個標記。

examples.en: Use a permanent marker to write your name on the box.
examples.zh: 用麥克筆在盒子上寫下你的名字。

examples.en: The choir sang a joyful gospel that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 合唱團唱了一首歡樂的福音歌曲，感動了觀眾。

examples.en: He treated the coach's advice as gospel and followed it exactly.
examples.zh: 他把教練的建議視為真理，完全照做。

examples.en: The gymnast performed a somerset and landed perfectly.
examples.zh: 體操選手做了一個翻滾動作，完美落地。

examples.en: Learning a somerset takes practice and courage.
examples.zh: 學會翻滾動作需要練習和勇氣。

examples.en: The little boy had blond hair and bright blue eyes.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩有金髮和明亮的藍眼睛。

examples.en: She dyed her hair blond for the summer.
examples.zh: 她為了夏天把頭髮染成金色。

examples.en: The caravan of camels moved slowly across the desert.
examples.zh: 駱駝商隊緩慢地穿越沙漠。

examples.en: They traveled in a caravan to explore the national park.
examples.zh: 他們乘坐露營車探索國家公園。

examples.en: The accident caused severe trauma to his leg.
examples.zh: 那場事故對他的腿造成了嚴重的外傷。

examples.en: She sought therapy to cope with the trauma of the fire.
examples.zh: 她尋求治療以應對火災帶來的心理創傷。

examples.en: We hiked through the peaceful woodland and saw many birds.
examples.zh: 我們徒步穿過寧靜的林地，看到許多鳥類。

examples.en: The woodland is home to deer and foxes.
examples.zh: 這片林地是鹿和狐狸的家。

examples.en: She decided to seek counselling after the loss of her job.
examples.zh: 失業後，她決定尋求諮商。

examples.en: The school offers counselling to students who feel stressed.
examples.zh: 學校為感到壓力的學生提供輔導。

examples.en: The carter loaded the goods onto his cart and set off.
examples.zh: 馬車伕把貨物裝上馬車後出發。

examples.en: In the past, a carter was essential for transporting goods.
examples.zh: 過去，馬車伕對於運輸貨物是不可或缺的。

examples.en: Insert a coin into the slot to start the machine.
examples.zh: 將硬幣投入投幣口以啟動機器。

examples.en: The meeting is scheduled for the 3 PM slot.
examples.zh: 會議安排在下午三點的時段。

examples.en: The company was sued for negligence after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，該公司因過失而被起訴。

examples.en: His negligence in locking the door led to a burglary.
examples.zh: 他疏忽未鎖門，導致了竊盜案。

examples.en: She coordinated the efforts of all the volunteers.
examples.zh: 她協調所有志工的努力。

examples.en: The map shows the coordinates of the hidden treasure.
examples.zh: 地圖顯示了寶藏的座標。

examples.en: The circular table in the dining room seats eight people comfortably.
examples.zh: 餐廳裡的圓桌可以舒適地坐八個人。

examples.en: She received a circular from the supermarket advertising this week's special offers.
examples.zh: 她收到超市寄來的廣告傳單，宣傳本週的特價商品。

examples.en: My sister is studying nursing at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在台北的一所大學攻讀護理。

examples.en: The nursing staff at the hospital were very kind to my grandmother.
examples.zh: 醫院的護理人員對我祖母非常親切。

examples.en: The university invited a distinguished scientist to give the opening lecture.
examples.zh: 大學邀請了一位著名的科學家來發表開幕演講。

examples.en: He looked quite distinguished in his dark suit and silver tie.
examples.zh: 他穿著深色西裝搭配銀色領帶，看起來相當有威嚴。

examples.en: The machines are routinely checked to make sure they are safe.
examples.zh: 這些機器會定期檢查，以確保安全。

examples.en: She routinely arrives at the office before seven in the morning.
examples.zh: 她通常早上七點前就到辦公室了。

examples.en: The gas regulator on the heater needs to be replaced.
examples.zh: 暖氣上的瓦斯調節器需要更換了。

examples.en: The financial regulator fined the bank for breaking the rules.
examples.zh: 金融監管機構對這家銀行違規處以罰款。

examples.en: The professor wrote several books on theological subjects.
examples.zh: 這位教授寫了好幾本關於神學主題的書。

examples.en: They had a long theological discussion about the nature of faith.
examples.zh: 他們針對信仰的本質進行了長時間的神學討論。

examples.en: The arrow's shaft was made of straight, lightweight wood.
examples.zh: 這支箭的箭桿是用筆直、輕盈的木頭製成的。

examples.en: Miners descended into the dark shaft to reach the coal seam.
examples.zh: 礦工們下降到黑暗的礦井中，以到達煤層。

examples.en: We spent a week hiking along the coast of Cornwall last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我們在康沃爾海岸健行了一個星期。

examples.en: Cornwall is known for its beautiful beaches and mild climate.
examples.zh: 康沃爾以其美麗的海灘和溫和的氣候聞名。

examples.en: The steward showed us to our seats and offered us drinks.
examples.zh: 空服員帶我們到座位上，並提供飲料。

examples.en: He was hired as a steward to manage the family's estate.
examples.zh: 他受雇為管家，管理這個家族的產業。

examples.en: As an undergraduate, she majored in history and minored in French.
examples.zh: 大學時期，她主修歷史，副修法文。

examples.en: The library is open to both undergraduates and graduate students.
examples.zh: 圖書館對大學部和研究生都開放。

examples.en: After a long week at work, I look forward to some relaxation on the weekend.
examples.zh: 經過一週漫長的工作，我期待週末能好好放鬆。

examples.en: Yoga and meditation are great ways to achieve relaxation.
examples.zh: 瑜伽和冥想是達到放鬆的好方法。

examples.en: The sales projection for next year looks very optimistic.
examples.zh: 明年的銷售預測看起來非常樂觀。

examples.en: The projection of the film onto the large screen was crystal clear.
examples.zh: 影片投影在大螢幕上非常清晰。

examples.en: The new trainee is learning how to operate the machinery.
examples.zh: 新來的實習生正在學習如何操作機器。

examples.en: Each trainee is assigned a mentor for the first three months.
examples.zh: 每位受訓者在頭三個月都會分配一位導師。

examples.en: The university held an open day for prospective students.
examples.zh: 大學為未來的學生舉辦了開放日。

examples.en: She met with a prospective client to discuss the project.
examples.zh: 她與一位潛在客戶見面討論這個專案。

examples.en: She used her inheritance to start a small business.
examples.zh: 她利用繼承的遺產創立了一家小公司。

examples.en: The color of your eyes is determined by genetic inheritance.
examples.zh: 你眼睛的顏色是由基因遺傳決定的。

examples.en: The university will confer an honorary degree on the retired professor.
examples.zh: 大學將授予這位退休教授名譽學位。

examples.en: The lawyers conferred with their client before the hearing.
examples.zh: 律師們在聽證會前與他們的客戶協商。

examples.en: A car was parked in the driveway, blocking the entrance.
examples.zh: 一輛車停在車道上，擋住了入口。

examples.en: He shoveled the snow off the driveway after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雪過後，他把車道上的雪鏟掉。

examples.en: The students respectfully addressed their professor as "Don".
examples.zh: 學生們恭敬地稱他們的教授為「唐」。

examples.en: She donned her coat and headed out into the cold.
examples.zh: 她穿上外套，走進寒冷的天氣中。

examples.en: The promoter booked a famous band for the summer music festival.
examples.zh: 主辦人為夏季音樂節預訂了一個知名樂團。

examples.en: As a promoter of healthy eating, she often gives talks at local schools.
examples.zh: 作為健康飲食的倡導者，她經常在當地學校演講。

examples.en: We need sustainable solutions to reduce plastic waste in our oceans.
examples.zh: 我們需要可持續的解決方案來減少海洋中的塑料垃圾。

examples.en: Is this pace of economic growth sustainable in the long term?
examples.zh: 這種經濟增長速度從長遠來看是可持續的嗎？

examples.en: The company invests heavily in telecommunication networks to improve rural connectivity.
examples.zh: 該公司大力投資電信網路，以改善農村地區的連接性。

examples.en: Advances in telecommunication have made global communication faster and cheaper.
examples.zh: 電信的進步使全球通訊變得更快、更便宜。

examples.en: Scientists studied the molecular structure of the virus to develop a vaccine.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了病毒的分子結構以開發疫苗。

examples.en: At the molecular level, water consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 在分子層面上，水由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。

examples.en: The room measures 12 ft by 15 ft, which is quite spacious.
examples.zh: 這個房間的面積是12英尺乘15英尺，相當寬敞。

examples.en: He is 6 ft tall and plays basketball for his school team.
examples.zh: 他身高6英尺，為校隊打籃球。

examples.en: The narrator of the audiobook has a soothing voice.
examples.zh: 有聲書的旁白聲音很舒緩。

examples.en: In the novel, the narrator is a young girl who observes everything around her.
examples.zh: 在小說中，敘述者是一個觀察周圍一切的小女孩。

examples.en: Drinking milk is a good way to get enough calcium for strong bones.
examples.zh: 喝牛奶是攝取足夠鈣質以保持骨骼強壯的好方法。

examples.en: The doctor recommended calcium supplements because her diet lacked dairy products.
examples.zh: 醫生建議她補充鈣片，因為她的飲食缺乏乳製品。

examples.en: The privatisation of the national railway was met with both support and criticism.
examples.zh: 國家鐵路的私有化既得到了支持，也受到了批評。

examples.en: Many economists argue that privatisation can lead to more efficient services.
examples.zh: 許多經濟學家認為私有化可以帶來更有效率的服務。

examples.en: In a network, each computer is a node that can send and receive data.
examples.zh: 在網路中，每台電腦都是一個可以發送和接收資料的節點。

examples.en: The gardener removed the damaged node from the stem to help the plant grow.
examples.zh: 園丁從莖上移除了受損的節，以幫助植物生長。

examples.en: The semantic difference between 'childish' and 'childlike' is important.
examples.zh: 「幼稚的」和「天真的」之間的語義差異很重要。

examples.en: Linguists study semantic changes in words over centuries.
examples.zh: 語言學家研究詞彙數百年來的語義變化。

examples.en: The doctor sent a blood sample to the lab to test the serum for antibodies.
examples.zh: 醫生將血液樣本送到實驗室檢測血清中的抗體。

examples.en: After the blood coagulated, the serum was separated for further analysis.
examples.zh: 血液凝固後，血清被分離出來進行進一步分析。

examples.en: The police diverted traffic away from the accident scene.
examples.zh: 警方將交通疏導遠離事故現場。

examples.en: She diverted herself by reading a novel while waiting for the train.
examples.zh: 她在等火車時讀小說來打發時間。

examples.en: The children caught small fish in the creek behind their house.
examples.zh: 孩子們在屋後的小溪裡抓小魚。

examples.en: A narrow creek flows through the meadow and joins the river.
examples.zh: 一條狹窄的小溪流經草地，匯入河流。

examples.en: The motion sensor turns on the lights when someone enters the room.
examples.zh: 當有人進入房間時，動作感測器會打開燈。

examples.en: Engineers installed a temperature sensor to monitor the machine's performance.
examples.zh: 工程師安裝了溫度感測器來監控機器的效能。

examples.en: She trained her dog to retrieve the ball and bring it back.
examples.zh: 她訓練她的狗撿球並把它帶回來。

examples.en: You can retrieve deleted files from the recycle bin on your computer.
examples.zh: 你可以從電腦的資源回收筒中檢索已刪除的檔案。

examples.en: The museum displays a World War II bomber and other historic aircraft.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一架二戰轟炸機和其他歷史飛機。

examples.en: The police arrested the bomber before he could plant the device.
examples.zh: 警方在炸彈客安裝裝置前逮捕了他。

examples.en: The ship dropped its anchor in the bay to wait out the storm.
examples.zh: 船在灣內拋錨，等待風暴過去。

examples.en: The news anchor interviewed the mayor live on television.
examples.zh: 新聞主播在電視上直播採訪了市長。

examples.en: The company's financial records came under close scrutiny by auditors.
examples.zh: 該公司的財務記錄受到審計師的密切審查。

examples.en: Under the scrutiny of the crowd, the performer felt nervous.
examples.zh: 在人群的注視下，表演者感到緊張。

examples.en: The television screen showed only static after the storm damaged the antenna.
examples.zh: 風暴損壞天線後，電視螢幕只顯示靜電干擾。

examples.en: The population of the town has remained static for the past decade.
examples.zh: 過去十年來，該鎮的人口一直保持靜止不變。

examples.en: You should reduce your intake of sugary drinks to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 你應該減少含糖飲料的攝取量以保持健康。

examples.en: The water intake pipe was clogged with leaves and debris.
examples.zh: 進水管被樹葉和雜物堵塞了。

examples.en: She wrote a detailed critique of the new policy for the school newspaper.
examples.zh: 她為校刊寫了一篇對新政策的詳細評論。

examples.en: The professor will critique your essay and give you feedback next week.
examples.zh: 教授會評論你的文章，並在下週給你回饋。

examples.en: After a lengthy discussion, the committee finally reached a decision.
examples.zh: 經過冗長的討論後，委員會終於做出決定。

examples.en: The doctor's lengthy explanation helped me understand the treatment options.
examples.zh: 醫生漫長的解釋幫助我了解治療選項。

examples.en: Her compassion for the homeless led her to volunteer at the shelter every weekend.
examples.zh: 她對無家可歸者的同情促使她每個週末都在收容所當志工。

examples.en: He showed great compassion when he sat with the lonely old man and listened to his stories.
examples.zh: 當他坐下來陪伴那位孤獨的老人並聆聽他的故事時，展現了極大的憐憫。

examples.en: The congregation stood up to sing the opening hymn.
examples.zh: 會眾站起來唱開場的讚美詩。

examples.en: A large congregation gathered in the square to celebrate the festival.
examples.zh: 一大群人聚集在廣場慶祝節日。

examples.en: Possession of marijuana is still illegal in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，持有大麻仍然是非法的。

examples.en: Some patients use marijuana to relieve chronic pain.
examples.zh: 有些病人使用大麻來緩解慢性疼痛。

examples.en: The local militia was called out to help after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水過後，當地民兵被召集來幫忙。

examples.en: In times of war, the militia often fights alongside the regular army.
examples.zh: 在戰爭時期，民兵經常與正規軍並肩作戰。

examples.en: During his tenure as mayor, the city built several new parks.
examples.zh: 在他擔任市長期間，這座城市建造了幾座新公園。

examples.en: After five years of teaching, she was granted tenure at the university.
examples.zh: 教書五年後，她獲得了大學的終身職。

examples.en: The sheriff arrested the suspect and took him to jail.
examples.zh: 治安官逮捕了嫌犯並將他送進監獄。

examples.en: Voters elected a new sheriff who promised to reduce crime.
examples.zh: 選民選出了一位承諾減少犯罪的新治安官。

examples.en: The old photograph evoked memories of my childhood summers.
examples.zh: 這張老照片喚起了我童年夏天的回憶。

examples.en: Her speech evoked strong emotions from the audience.
examples.zh: 她的演講引起了觀眾強烈的情感。

examples.en: The weather this winter has been comparatively mild.
examples.zh: 今年冬天的天氣相對溫和。

examples.en: Comparatively speaking, this restaurant is cheaper than the one next door.
examples.zh: 相對來說，這家餐廳比隔壁那家便宜。

examples.en: She gave an affirmative nod when asked if she agreed.
examples.zh: 當被問到是否同意時，她肯定地點了點頭。

examples.en: The company took affirmative steps to hire more women.
examples.zh: 公司採取了積極的措施來雇用更多女性。

examples.en: There is a slight variance in the test results between the two groups.
examples.zh: 兩組之間的測試結果有輕微的差異。

examples.en: His actions were at variance with his stated principles.
examples.zh: 他的行為與他宣稱的原則不一致。

examples.en: The sailor climbed the mast to adjust the sails.
examples.zh: 水手爬上桅杆調整帆。

examples.en: My grandfather was a sailor in the merchant navy.
examples.zh: 我的祖父曾是商船隊的船員。

examples.en: The manager gave a fair appraisal of each employee's performance.
examples.zh: 經理對每位員工的表現給予了公平的評價。

examples.en: We need an expert appraisal of the painting before we sell it.
examples.zh: 在賣掉這幅畫之前，我們需要專家估價。

examples.en: The book includes a commentary on each of Shakespeare's sonnets.
examples.zh: 這本書包含了對莎士比亞每首十四行詩的註釋。

examples.en: We listened to the live commentary of the baseball game on the radio.
examples.zh: 我們在收音機上收聽棒球比賽的現場評論。

examples.en: He follows orthodox medical treatments rather than alternative therapies.
examples.zh: 他遵循正統的醫學治療，而不是替代療法。

examples.en: Her views are quite orthodox for someone of her generation.
examples.zh: 對她這個世代的人來說，她的觀點相當傳統。

examples.en: The cowboy rode into town on his horse after a long day on the range.
examples.zh: 牛仔在牧場上度過漫長的一天後，騎馬進入鎮上。

examples.en: He was acting like a cowboy, driving recklessly without a seatbelt.
examples.zh: 他像個莽漢一樣，不繫安全帶魯莽駕駛。

examples.en: The thief snatched her purse and ran away.
examples.zh: 小偷搶了她的錢包就跑走了。

examples.en: I only caught a snatch of their conversation as I walked past.
examples.zh: 我走過去時只聽到他們談話的片段。

examples.en: Solar power is now a viable alternative to fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 太陽能現在是化石燃料的可行替代方案。

examples.en: The seeds will remain viable for several years if stored properly.
examples.zh: 如果儲存得當，這些種子可以保持活力好幾年。

examples.en: The moon exerts a gravitational pull on the Earth's oceans.
examples.zh: 月球對地球的海洋施加引力。

examples.en: She had to exert all her strength to lift the heavy box.
examples.zh: 她必須使出全身力氣才能抬起那個重箱子。

examples.en: She finished ninth in the marathon despite the hot weather.
examples.zh: 儘管天氣炎熱，她仍在馬拉松比賽中獲得第九名。

examples.en: Only a ninth of the students passed the difficult exam.
examples.zh: 只有九分之一的學生通過了那場困難的考試。

examples.en: The pitcher walked slowly to the mound before the final inning.
examples.zh: 在最後一局之前，投手慢慢地走向投手丘。

examples.en: A small mound of earth marked the spot where the treasure was buried.
examples.zh: 一個小土墩標記了寶藏埋藏的地點。

examples.en: The old picture on the wall was starting to tilt to one side.
examples.zh: 牆上的舊畫開始向一側傾斜。

examples.en: His strong tilt toward conservative views surprised his friends.
examples.zh: 他強烈傾向保守觀點，讓朋友們感到驚訝。

examples.en: Her advocacy for animal rights has inspired many young people.
examples.zh: 她對動物權利的倡導激勵了許多年輕人。

examples.en: The group's advocacy led to changes in the local housing policy.
examples.zh: 該團體的倡導導致了當地住房政策的改變。

examples.en: The two countries have a long-standing territorial dispute over the islands.
examples.zh: 兩國對這些島嶼有長期的領土爭端。

examples.en: Cats are very territorial and will defend their space aggressively.
examples.zh: 貓非常有領域性，會積極保衛自己的地盤。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic to treat the bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 醫生開了一種抗生素來治療細菌感染。

examples.en: Overuse of antibiotic drugs can lead to resistant bacteria.
examples.zh: 過度使用抗生素藥物可能導致細菌產生抗藥性。

examples.en: After the revolution, the former leader lived in exile for many years.
examples.zh: 革命後，前領導人流亡多年。

examples.en: The government decided to exile the dissident writer to a remote island.
examples.zh: 政府決定將那位異議作家流放到一個偏遠的島嶼。

examples.en: There was an implicit threat in his calm but firm tone.
examples.zh: 他平靜而堅定的語氣中隱含著威脅。

examples.en: She trusted him with implicit confidence, never questioning his motives.
examples.zh: 她對他抱有絕對的信任，從不質疑他的動機。

examples.en: The city is famous for its stunning architectural landmarks.
examples.zh: 這座城市以其令人驚嘆的建築地標而聞名。

examples.en: They studied the architectural plans carefully before starting the renovation.
examples.zh: 他們在開始翻修前仔細研究了建築圖紙。

examples.en: The authorities decided to prosecute the company for environmental violations.
examples.zh: 當局決定以違反環境法規為由起訴該公司。

examples.en: She will prosecute her research project despite the funding cuts.
examples.zh: 儘管資金削減，她仍將繼續進行她的研究項目。

examples.en: Lancaster was the English royal house that reigned from 1399 to 1461.
examples.zh: 蘭開斯特是1399年至1461年間統治英格蘭的王室。

examples.en: The red rose was the emblem of the House of Lancaster.
examples.zh: 紅玫瑰是蘭開斯特王室的象徵。

examples.en: The cooper carefully repaired the old wooden barrel.
examples.zh: 製桶工人仔細地修理了那個舊木桶。

examples.en: In the past, every village needed a skilled cooper to make casks.
examples.zh: 在過去，每個村莊都需要一個熟練的製桶工人來製作木桶。

examples.en: Bradford is a city in West Yorkshire, England.
examples.zh: 布拉德福德是英格蘭西約克郡的一座城市。

examples.en: She was born in Bradford but moved to London for work.
examples.zh: 她出生於布拉德福德，但為了工作搬到了倫敦。

examples.en: Hampshire is known for its beautiful countryside and historic towns.
examples.zh: 漢普郡以其美麗的鄉村和歷史悠久的城鎮而聞名。

examples.en: The Hampshire sheep is a British breed with a dark face.
examples.zh: 漢普郡羊是一種面部深色的英國品種。

examples.en: The air traffic controller guided the planes safely to the runway.
examples.zh: 航空管制員引導飛機安全地飛向跑道。

examples.en: He works as a financial controller for a large corporation.
examples.zh: 他在一家大公司擔任財務主管。

examples.en: The event organizer made sure everything ran smoothly.
examples.zh: 活動組織者確保了一切順利進行。

examples.en: She bought a new digital organizer to keep track of her appointments.
examples.zh: 她買了一個新的數位行程管理裝置來記錄她的約會。

examples.en: Fear of criticism can inhibit creativity in the workplace.
examples.zh: 對批評的恐懼會抑制工作中的創造力。

examples.en: The new law aims to inhibit the spread of misinformation online.
examples.zh: 新法律旨在禁止網路上不實資訊的傳播。

examples.en: The surveyor measured the land before the new building was constructed.
examples.zh: 測量員在新大樓建造前測量了土地。

examples.en: A team of surveyors was hired to conduct the statistical survey.
examples.zh: 聘請了一組調查員來進行統計調查。

examples.en: The project was delayed due to adverse weather conditions.
examples.zh: 由於惡劣的天氣條件，該項目被延誤了。

examples.en: She remained calm despite the adverse comments from her critics.
examples.zh: 儘管批評者對她發表了敵對的評論，她仍保持冷靜。

examples.en: The plumber replaced the broken valve under the sink.
examples.zh: 水管工更換了水槽下方損壞的閥門。

examples.en: The heart has four valves that control blood flow.
examples.zh: 心臟有四個瓣膜控制血液流動。

examples.en: The teacher arranged the students into small groupings for the project.
examples.zh: 老師將學生分成小組來進行這個專案。

examples.en: Proper grouping of the data makes the report easier to read.
examples.zh: 將資料妥善分組能讓報告更容易閱讀。

examples.en: She is passionate about protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 她對環境保護充滿熱情。

examples.en: His passionate speech moved the audience to tears.
examples.zh: 他熱烈的演講讓觀眾感動落淚。

examples.en: The painting depicts a biblical scene from the Old Testament.
examples.zh: 這幅畫描繪了舊約聖經中的場景。

examples.en: Many biblical stories have been adapted into films.
examples.zh: 許多聖經故事已被改編成電影。

examples.en: The new pipeline will carry natural gas across the country.
examples.zh: 新的管道將輸送天然氣橫跨全國。

examples.en: Several innovative products are currently in the pipeline.
examples.zh: 幾項創新產品目前正在開發中。

examples.en: Could you summarise the main points of the article?
examples.zh: 你能總結這篇文章的要點嗎？

examples.en: She summarised the meeting in a short email.
examples.zh: 她在一封簡短的電子郵件中概述了會議內容。

examples.en: The government imposed a tariff on imported steel.
examples.zh: 政府對進口鋼鐵課徵關稅。

examples.en: Higher tariffs may lead to increased prices for consumers.
examples.zh: 較高的關稅可能導致消費者面臨價格上漲。

examples.en: Many migrant workers send money back to their families.
examples.zh: 許多移居工人寄錢回家。

examples.en: The birds are migrant and travel south every winter.
examples.zh: 這些鳥是候鳥，每年冬天向南遷徙。

examples.en: The synthesis of the two chemicals produced a bright blue compound.
examples.zh: 這兩種化學物質的合成產生了一種亮藍色的化合物。

examples.en: Her book is a synthesis of ideas from several disciplines.
examples.zh: 她的書綜合了來自幾個學科的想法。

examples.en: The film is an adaptation of a popular novel.
examples.zh: 這部電影是改編自一本暢銷小說。

examples.en: Adaptation to the new climate took several weeks.
examples.zh: 適應新氣候花了幾週的時間。

examples.en: She gasped in surprise when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 她看到禮物時驚訝地喘了口氣。

examples.en: He was gasping for air after the long run.
examples.zh: 長跑之後他氣喘吁吁。

examples.en: The poet uses vivid imagery to describe the sunset.
examples.zh: 詩人用生動的意象來描寫日落。

examples.en: The novel's imagery creates a strong sense of place.
examples.zh: 這本小說的意象營造出強烈的地方感。

examples.en: The discovery led to a new paradigm in physics.
examples.zh: 這項發現導致物理學的新範例。

examples.en: This approach challenges the traditional paradigm of education.
examples.zh: 這種方法挑戰了傳統的教育典範。

examples.en: The old steam locomotive pulled several passenger cars.
examples.zh: 老式蒸汽火車頭拉著幾節客車車廂。

examples.en: A diesel locomotive is more powerful than a steam one.
examples.zh: 柴油機車比蒸汽機車更有力。

examples.en: She bought a ball of yarn to knit a scarf.
examples.zh: 她買了一團紗線來織圍巾。

examples.en: Grandpa loves to spin a yarn about his childhood.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡講他童年的故事。

examples.en: The debtor agreed to repay the loan in monthly installments.
examples.zh: 債務人同意按月分期償還貸款。

examples.en: Creditors may take legal action against a debtor who defaults.
examples.zh: 債權人可能會對違約的債務人採取法律行動。

examples.en: The doctor gave me a referral to a specialist.
examples.zh: 醫生給了我一張轉診單去看專科醫生。

examples.en: She got the job through a referral from a friend.
examples.zh: 她透過朋友的介紹得到了這份工作。

examples.en: The floor was decorated with a beautiful mosaic.
examples.zh: 地板上裝飾著美麗的馬賽克。

examples.en: The artist created a mosaic using pieces of colored glass.
examples.zh: 藝術家用彩色玻璃碎片創作了鑲嵌畫。

examples.en: The company faced years of litigation over the patent.
examples.zh: 這家公司因專利問題面臨多年的訴訟。

examples.en: Litigation can be expensive and time-consuming.
examples.zh: 訴訟可能既昂貴又耗時。

examples.en: Children develop spatial awareness through play.
examples.zh: 兒童透過遊戲發展空間意識。

examples.en: The spatial arrangement of the furniture makes the room feel larger.
examples.zh: 家具的空間安排讓房間感覺更大。

examples.en: This enzyme helps break down proteins in the stomach.
examples.zh: 這種酶有助於分解胃中的蛋白質。

examples.en: Enzymes act as catalysts in many biochemical reactions.
examples.zh: 酶在許多生化反應中作為催化劑。

examples.en: She wore a shiny silver dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件閃亮的銀色洋裝去參加派對。

examples.en: The coins were polished until they were shiny.
examples.zh: 這些硬幣被擦得閃閃發亮。

examples.en: I wrote a memo to remind everyone about the meeting.
examples.zh: 我寫了一份備忘錄，提醒大家開會的事。

examples.en: The manager sent a memo about the new policy.
examples.zh: 經理發了一份關於新政策的備忘錄。

examples.en: Suffolk is known for its beautiful countryside and historic towns.
examples.zh: 薩福克以其美麗的鄉村和歷史悠久的城鎮而聞名。

examples.en: They visited a farm in Suffolk to see the famous sheep.
examples.zh: 他們參觀了薩福克的一個農場，去看著名的羊。

examples.en: The city is experiencing a revival of its downtown area.
examples.zh: 這座城市的市中心地區正在復興。

examples.en: The doctor performed CPR and the patient showed signs of revival.
examples.zh: 醫生進行了心肺復甦術，病人顯示出甦醒的跡象。

examples.en: The event would not be possible without the sponsorship of local businesses.
examples.zh: 沒有當地企業的贊助，這個活動就不可能舉辦。

examples.en: She secured sponsorship for her charity run from several companies.
examples.zh: 她從幾家公司為她的慈善路跑爭取到了贊助。

examples.en: The reconstruction of the bridge took over two years.
examples.zh: 這座橋的重建花了兩年多的時間。

examples.en: Historians pieced together a reconstruction of the ancient city.
examples.zh: 歷史學家拼湊出了這座古城的重建樣貌。

examples.en: It's important to differentiate between fact and opinion.
examples.zh: 區分事實和意見是很重要的。

examples.en: The company differentiates its products through superior customer service.
examples.zh: 該公司透過優質的客戶服務來區隔其產品。

examples.en: Southampton is a major port city on the south coast of England.
examples.zh: 南安普敦是英格蘭南海岸的主要港口城市。

examples.en: We took a ferry from Southampton to the Isle of Wight.
examples.zh: 我們從南安普敦搭渡輪到懷特島。

examples.en: This software is compatible with most operating systems.
examples.zh: 這個軟體與大多數作業系統相容。

examples.en: They are compatible roommates who rarely argue.
examples.zh: 他們是能和睦相處的室友，很少爭吵。

examples.en: The cathedral features stunning Gothic architecture.
examples.zh: 這座大教堂以令人驚嘆的哥德式建築為特色。

examples.en: She enjoys reading Gothic novels with dark, mysterious settings.
examples.zh: 她喜歡閱讀背景黑暗神秘的哥德式小說。

examples.en: Canterbury has been a pilgrimage site for centuries.
examples.zh: 坎特伯雷幾個世紀以來一直是朝聖地。

examples.en: We visited the ancient cathedral in Canterbury.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了坎特伯雷的古老主教座堂。

examples.en: The audience was predominantly young adults.
examples.zh: 觀眾主要是年輕人。

examples.en: The region is predominantly agricultural, with few factories.
examples.zh: 該地區以農業為主，工廠很少。

examples.en: The doctor checked his kidney function with a blood test.
examples.zh: 醫生透過血液檢查來檢查他的腎功能。

examples.en: She donated a kidney to her brother last year.
examples.zh: 她去年捐了一顆腎給她的哥哥。

examples.en: The inclusion of a glossary makes the book more useful.
examples.zh: 包含詞彙表使這本書更有用。

examples.en: The school promotes inclusion of students with disabilities.
examples.zh: 學校提倡接納身心障礙學生。

examples.en: The healing process took several weeks after the surgery.
examples.zh: 手術後的癒合過程花了幾週時間。

examples.en: She found the peaceful garden very healing.
examples.zh: 她覺得這個寧靜的花園很有療癒效果。

examples.en: The abolition of slavery was a major historical milestone.
examples.zh: 奴隸制度的廢除是一個重大的歷史里程碑。

examples.en: They campaigned for the abolition of the death penalty.
examples.zh: 他們為廢除死刑而奔走。

examples.en: The program aims to improve adult literacy in rural areas.
examples.zh: 該計畫旨在提升鄉村地區的成人識字率。

examples.en: Digital literacy is essential in today's job market.
examples.zh: 在當今的就業市場中，數位素養至關重要。

examples.en: The company made a full disclosure of its financial records.
examples.zh: 該公司完全揭露了其財務記錄。

examples.en: The disclosure of the secret caused a scandal.
examples.zh: 這個秘密的揭露引發了醜聞。

examples.en: The binding of the old book was falling apart.
examples.zh: 這本舊書的裝訂正在解體。

examples.en: The contract is legally binding once signed.
examples.zh: 合同一旦簽署就具有法律約束力。

examples.en: The marine corps trained rigorously for the mission.
examples.zh: 海軍陸戰隊為這次任務進行了嚴格訓練。

examples.en: A corps of volunteers helped with the disaster relief.
examples.zh: 一群志工協助救災工作。

examples.en: The congressman voted against the new tax bill.
examples.zh: 那位國會議員投票反對新的稅收法案。

examples.en: She wrote a letter to her congressman about the issue.
examples.zh: 她寫信給她的國會議員討論這個問題。

examples.en: I ordered a Collins at the bar.
examples.zh: 我在酒吧點了一杯柯林斯。

examples.en: Would you like a Collins or a beer?
examples.zh: 你想喝柯林斯還是啤酒？

examples.en: The scientist studied the evolutionary changes in the species.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了該物種的進化變化。

examples.en: Evolutionary theory explains how life on Earth developed.
examples.zh: 進化論解釋了地球上的生命是如何發展的。

examples.en: He drew an analogy between the brain and a computer.
examples.zh: 他將大腦與電腦進行類比。

examples.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain the concept.
examples.zh: 老師用類比來解釋這個概念。

examples.en: The plant is found only in this locality.
examples.zh: 這種植物只在這個地區被發現。

examples.en: People from the surrounding locality came to the fair.
examples.zh: 來自附近地區的人們來參加博覽會。

examples.en: The doctor was concerned about the regression in the patient's development.
examples.zh: 醫生擔心病人發育上的退步。

examples.en: Regression analysis helps predict future trends.
examples.zh: 迴歸分析有助於預測未來的趨勢。

examples.en: The burial took place at the village cemetery.
examples.zh: 葬禮在村莊的墓地舉行。

examples.en: They planned a simple burial for their father.
examples.zh: 他們為父親規劃了一場簡單的葬禮。

examples.en: Good posture can help prevent back pain.
examples.zh: 良好的姿勢有助於預防背痛。

examples.en: The government adopted a tough posture on crime.
examples.zh: 政府對犯罪採取了強硬的態度。

examples.en: The priest invoked a blessing on the congregation.
examples.zh: 牧師祈求祝福會眾。

examples.en: The lawyer invoked the Fifth Amendment.
examples.zh: 律師援引了第五修正案。

examples.en: The bank requires monthly repayment of the loan.
examples.zh: 銀行要求每月償還貸款。

examples.en: He made a repayment to his friend for the borrowed money.
examples.zh: 他還了向朋友借的錢。

examples.en: The reservoir supplies water to the entire city.
examples.zh: 水庫供應整個城市的水。

examples.en: She has a reservoir of knowledge about history.
examples.zh: 她擁有豐富的歷史知識。

examples.en: The landowner rented the field to a farmer.
examples.zh: 地主將田地租給了一位農夫。

examples.en: Local landowners opposed the new highway project.
examples.zh: 當地地主反對新的高速公路計畫。

examples.en: She hung her dress in the wardrobe.
examples.zh: 她把洋裝掛在衣櫥裡。

examples.en: He needs to update his wardrobe for the new job.
examples.zh: 他需要為新工作添購新衣。

examples.en: The hull of the ship was damaged in the storm.
examples.zh: 船的船體在風暴中受損。

examples.en: You need to hull the strawberries before making jam.
examples.zh: 做果醬前你需要去掉草莓的蒂。

examples.en: The company achieved dominance in the smartphone market.
examples.zh: 該公司在智慧型手機市場取得了優勢地位。

examples.en: The alpha wolf showed dominance over the pack.
examples.zh: 領頭狼對狼群展現了支配地位。

examples.en: The survey asked about age, gender, and ethnicity.
examples.zh: 這項調查詢問了年齡、性別和種族。

examples.en: People of different ethnicities live in this neighborhood.
examples.zh: 不同種族的人們住在這個社區。

examples.en: The assassination of the president shocked the nation.
examples.zh: 總統的暗殺事件震驚了全國。

examples.en: They plotted the assassination of the dictator.
examples.zh: 他們策劃暗殺獨裁者。

examples.en: The geographic location of the town makes it prone to floods.
examples.zh: 該城鎮的地理位置使其容易發生洪水。

examples.en: Geographic barriers can isolate animal populations.
examples.zh: 地理屏障可能隔離動物族群。

examples.en: The plants absorb moisture from the air.
examples.zh: 植物從空氣中吸收水分。

examples.en: Wipe the screen to remove any moisture.
examples.zh: 擦拭螢幕以去除任何濕氣。

examples.en: Good parenting requires patience and consistency.
examples.zh: 良好的育兒需要耐心和一致性。

examples.en: They attended a workshop on parenting skills.
examples.zh: 他們參加了一個關於育兒技巧的研討會。

examples.en: The liver produces bile, which helps digest fats in the small intestine.
examples.zh: 肝臟製造膽汁，幫助在小腸中消化脂肪。

examples.en: His remarks were full of bile and resentment.
examples.zh: 他的話語充滿了怨恨和敵意。

examples.en: The jazz ensemble performed a lively set at the festival.
examples.zh: 爵士樂團在音樂節上表演了一組活潑的曲目。

examples.en: She wore a striking ensemble of a red jacket and black skirt.
examples.zh: 她穿著一套引人注目的服裝，包括紅色外套和黑色裙子。

examples.en: The Council of Constance was held in the 15th century.
examples.zh: 康士坦茨會議於十五世紀舉行。

examples.en: Constance is a beautiful city located on Lake Constance.
examples.zh: 康士坦茨是一座位於康士坦茨湖邊的美麗城市。

examples.en: Plastics are made from long-chain polymers derived from petroleum.
examples.zh: 塑膠是由源自石油的長鏈聚合物製成的。

examples.en: Scientists developed a new polymer that can conduct electricity.
examples.zh: 科學家開發出一種可以導電的新聚合物。

examples.en: The preservation of historic buildings requires careful planning.
examples.zh: 歷史建築的保存需要仔細的規劃。

examples.en: Salt has been used for centuries for the preservation of food.
examples.zh: 鹽幾個世紀以來一直被用於保存食物。

examples.en: The rotation of the Earth causes day and night.
examples.zh: 地球的自轉造成了晝夜。

examples.en: The doctor's schedule works on a rotation system.
examples.zh: 醫生的班表採用輪流制。

examples.en: Carrie is my cousin and she loves to paint.
examples.zh: 卡麗是我的表妹，她熱愛畫畫。

examples.en: I met Carrie at the coffee shop yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在咖啡店遇見卡麗。

examples.en: The film developed a cult following among young people.
examples.zh: 這部電影在年輕人中培養出一群狂熱的追隨者。

examples.en: Police raided the cult's compound on the outskirts of town.
examples.zh: 警方突襲了該教派在城郊的總部。

examples.en: The living conditions in the refugee camp were appalling.
examples.zh: 難民營裡的生活條件令人震驚。

examples.en: It is appalling that so many people still lack clean water.
examples.zh: 這麼多人仍然缺乏乾淨的水，令人震驚。

examples.en: His hatred of injustice drove him to become a lawyer.
examples.zh: 他對不公義的憎恨促使他成為律師。

examples.en: The two families lived in mutual hatred for years.
examples.zh: 這兩個家庭多年來互相憎恨。

examples.en: The doctor gave the patient a thorough examination.
examples.zh: 醫生對病人進行了徹底的檢查。

examples.en: She is thorough in her research and never misses a detail.
examples.zh: 她研究十分徹底，從不放過任何細節。

examples.en: The rookie made several mistakes during his first game.
examples.zh: 這位新手在他的第一場比賽中犯了幾個錯誤。

examples.en: As a rookie, she had a lot to learn about the job.
examples.zh: 作為一名新手，她對這份工作還有很多要學。

examples.en: The teacher spoke to each student individually after class.
examples.zh: 老師在課後個別與每位學生談話。

examples.en: These items are sold individually, not as a set.
examples.zh: 這些物品是單獨販售的，不是整套賣。

examples.en: Researchers found that income correlates with education level.
examples.zh: 研究人員發現收入與教育程度相關。

examples.en: The study correlates sleep quality with academic performance.
examples.zh: 這項研究將睡眠品質與學業表現相互關聯。

examples.en: The chorus sang beautifully during the school concert.
examples.zh: 合唱團在學校音樂會上唱得很美妙。

examples.en: The audience answered in chorus, “Yes!”
examples.zh: 觀眾齊聲回答：「是的！」

examples.en: The new policy will be implemented nationally next year.
examples.zh: 新政策將於明年在全國實施。

examples.en: The team is ranked nationally among the top ten.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在全國排名前十。

examples.en: Dark clouds loomed on the horizon before the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨前，烏雲在地平線上隱約出現。

examples.en: A tall figure loomed in the fog, startling the children.
examples.zh: 一個高挑的身影在霧中朦朧地出現，嚇到了孩子們。

examples.en: The majesty of the mountains left us speechless.
examples.zh: 山脈的雄偉讓我們說不出話來。

examples.en: The queen was addressed as “Your Majesty”.
examples.zh: 女王被稱為「陛下」。

examples.en: The old books on the shelf were dusty and forgotten.
examples.zh: 書架上的舊書佈滿灰塵，被人遺忘。

examples.en: He sneezed as he walked into the dusty attic.
examples.zh: 他走進滿是灰塵的閣樓時打了個噴嚏。

examples.en: The constant noise from the construction site is a real nuisance.
examples.zh: 建築工地持續的噪音真是討厭。

examples.en: Littering in public places is considered a nuisance by law.
examples.zh: 在公共場所亂丟垃圾在法律上被視為一種損害行為。

examples.en: The storm inflicted severe damage on the coastal villages.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對沿海村莊造成了嚴重破壞。

examples.en: He apologized for the pain his words had inflicted on her.
examples.zh: 他為自己的話對她造成的痛苦道歉。

examples.en: The surgical team prepared the patient for the operation.
examples.zh: 外科團隊為病人做好手術準備。

examples.en: Her movements were so surgical that she never wasted a single step.
examples.zh: 她的動作精準如手術，從不浪費一步。

examples.en: She works as a liaison between the company and its overseas clients.
examples.zh: 她擔任公司與海外客戶之間的聯絡人。

examples.en: The two departments established a close liaison to speed up the project.
examples.zh: 兩個部門建立了密切的聯絡以加速專案進行。

examples.en: This specialized software is designed for medical imaging analysis.
examples.zh: 這套專門的軟體是為醫學影像分析設計的。

examples.en: You need specialized training to operate this machine safely.
examples.zh: 你需要接受專門訓練才能安全操作這台機器。

examples.en: The laboratory apparatus must be cleaned after every experiment.
examples.zh: 實驗室儀器在每次實驗後都必須清洗。

examples.en: The breathing apparatus helped the divers stay underwater longer.
examples.zh: 呼吸裝置幫助潛水員在水下待得更久。

examples.en: She began her speech with a quotation from a famous philosopher.
examples.zh: 她以一位著名哲學家的引語開始演講。

examples.en: The supplier sent us a quotation for the new equipment.
examples.zh: 供應商寄給我們新設備的報價單。

examples.en: An insider revealed that the company plans to merge with a rival.
examples.zh: 一位內部人士透露，公司計劃與競爭對手合併。

examples.en: Insider trading is illegal and can lead to serious penalties.
examples.zh: 內線交易是違法的，可能導致嚴重的處罰。

examples.en: We walked along the pier and watched the fishing boats return.
examples.zh: 我們沿著碼頭散步，看著漁船歸來。

examples.en: The old pier was damaged by the typhoon last summer.
examples.zh: 那座舊碼頭去年夏天被颱風損壞了。

examples.en: The company added twenty new employees to its payroll this month.
examples.zh: 公司這個月新增了二十名員工到薪資名單中。

examples.en: She works in payroll and handles all salary payments.
examples.zh: 她在薪資部門工作，處理所有薪資發放事宜。

examples.en: A single bead of sweat rolled down his forehead.
examples.zh: 一滴汗水從他的額頭滾落。

examples.en: She threaded the colorful beads onto a string to make a necklace.
examples.zh: 她把彩色珠子穿在線上做成項鍊。

examples.en: The court upheld the original decision after reviewing the evidence.
examples.zh: 法院在審查證據後維持原判。

examples.en: We must uphold the principles of fairness and honesty.
examples.zh: 我們必須堅持公平與誠信的原則。

examples.en: The young chess player proved to be a formidable opponent.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的棋手證明自己是個可怕的對手。

examples.en: Climbing that mountain in winter is a formidable challenge.
examples.zh: 冬天攀登那座山是一項艱鉅的挑戰。

examples.en: Driving in heavy fog can be extremely hazardous.
examples.zh: 在濃霧中開車可能極度危險。

examples.en: The workers wore protective gear while handling hazardous materials.
examples.zh: 工人們在處理危險物質時穿著防護裝備。

examples.en: The clarity of her explanation made the complex topic easy to understand.
examples.zh: 她解釋得清晰明瞭，讓這個複雜的主題變得容易理解。

examples.en: The clarity of the lake water surprised all the visitors.
examples.zh: 湖水清澈見底，讓所有遊客都感到驚訝。

examples.en: Despite the criticism, his opinion remained unchanged.
examples.zh: 儘管受到批評，他的意見依然沒有改變。

examples.en: The room looked unchanged since we left it ten years ago.
examples.zh: 這個房間看起來和十年前我們離開時一樣，毫無變化。

examples.en: The legal proceedings against the company lasted for months.
examples.zh: 對該公司的法律訴訟持續了好幾個月。

examples.en: The proceedings of the conference were published in a thick volume.
examples.zh: 會議紀錄被出版成厚厚的一冊。

examples.en: The renewal of your passport can be done online.
examples.zh: 你的護照換發可以在網路上辦理。

examples.en: The city invested in the renewal of its old downtown area.
examples.zh: 這座城市投資更新老舊的市中心區域。

examples.en: The airplane began its descent toward the airport.
examples.zh: 飛機開始向機場下降。

examples.en: She is proud of her Irish descent and often visits her relatives there.
examples.zh: 她以愛爾蘭血統為榮，經常去那裡探望親戚。

examples.en: A deficiency of vitamin C can lead to various health problems.
examples.zh: 缺乏維生素C可能導致各種健康問題。

examples.en: The report pointed out a serious deficiency in the safety procedures.
examples.zh: 報告指出安全程序有嚴重的不足。

examples.en: The gardener transplanted the young trees to a sunnier spot.
examples.zh: 園丁把幼樹移植到陽光更充足的地方。

examples.en: He received a kidney transplant from his brother last year.
examples.zh: 他去年接受了哥哥的腎臟移植。

examples.en: The superintendent of the building fixed the leaking pipe this morning.
examples.zh: 大樓管理員今天早上修好了漏水的管子。

examples.en: She was promoted to superintendent of the school district last year.
examples.zh: 她去年被提升為學區的督學。

examples.en: The baby shook the rattle happily in her crib.
examples.zh: 寶寶在嬰兒床裡開心地搖著撥浪鼓。

examples.en: The old truck rattled loudly as it drove down the bumpy road.
examples.zh: 那輛舊卡車在顛簸的路上行駛時發出很大的嘎嘎聲。

examples.en: The manager sent a memorandum to all staff about the new policy.
examples.zh: 經理發了一份備忘錄給全體員工，說明新政策。

examples.en: Please sign the memorandum and return it to the HR department.
examples.zh: 請在備忘錄上簽名後交回人力資源部。

examples.en: The company took disciplinary action against the employee for repeated lateness.
examples.zh: 公司對該員工多次遲到採取了紀律處分。

examples.en: The university has a disciplinary committee to handle student misconduct.
examples.zh: 這所大學設有紀律委員會來處理學生不當行為。

examples.en: The electorate will decide the outcome of the referendum next month.
examples.zh: 選民將在下個月的公投中決定結果。

examples.en: Candidates must appeal to a wide electorate to win the election.
examples.zh: 候選人必須爭取廣大選民的支持才能贏得選舉。

examples.en: Chester is a historic city in northwestern England.
examples.zh: 切斯特是英格蘭西北部的一座歷史名城。

examples.en: They visited Chester during their trip to the UK last summer.
examples.zh: 他們去年夏天去英國旅行時參觀了切斯特。

examples.en: Blake is a common surname in English-speaking countries.
examples.zh: 布萊克是英語系國家常見的姓氏。

examples.en: My friend Blake works as a graphic designer in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我的朋友布萊克在台北當平面設計師。

examples.en: Statistically, the new drug reduces recovery time by about three days.
examples.zh: 從統計上來看，這種新藥能將康復時間縮短約三天。

examples.en: The difference between the two groups was not statistically significant.
examples.zh: 兩組之間的差異在統計上並不顯著。

examples.en: Always make a backup of your important files before updating the software.
examples.zh: 更新軟體前，一定要備份重要檔案。

examples.en: The singer needed a backup vocalist for the live concert.
examples.zh: 這位歌手在現場演唱會上需要一位和聲歌手。

examples.en: The smoke detector went off when I burned the toast.
examples.zh: 我把吐司烤焦時，煙霧偵測器響了。

examples.en: Airport security uses a metal detector to screen passengers.
examples.zh: 機場安檢使用金屬探測器來檢查旅客。

examples.en: The earth rotates once every twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 地球每二十四小時自轉一次。

examples.en: The staff rotate their shifts every two weeks.
examples.zh: 員工每兩週輪班一次。

examples.en: Madame Curie was a pioneering scientist in the field of radioactivity.
examples.zh: 居里夫人是放射性領域的先驅科學家。

examples.en: The waiter greeted her politely, saying, "Good evening, madame."
examples.zh: 服務生禮貌地問候她：「晚安，夫人。」

examples.en: The actress stood in the spotlight and smiled at the audience.
examples.zh: 女演員站在聚光燈下，向觀眾微笑。

examples.en: The scandal put the company under the media spotlight for weeks.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞讓該公司連續數週成為媒體關注的焦點。

examples.en: Drinking plenty of water is good for your bladder and kidneys.
examples.zh: 多喝水對膀胱和腎臟有好處。

examples.en: The doctor examined his bladder with an ultrasound scan.
examples.zh: 醫生用超音波掃描檢查他的膀胱。

examples.en: The unionist demanded better working conditions for factory workers.
examples.zh: 工會會員要求為工廠工人爭取更好的工作條件。

examples.en: As a unionist, she often participated in negotiations with management.
examples.zh: 身為工會會員，她經常參與與管理階層的協商。

examples.en: The region became autonomous after years of negotiation.
examples.zh: 該地區經過多年協商後獲得自治。

examples.en: Autonomous vehicles are being tested on roads in several countries.
examples.zh: 自動駕駛車輛正在好幾個國家的道路上進行測試。

examples.en: The telescope uses optical lenses to magnify distant stars.
examples.zh: 這台望遠鏡使用光學鏡片來放大遙遠的星星。

examples.en: Optical illusions can trick the brain into seeing things that aren't there.
examples.zh: 視錯覺能欺騙大腦，讓人看到不存在的東西。

examples.en: The researchers explained their methodology in the first chapter of the report.
examples.zh: 研究人員在報告的第一章說明了他們的研究方法。

examples.en: A clear methodology is essential for any scientific study.
examples.zh: 明確的方法論對任何科學研究都至關重要。

examples.en: In medieval England, a chapman traveled from town to town selling goods.
examples.zh: 在中世紀的英格蘭，小販會從一個城鎮到另一個城鎮販賣貨物。

examples.en: The chapman carried a heavy pack of fabrics and spices.
examples.zh: 那個小販背著一包沉重的布料和香料。

examples.en: The aggregate cost of the project exceeded our initial estimate.
examples.zh: 該專案的總成本超出了我們最初的估計。

examples.en: Gravel and sand are common aggregates used in making concrete.
examples.zh: 礫石和沙子是製作混凝土常用的骨材。

examples.en: She published a memoir about her childhood in the countryside.
examples.zh: 她出版了一本關於她在鄉村童年的回憶錄。

examples.en: The scientist's memoir on climate change was widely cited.
examples.zh: 那位科學家關於氣候變遷的研究報告被廣泛引用。

examples.en: He was in agony after breaking his leg in the accident.
examples.zh: 他在事故中摔斷腿後痛苦不堪。

examples.en: The patient's agony was evident from his facial expression.
examples.zh: 從病人的表情明顯看出他極度痛苦。

examples.en: The nurse will inject the vaccine into your arm.
examples.zh: 護士會把疫苗注射到你的手臂。

examples.en: The new manager tried to inject some enthusiasm into the team.
examples.zh: 新經理試圖為團隊注入一些熱情。

examples.en: Put the additional information in brackets at the end of the sentence.
examples.zh: 把補充資訊放在句末的括號裡。

examples.en: She was placed in the 30-40 age bracket for the survey.
examples.zh: 在調查中她被歸入30至40歲的年齡層。

examples.en: The realization that she had lost her keys hit her suddenly.
examples.zh: 她突然意識到自己弄丟了鑰匙。

examples.en: The realization of his dream to become a pilot took years of hard work.
examples.zh: 他實現成為飛行員的夢想花了多年的努力。

examples.en: Aluminium is a lightweight metal often used in aircraft construction.
examples.zh: 鋁是一種輕金屬，常用於飛機製造。

examples.en: She wrapped the leftovers in aluminium foil before storing them.
examples.zh: 她把剩菜用鋁箔紙包好後再存放。

examples.en: He was unwilling to admit that he had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 他不願意承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: The company was unwilling to negotiate with the striking workers.
examples.zh: 公司不願意與罷工工人談判。

examples.en: The children believed the forest was full of magical creatures.
examples.zh: 孩子們相信森林裡充滿了魔法生物。

examples.en: The sunset over the ocean created a magical atmosphere.
examples.zh: 海上的日落營造出一種不可思議的氛圍。

examples.en: There was a heap of dirty laundry in the corner of the room.
examples.zh: 房間角落有一堆髒衣服。

examples.en: He heaped praise on his team after their successful project.
examples.zh: 專案成功後，他對團隊大加讚揚。

examples.en: She bundled the old newspapers and tied them with string.
examples.zh: 她把舊報紙捆起來並用繩子綁好。

examples.en: The baby was bundled up in a warm blanket.
examples.zh: 嬰兒被裹在溫暖的毯子裡。

examples.en: The audience broke into spontaneous applause after the performance.
examples.zh: 表演結束後，觀眾自發地爆發出掌聲。

examples.en: Their spontaneous decision to go camping turned out to be a great adventure.
examples.zh: 他們臨時決定去露營，結果成了一場很棒的冒險。

examples.en: The truck barely had enough clearance to pass under the bridge.
examples.zh: 那輛卡車幾乎沒有足夠的間隙通過橋下。

examples.en: The pilot waited for clearance from the control tower before taking off.
examples.zh: 飛行員等待塔台許可後才起飛。

examples.en: The startup secured financing from several venture capital firms.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司從幾家創投公司籌集到資金。

examples.en: They are still working on the financing for the new building.
examples.zh: 他們仍在為新大樓籌措資金。

examples.en: She showed great reluctance to leave her hometown.
examples.zh: 她非常不情願離開家鄉。

examples.en: His reluctance to apologize only made the situation worse.
examples.zh: 他不願意道歉只讓情況變得更糟。

examples.en: In physics, a quantum is the smallest discrete amount of energy.
examples.zh: 在物理學中，量子是最小的離散能量單位。

examples.en: The discovery of quantum mechanics revolutionized modern science.
examples.zh: 量子力學的發現徹底改變了現代科學。

examples.en: We went for a long walk across the heath on Sunday.
examples.zh: 星期天我們在石南荒原上走了很長一段路。

examples.en: The heath was covered with purple flowers in early summer.
examples.zh: 初夏時，荒原上開滿了紫色的花。

examples.en: The wedding feast lasted late into the night.
examples.zh: 婚宴持續到深夜。

examples.en: We feasted on fresh seafood at the beachside restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊餐廳盡情享用新鮮海鮮。

examples.en: The grand jury returned an indictment against the suspect.
examples.zh: 大陪審團對嫌犯提出了起訴。

examples.en: The report is a damning indictment of the company's safety practices.
examples.zh: 這份報告是對該公司安全措施的嚴厲控訴。

examples.en: She poured the chocolate into a heart-shaped mould.
examples.zh: 她把巧克力倒入心形的模子裡。

examples.en: The damp walls were covered with black mould.
examples.zh: 潮濕的牆壁上長滿了黑色的黴。

examples.en: The dairy produces organic milk and cheese.
examples.zh: 這家乳牛場生產有機牛奶和起司。

examples.en: She is allergic to dairy products, so she avoids milk and cheese.
examples.zh: 她對乳製品過敏，所以避免牛奶和起司。

examples.en: The new government declared an amnesty for all political prisoners.
examples.zh: 新政府宣布對所有政治犯實行大赦。

examples.en: Under the amnesty, tax evaders could pay their debts without facing prosecution.
examples.zh: 根據這項赦免，逃稅者可以償還欠稅而不被起訴。

examples.en: The river carries sediment downstream and deposits it on the floodplain.
examples.zh: 河流將沉積物帶往下游，並堆積在洪泛平原上。

examples.en: After the wine aged, a layer of sediment settled at the bottom of the bottle.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒陳年後，一瓶底會沉澱出一層沉積物。

examples.en: The bank still relies on a mainframe to process millions of transactions daily.
examples.zh: 這家銀行仍然依靠大型主機來處理每天數百萬筆的交易。

examples.en: Mainframes are known for their reliability and ability to handle huge workloads.
examples.zh: 大型主機以可靠性和處理龐大工作量的能力聞名。

examples.en: The shah ruled Iran for decades before the revolution.
examples.zh: 沙阿在革命前統治伊朗數十年。

examples.en: Many Iranians have mixed feelings about the era of the shah.
examples.zh: 許多伊朗人對沙阿時代有著複雜的感受。

examples.en: I need to restart the modem because the internet connection is unstable.
examples.zh: 我需要重新啟動數據機，因為網路連線不穩定。

examples.en: The old modem made a series of beeping sounds when connecting.
examples.zh: 舊式數據機在連線時會發出一連串嗶嗶聲。

examples.en: The study focuses on lexical development in bilingual children.
examples.zh: 這項研究聚焦於雙語兒童的詞彙發展。

examples.en: Lexical items are stored in the mental lexicon.
examples.zh: 詞彙項目儲存在心理詞典中。

examples.en: The mucosa lining the stomach protects it from digestive acids.
examples.zh: 胃黏膜保護胃部免受消化酸的侵蝕。

examples.en: Infections can cause inflammation of the mucosa in the respiratory tract.
examples.zh: 感染可能導致呼吸道黏膜發炎。

examples.en: The artist's work is highly conceptual and requires careful interpretation.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家的作品非常概念化，需要仔細解讀。

examples.en: Children develop conceptual understanding of numbers through play.
examples.zh: 兒童透過遊戲發展對數字的概念性理解。

examples.en: The pylorus controls the passage of food from the stomach to the small intestine.
examples.zh: 幽門控制食物從胃進入小腸的通道。

examples.en: Surgery may be needed if the pylorus becomes narrowed.
examples.zh: 如果幽門變窄，可能需要手術。

examples.en: The city plans to demolish the old stadium and build a park.
examples.zh: 市政府計劃拆除舊體育場並興建公園。

examples.en: He demolished the entire pizza by himself.
examples.zh: 他一個人吃光了整份披薩。

examples.en: Good teachers nurture their students' curiosity and confidence.
examples.zh: 好老師培養學生的好奇心和自信心。

examples.en: She nurtured her younger brother after their parents passed away.
examples.zh: 父母過世後，她撫養弟弟長大。

examples.en: The novel paints a vivid picture of life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 這本小說生動地描繪了鄉村生活。

examples.en: She wore a vivid red dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件鮮紅色的洋裝去參加派對。

examples.en: During the holidays, many people indulge in rich food and sweets.
examples.zh: 假日期間，許多人縱情於油膩食物和甜點。

examples.en: He indulged his passion for painting by spending hours in the studio.
examples.zh: 他放任自己對繪畫的熱愛，在畫室待上好幾個小時。

examples.en: Only privileged members of society could afford such an education.
examples.zh: 只有社會上的特權階層才負擔得起這種教育。

examples.en: I feel privileged to have worked with such talented people.
examples.zh: 能與如此有才華的人共事，我感到很榮幸。

examples.en: Please check that the attachment is included before sending the email.
examples.zh: 寄出電子郵件前，請確認已包含附件。

examples.en: The child formed a strong attachment to her kindergarten teacher.
examples.zh: 這孩子對幼稚園老師產生了強烈的依戀。

examples.en: The labourer worked long hours under the hot sun.
examples.zh: 那名勞工在烈日下長時間工作。

examples.en: Many labourers migrated to the city in search of better wages.
examples.zh: 許多勞工遷移到城市尋求更好的工資。

examples.en: The new policy proved problematic and was quickly revised.
examples.zh: 新政策證明有問題，很快就被修訂了。

examples.en: It is problematic to draw conclusions from such a small sample.
examples.zh: 從這麼小的樣本得出結論是有問題的。

examples.en: She took a vigorous walk every morning to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都進行精力充沛的散步以保持健康。

examples.en: The proposal met with vigorous opposition from local residents.
examples.zh: 這項提案遭到當地居民強烈的反對。

examples.en: The physicist explained the theory of relativity in simple terms.
examples.zh: 這位物理學家用簡單的術語解釋了相對論。

examples.en: Physicists are still searching for a unified theory of everything.
examples.zh: 物理學家仍在尋找統一萬物理論。

examples.en: The documents were duly signed and witnessed.
examples.zh: 文件已按規定簽署並見證。

examples.en: She duly noted the instructions and followed them carefully.
examples.zh: 她適當地記下指示並仔細遵循。

examples.en: The team's morale improved after they won three games in a row.
examples.zh: 球隊連續贏了三場比賽後，士氣大振。

examples.en: Low morale among employees often leads to higher turnover rates.
examples.zh: 員工士氣低落往往導致更高的離職率。

examples.en: The collision between the two cars caused major traffic delays.
examples.zh: 兩輛車的碰撞造成了嚴重的交通延誤。

examples.en: A collision of ideas during the meeting led to a better solution.
examples.zh: 會議中意見的衝突激盪出了更好的解決方案。

examples.en: The festival encompasses music, food, and art from many cultures.
examples.zh: 這個節慶包含了來自許多文化的音樂、美食和藝術。

examples.en: Her research encompasses a wide range of topics in environmental science.
examples.zh: 她的研究涵蓋了環境科學中廣泛的主題。

examples.en: Heat some oil in a skillet before adding the vegetables.
examples.zh: 在加入蔬菜之前，先在平底鍋中加熱一些油。

examples.en: She cooked the pancakes in a cast-iron skillet.
examples.zh: 她用鑄鐵平底鍋煎了鬆餅。

examples.en: Peat is often used as fuel in regions with few trees.
examples.zh: 泥炭在樹木稀少的地區常被用作燃料。

examples.en: The garden soil was enriched with peat to help plants grow.
examples.zh: 花園的土壤添加了泥炭來幫助植物生長。

examples.en: The rescue mission was unsuccessful due to bad weather.
examples.zh: 由於天氣惡劣，救援任務沒有成功。

examples.en: After an unsuccessful attempt, he decided to try a different approach.
examples.zh: 在一次不成功的嘗試後，他決定採用不同的方法。

examples.en: In the aftermath of the earthquake, volunteers helped rebuild homes.
examples.zh: 地震過後，志工們協助重建家園。

examples.en: The aftermath of the scandal left the company struggling to regain trust.
examples.zh: 醜聞的後果讓公司難以重獲信任。

examples.en: During wartime, many families were separated for years.
examples.zh: 戰時，許多家庭分離多年。

examples.en: The museum displays letters written by soldiers in wartime.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了戰時士兵寫的信件。

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to loud noise can damage your hearing.
examples.zh: 長時間暴露在噪音中會損害聽力。

examples.en: The patient suffered from a prolonged illness that lasted months.
examples.zh: 這位病人患了一場持續數月的長期疾病。

examples.en: From the outset, it was clear that the project would be challenging.
examples.zh: 從一開始就很明顯，這個專案會很有挑戰性。

examples.en: She made her intentions clear at the outset of the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在會議開始時就表明了自己的意圖。

examples.en: The couple exchanged vows at the altar in the old church.
examples.zh: 這對情侶在古老教堂的聖壇前交換誓言。

examples.en: Ancient people built an altar to offer sacrifices to their gods.
examples.zh: 古人建造祭壇來向他們的神獻祭。

examples.en: The lieutenant led the platoon during the training exercise.
examples.zh: 中尉在訓練演習中率領這個排。

examples.en: She was promoted to lieutenant after five years of service.
examples.zh: 她服務五年後被晉升為中尉。

examples.en: The website provides a listing of all available apartments in the city.
examples.zh: 這個網站提供了城市中所有可租公寓的清單。

examples.en: He checked the job listing to see if he met the requirements.
examples.zh: 他查看了職缺列表，看看自己是否符合要求。

examples.en: The intimacy between the two friends was evident in their easy laughter.
examples.zh: 兩個朋友之間的親密關係從他們輕鬆的笑聲中明顯可見。

examples.en: She values intimacy and honesty in her relationships.
examples.zh: 她在人際關係中重視親密和誠實。

examples.en: The soldiers dug a trench to protect themselves from enemy fire.
examples.zh: 士兵們挖了一條戰壕來保護自己免受敵方炮火攻擊。

examples.en: Workers dug a deep trench to lay the new water pipes.
examples.zh: 工人們挖了一條深溝來鋪設新的水管。

examples.en: The region is principally known for its coffee production.
examples.zh: 這個地區主要以咖啡生產聞名。

examples.en: The delay was principally caused by bad weather.
examples.zh: 延誤主要是由惡劣天氣造成的。

examples.en: The storm caused a major disruption to train services.
examples.zh: 暴風雨對火車服務造成了重大中斷。

examples.en: The new policy led to disruption in the normal workflow.
examples.zh: 新政策導致了正常工作流程的混亂。

examples.en: She indirectly hinted that she wanted a different gift.
examples.zh: 她間接地暗示她想要不同的禮物。

examples.en: The company was indirectly affected by the new trade regulations.
examples.zh: 這家公司間接地受到了新貿易法規的影響。

examples.en: A lack of funding constrained the team's ability to expand the project.
examples.zh: 資金不足限制了團隊擴展專案的能力。

examples.en: She felt constrained by the strict rules of the competition.
examples.zh: 她感到被比賽的嚴格規則所限制。

examples.en: The nun devoted her life to helping the poor in her community.
examples.zh: 這位修女一生致力於幫助社區中的窮人。

examples.en: Every morning, the nuns gather in the chapel to pray.
examples.zh: 每天早晨，修女們聚集在教堂裡祈禱。

examples.en: He bought a cup of tea for a few shillings.
examples.zh: 他花了幾先令買了一杯茶。

examples.en: The old coin collection included a silver shilling from the 19th century.
examples.zh: 那個舊硬幣收藏中包含一枚19世紀的銀先令。

examples.en: A set of keys dangled from her belt as she walked.
examples.zh: 她走路時，一串鑰匙在她腰間晃動。

examples.en: He dangled the toy in front of the baby to make her laugh.
examples.zh: 他在寶寶面前晃動玩具，逗她笑。

examples.en: The small inn served as a haven for weary travelers.
examples.zh: 這家小旅館成了疲憊旅人的避風港。

examples.en: They found a quiet haven away from the noisy city.
examples.zh: 他們找到了一個遠離喧囂城市的寧靜避難所。

examples.en: The company planted trees to offset its carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 該公司種樹以抵消其碳排放。

examples.en: Higher fuel costs were offset by savings in other areas.
examples.zh: 較高的燃料成本被其他方面的節省所抵消。

examples.en: The vicar greeted the congregation after the Sunday service.
examples.zh: 教區牧師在週日禮拜後問候會眾。

examples.en: She asked the vicar to help organize the charity event.
examples.zh: 她請教區牧師協助籌辦慈善活動。

examples.en: The two departments have competing goals that often conflict.
examples.zh: 這兩個部門有著相互矛盾的目標，經常發生衝突。

examples.en: We need to balance competing demands for limited resources.
examples.zh: 我們需要在有限資源下平衡相互競爭的需求。

examples.en: Poor drainage caused water to pool in the garden.
examples.zh: 排水不良導致花園積水。

examples.en: The city improved its drainage system to prevent flooding.
examples.zh: 市政府改善了排水系統以防止淹水。

examples.en: The gloom of the cave made it hard to see.
examples.zh: 洞穴的幽暗讓人難以看清。

examples.en: A sense of gloom settled over the office after the bad news.
examples.zh: 壞消息傳來後，辦公室籠罩著一股憂鬱的氣氛。

examples.en: The doctor gave him medicine to stabilize his blood pressure.
examples.zh: 醫生給他藥以穩定血壓。

examples.en: The economy began to stabilize after months of uncertainty.
examples.zh: 經濟在數月的不確定後開始穩定下來。

examples.en: She bought a litre of milk at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 她在超市買了一公升牛奶。

examples.en: The car's engine uses about a litre of oil per month.
examples.zh: 這輛車的引擎每月大約使用一公升機油。

examples.en: The wrestler applied a nelson to pin his opponent.
examples.zh: 摔跤選手使出肩下握頸來壓制對手。

examples.en: He escaped from the nelson with a quick twist.
examples.zh: 他快速一扭，掙脫了肩下握頸。

examples.en: The guild of local artisans holds an annual craft fair.
examples.zh: 當地工匠的同業公會每年舉辦手工藝博覽會。

examples.en: She joined a writers' guild to connect with other authors.
examples.zh: 她加入作家協會，以便與其他作家交流。

examples.en: The preacher delivered a powerful sermon on forgiveness.
examples.zh: 傳道士發表了一篇關於寬恕的強而有力的講道。

examples.en: A street preacher was shouting verses from the Bible.
examples.zh: 一位街頭傳教士正大聲朗讀聖經經文。

examples.en: The catering for the wedding was handled by a local company.
examples.zh: 婚禮的餐飲由當地一家公司承辦。

examples.en: She works in catering and often prepares meals for large events.
examples.zh: 她從事餐飲業，經常為大型活動準備餐點。

examples.en: The plantation produces coffee and bananas for export.
examples.zh: 這座種植園生產咖啡和香蕉以供出口。

examples.en: Workers on the tea plantation start picking early in the morning.
examples.zh: 茶園的工人一大早就開始採摘。

examples.en: Blackpool is a popular seaside resort in England.
examples.zh: 黑潭是英格蘭受歡迎的海濱度假勝地。

examples.en: They spent the weekend in Blackpool enjoying the beach.
examples.zh: 他們在黑潭度過週末，享受海灘。

examples.en: The movie's ending was so predictable that I lost interest.
examples.zh: 這部電影的結局太容易預料，讓我失去興趣。

examples.en: His predictable routine makes it easy to know where he is.
examples.zh: 他一成不變的作息讓人很容易知道他在哪裡。

examples.en: The residue of the coffee left a dark ring in the cup.
examples.zh: 咖啡的殘渣在杯裡留下一個深色圓環。

examples.en: Chemists analyzed the residue to identify the substance.
examples.zh: 化學家分析殘留物以鑑定該物質。

examples.en: The manipulation of public opinion through false news is dangerous.
examples.zh: 透過假新聞操縱輿論是危險的。

examples.en: His skillful manipulation of the puppet amazed the children.
examples.zh: 他巧妙地操作木偶讓孩子們驚嘆。

examples.en: She is a strong proponent of renewable energy.
examples.zh: 她是再生能源的強力支持者。

examples.en: Proponents of the new policy argue that it will save money.
examples.zh: 新政策的支持者主張它將節省金錢。

examples.en: The school posted a bulletin about the upcoming science fair.
examples.zh: 學校張貼了一則關於即將到來的科學展覽的公告。

examples.en: A news bulletin interrupted the regular broadcast to report the storm warning.
examples.zh: 一則新聞快報中斷了正常廣播，報導風暴警告。

examples.en: The court questioned the legitimacy of the contract signed under pressure.
examples.zh: 法院質疑在壓力下簽署的合約的合法性。

examples.en: Elected officials must constantly prove the legitimacy of their decisions to the public.
examples.zh: 民選官員必須不斷向公眾證明其決策的正當性。

examples.en: The train carries freight across the country every night.
examples.zh: 這列火車每晚載運貨物穿越全國。

examples.en: We paid extra freight to have the package delivered by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們支付了額外的運費，讓包裹在週五前送達。

examples.en: Culturally, the two cities share many traditions despite their distance.
examples.zh: 在文化上，這兩座城市儘管相距遙遠，卻有許多共同傳統。

examples.en: The festival is culturally significant to the indigenous people.
examples.zh: 這個節慶對原住民具有文化意義。

examples.en: The judge issued an injunction to stop the construction immediately.
examples.zh: 法官發布禁令，立即停止施工。

examples.en: She ignored her doctor's injunction to rest and went back to work.
examples.zh: 她忽視醫生要她休息的囑咐，又回去工作了。

examples.en: The reconciliation between the two families finally brought peace to the village.
examples.zh: 兩個家庭之間的和解終於為村莊帶來了和平。

examples.en: Monthly reconciliation of the bank statement helps catch errors early.
examples.zh: 每月對帳銀行對帳單有助於及早發現錯誤。

examples.en: Hearing impairment can affect a child's language development.
examples.zh: 聽力損傷可能影響兒童的語言發展。

examples.en: The accident caused a slight impairment of his vision.
examples.zh: 那場事故造成他視力輕微受損。

examples.en: Only the manager can authorise overtime work on weekends.
examples.zh: 只有經理可以授權週末加班。

examples.en: The committee authorised the release of the funds last week.
examples.zh: 委員會上週批准了這筆資金的發放。

examples.en: She plugged the charger into the socket on the wall.
examples.zh: 她把充電器插進牆上的插座。

examples.en: The dentist examined the socket where the tooth had been removed.
examples.zh: 牙醫檢查了拔牙後的齒槽。

examples.en: The old brewery now offers tours and beer tastings.
examples.zh: 這座老釀酒廠現在提供導覽和啤酒品嚐。

examples.en: They built a new brewery near the river to use the fresh water.
examples.zh: 他們在河邊建了一座新啤酒廠，以使用淡水。

examples.en: The telecom industry has grown rapidly with the rise of mobile phones.
examples.zh: 隨著手機的普及，電信產業迅速成長。

examples.en: She works for a telecom company that provides internet services.
examples.zh: 她在一家提供網路服務的電信公司工作。

examples.en: The knight wore heavy armor into battle.
examples.zh: 騎士穿著沉重的盔甲上戰場。

examples.en: Tanks are protected by thick armor against enemy fire.
examples.zh: 坦克有厚裝甲保護，抵禦敵方炮火。

examples.en: The wetland is home to many rare birds and plants.
examples.zh: 這片濕地是許多稀有鳥類和植物的家園。

examples.en: Developers were not allowed to build on the protected wetland.
examples.zh: 開發商不得在受保護的濕地上建造。

examples.en: The governing body of the sport met to discuss rule changes.
examples.zh: 該運動的管理機構開會討論規則變更。

examples.en: Good governing requires transparency and accountability.
examples.zh: 良好的治理需要透明和問責。

examples.en: The Reverend led the congregation in prayer.
examples.zh: 牧師帶領會眾祈禱。

examples.en: She was ordained as a reverend last year.
examples.zh: 她去年被任命為牧師。

examples.en: The school counsellor helped students deal with stress.
examples.zh: 學校輔導員幫助學生應對壓力。

examples.en: He works as a counsellor at a summer camp.
examples.zh: 他在夏令營擔任輔導員。

examples.en: The ministerial meeting will focus on trade agreements.
examples.zh: 部長級會議將聚焦於貿易協定。

examples.en: She holds a ministerial position in the government.
examples.zh: 她在政府中擔任部長職位。

examples.en: The dress has a feminine cut that many women prefer.
examples.zh: 這件洋裝有許多女性偏好的女性化剪裁。

examples.en: In French, nouns are either masculine or feminine.
examples.zh: 在法語中，名詞分為陽性或陰性。

examples.en: The absorption of nutrients occurs mainly in the small intestine.
examples.zh: 營養的吸收主要發生在小腸。

examples.en: His absorption in the book made him forget the time.
examples.zh: 他專心看書，忘了時間。

examples.en: Governmental agencies are responsible for enforcing the new law.
examples.zh: 政府機構負責執行新法律。

examples.en: The report examines governmental spending on education.
examples.zh: 該報告檢視政府在教育上的支出。

examples.en: The setup for the experiment took longer than expected.
examples.zh: 實驗的設定比預期花了更久的時間。

examples.en: They accused him of being part of a setup to steal company secrets.
examples.zh: 他們指控他參與一場竊取公司機密的陷害。

examples.en: The school hired a specialist to address behavioural issues in the classroom.
examples.zh: 學校聘請了一位專家來處理教室裡的行為問題。

examples.en: Researchers are studying the behavioural patterns of wild birds.
examples.zh: 研究人員正在研究野生鳥類的行為模式。

examples.en: The cleanup after the festival took the whole morning.
examples.zh: 節慶結束後的清掃工作花了整個上午。

examples.en: He made a huge cleanup by selling his old comic collection.
examples.zh: 他賣掉舊漫畫收藏賺了一大筆暴利。

examples.en: The organisational structure of the company changed after the merger.
examples.zh: 公司在合併後組織結構發生了變化。

examples.en: She has strong organisational skills and can manage multiple projects.
examples.zh: 她有很強的組織能力，可以管理多個專案。

examples.en: The geological survey revealed rich mineral deposits in the area.
examples.zh: 地質調查顯示該地區有豐富的礦藏。

examples.en: Scientists studied the geological history of the canyon.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了這座峽谷的地質歷史。

examples.en: The plane taxied slowly along the runway before takeoff.
examples.zh: 飛機在起飛前沿著跑道慢慢滑行。

examples.en: Models walked down the runway in the latest designer gowns.
examples.zh: 模特兒穿著最新設計的禮服走在伸展台上。

examples.en: The company announced a major restructuring to cut costs.
examples.zh: 公司宣布進行大規模重組以削減成本。

examples.en: Restructuring the database improved its performance significantly.
examples.zh: 重構資料庫大幅提升了它的效能。

examples.en: The theorist proposed a new model to explain social behavior.
examples.zh: 這位理論家提出了一個新模型來解釋社會行為。

examples.en: As a political theorist, she wrote extensively on democracy.
examples.zh: 作為一位政治理論家，她寫了大量關於民主的著作。

examples.en: The jockey rode the horse to victory in the final race.
examples.zh: 賽馬騎師在最後一場比賽中騎馬獲勝。

examples.en: Politicians often jockey for position before an election.
examples.zh: 政治人物常在選舉前爭奪有利位置。

examples.en: The lake's water was so transparent that we could see the fish.
examples.zh: 湖水清澈透明，我們可以看到魚。

examples.en: The government promised to be transparent about its spending.
examples.zh: 政府承諾對其支出保持透明。

examples.en: The ball rebounded off the backboard and into the net.
examples.zh: 球從籃板彈回並落入網中。
