examples.en: Her immaculate white dress stood out at the party.
examples.zh: 她那件潔白無瑕的洋裝在派對上十分顯眼。

examples.en: The police uncovered an illicit trade in stolen goods.
examples.zh: 警方揭發了一起贓物非法交易。

examples.en: They were arrested for illicit drug possession.
examples.zh: 他們因非法持有毒品而被捕。

examples.en: The argument caused a deep rift between the two friends.
examples.zh: 那場爭吵導致兩位朋友之間產生嚴重的裂痕。

examples.en: A narrow rift in the rock allowed a thin beam of light to enter.
examples.zh: 岩石中一道狹窄的裂縫讓一束光線透進來。

examples.en: They used a makeshift table made from old boxes for the picnic.
examples.zh: 他們用舊箱子拼成臨時桌子來野餐。

examples.en: The refugees built makeshift shelters out of plastic sheets.
examples.zh: 難民用塑膠布搭建臨時避難所。

examples.en: Only a few officials were privy to the secret negotiations.
examples.zh: 只有少數官員知悉那場秘密談判。

examples.en: The old house had a privy in the backyard.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子在後院有個廁所。

examples.en: We must consider every facet of the problem before deciding.
examples.zh: 我們必須在決定前考慮問題的每個層面。

examples.en: The diamond's facets sparkled under the bright light.
examples.zh: 鑽石的刻面在強光下閃閃發光。

examples.en: The company denied any wrongdoing in the accounting scandal.
examples.zh: 該公司否認在會計醜聞中有任何不法行為。

examples.en: She was determined to expose the wrongdoing of her boss.
examples.zh: 她決心揭發老闆的壞事。

examples.en: The team thrashed their opponents by five goals.
examples.zh: 那支球隊以五球大勝對手。

examples.en: The fish thrashed wildly in the net.
examples.zh: 那條魚在網中猛烈扭動。

examples.en: As a skeptic, he demanded evidence before believing the claim.
examples.zh: 作為一個懷疑者，他在相信那個說法之前要求證據。

examples.en: The scientist was a skeptic about the new theory until she saw the data.
examples.zh: 那位科學家對新理論持懷疑態度，直到她看到數據。

examples.en: The agency conducted covert operations to gather intelligence.
examples.zh: 該機構進行秘密行動以收集情報。

examples.en: They exchanged covert glances during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他們在會議中偷偷交換眼神。

examples.en: The police managed to disarm the suspect without firing a shot.
examples.zh: 警方未發一槍就設法解除了嫌犯的武裝。

examples.en: Her friendly smile helped disarm the tense atmosphere.
examples.zh: 她友好的微笑有助於緩和緊張的氣氛。

examples.en: She implicitly trusted her doctor's advice.
examples.zh: 她完全信任醫生的建議。

examples.en: The contract implicitly requires both parties to act in good faith.
examples.zh: 該合約隱含要求雙方誠信行事。

examples.en: He likes to fiddle with his guitar in his free time.
examples.zh: 他閒暇時喜歡拉小提琴。

examples.en: Stop fiddling with your pen and pay attention.
examples.zh: 別再撥弄你的筆了，專心一點。

examples.en: The disease is hereditary, so she gets tested regularly.
examples.zh: 這種疾病是遺傳性的，所以她定期接受檢查。

examples.en: The title was hereditary and passed to the eldest son.
examples.zh: 這個爵位是世襲的，傳給長子。

examples.en: The young challenger defeated the reigning champion in straight sets.
examples.zh: 年輕的挑戰者直落三盤擊敗了衛冕冠軍。

examples.en: Every challenger must submit a proposal by Friday.
examples.zh: 每位挑戰者都必須在週五前提交提案。

examples.en: She announced her candidacy for mayor last week.
examples.zh: 她上週宣布競選市長。

examples.en: His candidacy was supported by several local groups.
examples.zh: 他的候選資格得到了幾個當地團體的支持。

examples.en: The officer carried a handgun in a holster on his belt.
examples.zh: 那名警官腰帶上的槍套裡攜帶一把手槍。

examples.en: It is illegal to carry a handgun without a permit.
examples.zh: 無許可證攜帶手槍是違法的。

examples.en: Driving in such heavy fog is suicidal.
examples.zh: 在這麼濃的霧中開車是自殺行為。

examples.en: She felt suicidal after the loss of her job.
examples.zh: 她在失業後感到有自殺傾向。

examples.en: The bakery offers a wide assortment of pastries.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店提供各式各樣的糕點。

examples.en: He arranged an assortment of chocolates in the box.
examples.zh: 他在盒子裡排列了各種巧克力。

examples.en: Heavy traffic impeded our progress to the airport.
examples.zh: 繁忙的交通阻礙了我們前往機場的進度。

examples.en: Lack of funding may impede the research project.
examples.zh: 缺乏資金可能會妨礙這個研究計畫。

examples.en: She winced when the doctor cleaned the wound.
examples.zh: 醫生清理傷口時，她痛得皺起臉。

examples.en: He winced at the memory of his embarrassing mistake.
examples.zh: 一想到自己尷尬的錯誤，他就畏縮了一下。

examples.en: The company has stringent rules about workplace safety.
examples.zh: 公司對工作場所安全有嚴格的規定。

examples.en: Stringent testing is required before the drug is released.
examples.zh: 藥物上市前需要經過嚴格的測試。

examples.en: She excelled in both collegiate and professional sports.
examples.zh: 她在學院和職業運動中都表現出色。

examples.en: The collegiate atmosphere made him feel at home.
examples.zh: 大學的氛圍讓他感到自在。

examples.en: The charity provides food and clothing to needy families.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構提供食物和衣物給貧困家庭。

examples.en: He became very needy after his parents divorced.
examples.zh: 父母離婚後，他變得非常需要關愛。

examples.en: The first baseman caught the ball for the final out.
examples.zh: 一壘手接到球，拿下最後一個出局數。

examples.en: He dreams of becoming a professional baseman.
examples.zh: 他夢想成為職業壘手。

examples.en: The large corporation felt cold and impersonal to new employees.
examples.zh: 這家大公司對新員工來說感覺冷淡且沒有人情味。

examples.en: His impersonal remarks made her feel unimportant.
examples.zh: 他客觀冷淡的評論讓她覺得自己不重要。

examples.en: Scientists hypothesize that the virus originated in animals.
examples.zh: 科學家假設這種病毒源自動物。

examples.en: Can we hypothesize a link between the two events?
examples.zh: 我們能假設這兩個事件之間有關聯嗎？

examples.en: She is an outspoken critic of the new policy.
examples.zh: 她是這項新政策的直言批評者。

examples.en: His outspoken comments often get him into trouble.
examples.zh: 他坦率的評論常常給他帶來麻煩。

examples.en: The bewildered tourists couldn't find their way back to the hotel.
examples.zh: 困惑的遊客找不到回飯店的路。

examples.en: She looked bewildered by the complicated instructions.
examples.zh: 她對複雜的指示顯得不知所措。

examples.en: The city spends millions cleaning graffiti off public walls.
examples.zh: 市政府花費數百萬清理公共牆壁上的塗鴉。

examples.en: Someone sprayed graffiti on the side of the building.
examples.zh: 有人在建築物側面噴了塗鴉。

examples.en: The movie's plot was full of cliches.
examples.zh: 這部電影的情節充滿了陳腔濫調。

examples.en: Saying 'time heals all wounds' is a cliche.
examples.zh: 說「時間能治癒一切傷口」是陳腔濫調。

examples.en: Her voice faltered as she talked about the accident.
examples.zh: 她談到那場意外時聲音顫抖。

examples.en: The economy began to falter after the crisis.
examples.zh: 危機過後，經濟開始衰退。

examples.en: The barren land could not support any crops.
examples.zh: 這片貧瘠的土地無法種植任何作物。

examples.en: The couple struggled with the pain of a barren marriage.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻為沒有子女的婚姻痛苦掙扎。

examples.en: The door squeaked because the hinge needed oil.
examples.zh: 門發出嘎吱聲，因為鉸鏈需要上油。

examples.en: The success of the project hinges on your support.
examples.zh: 這個計畫的成功取決於你的支持。

examples.en: To her annoyance, the train was delayed again.
examples.zh: 令她煩惱的是，火車又誤點了。

examples.en: He couldn't hide his annoyance at the constant noise.
examples.zh: 他無法掩飾對持續噪音的厭煩。

examples.en: The hospital sent a billing statement for the surgery.
examples.zh: 醫院寄來了手術的帳單。

examples.en: She handles billing and payments for the clinic.
examples.zh: 她負責診所的帳單和付款事宜。

examples.en: The rector of the parish welcomed the new members after the Sunday service.
examples.zh: 教區長在週日禮拜後歡迎新成員。

examples.en: As university rector, she focused on improving student welfare and campus facilities.
examples.zh: 作為大學校長，她專注於改善學生福利和校園設施。

examples.en: The charity provides free tutoring to disadvantaged children in the community.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構為社區中弱勢兒童提供免費輔導。

examples.en: Growing up in a disadvantaged neighborhood, he learned to appreciate small opportunities.
examples.zh: 在弱勢社區長大，他學會珍惜小小的機會。

examples.en: The old aristocracy still holds considerable influence in some European countries.
examples.zh: 舊貴族在某些歐洲國家仍具有相當大的影響力。

examples.en: She believed that a natural aristocracy of talent should lead society.
examples.zh: 她相信應由才能出眾的自然貴族來領導社會。

examples.en: The resurrection of the old theater brought new life to the downtown area.
examples.zh: 老劇院的復興為市中心帶來了新生命。

examples.en: Many fans hoped for the resurrection of the band after a decade of silence.
examples.zh: 許多粉絲希望樂團在沉寂十年後能復出。

examples.en: The purport of his speech was that education should be accessible to all.
examples.zh: 他演講的要旨是教育應該普及。

examples.en: The document purports to reveal the true cause of the accident.
examples.zh: 該文件聲稱要揭露事故的真正原因。

examples.en: It is the manager's prerogative to decide who attends the meeting.
examples.zh: 決定誰參加會議是經理的特權。

examples.en: Changing the company's policy is not your prerogative without approval.
examples.zh: 未經批准，改變公司政策不是你的職權。

examples.en: The Presbyterian church on the corner is known for its community outreach.
examples.zh: 轉角處的長老教會以社區外展聞名。

examples.en: As a devout Presbyterian, he attends services every Sunday.
examples.zh: 作為虔誠的長老教友，他每週日都參加禮拜。

examples.en: The company spokesperson declined to comment on the recent rumors.
examples.zh: 公司發言人拒絕評論最近的謠言。

examples.en: We need a spokesperson to represent our group at the press conference.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位發言人在記者會上代表我們的團體。

examples.en: After work, they often gathered at the local tavern for a drink.
examples.zh: 下班後，他們經常在當地酒館聚會喝一杯。

examples.en: The old tavern has been serving travelers for over a century.
examples.zh: 這家老客棧已經服務旅客超過一個世紀。

examples.en: The assassin was hired to eliminate the political leader.
examples.zh: 刺客受雇來暗殺這位政治領袖。

examples.en: Security was tightened after an assassin threatened the president.
examples.zh: 在刺客威脅總統後，安全措施更加嚴密。

examples.en: She closed the shutters to keep the afternoon sun out of the room.
examples.zh: 她關上百葉窗，擋住午後的陽光。

examples.en: The camera's shutter speed was too slow, so the photo came out blurry.
examples.zh: 相機的快門速度太慢，所以照片模糊了。

examples.en: The beech trees in the park turn a beautiful golden color in autumn.
examples.zh: 公園裡的山毛櫸在秋天變成美麗的金黃色。

examples.en: He carved his initials into the smooth bark of a beech.
examples.zh: 他在一棵山毛櫸光滑的樹皮上刻下自己名字的縮寫。

examples.en: His avoidance of the topic made everyone suspect he was hiding something.
examples.zh: 他對這個話題的迴避讓大家懷疑他在隱瞞什麼。

examples.en: Tax avoidance is legal, but tax evasion is not.
examples.zh: 避稅是合法的，但逃稅不是。

examples.en: She had an aristocratic bearing that made people treat her with respect.
examples.zh: 她有一種貴族氣派，讓人們對她肅然起敬。

examples.en: The aristocratic family owned vast lands for generations.
examples.zh: 這個貴族家庭世代擁有廣闊的土地。

examples.en: The nightly news program covers the day's major events.
examples.zh: 夜間新聞節目報導當天的主要事件。

examples.en: He takes a nightly walk around the neighborhood before bed.
examples.zh: 他每晚睡前都會在附近散步。

examples.en: The two countries signed a reciprocal agreement to reduce tariffs.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署了互惠協議以降低關稅。

examples.en: In mathematics, the reciprocal of 5 is 1/5.
examples.zh: 在數學中，5 的倒數是 1/5。

examples.en: The liberalization of trade policies boosted the country's economy.
examples.zh: 貿易政策的自由化促進了該國經濟。

examples.en: Many people welcome the liberalization of laws regarding small businesses.
examples.zh: 許多人歡迎有關小型企業法律的自由化。

examples.en: The baby refused to drink from the bottle because the nipple was too hard.
examples.zh: 嬰兒拒絕喝奶瓶，因為奶嘴太硬了。

examples.en: She carefully cleaned the nipple of the feeding bottle before each use.
examples.zh: 她每次使用前都仔細清洗奶瓶的奶嘴。

examples.en: He bought the car outright, so he didn't need a loan.
examples.zh: 他全額買下了那輛車，所以不需要貸款。

examples.en: She denied the accusation outright, leaving no room for doubt.
examples.zh: 她完全否認了指控，不留下任何疑問。

examples.en: The war caused the displacement of thousands of families.
examples.zh: 戰爭導致數千個家庭流離失所。

examples.en: The displacement of the old bridge was necessary for the new highway.
examples.zh: 為了新高速公路，舊橋的遷移是必要的。

examples.en: The old house needs new plumbing because the pipes are leaking.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子需要新的水管設備，因為管子正在漏水。

examples.en: He learned plumbing from his father and now runs his own business.
examples.zh: 他從父親那裡學到水管工的手藝，現在自己經營事業。

examples.en: The movie is a cerebral thriller that makes you think about memory.
examples.zh: 這部電影是部引人思考的驚悚片，讓你思考記憶的問題。

examples.en: A cerebral hemorrhage can be life-threatening and requires immediate medical attention.
examples.zh: 腦出血可能危及生命，需要立即的醫療照護。

examples.en: It takes time for students to assimilate all the new information.
examples.zh: 學生需要時間吸收所有新資訊。

examples.en: Immigrants often assimilate into the local culture over several years.
examples.zh: 移民通常會在幾年內融入當地文化。

examples.en: The coping on the brick wall was damaged by the storm.
examples.zh: 磚牆的壓頂被暴風雨損壞了。

examples.en: Workers replaced the coping along the top of the garden wall.
examples.zh: 工人更換了花園牆頂的壓頂。

examples.en: The crowd spontaneously burst into applause after the performance.
examples.zh: 表演結束後，群眾自發地爆出掌聲。

examples.en: Sometimes the best ideas come spontaneously during a casual conversation.
examples.zh: 有時候最好的點子是在閒聊中自然產生的。

examples.en: A thin trickle of water ran down the side of the glass.
examples.zh: 一道細細的水流沿著玻璃杯的側面流下。

examples.en: After the storm, water trickled slowly from the roof.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，水從屋頂慢慢滴流下來。

examples.en: The armoured vehicle was designed to protect soldiers in combat.
examples.zh: 這輛裝甲車的設計是為了在戰鬥中保護士兵。

examples.en: Some animals, like armadillos, are naturally armoured against predators.
examples.zh: 有些動物，例如犰狳，天生就有裝甲抵禦掠食者。

examples.en: Interest will accrue on your savings account every month.
examples.zh: 你的儲蓄帳戶每個月都會產生利息。

examples.en: Benefits accrue to those who consistently work hard.
examples.zh: 好處會累積給那些持續努力的人。

examples.en: The suppression of free speech is a serious concern in many countries.
examples.zh: 言論自由的壓制在許多國家是個嚴重的問題。

examples.en: He struggled with the suppression of his emotions during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議中努力壓抑自己的情緒。

examples.en: These flowers are perennials that bloom every spring.
examples.zh: 這些花是多年生植物，每年春天都會開花。

examples.en: Traffic congestion is a perennial problem in big cities.
examples.zh: 交通壅塞是大城市長期存在的問題。

examples.en: It is a presumption that everyone wants to be famous.
examples.zh: 每個人都想出名是一種假定。

examples.en: His presumption in taking the best seat annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他擅自佔據最好的座位，讓大家都很不高興。

examples.en: Regular exercise and a healthy diet contribute to longevity.
examples.zh: 規律運動和健康飲食有助於長壽。

examples.en: The longevity of this product is due to its high-quality materials.
examples.zh: 這項產品的使用壽命長，是因為材料品質高。

examples.en: The police must act in a lawful manner at all times.
examples.zh: 警察在任何時候都必須依法行事。

examples.en: It is lawful to protest peacefully in most democracies.
examples.zh: 在大多數民主國家，和平抗議是合法的。

examples.en: The dog handler trained the puppy to follow basic commands.
examples.zh: 訓犬師訓練小狗遵循基本指令。

examples.en: As a baggage handler, he loads and unloads luggage at the airport.
examples.zh: 作為行李搬運工，他在機場裝卸行李。

examples.en: Many old computer programs have become obsolete and are no longer supported.
examples.zh: 許多舊的電腦程式已經過時，不再被支援。

examples.en: The invention of the smartphone made many devices obsolete.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的發明讓許多裝置被淘汰。

examples.en: The regent ruled the country until the young prince came of age.
examples.zh: 攝政王統治國家，直到年輕王子成年。

examples.en: She served as a regent on the university board for ten years.
examples.zh: 她在大學董事會擔任董事十年。

examples.en: The issue of gun control is highly contentious in the United States.
examples.zh: 槍枝管制的議題在美國極具爭議。

examples.en: He has a contentious personality and often argues with his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他個性好爭吵，經常與同事爭論。

examples.en: The greatness of the ancient civilization is still visible in its ruins.
examples.zh: 這個古文明的偉大仍可在其遺跡中看見。

examples.en: She achieved greatness in her field through years of dedication.
examples.zh: 她透過多年的奉獻，在她的領域中達到偉大成就。

examples.en: A civilised society treats all its members with respect and dignity.
examples.zh: 文明的社會以尊重和尊嚴對待所有成員。

examples.en: The debate was conducted in a civilised manner, without personal attacks.
examples.zh: 這場辯論以文明的方式進行，沒有人身攻擊。

examples.en: She finds the debate intellectually stimulating.
examples.zh: 她覺得這場辯論在智性上很有啟發性。

examples.en: Intellectually, the problem is easy, but emotionally it's hard.
examples.zh: 理智上，這個問題很簡單，但情感上卻很難。

examples.en: The movie mogul owns several production companies.
examples.zh: 這位電影大亨擁有幾家製作公司。

examples.en: She became a fashion mogul after launching her own brand.
examples.zh: 她創立自己的品牌後成為時尚界大人物。

examples.en: The baby began to wail when her toy was taken away.
examples.zh: 當玩具被拿走時，嬰兒開始嚎啕大哭。

examples.en: We could hear the wail of sirens in the distance.
examples.zh: 我們可以聽到遠處警笛的呼嘯聲。

examples.en: The watcher stood quietly at the corner of the street.
examples.zh: 守望者靜靜地站在街角。

examples.en: As a bird watcher, he spends hours in the forest.
examples.zh: 作為一名賞鳥者，他在森林裡待上好幾個小時。

examples.en: The sequel to the popular novel was released last month.
examples.zh: 那本暢銷小說的續集上個月出版了。

examples.en: There was an unfortunate sequel to their argument.
examples.zh: 他們的爭吵有一個不幸的後果。

examples.en: The hikers found a cache of food hidden under the rocks.
examples.zh: 登山者在岩石下發現了一個藏有食物的隱藏處。

examples.en: Clearing the cache can help speed up your computer.
examples.zh: 清除快取可以幫助加快電腦速度。

examples.en: A tramp was sleeping on the park bench.
examples.zh: 一個流浪漢睡在公園的長椅上。

examples.en: We tramped through the muddy fields for hours.
examples.zh: 我們在泥濘的田野裡跋涉了好幾個小時。

examples.en: The receptionist greeted us with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 接待員以溫暖的微笑迎接我們。

examples.en: Please ask the receptionist for the meeting room key.
examples.zh: 請向接待員索取會議室的鑰匙。

examples.en: She acted as a surrogate mother for her sister.
examples.zh: 她為她的妹妹擔任代理孕母。

examples.en: The manager sent a surrogate to attend the conference.
examples.zh: 經理派了一位代理人去參加會議。

examples.en: It is difficult to quantify the impact of the new policy.
examples.zh: 很難量化新政策的影響。

examples.en: Can you quantify the amount of time you spend on social media?
examples.zh: 你能量化你花在社群媒體上的時間嗎？

examples.en: The ship docked at the quay early in the morning.
examples.zh: 船在清晨停靠在碼頭。

examples.en: We walked along the quay and watched the boats.
examples.zh: 我們沿著碼頭散步，看著船隻。

examples.en: The company holds a yearly meeting for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司每年為所有員工舉行一次會議。

examples.en: She visits her grandparents yearly during the summer.
examples.zh: 她每年夏天都會去看望她的祖父母。

examples.en: He wore a tweed jacket to the interview.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件花呢夾克去面試。

examples.en: Tweed is a warm fabric often used for winter coats.
examples.zh: 花呢是一種溫暖的布料，常用於冬季外套。

examples.en: The negotiating team worked late to reach an agreement.
examples.zh: 談判團隊工作到很晚才達成協議。

examples.en: She is skilled at negotiating better prices with suppliers.
examples.zh: 她擅長與供應商談判更好的價格。

examples.en: The company faced punitive damages for the lawsuit.
examples.zh: 該公司因訴訟面臨懲罰性賠償。

examples.en: Punitive measures were taken against the employees who broke the rules.
examples.zh: 對違反規定的員工採取了懲罰性措施。

examples.en: The reporters fired a barrage of questions at the mayor.
examples.zh: 記者們向市長連珠炮似地提問。

examples.en: The soldiers were caught in a barrage of artillery fire.
examples.zh: 士兵們陷入了一陣猛烈的砲火中。

examples.en: The two cultures have disparate traditions and values.
examples.zh: 這兩種文化有著截然不同的傳統和價值觀。

examples.en: The committee tried to combine disparate ideas into one plan.
examples.zh: 委員會試圖將不同的想法整合成一個計畫。

examples.en: She is known for her captivating storytelling.
examples.zh: 她以引人入勝的說故事技巧聞名。

examples.en: The festival celebrates the art of storytelling.
examples.zh: 這個節慶慶祝說故事的藝術。

examples.en: The main entree was grilled salmon with vegetables.
examples.zh: 主菜是烤鮭魚配蔬菜。

examples.en: His famous name was his entree into high society.
examples.zh: 他的名氣是他進入上流社會的入場券。

examples.en: They served chilled perry at the summer picnic.
examples.zh: 他們在夏日野餐時提供了冰鎮梨子酒。

examples.en: This perry is made from locally grown pears.
examples.zh: 這款梨子酒是用當地種植的梨子釀造的。

examples.en: She shared a funny anecdote about her first day at work.
examples.zh: 她分享了一則關於她第一天上班的趣事。

examples.en: The biography is full of amusing anecdotes about the artist's childhood.
examples.zh: 這本傳記充滿了關於這位藝術家童年的有趣軼事。

examples.en: The manager was fired for financial misconduct.
examples.zh: 那位經理因財務瀆職而被解僱。

examples.en: The referee sent the player off for violent misconduct.
examples.zh: 裁判因暴力行為不端而將該球員罰下場。

examples.en: A group of hooligans vandalized the bus stop last night.
examples.zh: 一群小流氓昨晚破壞了公車站。

examples.en: The police arrested several hooligans after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，警方逮捕了幾名流氓。

examples.en: The company reported a budget shortfall of two million dollars.
examples.zh: 該公司報告了兩百萬美元的預算不足。

examples.en: A shortfall in donations forced the charity to cancel the event.
examples.zh: 捐款不足迫使該慈善機構取消活動。

examples.en: They used plywood to board up the windows before the storm.
examples.zh: 他們在暴風雨來臨前用合板封住窗戶。

examples.en: The table is made of plywood covered with a thin veneer.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是由夾板製成，表面覆蓋著一層薄薄的飾面。

examples.en: My workload has doubled since my colleague left.
examples.zh: 自從同事離職後，我的工作量增加了一倍。

examples.en: Teachers often struggle to manage a heavy workload.
examples.zh: 教師們常常難以應付繁重的工作量。

examples.en: They sat by the hearth, telling stories late into the night.
examples.zh: 他們坐在爐邊，說故事直到深夜。

examples.en: The old cottage had a large stone hearth in the living room.
examples.zh: 那間老屋的客廳裡有一個大型的石砌爐床。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to a temporary truce during the holidays.
examples.zh: 兩國同意在假日期間暫時停戰。

examples.en: After hours of arguing, they called a truce and went to bed.
examples.zh: 爭吵了幾個小時後，他們宣布休戰並上床睡覺。

examples.en: The event was sponsored by several local businesses.
examples.zh: 該活動由幾家當地企業贊助。

examples.en: She sponsored a child's education through a charity program.
examples.zh: 她透過慈善計畫資助一名兒童的教育。

examples.en: The hospital chaplain visited patients every morning.
examples.zh: 醫院牧師每天早上探訪病人。

examples.en: He served as a military chaplain for over twenty years.
examples.zh: 他擔任軍隊牧師超過二十年。

examples.en: The store sells outdoor apparel for hiking and camping.
examples.zh: 這家店販售適合健行和露營的戶外服裝。

examples.en: She was appareled in a elegant silk gown for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 她為典禮穿上優雅的絲綢禮服。

examples.en: A heavy barge slowly moved down the river carrying coal.
examples.zh: 一艘載著煤炭的重型駁船緩緩沿河而下。

examples.en: He barged into the meeting without knocking.
examples.zh: 他沒敲門就闖進了會議。

examples.en: The composer orchestrated the piece for a full symphony.
examples.zh: 作曲家為整首交響樂團編寫了這首曲子的管絃樂。

examples.en: She orchestrated a successful marketing campaign for the new product.
examples.zh: 她為新產品精心策劃了一場成功的行銷活動。

examples.en: The students listened intently to the professor's lecture.
examples.zh: 學生們專心地聽教授講課。

examples.en: He stared intently at the chessboard, planning his next move.
examples.zh: 他專心地盯著棋盤，計劃下一步。

examples.en: The contracting parties signed the agreement yesterday.
examples.zh: 締約雙方昨天簽署了協議。

examples.en: She works for a contracting firm that builds bridges.
examples.zh: 她在一家承包橋樑工程的建築公司工作。

examples.en: He used a hone to sharpen the kitchen knife.
examples.zh: 他用磨刀石來磨利廚房刀具。

examples.en: She practices the piano daily to hone her skills.
examples.zh: 她每天練習鋼琴以磨練技巧。

examples.en: The baby's baptism will be held at the local church next Sunday.
examples.zh: 寶寶的洗禮將於下週日在當地教堂舉行。

examples.en: Her baptism marked the beginning of her Christian journey.
examples.zh: 她的洗禮標誌著她基督教信仰旅程的開始。

examples.en: The contract and any amendments thereof must be in writing.
examples.zh: 合約及其任何修正條款都必須以書面形式為之。

examples.en: He was accused of theft and found guilty thereof.
examples.zh: 他被指控盜竊，並因此被判有罪。

examples.en: Traffic congestion in the city center is worst during rush hour.
examples.zh: 市中心的交通擁擠在尖峰時段最為嚴重。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medicine to relieve nasal congestion.
examples.zh: 醫生開了藥來緩解鼻塞。

examples.en: The survey results are indicative of a growing trend.
examples.zh: 調查結果顯示了一個日益增長的趨勢。

examples.en: In English, the indicative mood is used for factual statements.
examples.zh: 在英語中，直陳語氣用於陳述事實。

examples.en: Planting trees can help mitigate the effects of climate change.
examples.zh: 種樹有助於減輕氣候變遷的影響。

examples.en: The doctor gave her some medicine to mitigate the pain.
examples.zh: 醫生給她一些藥來緩和疼痛。

examples.en: Many factories rely on unskilled workers for simple tasks.
examples.zh: 許多工廠依賴不熟練的工人來做簡單的工作。

examples.en: His unskilled performance disappointed the audience.
examples.zh: 他拙劣的表演讓觀眾失望。

examples.en: The company went into liquidation after years of losses.
examples.zh: 這家公司虧損多年後進行清算。

examples.en: Liquidation of the assets will take several months.
examples.zh: 資產的清算將需要幾個月的時間。

examples.en: Scientific experimentation is essential for medical progress.
examples.zh: 科學實驗對醫學進步至關重要。

examples.en: The lab encourages experimentation with new materials.
examples.zh: 這個實驗室鼓勵對新材料進行實驗。

examples.en: She learned traditional cookery from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她從祖母那裡學到了傳統烹飪法。

examples.en: The school offers a course in basic cookery.
examples.zh: 這所學校開設基礎烹飪課程。

examples.en: From our vantage point on the hill, we could see the entire valley.
examples.zh: 從山丘上的有利位置，我們可以看到整個山谷。

examples.en: Her vantage in the negotiation gave her an advantage.
examples.zh: 她在談判中的優勢給了她有利條件。

examples.en: The old building was found to contain asbestos in its walls.
examples.zh: 這棟舊建築的牆壁被發現含有石棉。

examples.en: Workers must wear protective gear when removing asbestos.
examples.zh: 工人在移除石棉時必須穿戴防護裝備。

examples.en: After his parents left, he had to fend for himself.
examples.zh: 父母離開後，他必須自己照顧自己。

examples.en: She used a stick to fend off the stray dog.
examples.zh: 她用棍子擊退那隻流浪狗。

examples.en: His impatience grew as the train was delayed again.
examples.zh: 火車又誤點，他越來越不耐煩。

examples.en: She tapped her foot with impatience while waiting in line.
examples.zh: 她排隊時不耐煩地跺腳。

examples.en: The novel is rich in symbolism, with the river representing life's journey.
examples.zh: 這本小說充滿象徵主義，河流代表生命的旅程。

examples.en: The artist's use of symbolism made the painting open to interpretation.
examples.zh: 藝術家運用象徵手法讓這幅畫有多種解讀。

examples.en: The punter placed a bet on the underdog horse.
examples.zh: 賭客把賭注下在那匹冷門馬身上。

examples.en: As a punter, he enjoyed the thrill of gambling.
examples.zh: 作為賭博者，他享受賭博的刺激。

examples.en: The musical duo performed their latest song at the concert.
examples.zh: 這對音樂二重唱在演唱會上表演了他們的最新歌曲。

examples.en: The comedy duo had the audience laughing all night.
examples.zh: 這對喜劇搭檔讓觀眾整晚笑聲不斷。

examples.en: The author's unpublished manuscript was found in the attic.
examples.zh: 作者未發表的手稿在閣樓裡被發現。

examples.en: She cited several unpublished studies in her research.
examples.zh: 她在研究中引用了幾篇未發表的論文。

examples.en: The tribal chief wore a ceremonial mask during the ritual.
examples.zh: 部落酋長在儀式中戴著儀式面具。

examples.en: The president attended the ceremonial opening of the new library.
examples.zh: 總統出席了新圖書館的正式開幕儀式。

examples.en: They threw a lavish party to celebrate their anniversary.
examples.zh: 他們舉辦了一場盛大的派對來慶祝週年紀念。

examples.en: She lavished attention on her new puppy.
examples.zh: 她對新來的小狗傾注了大量的關愛。

examples.en: The hotel's ballroom was decorated with flowers for the wedding.
examples.zh: 飯店的舞廳為了婚禮用鮮花裝飾。

examples.en: They danced gracefully across the ballroom floor.
examples.zh: 他們在舞廳的地板上優雅地跳舞。

examples.en: She learned the art of weaving from her mother.
examples.zh: 她從母親那裡學到了編織的藝術。

examples.en: The museum displays traditional weaving techniques.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了傳統的編織技術。

examples.en: He scraped his knuckle while fixing the car.
examples.zh: 他修車時擦傷了指節。

examples.en: She knocked on the door with her knuckles.
examples.zh: 她用指節敲門。

examples.en: The country's economy is in a state of flux.
examples.zh: 這個國家的經濟處於不斷變化的狀態。

examples.en: The flux of the river varies with the seasons.
examples.zh: 河流的流量隨季節變化。

examples.en: She grew up in a small midwestern town.
examples.zh: 她在美國中西部的一個小鎮長大。

examples.en: The midwestern landscape is known for its vast cornfields.
examples.zh: 美國中西部的風景以廣闊的玉米田聞名。

examples.en: After running up the stairs, she was breathless and had to sit down.
examples.zh: 跑上樓梯後，她喘不過氣來，不得不坐下來。

examples.en: The audience watched the final performance in breathless silence.
examples.zh: 觀眾屏息凝神地觀看最後的表演。

examples.en: The editing of the manuscript took several weeks.
examples.zh: 手稿的編輯花了幾週的時間。

examples.en: She is responsible for the editing of all company reports.
examples.zh: 她負責所有公司報告的編輯工作。

examples.en: All participating students will receive a certificate.
examples.zh: 所有參與的學生都會獲得證書。

examples.en: The participating teams gathered at the stadium before the match.
examples.zh: 參賽隊伍在比賽前於體育場集合。

examples.en: The scandal discredited the politician's reputation.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞使那位政治人物的名譽受損。

examples.en: Scientists were quick to discredit the false theory.
examples.zh: 科學家們迅速駁斥了那個錯誤的理論。

examples.en: They returned to their ancestral home in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他們回到鄉間的祖厝。

examples.en: She inherited an ancestral ring from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她從祖母那裡繼承了一枚祖傳戒指。

examples.en: Copying the software without permission is a clear infringement of copyright.
examples.zh: 未經許可複製軟體明顯侵犯了著作權。

examples.en: The company was sued for patent infringement.
examples.zh: 該公司因專利侵權而被起訴。

examples.en: The Scotsman wore a traditional kilt to the festival.
examples.zh: 那位蘇格蘭人穿著傳統蘇格蘭裙參加慶典。

examples.en: A friendly Scotsman gave us directions to the castle.
examples.zh: 一位友善的蘇格蘭人告訴我們去城堡的路。

examples.en: The farmers rely on groundwater to irrigate their crops.
examples.zh: 農民依賴地下水來灌溉作物。

examples.en: Pollution has contaminated the groundwater in this area.
examples.zh: 污染已經汙染了這個地區的地下水。

examples.en: The film pays homage to classic Hollywood movies.
examples.zh: 這部電影向經典好萊塢電影致敬。

examples.en: Fans gathered to pay homage to the late singer.
examples.zh: 粉絲們聚集起來向已故歌手致敬。

examples.en: The brewing of beer requires careful control of temperature.
examples.zh: 啤酒的釀造需要小心控制溫度。

examples.en: He learned the art of brewing from his grandfather.
examples.zh: 他從祖父那裡學到了釀造的藝術。

examples.en: The viability of the project depends on securing enough funding.
examples.zh: 該專案的可行性取決於能否獲得足夠的資金。

examples.en: Researchers are studying the viability of seeds in harsh conditions.
examples.zh: 研究人員正在研究種子在惡劣條件下的生存能力。

examples.en: The farmer planted cole crops such as cabbage and kale.
examples.zh: 農民種植了甘藍和羽衣甘藍等蕓薹屬作物。

examples.en: Cole is often used as a general term for cabbage-like plants.
examples.zh: 「cole」常被用作甘藍類植物的統稱。

examples.en: The wind farm is capable of generating enough electricity for thousands of homes.
examples.zh: 這座風力發電廠能產生足夠數千戶家庭使用的電力。

examples.en: Solar panels are generating more power than ever before.
examples.zh: 太陽能板產生的電力比以往任何時候都多。

examples.en: The team conducted a feasibility study before starting the project.
examples.zh: 團隊在開始專案前進行了可行性研究。

examples.en: There are doubts about the feasibility of completing the bridge by next year.
examples.zh: 對於明年完成這座橋的可行性存有疑慮。

examples.en: Her stepfather helped her with her homework every evening.
examples.zh: 她的繼父每天晚上幫她做功課。

examples.en: He introduced his stepfather to his friends at the party.
examples.zh: 他在派對上把繼父介紹給朋友們。

examples.en: The summer blockbuster broke box office records worldwide.
examples.zh: 這部暑期強檔大片打破了全球票房紀錄。

examples.en: She wrote a blockbuster novel that sold millions of copies.
examples.zh: 她寫了一本暢銷小說，賣出了數百萬本。

examples.en: She studied piano at a famous conservatory in Paris.
examples.zh: 她在巴黎一所著名的音樂學院學習鋼琴。

examples.en: The conservatory is filled with tropical plants.
examples.zh: 溫室裡種滿了熱帶植物。

examples.en: You'll need a mixer to blend the ingredients smoothly.
examples.zh: 你需要一台攪拌機來把材料攪拌均勻。

examples.en: At the party, she was a great mixer and talked to everyone.
examples.zh: 在派對上，她很善於交際，和每個人都聊得來。

examples.en: I like to add raisins to my oatmeal for extra sweetness.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在燕麥粥裡加葡萄乾來增加甜味。

examples.en: The cookies are packed with chocolate chips and raisins.
examples.zh: 這些餅乾裡滿是巧克力豆和葡萄乾。

examples.en: The invention of the printing press was a milestone in human history.
examples.zh: 印刷機的發明是人類歷史上的一個里程碑。

examples.en: Finishing her first marathon was a personal milestone for her.
examples.zh: 完成她的第一場馬拉松對她來說是個人的里程碑。

examples.en: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the outdoor concert went ahead as planned.
examples.zh: 儘管下著大雨，戶外音樂會仍按計劃舉行。

examples.en: The team won the championship, notwithstanding the loss of their star player.
examples.zh: 儘管失去了明星球員，這支球隊還是贏得了冠軍。

examples.en: The tourism industry is booming in this coastal town.
examples.zh: 這個沿海城鎮的旅遊業正在蓬勃發展。

examples.en: His booming voice could be heard across the entire hall.
examples.zh: 他洪亮的聲音整個大廳都聽得到。

examples.en: “Never give up” has always been her motto in life.
examples.zh: 「永不放棄」一直是她的人生座右銘。

examples.en: The company's motto emphasizes quality and customer satisfaction.
examples.zh: 這家公司的箴言強調品質與顧客滿意度。

examples.en: Philips is a well-known Dutch company that makes electronics and lighting.
examples.zh: 飛利浦是一家知名的荷蘭公司，生產電子產品和照明設備。

examples.en: She bought a Philips blender for her new kitchen.
examples.zh: 她為新廚房買了一台飛利浦的果汁機。

examples.en: Switzerland has a long history of political neutrality.
examples.zh: 瑞士有悠久的政治中立歷史。

examples.en: The judge must maintain neutrality throughout the trial.
examples.zh: 法官在整個審判過程中必須保持中立。

examples.en: They spent the afternoon touring a vineyard in Napa Valley.
examples.zh: 他們花了一下午參觀納帕谷的一座葡萄園。

examples.en: The vineyard produces some of the finest wines in the region.
examples.zh: 這座葡萄園生產該地區一些最優質的葡萄酒。

examples.en: The singer's phenomenal talent attracted fans from all over the world.
examples.zh: 這位歌手非凡的才華吸引了來自世界各地的粉絲。

examples.en: Sales of the new phone were phenomenal in the first week.
examples.zh: 新手機第一週的銷售量驚人。

examples.en: Rhodes is the largest island in the Dodecanese group in Greece.
examples.zh: 羅茲島是希臘佐澤卡尼索斯群島中最大的島嶼。

examples.en: We spent our summer vacation on Rhodes, enjoying the beaches and history.
examples.zh: 我們在羅茲島度過暑假，享受海灘和歷史古蹟。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful satin dress to the wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的緞面禮服參加婚禮。

examples.en: The curtains are made of satin, giving the room an elegant look.
examples.zh: 窗簾是緞子做的，讓房間看起來很優雅。

examples.en: Farmers spread fertiliser on the fields before planting the seeds.
examples.zh: 農民在播種前將肥料撒在田裡。

examples.en: Too much fertiliser can harm the soil and nearby water sources.
examples.zh: 過多的肥料會傷害土壤和附近的水源。

examples.en: The hikers got lost on the vast moorland in heavy fog.
examples.zh: 健行者在濃霧中於廣闊的高沼地迷路了。

examples.en: Sheep graze freely on the moorland during the summer months.
examples.zh: 夏季時羊群在高沼地上自由吃草。

examples.en: The boxer clinched his opponent to avoid further punches.
examples.zh: 拳擊手緊抱住對手以避免更多攻擊。

examples.en: The final goal clinched the victory for the home team.
examples.zh: 最後一個進球為地主隊鎖定了勝利。

examples.en: The glamor of Hollywood attracts many aspiring actors.
examples.zh: 好萊塢的魅力吸引了許多有抱負的演員。

examples.en: She added a touch of glamor to the party with her elegant dress.
examples.zh: 她優雅的穿著為派對增添了一絲魅力。

examples.en: The pond water was murky after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，池塘的水變得混濁。

examples.en: He didn't want to swim in the murky river.
examples.zh: 他不想在混濁的河裡游泳。

examples.en: There have been several sightings of the rare bird in this area.
examples.zh: 這個地區已經有幾次這種稀有鳥類的目擊記錄。

examples.en: The first sighting of the comet was reported by an amateur astronomer.
examples.zh: 這顆彗星的首次觀測是由一位業餘天文學家報告的。

examples.en: His conservatism made him resist any changes to the traditional procedure.
examples.zh: 他的保守主義使他抗拒對傳統程序的任何改變。

examples.en: The company's conservatism in investing saved it from major losses.
examples.zh: 該公司在投資上的保守態度使其免於重大損失。

examples.en: This soup needs a little more seasoning.
examples.zh: 這湯需要多加一點調味料。

examples.en: Salt and pepper are the most common seasonings in Western cooking.
examples.zh: 鹽和胡椒是西式烹飪中最常見的調味料。

examples.en: The assessor evaluated the property for tax purposes.
examples.zh: 估稅員為了稅務目的評估了該房產。

examples.en: An independent assessor will review the damage claims.
examples.zh: 一位獨立的評估員將審查損害賠償申請。

examples.en: The accident left him psychologically scarred for years.
examples.zh: 那場事故使他心理上留下多年的創傷。

examples.en: Children can be psychologically affected by constant criticism.
examples.zh: 孩子可能會因為不斷的批評而在心理上受到影響。

examples.en: Alcoholism is a disease that affects millions of people worldwide.
examples.zh: 酗酒是一種影響全球數百萬人的疾病。

examples.en: He sought treatment for his alcoholism after his family intervened.
examples.zh: 在家人的介入下，他尋求酗酒的治療。

examples.en: She wisely decided to save money for emergencies.
examples.zh: 她明智地決定存錢以備不時之需。

examples.en: Invest wisely, and you will see your savings grow over time.
examples.zh: 明智地投資，你將看到儲蓄隨著時間增長。

examples.en: The cold wind made the wet clothes stiffen on the line.
examples.zh: 寒風使晾在繩上的濕衣服變硬。

examples.en: Her muscles began to stiffen after the long run.
examples.zh: 長跑後她的肌肉開始變得僵硬。

examples.en: The company undercut its competitors by offering lower prices.
examples.zh: 該公司以較低的價格削價競爭，擊敗了對手。

examples.en: They undercut the tree trunk to control the direction of its fall.
examples.zh: 他們在樹幹底部切出切口，以控制樹木倒下的方向。

examples.en: The lowland areas are prone to flooding during the rainy season.
examples.zh: 低地地區在雨季容易發生水患。

examples.en: Many species of birds migrate to the lowlands in winter.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類在冬天遷徙到低地。

examples.en: After the scandal, he was shunned by his former friends.
examples.zh: 醜聞發生後，他遭到昔日朋友迴避。

examples.en: She tends to shun publicity and prefers a quiet life.
examples.zh: 她傾向於避開公眾關注，喜歡平靜的生活。

examples.en: The insertion of a new clause into the contract required both parties' approval.
examples.zh: 在合約中插入新條款需要雙方的同意。

examples.en: The magazine's insertion of advertisements increased its revenue.
examples.zh: 雜誌插入廣告增加了收入。

examples.en: The caption below the photograph explained the scene.
examples.zh: 照片下方的說明文字解釋了場景。

examples.en: She captioned the video with a funny remark.
examples.zh: 她為影片加上了有趣的標題。

examples.en: The church is famous for its baroque architecture and ornate decorations.
examples.zh: 這座教堂以其巴洛克式建築和華麗裝飾聞名。

examples.en: His writing style is often described as baroque, full of elaborate metaphors.
examples.zh: 他的寫作風格常被形容為巴洛克式，充滿精雕細琢的隱喻。

examples.en: The earthquake left a trail of devastation across the city.
examples.zh: 地震在城市中留下了一片毀壞的痕跡。

examples.en: She was overwhelmed with devastation when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 當她聽到這個消息時，感到極度的震驚和悲痛。

examples.en: The racer sped around the track at incredible speed.
examples.zh: 賽車手以驚人的速度在賽道上疾馳。

examples.en: She is a professional racer who competes in international events.
examples.zh: 她是一名參加國際賽事的職業賽車手。

examples.en: The potency of the medicine was reduced after it expired.
examples.zh: 藥物過期後效力降低了。

examples.en: The dictator's potency was challenged by the rising opposition.
examples.zh: 獨裁者的權力受到了日益高漲的反對勢力的挑戰。

examples.en: She placed the teacup on the saucer carefully.
examples.zh: 她小心地把茶杯放在茶碟上。

examples.en: The cat lapped up the milk from the saucer.
examples.zh: 貓從茶碟裡舔光了牛奶。

examples.en: The town celebrated its centenary with a grand parade.
examples.zh: 該鎮以盛大的遊行慶祝建鎮一百週年。

examples.en: A special exhibition was held to mark the centenary of the artist's birth.
examples.zh: 為了紀念這位藝術家誕辰一百週年，舉辦了一場特別展覽。

examples.en: The university offers an interdisciplinary program combining biology and computer science.
examples.zh: 這所大學提供結合生物學和電腦科學的跨學科課程。

examples.en: Interdisciplinary research often leads to innovative solutions.
examples.zh: 跨學科研究往往能帶來創新的解決方案。

examples.en: The nuclear test produced radioactive fallout that spread over a wide area.
examples.zh: 核試驗產生了放射性落塵，擴散到廣大地區。

examples.en: The political scandal had serious fallout for the entire administration.
examples.zh: 這起政治醜聞對整個政府造成了嚴重的附帶影響。

examples.en: The fisherman caught a large pike in the lake.
examples.zh: 漁夫在湖裡捕到一條大狗魚。

examples.en: The soldier carried a pike as his primary weapon.
examples.zh: 士兵攜帶長矛作為主要武器。

examples.en: The small intestine is where most nutrients are absorbed.
examples.zh: 小腸是大部分營養素被吸收的地方。

examples.en: He suffered from an intestine infection and had to stay in bed.
examples.zh: 他腸道感染，不得不臥床休息。

examples.en: The online scam tricked many people into giving away their bank details.
examples.zh: 這起網路騙局騙取了許多人的銀行資料。

examples.en: She realized it was a scam and reported it to the police.
examples.zh: 她意識到這是詐騙，於是向警方報案。

examples.en: The bridge was declared unsafe after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震後這座橋被宣布為不安全。

examples.en: Driving in heavy fog is unsafe without proper lights.
examples.zh: 在濃霧中開車而沒有適當的燈光是不安全的。

examples.en: The city is divided into several discrete neighborhoods, each with its own character.
examples.zh: 這座城市劃分為幾個各自獨立的街區，每個街區都有自己的特色。

examples.en: In mathematics, a discrete set consists of isolated points with no continuous connection.
examples.zh: 在數學中，離散集合由彼此孤立、沒有連續連接的點組成。

examples.en: The team's cohesion improved after they spent a weekend together.
examples.zh: 團隊在共度一個週末後，凝聚力提升了。

examples.en: Water molecules exhibit strong cohesion, which helps create surface tension.
examples.zh: 水分子具有很強的內聚力，這有助於形成表面張力。

examples.en: She wore a fluorescent jacket so drivers could see her at night.
examples.zh: 她穿著螢光外套，讓駕駛人在夜間能看到她。

examples.en: The office uses fluorescent lights to save energy.
examples.zh: 這間辦公室使用螢光燈來節省能源。

examples.en: They spent the afternoon playing snooker at the local club.
examples.zh: 他們下午在當地的俱樂部打司諾克。

examples.en: He tried to snooker his opponent by leaving the cue ball in a difficult position.
examples.zh: 他試圖讓對手陷入困境，把母球留在一個難以擊球的位置。

examples.en: The union hired a mediator to help resolve the dispute with management.
examples.zh: 工會聘請了一位調解人來協助解決與管理層的爭議。

examples.en: As a mediator, she listens carefully to both sides before suggesting a compromise.
examples.zh: 作為調解者，她會仔細聆聽雙方的意見，然後才提出折衷方案。

examples.en: Farmers vaccinate their cattle to protect them from anthrax.
examples.zh: 農民為牛隻接種疫苗，以保護牠們免於炭疽病。

examples.en: Anthrax can be transmitted to humans through contact with infected animals.
examples.zh: 炭疽病可透過接觸受感染的動物傳染給人類。

examples.en: The company published a report on the sustainability of its supply chain.
examples.zh: 該公司發布了一份關於其供應鏈永續性的報告。

examples.en: Environmentalists emphasize the importance of sustainability in urban planning.
examples.zh: 環保人士強調永續性在城市規劃中的重要性。

examples.en: A young lass from the village offered to guide us to the waterfall.
examples.zh: 村裡的一位年輕姑娘主動提出帶我們去瀑布。

examples.en: The old song tells the story of a lass waiting for her sailor to return.
examples.zh: 這首老歌講述一位少女等待水手歸來的故事。

examples.en: The small ethnic enclave has preserved its unique language and customs.
examples.zh: 這個少數族裔的飛地保留了其獨特的語言和習俗。

examples.en: West Berlin was once an enclave surrounded by East Germany.
examples.zh: 西柏林曾經是被東德包圍的飛地。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with leukaemia and began chemotherapy immediately.
examples.zh: 她被診斷出白血病，並立即開始化療。

examples.en: Research into leukaemia has led to improved treatments for children.
examples.zh: 對白血病的研究促成了兒童治療方法的改善。

examples.en: We plan to trek through the mountains for three days next summer.
examples.zh: 我們計劃明年夏天在山中健行三天。

examples.en: The long trek across the desert left everyone exhausted.
examples.zh: 橫越沙漠的漫長跋涉讓每個人都筋疲力盡。

examples.en: The leftist candidate promised to increase spending on public education.
examples.zh: 這位左派候選人承諾增加公共教育支出。

examples.en: As a leftist, he often criticized the government's economic policies.
examples.zh: 作為一名左派人士，他經常批評政府的經濟政策。

examples.en: Many farmers in the region rely on subsistence agriculture to feed their families.
examples.zh: 該地區的許多農民依靠自給農業來養活家人。

examples.en: The charity provides subsistence allowances to families living in poverty.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構向貧困家庭提供生活津貼。

examples.en: The old furnace in the basement broke down during the cold snap.
examples.zh: 寒流期間，地下室的老舊火爐故障了。

examples.en: Workers smelt iron ore in a huge furnace at the steel plant.
examples.zh: 工人們在鋼鐵廠的巨大熔爐中冶煉鐵礦石。

examples.en: The artist mixed natural pigments with oil to create vibrant colors.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家將天然顏料與油混合，創造出鮮豔的色彩。

examples.en: Melanin is the pigment that gives skin and hair their color.
examples.zh: 黑色素是賦予皮膚和頭髮顏色的色素。

examples.en: The author wrote a short preface explaining why she wrote the book.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一篇簡短的序言，解釋她為何寫這本書。

examples.en: He prefaced his remarks with a joke to put the audience at ease.
examples.zh: 他以一個笑話作為開場白，讓觀眾放鬆下來。

examples.en: Translators must pay attention to every nuance of meaning in the original text.
examples.zh: 譯者必須注意原文中每個意義的細微差別。

examples.en: She appreciated the nuance in his tone, which suggested he was not entirely convinced.
examples.zh: 她聽出他語氣中的細微差異，這表示他並不完全信服。

examples.en: He bought a new kitchen gadget that peels and slices apples in seconds.
examples.zh: 他買了一個新的廚房小工具，能在幾秒鐘內削皮和切片蘋果。

examples.en: Modern gadgets like smartwatches can monitor your heart rate.
examples.zh: 像智慧手錶這樣的現代小裝置可以監測你的心率。

examples.en: The actor performed a dangerous stunt for the movie's opening scene.
examples.zh: 這位演員為電影的開場戲表演了一項危險的特技。

examples.en: Lack of proper nutrition can stunt a child's growth.
examples.zh: 缺乏適當的營養會阻礙兒童的成長。

examples.en: The word "happiness" is a derivative of the adjective "happy".
examples.zh: 「happiness」這個字是形容詞「happy」的衍生字。

examples.en: Many financial derivatives are traded on global markets.
examples.zh: 許多金融衍生性商品在全球市場上交易。

examples.en: Critics liken her writing style to that of a modern poet.
examples.zh: 評論家將她的寫作風格比擬為現代詩人。

examples.en: He likened the crowded subway to a can of sardines.
examples.zh: 他把擁擠的地鐵比作一罐沙丁魚。

examples.en: Hammond is a city in Indiana known for its industrial history.
examples.zh: 哈蒙德是印第安納州的一座城市，以其工業歷史聞名。

examples.en: My cousin moved to Hammond last year for a new job.
examples.zh: 我表哥去年搬到哈蒙德，因為有新工作。

examples.en: The surname Bates appears frequently in English literature.
examples.zh: 貝茨這個姓氏在英國文學中經常出現。

examples.en: I met a friendly couple named Bates at the conference.
examples.zh: 我在會議上認識了一對姓貝茨的友善夫妻。

examples.en: The bus lurched forward suddenly, making everyone grab the handrails.
examples.zh: 公車突然向前猛衝，讓大家趕緊抓住扶手。

examples.en: He lurched from side to side as he tried to walk after the injury.
examples.zh: 受傷後他試著走路時，身體左右搖晃。

examples.en: The incorporation of new technologies into the classroom has changed teaching methods.
examples.zh: 將新科技融入課堂已經改變了教學方法。

examples.en: The company's incorporation was completed last month.
examples.zh: 該公司的註冊成立於上個月完成。

examples.en: The wings of a bird and the wings of a butterfly are analogous structures.
examples.zh: 鳥的翅膀和蝴蝶的翅膀是類似的結構。

examples.en: Her role in the team is analogous to that of a coach.
examples.zh: 她在團隊中的角色類似於教練。

examples.en: She gently rocked the baby in the rocker until he fell asleep.
examples.zh: 她輕輕地在搖椅中搖著嬰兒，直到他睡著。

examples.en: The rocker performed a loud guitar solo at the concert.
examples.zh: 那位搖滾樂手在演唱會上表演了一段響亮的吉他獨奏。

examples.en: The speed limit on this highway is 65 mph.
examples.zh: 這條高速公路的速限是每小時65英里。

examples.en: The car was traveling at 80 mph when it hit the curve.
examples.zh: 那輛車撞上彎道時正以每小時80英里的速度行駛。

examples.en: He was ostensibly studying, but he was actually watching videos.
examples.zh: 他表面上在讀書，但實際上在看影片。

examples.en: The meeting was ostensibly about budget cuts, but other issues were raised.
examples.zh: 這場會議表面上是關於預算削減，但其他問題也被提出。

examples.en: My uncle has been a bach for years and enjoys his freedom.
examples.zh: 我叔叔多年來一直單身，享受他的自由。

examples.en: They bached together in a small apartment during college.
examples.zh: 他們大學時一起在一間小公寓裡過獨身生活。

examples.en: Eating too much fatty food can be bad for your heart.
examples.zh: 吃太多油膩的食物對心臟不好。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to avoid fatty foods and exercise more.
examples.zh: 醫生建議他避免高脂肪食物並多運動。

examples.en: The president reaffirmed his commitment to environmental protection.
examples.zh: 總統重申他對環境保護的承諾。

examples.en: She reaffirmed her love for him on their anniversary.
examples.zh: 她在他們的週年紀念日重申對他的愛。

examples.en: The skinner carefully removed the fur from the animal.
examples.zh: 剝皮工人小心地從動物身上取下毛皮。

examples.en: In the past, a skinner was an important job in many communities.
examples.zh: 在過去，剝皮工人在許多社區中是一項重要的工作。

examples.en: In the 19th century, many poor families were forced into the workhouse.
examples.zh: 在19世紀，許多貧困家庭被迫進入濟貧院。

examples.en: The old workhouse has been converted into a museum.
examples.zh: 這座舊濟貧院已被改建成博物館。

examples.en: The charity gala raised thousands of dollars for the hospital.
examples.zh: 慈善晚會為醫院籌集了數千美元。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful gown to the gala.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的禮服去參加盛會。

examples.en: The orchestra played a piece by Wagner at the concert.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團在音樂會上演奏了華格納的作品。

examples.en: He is a great admirer of Wagner's operas.
examples.zh: 他非常欣賞華格納的歌劇。

examples.en: I concur with your assessment of the situation.
examples.zh: 我同意你對情況的評估。

examples.en: The two events concurred, making it difficult to attend both.
examples.zh: 這兩個活動同時發生，讓人難以同時參加。

examples.en: The convergence of the two rivers creates a spectacular view.
examples.zh: 兩條河流的匯合創造了壯觀的景色。

examples.en: The convergence of technology and art has led to new forms of expression.
examples.zh: 科技與藝術的融合帶來了新的表達形式。

examples.en: The raider attacked the village under the cover of darkness.
examples.zh: 襲擊者在夜色掩護下攻擊了村莊。

examples.en: The corporate raider bought enough shares to control the company.
examples.zh: 這位企業狙擊手買下足夠的股份來控制公司。

examples.en: My cousin is a professional cricketer who plays for a national team.
examples.zh: 我的表哥是職業板球選手，效力於國家隊。

examples.en: The young cricketer practiced batting for hours every day.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的板球選手每天練習打擊好幾個小時。

examples.en: The weaver carefully threaded the loom before starting her work.
examples.zh: 織工在開始工作前仔細地將線穿過織布機。

examples.en: We watched a weaver bird building its intricate nest.
examples.zh: 我們看著一隻織巢鳥築起精巧的巢。

examples.en: She appointed her lawyer as a proxy to vote at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她指定她的律師作為代理人，在會議上投票。

examples.en: Shareholders may vote by proxy if they cannot attend.
examples.zh: 股東若無法出席，可以透過委託書投票。

examples.en: The doctor examined the coronary arteries for any signs of blockage.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查冠狀動脈是否有任何阻塞的跡象。

examples.en: He was hospitalized after suffering a coronary thrombosis.
examples.zh: 他因冠狀動脈血栓而住院治療。

examples.en: The baby slept peacefully in the wooden crib.
examples.zh: 嬰兒在木製的小床裡安穩地睡著。

examples.en: She used a crib to help her translate the Latin text.
examples.zh: 她使用對照譯本幫助她翻譯拉丁文。

examples.en: The wheeler repaired the wooden wheel of the old cart.
examples.zh: 車輪匠修理了舊手推車的木輪。

examples.en: As a keen wheeler, he cycles to work every day.
examples.zh: 身為熱愛騎車的人，他每天騎腳踏車上班。

examples.en: The colliery provided jobs for hundreds of local miners.
examples.zh: 這座煤礦為數百名當地礦工提供了工作機會。

examples.en: After the colliery closed, the town struggled economically.
examples.zh: 煤礦關閉後，這個城鎮的經濟陷入困境。

examples.en: Fishing is the main livelihood for many coastal villages.
examples.zh: 捕魚是許多沿海村莊的主要生計。

examples.en: The drought threatened the livelihood of local farmers.
examples.zh: 乾旱威脅了當地農民的生計。

examples.en: In the debate, the opponents outnumbered our team by three to one.
examples.zh: 在辯論中，對方人數以三比一超過我們隊。

examples.en: Female students outnumber male students in this program.
examples.zh: 在這個學程中，女學生人數多於男學生。

examples.en: The payer must sign the check before handing it over.
examples.zh: 付款人必須在支票上簽名才能交出。

examples.en: As the primary payer, she covered most of the medical bills.
examples.zh: 作為主要付款人，她支付了大部分的醫療費用。

examples.en: The breeder raised puppies and sold them to good homes.
examples.zh: 這位飼養員養育小狗並賣給好人家。

examples.en: A responsible breeder will health-test the parent dogs.
examples.zh: 負責任的飼養員會對種犬進行健康檢查。

examples.en: The island's fauna includes many rare bird species.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼的動物相包含許多稀有鳥類。

examples.en: Scientists studied the fauna of the deep ocean.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了深海的動物群。

examples.en: The building has a pentagon shape with five equal sides.
examples.zh: 這棟建築呈五邊形，有五個相等的邊。

examples.en: Officials at the Pentagon held a press conference.
examples.zh: 五角大廈的官員舉行了記者會。

examples.en: Her revealing comment accidentally disclosed the surprise party.
examples.zh: 她不經意的評論意外洩露了驚喜派對。

examples.en: The documentary was revealing about the artist's early life.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片揭露了這位藝術家的早年生活。

examples.en: I ordered a turkey sub for lunch at the deli.
examples.zh: 我在熟食店點了一個火雞潛艇堡當午餐。

examples.en: The coach put in a sub during the second half.
examples.zh: 教練在下半場換上了一名替補球員。

examples.en: The expansive lawn stretched all the way to the river.
examples.zh: 廣闊的草坪一直延伸到河邊。

examples.en: He had an expansive personality and made friends easily.
examples.zh: 他性格豪爽，很容易交到朋友。

examples.en: The mixture should be homogeneous before you pour it.
examples.zh: 在倒入之前，混合物應該是均勻的。

examples.en: The community is not homogeneous; it includes many cultures.
examples.zh: 這個社區並非同質的，它包含了許多文化。

examples.en: She found motherhood both challenging and rewarding.
examples.zh: 她覺得為人母既充滿挑戰又很有收穫。

examples.en: The book explores the joys and struggles of motherhood.
examples.zh: 這本書探討了母職的喜悅與掙扎。

examples.en: The artist inscribed his name on the bottom of the sculpture.
examples.zh: 藝術家在雕塑底部刻上了自己的名字。

examples.en: Please inscribe the book with a personal message.
examples.zh: 請在這本書上題寫一段個人的話。

examples.en: The sliding door opened smoothly as we approached.
examples.zh: 當我們走近時，滑動門平順地打開了。

examples.en: She adjusted the sliding scale to measure the weight accurately.
examples.zh: 她調整滑動標尺以準確測量重量。

examples.en: The small township has only one school and a post office.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮只有一所學校和一個郵局。

examples.en: Residents of the township gathered to discuss the new park.
examples.zh: 鎮區的居民聚集起來討論新公園的事宜。

examples.en: The program is federally funded and available to all citizens.
examples.zh: 該計畫由聯邦政府資助，所有公民均可參加。

examples.en: Federally regulated industries must follow strict safety guidelines.
examples.zh: 受聯邦政府監管的行業必須遵守嚴格的安全準則。

examples.en: The coach's speech energized the team before the final match.
examples.zh: 教練的演講在決賽前激勵了全隊。

examples.en: A good breakfast will energize you for the whole morning.
examples.zh: 一頓豐盛的早餐會讓你整個上午精力充沛。

examples.en: She gave him a gentle prod to remind him of the meeting.
examples.zh: 她輕輕戳了他一下，提醒他開會的事。

examples.en: The farmer prodded the sheep to move them into the pen.
examples.zh: 農夫用刺棒趕羊，把它們趕進圍欄。

examples.en: The project found a generous backer who funded the entire research.
examples.zh: 該項目找到了一位慷慨的贊助者，資助了整個研究。

examples.en: Without a financial backer, the startup struggled to survive.
examples.zh: 沒有財務支持者，這家新創公司難以生存。

examples.en: The friar walked from village to village preaching and helping the poor.
examples.zh: 這位修道士從一個村莊走到另一個村莊，傳道並幫助窮人。

examples.en: A kind friar offered us shelter for the night in the monastery.
examples.zh: 一位善良的修道士在修道院裡提供我們過夜的地方。

examples.en: He responded to her beck and came over immediately.
examples.zh: 他回應她的招手，立刻走了過來。

examples.en: With a slight beck of his head, he signaled for us to follow.
examples.zh: 他輕輕點頭示意，要我們跟著他。

examples.en: The judiciary must remain independent from political influence.
examples.zh: 司法部門必須保持獨立，不受政治影響。

examples.en: Reforms were proposed to strengthen the judiciary and ensure fair trials.
examples.zh: 有人提出改革方案以強化司法系統並確保公平審判。

examples.en: Her singular talent for music impressed everyone at the recital.
examples.zh: 她在音樂方面非凡的才華讓獨奏會上的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: The word 'child' is singular, but 'children' is plural.
examples.zh: 「child」這個字是單數，但「children」是複數。

examples.en: The depreciation of the currency made imported goods more expensive.
examples.zh: 貨幣貶值使得進口商品變得更貴。

examples.en: The company calculated the depreciation of its equipment over five years.
examples.zh: 公司計算了設備在五年內的折舊。

examples.en: The soldiers at the outpost kept watch for any signs of danger.
examples.zh: 前哨基地的士兵們密切注意任何危險的跡象。

examples.en: This small town is the last outpost of civilization before the desert.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮是沙漠前文明的最後一個前哨。

examples.en: She listens to motivational podcasts every morning to start her day.
examples.zh: 她每天早上聽激勵性的播客來開始一天。

examples.en: The workshop focused on motivational strategies for team leaders.
examples.zh: 該工作坊專注於團隊領導者的激勵策略。

examples.en: The committee reviewed the budgetary constraints before approving the plan.
examples.zh: 委員會在批准計畫前審查了預算限制。

examples.en: Budgetary cuts forced the department to reduce its staff.
examples.zh: 預算削減迫使該部門精簡人力。

examples.en: The devolution of power to local governments was a major reform.
examples.zh: 將權力下放給地方政府是一項重大改革。

examples.en: Some argue that devolution leads to more responsive governance.
examples.zh: 有些人認為權力下放能帶來更回應民意的治理。

examples.en: Petersburg is a city in Virginia known for its rich history.
examples.zh: 彼得斯堡是維吉尼亞州的一座城市，以其豐富的歷史聞名。

examples.en: We visited Petersburg during our trip to the East Coast.
examples.zh: 我們在東岸旅行時參觀了彼得斯堡。

examples.en: Use this template to format your report consistently.
examples.zh: 使用這個模板來一致地格式化你的報告。

examples.en: The designer created a website template that is easy to customize.
examples.zh: 設計師創建了一個易於自訂的網站模板。

examples.en: The scholar analyzed the textual differences between the two manuscripts.
examples.zh: 學者分析了兩份手稿在文本上的差異。

examples.en: Textual evidence supports the theory that the play was revised.
examples.zh: 文本證據支持這齣戲曾被修訂的理論。

examples.en: The government accused the cartel of fixing prices on essential goods.
examples.zh: 政府指控該卡特爾操縱基本商品的價格。

examples.en: Several companies formed a cartel to control the market.
examples.zh: 幾家公司組成企業聯合來控制市場。

examples.en: The relocation of the company's headquarters affected many employees.
examples.zh: 公司總部的搬遷影響了許多員工。

examples.en: They planned a smooth relocation to their new apartment.
examples.zh: 他們計劃順利搬遷到新公寓。

examples.en: The Reich was the German state from 1871 to 1945.
examples.zh: 德意志帝國是從1871年到1945年的德國國家。

examples.en: Historians often debate the legacy of the Reich.
examples.zh: 歷史學家經常爭論德意志帝國的遺產。

examples.en: She prepared a refreshing infusion of mint and lemon.
examples.zh: 她準備了清涼的薄荷檸檬浸泡飲料。

examples.en: The nurse administered an infusion of antibiotics to the patient.
examples.zh: 護士給病人注射了抗生素輸液。

examples.en: The neural pathways in the brain are incredibly complex.
examples.zh: 大腦中的神經通路極其複雜。

examples.en: Researchers are studying neural activity during sleep.
examples.zh: 研究人員正在研究睡眠期間的神經活動。

examples.en: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass for privacy.
examples.zh: 浴室的窗戶使用不透明玻璃以保護隱私。

examples.en: His explanation was so opaque that nobody understood it.
examples.zh: 他的解釋如此晦澀難懂，沒有人理解。

examples.en: After the long hike, she wearily climbed the stairs.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，她疲倦地爬上樓梯。

examples.en: He wearily agreed to work overtime again.
examples.zh: 他厭倦地同意再次加班。

examples.en: The mapping of the ocean floor took decades.
examples.zh: 海底測繪花了數十年時間。

examples.en: Gene mapping helps scientists identify inherited diseases.
examples.zh: 基因圖譜定位幫助科學家識別遺傳疾病。

examples.en: He studied optics at the university and became a lens designer.
examples.zh: 他在大學學習光學，並成為鏡片設計師。

examples.en: The optics of the new telescope are superior to the old one.
examples.zh: 新望遠鏡的光學性能優於舊的。

examples.en: The activation of the alarm system happens automatically at night.
examples.zh: 警報系統在夜間自動啟動。

examples.en: Enzyme activation is essential for digestion.
examples.zh: 酶的活化對消化至關重要。

examples.en: The emancipation of slaves was a turning point in history.
examples.zh: 奴隸的解放是歷史的轉捩點。

examples.en: She fought for the emancipation of women in her country.
examples.zh: 她為自己國家的婦女解放而奮鬥。

examples.en: He excels academically but struggles socially.
examples.zh: 他在學業上表現優異，但在社交方面有困難。

examples.en: Academically, the school is ranked among the best in the state.
examples.zh: 在學術上，這所學校被評為全州最好的學校之一。

examples.en: The peasantry formed the majority of the population in medieval times.
examples.zh: 在中世紀，農民構成了人口的大多數。

examples.en: Land reforms aimed to improve the lives of the peasantry.
examples.zh: 土地改革旨在改善農民的生活。

examples.en: Socialization helps children learn the norms of their culture.
examples.zh: 社會化幫助兒童學習其文化的規範。

examples.en: The socialization of new employees is an important part of onboarding.
examples.zh: 新員工的社會化是入職培訓的重要部分。

examples.en: She felt a sharp abdominal pain after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後她感到腹部劇痛。

examples.en: Abdominal exercises can strengthen your core muscles.
examples.zh: 腹部運動可以增強你的核心肌肉。

examples.en: The city is famously known for its delicious street food.
examples.zh: 這座城市以美味的街頭小吃聞名。

examples.en: He famously said that he would never retire.
examples.zh: 他曾著名地說他永遠不會退休。

examples.en: The study was criticized for its methodological flaws.
examples.zh: 這項研究因其方法論缺陷而受到批評。

examples.en: They discussed methodological issues in data collection.
examples.zh: 他們討論了數據收集中的方法論問題。

examples.en: The rare orchid blooms only once every few years.
examples.zh: 這種稀有的蘭花每幾年才開花一次。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful orchid corsage to the prom.
examples.zh: 她戴著美麗的蘭花胸花參加舞會。

examples.en: The company filed for insolvency after years of losses.
examples.zh: 該公司經過多年虧損後申請破產。

examples.en: Insolvency can lead to the liquidation of assets.
examples.zh: 無力償債可能導致資產清算。

examples.en: The country embraces cultural pluralism and diversity.
examples.zh: 該國擁抱文化多元主義和多樣性。

examples.en: Political pluralism is essential for a healthy democracy.
examples.zh: 政治多元主義對健康的民主至關重要。

examples.en: The mother kangaroo carries her baby in a pouch.
examples.zh: 袋鼠媽媽用育兒袋攜帶寶寶。

examples.en: He kept his coins in a small leather pouch.
examples.zh: 他把硬幣放在一個小皮革袋裡。

examples.en: The doctors described her recovery as miraculous.
examples.zh: 醫生們形容她的康復是奇蹟般的。

examples.en: It was a miraculous escape from the burning building.
examples.zh: 從燃燒的建築物中逃脫真是奇蹟。

examples.en: The suspect managed to elude the police for nearly a week.
examples.zh: 嫌犯設法逃避警方追捕將近一週。

examples.en: The exact meaning of the poem continues to elude scholars.
examples.zh: 這首詩的確切含義仍然讓學者們難以理解。

examples.en: This LED bulb uses only nine watts of power.
examples.zh: 這個 LED 燈泡只消耗九瓦的電力。

examples.en: The speaker can handle up to 100 watts of input.
examples.zh: 這台喇叭最高可承受一百瓦的輸入功率。

examples.en: Sunlight streamed through the stained glass windows into the nave.
examples.zh: 陽光透過彩繪玻璃窗灑進教堂中殿。

examples.en: The wedding guests filled the nave of the old church.
examples.zh: 婚禮賓客坐滿了這座古老教堂的中殿。

examples.en: The manager would often hector his employees into working overtime.
examples.zh: 經理經常威嚇員工加班。

examples.en: Don't hector me; I'm doing the best I can.
examples.zh: 別嚇唬我，我已經盡力了。

examples.en: Stamford is a city in southwestern Connecticut.
examples.zh: 斯坦福德是康乃狄克州西南部的一座城市。

examples.en: She grew up in Stamford before moving to New York.
examples.zh: 她在斯坦福德長大，後來搬到紐約。

examples.en: The abbot led the monks in their morning prayers.
examples.zh: 修道院院長帶領修士們進行晨禱。

examples.en: After decades of service, he was elected abbot of the monastery.
examples.zh: 服務數十年後，他被選為該修道院的院長。

examples.en: The storm caused severe erosion along the shoreline.
examples.zh: 暴風雨造成海岸線嚴重侵蝕。

examples.en: We walked along the rocky shoreline, collecting seashells.
examples.zh: 我們沿著多岩石的海岸線散步，撿拾貝殼。

examples.en: Papa always reads me a bedtime story before I go to sleep.
examples.zh: 爸爸總是在我睡覺前讀床邊故事給我聽。

examples.en: She called her father 'papa' even as an adult.
examples.zh: 她即使成年了，仍稱父親為「爸爸」。

examples.en: The course explores the aesthetics of modern architecture.
examples.zh: 這門課程探討現代建築的美學。

examples.en: His design philosophy is rooted in Japanese aesthetics.
examples.zh: 他的設計哲學根源於日本美學。

examples.en: The specificity of the instructions left no room for confusion.
examples.zh: 指示的明確性讓人沒有任何混淆的空間。

examples.en: Researchers studied the specificity of the enzyme to its substrate.
examples.zh: 研究人員研究了該酶對其受質的專一性。

examples.en: The old man grunted in response to my question.
examples.zh: 老人對我的問題咕噥了一聲作為回應。

examples.en: We heard the grunt of a wild boar in the bushes.
examples.zh: 我們聽到灌木叢中野豬的呼嚕聲。

examples.en: She bowed stiffly and left the room without a word.
examples.zh: 她僵硬地鞠了一躬，一言不發地離開了房間。

examples.en: The old door opened stiffly, as if it hadn't been used in years.
examples.zh: 那扇舊門僵硬地打開，好像多年沒用過一樣。

examples.en: The new policy is likely to engender resentment among workers.
examples.zh: 新政策可能會在員工中引起不滿。

examples.en: Trust is engendered through consistent and honest communication.
examples.zh: 信任是透過一致且誠實的溝通產生的。

examples.en: Could you lend me a fiver until tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你能借我五鎊到明天嗎？

examples.en: He paid for the coffee with a fiver and told her to keep the change.
examples.zh: 他用一張五鎊鈔票付了咖啡錢，並叫她不用找零。

examples.en: The bride and groom arrived at the reception in a white limo.
examples.zh: 新娘和新郎乘坐白色豪華轎車抵達婚宴會場。

examples.en: We hired a limo to take us to the airport.
examples.zh: 我們雇了一輛豪華轎車載我們去機場。

examples.en: She decided to major in the humanities rather than science.
examples.zh: 她決定主修人文學科而不是科學。

examples.en: The university offers a wide range of courses in the humanities.
examples.zh: 這所大學提供豐富的人文學科課程。

examples.en: The city's burgeoning tech industry has attracted many young professionals.
examples.zh: 這座城市急速增長的科技產業吸引了許多年輕專業人士。

examples.en: She has a burgeoning career as a fashion designer.
examples.zh: 她作為時裝設計師的事業正在急速發展。

examples.en: Regular exercise can help speed up your metabolism.
examples.zh: 規律運動有助於加速你的新陳代謝。

examples.en: The caterpillar's metabolism changes dramatically during metamorphosis.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲的新陳代謝在變態過程中會發生巨大變化。

examples.en: The fundamentalist refused to accept any modern interpretation of the ancient text.
examples.zh: 那位基要主義者拒絕接受對古代文本的任何現代詮釋。

examples.en: Her fundamentalist views often clashed with the more liberal ideas of her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她的基要主義觀點經常與同事們較為開明的想法衝突。

examples.en: The editor praised the writer's stylistic improvements in the revised draft.
examples.zh: 編輯稱讚作者在修訂稿中風格上的改進。

examples.en: Critics noted a stylistic shift in the director's latest film.
examples.zh: 影評人注意到這位導演最新電影在風格上的轉變。

examples.en: In the game, a score of nought meant the player had failed completely.
examples.zh: 在比賽中，零分意味著該選手完全失敗了。

examples.en: All their efforts came to nought when the funding was suddenly withdrawn.
examples.zh: 當資金突然被撤回時，他們所有的努力都化為烏有。

examples.en: She walked briskly to the station to catch the early train.
examples.zh: 她快步走向車站，以趕上早班火車。

examples.en: The waiter moved briskly between tables, taking orders efficiently.
examples.zh: 服務生在餐桌間輕快地穿梭，有效率地接受點餐。

examples.en: The publisher decided to reprint the novel after it sold out within a week.
examples.zh: 這本小說在一週內售罄後，出版商決定重新印製。

examples.en: This article is a reprint from a scientific journal published last year.
examples.zh: 這篇文章是去年發表的一份科學期刊的翻印本。

examples.en: She became hysterical when she couldn't find her passport before the flight.
examples.zh: 她在航班起飛前找不到護照時，變得歇斯底里。

examples.en: The audience burst into hysterical laughter at the comedian's joke.
examples.zh: 觀眾聽到喜劇演員的笑話後，爆發出異常興奮的大笑。

examples.en: The map includes an inset showing the city center in greater detail.
examples.zh: 這張地圖包含一個插入的小圖，更詳細地顯示市中心。

examples.en: The craftsman inset a small diamond into the ring's band.
examples.zh: 工匠將一顆小鑽石嵌入戒指的戒圈中。

examples.en: He joined a fraternity during his first year at the university.
examples.zh: 他在大學一年級時加入了一個大學生聯誼會。

examples.en: The medical fraternity gathered for an annual conference on new treatments.
examples.zh: 醫學界人士齊聚一堂，參加關於新療法的年度會議。

examples.en: She applied a touch of rouge to her cheeks before the party.
examples.zh: 她在派對前在臉頰上抹了一點胭脂。

examples.en: The actress rouged her lips carefully in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 女演員在鏡子前仔細地塗口紅。

examples.en: The old church's crypt contained the tombs of several former bishops.
examples.zh: 這座古老教堂的地下室安放著幾位前主教的墳墓。

examples.en: Visitors descended into the dark crypt to view the ancient stone carvings.
examples.zh: 遊客們走下黑暗的地穴，觀看古老的石雕。

examples.en: The richness of the soil in the valley made it ideal for farming.
examples.zh: 山谷中土壤的肥沃使其成為農耕的理想之地。

examples.en: Critics praised the richness of the novel's language and imagery.
examples.zh: 評論家稱讚這本小說語言和意象的豐富性。

examples.en: The attacker tried to strangle his victim with a scarf.
examples.zh: 攻擊者試圖用圍巾勒死他的受害者。

examples.en: The new regulations could strangle innovation in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 新法規可能會壓制科技產業的創新。

examples.en: The referee ordered a replay of the match after a technical error.
examples.zh: 裁判在技術失誤後下令重賽。

examples.en: You can replay the video to catch any details you missed.
examples.zh: 你可以重播影片，以捕捉任何你漏掉的細節。

examples.en: The pup followed its mother everywhere around the farm.
examples.zh: 這隻小狗在農場裡到處跟著它的母親。

examples.en: He felt like a mere pup among the experienced engineers.
examples.zh: 在經驗豐富的工程師當中，他覺得自己只是個新手。

examples.en: The farmer built a rick of hay near the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫在穀倉附近堆了一個草堆。

examples.en: He ricked his neck while lifting the heavy box.
examples.zh: 他在抬起重箱時扭傷了脖子。

examples.en: We ordered a shrimp appetizer to share before the main course.
examples.zh: 我們點了一份蝦子開胃菜，在主菜前一起分享。

examples.en: The chef prepared a light appetizer to stimulate the guests' appetite.
examples.zh: 主廚準備了一道清淡的開胃食品來刺激客人的食慾。

examples.en: The driver was convicted of manslaughter after the fatal accident.
examples.zh: 那名駕駛在致命事故後被判過失殺人罪。

examples.en: The court reduced the charge from murder to manslaughter.
examples.zh: 法院將指控從謀殺減輕為過失殺人。

examples.en: She wore a chic black dress to the gallery opening.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件別緻的黑色洋裝去參加畫廊開幕。

examples.en: The hotel's lobby is decorated with Parisian chic.
examples.zh: 這家飯店的大廳以巴黎式的別緻風格裝飾。

examples.en: The lineman climbed the pole to repair the downed power line.
examples.zh: 線路工人爬上電線桿，修理掉落的電線。

examples.en: The football lineman blocked the opponent's rush effectively.
examples.zh: 足球隊的線鋒有效地阻擋了對手的衝刺。

examples.en: She is very communicative and always eager to share her ideas.
examples.zh: 她非常健談，總是渴望分享她的想法。

examples.en: The workshop aimed to improve employees' communicative skills.
examples.zh: 這個工作坊旨在提升員工的溝通技巧。

examples.en: The assimilation of immigrants into the local culture often takes several generations.
examples.zh: 移民融入當地文化的同化過程往往需要好幾代人的時間。

examples.en: Proper assimilation of nutrients is essential for maintaining good health.
examples.zh: 營養素的適當吸收對於維持健康至關重要。

examples.en: The conductance of the circuit was measured as 0.5 siemens.
examples.zh: 該電路的電導測得為0.5西門子。

examples.en: One siemens is equal to the reciprocal of one ohm.
examples.zh: 一西門子等於一歐姆的倒數。

examples.en: After completing his internship, he began a residency in pediatrics.
examples.zh: 實習結束後，他開始了兒科住院醫師的訓練。

examples.en: The artist's residency at the gallery lasted for three months.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家在畫廊的駐留為期三個月。

examples.en: Scientists have made significant progress in the cloning of animals.
examples.zh: 科學家在動物複製方面已取得重大進展。

examples.en: The cloning of human cells raises many ethical questions.
examples.zh: 人類細胞的複製引發了許多倫理問題。

examples.en: The detective managed to ferret out the truth from the confusing evidence.
examples.zh: 偵探從混亂的證據中設法查出了真相。

examples.en: She keeps a ferret as a pet and takes it for walks.
examples.zh: 她養了一隻雪貂當寵物，還會帶牠去散步。

examples.en: The patient was referred to a specialist for renal failure.
examples.zh: 這位病人因腎衰竭被轉診給專科醫師。

examples.en: Renal function tests are used to assess how well the kidneys are working.
examples.zh: 腎功能檢查用於評估腎臟的運作情況。

examples.en: The theory posits that all matter is made of tiny particles.
examples.zh: 該理論假設所有物質都是由微小粒子構成的。

examples.en: He posited the existence of an unseen force to explain the phenomenon.
examples.zh: 他假設存在一種看不見的力量來解釋這個現象。

examples.en: Children develop a schema for understanding the world through their experiences.
examples.zh: 兒童透過經驗發展出理解世界的基模。

examples.en: The database schema defines how the data is organized.
examples.zh: 資料庫模式定義了資料的組織方式。

examples.en: The film crew used a dolly to create a smooth moving shot.
examples.zh: 電影工作人員使用移動車來拍攝平滑的移動鏡頭。

examples.en: She pushed the heavy box on a dolly across the warehouse.
examples.zh: 她用推車把沉重的箱子推過倉庫。

examples.en: The new manager aims to reshape the company's image.
examples.zh: 新經理旨在重塑公司的形象。

examples.en: Technology continues to reshape the way we communicate.
examples.zh: 科技持續改變我們溝通的方式。

examples.en: The oil refinery processes thousands of barrels of crude oil daily.
examples.zh: 這座煉油廠每天處理數千桶原油。

examples.en: Environmental groups protested against the expansion of the sugar refinery.
examples.zh: 環保團體抗議糖廠的擴建。

examples.en: Please bring pens, paper, notebooks, etcetera, to the meeting.
examples.zh: 請帶筆、紙、筆記本等等到會議上。

examples.en: The list included items like soap, towels, and etcetera.
examples.zh: 清單上包括肥皂、毛巾等等物品。

examples.en: Ordinarily, I take the bus to work, but today I walked.
examples.zh: 通常我搭公車上班，但今天我走路。

examples.en: The shop is ordinarily open until nine in the evening.
examples.zh: 這家店通常營業到晚上九點。

examples.en: After her friend moved away, she felt a deep sense of emptiness.
examples.zh: 朋友搬走後，她感到深深的空虛。

examples.en: The emptiness of the desert stretched out in every direction.
examples.zh: 沙漠的空曠向四面八方延伸。

examples.en: A neutron has no electric charge and is found in the nucleus.
examples.zh: 中子不帶電荷，存在於原子核中。

examples.en: The reactor uses neutrons to sustain a chain reaction.
examples.zh: 反應爐利用中子來維持連鎖反應。

examples.en: Basal leaves of the plant grow close to the ground.
examples.zh: 這種植物的基部葉片貼近地面生長。

examples.en: The basal metabolic rate measures the energy used at rest.
examples.zh: 基礎代謝率測量休息時消耗的能量。

examples.en: The platoon was ordered to advance to the next hill.
examples.zh: 這個排奉命推進到下一座山丘。

examples.en: A platoon of volunteers cleaned up the beach after the storm.
examples.zh: 一群志工在暴風雨後清理了海灘。

examples.en: The doctor recommended a less invasive procedure to reduce recovery time.
examples.zh: 醫生建議採用侵入性較低的手術，以縮短恢復時間。

examples.en: Invasive species can disrupt the balance of an ecosystem.
examples.zh: 入侵物種可能破壞生態系統的平衡。

examples.en: A neuron transmits electrical signals throughout the nervous system.
examples.zh: 神經元在整個神經系統中傳遞電訊號。

examples.en: Damage to a single neuron can affect communication in the brain.
examples.zh: 單一神經元受損可能影響大腦中的溝通。

examples.en: The government launched a crackdown on illegal street racing.
examples.zh: 政府對非法街頭賽車展開取締行動。

examples.en: After the crackdown, many unlicensed vendors disappeared from the night market.
examples.zh: 在取締之後，許多無照攤販從夜市消失了。

examples.en: The judge decided to remand the suspect in custody until the trial.
examples.zh: 法官決定將嫌犯還押候審，直到開庭。

examples.en: The appellate court remanded the case to the lower court for further review.
examples.zh: 上訴法院將案件發回下級法院進一步審理。

examples.en: The city has a racially diverse population with people from many backgrounds.
examples.zh: 這座城市的人口在種族上很多元，有來自各種背景的人。

examples.en: They were accused of racially discriminating against job applicants.
examples.zh: 他們被指控在招聘時對求職者進行種族歧視。

examples.en: The team's relegation to the second division shocked its fans.
examples.zh: 該隊被降級到乙級聯賽，讓球迷震驚。

examples.en: His relegation to a minor role in the company was seen as a demotion.
examples.zh: 他在公司被降調到次要職位，被視為降級。

examples.en: She is proud of her Cherokee heritage and often attends cultural events.
examples.zh: 她以徹羅基族血統為榮，經常參加文化活動。

examples.en: The Cherokee people have a rich history and distinct language.
examples.zh: 徹羅基族人有豐富的歷史和獨特的語言。

examples.en: The people rose up against the tyranny of the dictator.
examples.zh: 人民起義反抗獨裁者的暴政。

examples.en: They fled the country to escape political tyranny.
examples.zh: 他們逃離該國以躲避政治暴政。

examples.en: The prime minister announced a cabinet reshuffle to improve efficiency.
examples.zh: 首相宣布內閣改組以提高效率。

examples.en: After the reshuffle, several ministers were replaced by younger politicians.
examples.zh: 改組後，幾位部長被更年輕的政治人物取代。

examples.en: The mice scurried across the kitchen floor when the light turned on.
examples.zh: 燈一亮，老鼠就急忙跑過廚房地板。

examples.en: Shoppers scurried from store to store looking for last-minute gifts.
examples.zh: 購物者匆忙地從一家店趕到另一家店，尋找最後一刻的禮物。

examples.en: The police arrested a notorious gangster involved in drug trafficking.
examples.zh: 警方逮捕了一名涉及販毒的惡名昭彰歹徒。

examples.en: In the movie, the gangster tries to leave his criminal life behind.
examples.zh: 在電影中，那名歹徒試圖脫離犯罪生活。

examples.en: An assemblage of fans gathered outside the stadium to welcome the team.
examples.zh: 一群球迷聚集在體育場外歡迎球隊。

examples.en: The artist created a sculpture from an assemblage of discarded metal parts.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家用廢棄金屬零件組合創作出雕塑。

examples.en: The surgeon washed her hands and put on sterile gloves before the operation.
examples.zh: 外科醫生手術前洗手並戴上無菌手套。

examples.en: The desert landscape appeared barren and sterile.
examples.zh: 沙漠景觀顯得貧瘠而不毛。

examples.en: In some British dialects, children call their mother 'mam'.
examples.zh: 在一些英國方言中，孩子們稱母親為「媽」。

examples.en: He wrote a letter addressed to his mam back in Wales.
examples.zh: 他寫了一封信給遠在威爾斯的媽媽。

examples.en: The two countries signed a multilateral agreement on trade and investment.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署了一項關於貿易和投資的多邊協議。

examples.en: Multilateral talks are needed to address climate change effectively.
examples.zh: 需要多邊會談才能有效應對氣候變遷。

examples.en: He became the boswell of the famous novelist, recording every conversation.
examples.zh: 他成了那位著名小說家的傳記作者，記錄下每一次談話。

examples.en: Every celebrity seems to have a boswell eager to write about their life.
examples.zh: 每位名人似乎都有一個急於撰寫其生平的傳記作者。

examples.en: The room was decorated in muted tones of beige and gray.
examples.zh: 房間以米色和灰色等柔和色調裝飾。

examples.en: She spoke in a muted voice so as not to wake the baby.
examples.zh: 她輕聲說話，以免吵醒嬰兒。

examples.en: The price of the tour was 50,000 roubles per person.
examples.zh: 這個旅遊行程的價格是每人五萬盧布。

examples.en: He exchanged his dollars for roubles at the airport.
examples.zh: 他在機場把美元兌換成盧布。

examples.en: The loyalists remained faithful to the king even during the rebellion.
examples.zh: 即使在叛亂期間，忠誠者仍對國王保持忠誠。

examples.en: As a loyalist, she refused to join the protest against the government.
examples.zh: 作為一名忠誠者，她拒絕加入反政府的抗議。

examples.en: The helicopter's rotor began to spin as the engine started.
examples.zh: 引擎啟動時，直升機的旋翼開始轉動。

examples.en: Technicians inspected the rotor for any signs of damage.
examples.zh: 技術人員檢查了轉子是否有任何損壞跡象。

examples.en: The company made a unilateral decision to cut salaries without consulting employees.
examples.zh: 公司在未諮詢員工的情況下單方面決定減薪。

examples.en: Unilateral action by one country can strain international relations.
examples.zh: 一個國家的單邊行動可能使國際關係緊張。

examples.en: After years of bachelorhood, he finally became a benedict at age 45.
examples.zh: 單身多年後，他終於在45歲時成為新婚男人。

examples.en: His friends teased him about becoming a benedict so suddenly.
examples.zh: 他的朋友們取笑他這麼突然就成了新婚男人。

examples.en: Despite the bad news, she remained upbeat and encouraged her team.
examples.zh: 儘管消息不好，她仍保持樂觀並鼓勵她的團隊。

examples.en: The song starts with an upbeat that leads into a lively chorus.
examples.zh: 這首歌以弱拍開始，然後進入活潑的副歌。

examples.en: In the clinical trial, half of the patients received a placebo instead of the real drug.
examples.zh: 在臨床試驗中，一半的患者接受了安慰劑而不是真正的藥物。

examples.en: Sometimes a doctor's reassuring words can act as a placebo for a worried patient.
examples.zh: 有時醫生安慰的話語可以對焦慮的患者起到安慰劑的作用。

examples.en: The government decided to outlaw the sale of single-use plastics.
examples.zh: 政府決定取締一次性塑膠的銷售。

examples.en: In the old West, an outlaw often had a bounty on his head.
examples.zh: 在舊西部，罪犯的頭上通常有懸賞金。

examples.en: The singer performed a beautiful ballad about lost love.
examples.zh: 歌手演唱了一首關於失去愛情的優美歌謠。

examples.en: This ballad has been passed down orally for generations.
examples.zh: 這首歌謠已經口耳相傳了好幾代。

examples.en: We had a picnic in a shady spot under the old oak tree.
examples.zh: 我們在老橡樹下蔭涼的地方野餐。

examples.en: The police are investigating a shady business deal.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查一筆可疑的交易。

examples.en: After the merger, the two companies were on an equal footing.
examples.zh: 合併後，兩家公司地位平等。

examples.en: She lost her footing on the icy steps and fell.
examples.zh: 她在結冰的台階上失去立足點而跌倒。

examples.en: He wavered for a moment before agreeing to the plan.
examples.zh: 他猶豫了一會兒才同意這個計劃。

examples.en: The candle flame wavered in the breeze from the open window.
examples.zh: 蠟燭火焰在開著的窗戶吹來的微風中搖曳。

examples.en: The report summarized the salient points of the discussion.
examples.zh: 報告總結了討論的要點。

examples.en: One salient feature of the design is its curved roof.
examples.zh: 這個設計的一個顯著特徵是它的弧形屋頂。

examples.en: The tank can hold up to 50 hl of liquid.
examples.zh: 這個儲罐最多可容納50百升的液體。

examples.en: They measured the water usage in hl to monitor consumption.
examples.zh: 他們以百升為單位測量用水量以監控消耗。

examples.en: The Sabine women were famously abducted by the early Romans.
examples.zh: 薩賓婦女被早期的羅馬人綁架是著名的事件。

examples.en: She studied the Sabine culture for her history thesis.
examples.zh: 她為歷史論文研究薩賓文化。

examples.en: The screenplay for the movie was written by a first-time writer.
examples.zh: 這部電影的劇本由一位首次編劇的人撰寫。
