examples.en: The coach's exhortation to never give up inspired the players.
examples.zh: 教練永不放棄的勸告激勵了球員。

examples.en: Despite his mother's exhortation to study harder, he kept playing video games.
examples.zh: 儘管母親勸他更用功，他仍繼續打電動。

examples.en: Biologists use taxonomy to classify and name new species.
examples.zh: 生物學家使用分類學來分類和命名新物種。

examples.en: The taxonomy of flowering plants has been revised based on genetic studies.
examples.zh: 開花植物的分類系統已根據基因研究修訂。

examples.en: After the hot yoga class, her forehead was beaded with sweat.
examples.zh: 熱瑜伽課後，她的額頭佈滿汗珠。

examples.en: The cold glass was beaded with condensation on a humid day.
examples.zh: 潮濕的日子裡，冰冷的玻璃杯上凝結著水珠。

examples.en: One distinguishing feature of this bird is its bright red beak.
examples.zh: 這種鳥的一個顯著特徵是牠鮮紅色的喙。

examples.en: The distinguishing mark on the painting helped experts identify the artist.
examples.zh: 畫作上的區別標記幫助專家辨識出藝術家。

examples.en: Whether the new policy will help the economy is debatable.
examples.zh: 新政策是否會幫助經濟尚有爭議。

examples.en: The team's chances of winning the championship are debatable after losing key players.
examples.zh: 在失去關鍵球員後，該隊贏得冠軍的機會成問題。

examples.en: The Olympic Games have a unifying effect on people from different countries.
examples.zh: 奧運會對來自不同國家的人們有團結的作用。

examples.en: A common language can be a unifying force in a diverse society.
examples.zh: 共同語言在多元社會中可以成為團結的力量。

examples.en: When asked about her age, she gave a coy smile and changed the subject.
examples.zh: 當被問到年齡時，她靦腆地笑了笑，轉移了話題。

examples.en: The politician remained coy about whether he would run for reelection.
examples.zh: 那位政治人物對於是否競選連任仍諱莫如深。

examples.en: The vanishing of the ship without a trace remains a mystery.
examples.zh: 那艘船消失得無影無蹤，仍是個謎。

examples.en: Conservationists are concerned about the vanishing of natural habitats.
examples.zh: 保育人士擔心自然棲息地正在消失。

examples.en: The evidence was amply sufficient to convict the defendant.
examples.zh: 證據充分足以將被告定罪。

examples.en: She was amply rewarded for her years of dedicated service.
examples.zh: 她多年的奉獻服務得到了豐厚的回報。

examples.en: The wastewater treatment plant processes biosolids into fertilizer for agriculture.
examples.zh: 污水處理廠將生物固體加工成農業肥料。

examples.en: Farmers must follow regulations when applying biosolids to their fields.
examples.zh: 農民在田裡施用生物固體時必須遵守規定。

examples.en: The doctor's calm explanation helped allay the patient's fears.
examples.zh: 醫生平靜的解釋幫助減輕了病人的恐懼。

examples.en: A glass of cold water can allay your thirst on a hot day.
examples.zh: 在炎熱的天氣裡，一杯冷水可以解渴。

examples.en: The guards treated the prisoners with inhuman cruelty.
examples.zh: 警衛以殘忍無人性的方式對待囚犯。

examples.en: A strange, inhuman cry came from the dark forest.
examples.zh: 黑暗的森林裡傳來一聲奇怪、非人類的呼喊。

examples.en: She grudgingly admitted that her brother was right.
examples.zh: 她勉強承認她弟弟是對的。

examples.en: He grudgingly agreed to help with the cleaning.
examples.zh: 他不情願地同意幫忙打掃。

examples.en: All the boxes are clearly labeled with their contents.
examples.zh: 所有箱子都清楚標示了內容物。

examples.en: The product was labeled as organic, but it wasn't.
examples.zh: 該產品標示為有機，但其實不是。

examples.en: The banking industry is tightly regulated by the government.
examples.zh: 銀行業受到政府嚴格的管制。

examples.en: In many countries, gun ownership is strictly regulated.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，槍枝擁有受到嚴格管制。

examples.en: The program is designed for children who are developmentally delayed.
examples.zh: 該計畫是為發育遲緩的兒童設計的。

examples.en: Such behavior is developmentally appropriate for a two-year-old.
examples.zh: 這種行為對兩歲小孩的發育來說是適當的。

examples.en: I can't recollect where I put my keys.
examples.zh: 我想不起來把鑰匙放在哪裡了。

examples.en: She tried hard to recollect the details of that night.
examples.zh: 她努力回想那天晚上的細節。

examples.en: The final score is a weighted average of all assignments.
examples.zh: 最終成績是所有作業的加權平均。

examples.en: The committee's decision was weighted in favor of larger companies.
examples.zh: 委員會的決定偏向有利於大公司。

examples.en: Her eyes were glistening with tears as she said goodbye.
examples.zh: 她道別時，雙眼淚光閃閃。

examples.en: The glistening surface of the lake reflected the morning sun.
examples.zh: 湖面閃閃發光，映照著晨陽。

examples.en: The preamble of the constitution explains its purpose.
examples.zh: 憲法的序文說明了其宗旨。

examples.en: He gave a short preamble before announcing the new policy.
examples.zh: 他在宣布新政策前做了簡短的開場白。

examples.en: A brief musical interlude separated the two acts.
examples.zh: 一段簡短的音樂插曲分隔了兩幕。

examples.en: Their argument was just a brief interlude in an otherwise peaceful evening.
examples.zh: 他們的爭吵只是原本平靜夜晚中的一段短暫插曲。

examples.en: My godfather gave me a silver watch for my graduation.
examples.zh: 我的教父送我一支銀錶作為畢業禮物。

examples.en: He asked his best friend to be the godfather of his son.
examples.zh: 他請最好的朋友當他兒子的教父。

examples.en: The response to the online survey was almost instantaneous.
examples.zh: 線上調查的回應幾乎是瞬間的。

examples.en: The car's braking system provides instantaneous reaction to danger.
examples.zh: 這輛車的煞車系統對危險提供即時反應。

examples.en: The old man's eccentricity made him a local legend.
examples.zh: 那位老人的古怪行為使他成為當地傳奇。

examples.en: Her eccentricity was reflected in the colorful clothes she wore.
examples.zh: 她的怪癖反映在她所穿的鮮豔衣服上。

examples.en: The hapless traveler lost his wallet and his passport.
examples.zh: 那位倒楣的旅客丟了錢包和護照。

examples.en: The hapless team lost every game of the season.
examples.zh: 那支不幸的球隊輸掉了賽季的每一場比賽。

examples.en: He used an abrasive pad to scrub the burnt pot.
examples.zh: 他用研磨墊刷洗燒焦的鍋子。

examples.en: Her abrasive manner often offended her coworkers.
examples.zh: 她粗魯的態度常常冒犯同事。

examples.en: The posterior part of the brain controls vision.
examples.zh: 大腦的後部控制視覺。

examples.en: He slipped and landed on his posterior.
examples.zh: 他滑倒，一屁股坐在地上。

examples.en: The prodigious amount of data took weeks to analyze.
examples.zh: 龐大的資料量花了數週才分析完。

examples.en: She has a prodigious talent for remembering names.
examples.zh: 她有驚人的記名字才能。

examples.en: The first manned mission to Mars is still years away.
examples.zh: 首次載人火星任務還要好幾年才會實現。

examples.en: A manned security booth stands at the entrance.
examples.zh: 入口處設有有人值守的警衛亭。

examples.en: The haunting melody stayed with me all day.
examples.zh: 那縈繞心頭的旋律整天在我腦海裡盤旋。

examples.en: The abandoned house had a haunting atmosphere.
examples.zh: 那棟廢棄的房子有一種令人不安的氛圍。

examples.en: My misplaced glasses were found in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我放錯地方的眼鏡在廚房找到了。

examples.en: His misplaced trust in the stranger cost him dearly.
examples.zh: 他錯信陌生人，付出了慘痛代價。

examples.en: The old theater has been handsomely restored and now hosts live shows.
examples.zh: 這座老劇院已被漂亮地修復，如今用來舉辦現場表演。

examples.en: She was rewarded handsomely for her years of loyal service.
examples.zh: 她因多年忠誠的服務而獲得優厚的報酬。

examples.en: The manager's criticism of her work seemed completely unwarranted.
examples.zh: 經理對她工作的批評似乎完全沒有道理。

examples.en: Police may not enter a home without a warrant; such intrusion is unwarranted.
examples.zh: 警方沒有搜索令不得進入民宅；這種侵入是未經授權的。

examples.en: The nurse carefully swathed the wound in clean bandages.
examples.zh: 護士小心地用乾淨的繃帶把傷口裹起來。

examples.en: Thick fog swathed the entire valley by early morning.
examples.zh: 清晨時分，濃霧籠罩了整個山谷。

examples.en: Scientists finished sequencing the virus's genetic code last month.
examples.zh: 科學家上個月完成了這種病毒基因密碼的定序。

examples.en: Proper sequencing of the tasks will save the team a lot of time.
examples.zh: 妥善排序這些任務將為團隊省下許多時間。

examples.en: Despite the setbacks, she remained resolute in her decision to finish school.
examples.zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，她完成學業的決心依然堅定。

examples.en: His resolute tone convinced everyone that further arguing was useless.
examples.zh: 他堅決的語氣讓大家相信再爭辯也沒有用。

examples.en: The committee reached its decision after a long and reasoned discussion.
examples.zh: 委員會經過長時間且言之有據的討論後做出決定。

examples.en: Her essay offers a calm, reasoned response to the criticism.
examples.zh: 她的文章對那些批評提出了冷靜、思路清晰的回應。

examples.en: He has a morbid fascination with old graveyards and ghost stories.
examples.zh: 他對古老墓園和鬼故事有一種病態的著迷。

examples.en: Doctors linked his fatigue to a morbid condition of the liver.
examples.zh: 醫生把他的疲倦歸因於肝臟的病變。

examples.en: Apply the sunscreen liberally to all exposed skin before going out.
examples.zh: 出門前請在所有外露的皮膚上大方地塗抹防曬乳。

examples.en: The phrase should be interpreted liberally, not word for word.
examples.zh: 這個片語應從寬理解，而不是逐字翻譯。

examples.en: She felt overwhelmed by the amount of work waiting on her desk.
examples.zh: 她被桌上堆積如山的工作壓得喘不過氣。

examples.en: The small clinic was overwhelmed by patients after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，這間小診所被病患擠得難以招架。

examples.en: A few colorful posters helped enliven the plain office walls.
examples.zh: 幾張色彩鮮豔的海報讓單調的辦公室牆面生動起來。

examples.en: The host told jokes to enliven the long, quiet dinner.
examples.zh: 主人講笑話來讓這場漫長沉悶的晚餐熱絡起來。

examples.en: He decorated his apartment with retro furniture from the 1970s.
examples.zh: 他用一九七○年代的復古家具布置公寓。

examples.en: Retro styles seem to come back into fashion every few years.
examples.zh: 復古風格似乎每隔幾年就會重新流行起來。

examples.en: Sales usually slacken during the hot summer months.
examples.zh: 銷售量在炎熱的夏季通常會減緩。

examples.en: He slackened the rope so the boat could drift closer to shore.
examples.zh: 他放鬆繩子，好讓小船能漂近岸邊。

examples.en: The university offers courses that encourage entrepreneurship among students.
examples.zh: 這所大學開設課程，鼓勵學生發揮創業精神。

examples.en: Her success in entrepreneurship inspired many young people in her hometown.
examples.zh: 她在創業上的成功激勵了家鄉許多年輕人。

examples.en: The smell coming from the trash can was absolutely revolting.
examples.zh: 垃圾桶散發出的氣味實在令人作嘔。

examples.en: Many viewers found the movie's violence revolting rather than exciting.
examples.zh: 許多觀眾覺得這部片的暴力令人厭惡，而不是刺激。

examples.en: Rural villages here are heavily reliant on well water.
examples.zh: 這裡的鄉村地區非常依賴井水。

examples.en: As a child, he was too reliant on his parents for every decision.
examples.zh: 小時候，他每個決定都太依賴父母。

examples.en: The dancer wore a feathered headdress that sparkled under the lights.
examples.zh: 那位舞者戴著一頂在燈光下閃閃發亮的羽毛頭飾。

examples.en: Traditional headdresses vary widely among the island's tribes.
examples.zh: 這座島上各部落的傳統頭飾差異很大。

examples.en: Scholars still debate which letters belong to the canonical texts.
examples.zh: 學者至今仍在爭論哪些書信屬於正典文本。

examples.en: This novel is now considered a canonical work of modern literature.
examples.zh: 這部小說如今被視為現代文學的經典之作。

examples.en: The donation came from a nameless stranger who left no contact details.
examples.zh: 這筆捐款來自一位沒有留下聯絡方式的匿名陌生人。

examples.en: A nameless fear kept her awake for most of the night.
examples.zh: 一股莫名的恐懼讓她整夜大半時間都睡不著。

examples.en: She felt honoured to be invited to speak at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 能受邀在典禮上致詞，她感到很榮幸。

examples.en: The town honoured its longtime doctor with a small garden.
examples.zh: 這座小鎮以一座小花園來表揚服務多年的醫生。

examples.en: A forlorn dog waited by the gate every evening for its owner.
examples.zh: 一隻孤零零的狗每晚都在門口等主人回來。

examples.en: The abandoned factory stood forlorn at the edge of town.
examples.zh: 那座廢棄的工廠孤寂地矗立在城鎮邊緣。

examples.en: Looking down from the tall building gave me a sudden attack of vertigo.
examples.zh: 從高樓往下看讓我突然一陣眩暈。

examples.en: She suffers from vertigo and avoids amusement park rides.
examples.zh: 她患有眩暈症，所以避免搭乘遊樂園的設施。

examples.en: The dolphin became entangled in a fishing net and needed help.
examples.zh: 那隻海豚被漁網纏住，需要協助。

examples.en: Don't entangle yourself in their family argument.
examples.zh: 別讓自己捲入他們的家庭爭吵。

examples.en: A judge should remain disinterested and base decisions on facts.
examples.zh: 法官應保持無私，並根據事實做出裁決。

examples.en: We need a disinterested observer to settle the dispute fairly.
examples.zh: 我們需要一位無私的旁觀者來公平解決爭端。

examples.en: The edges of the old rug were frayed and needed trimming.
examples.zh: 舊地毯的邊緣磨損了，需要修剪。

examples.en: After years of use, the rope was frayed and unsafe.
examples.zh: 經過多年使用，這條繩子磨損了，不安全。

examples.en: The birds flew eastward as the sun began to rise.
examples.zh: 當太陽開始升起時，鳥兒向東飛去。

examples.en: They traveled eastward for two days to reach the coast.
examples.zh: 他們向東旅行了兩天到達海岸。

examples.en: The region is abundantly supplied with fresh water and fertile soil.
examples.zh: 該地區有豐富的淡水和肥沃的土壤。

examples.en: She made it abundantly clear that she would not change her mind.
examples.zh: 她非常清楚地表示她不會改變主意。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed her with anemia and prescribed iron supplements.
examples.zh: 醫生診斷她患有貧血，並開了鐵劑。

examples.en: Fatigue and pale skin can be signs of anemia.
examples.zh: 疲勞和皮膚蒼白可能是貧血的徵兆。

examples.en: Cultural relativism suggests that moral values vary between societies.
examples.zh: 文化相對主義認為道德價值觀因社會而異。

examples.en: Some philosophers argue that relativism leads to moral confusion.
examples.zh: 有些哲學家主張相對主義會導致道德混亂。

examples.en: The butcher recommended a tender cut from the loin for roasting.
examples.zh: 屠夫推薦一塊從腰部切下的嫩肉來烤。

examples.en: He felt a sharp pain in his loin after lifting the heavy box.
examples.zh: 他抬起重箱子後感到腰部劇痛。

examples.en: The company's policy was manifestly unfair to part-time workers.
examples.zh: 該公司的政策對兼職員工明顯不公平。

examples.en: His excitement was manifestly obvious to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他的興奮對房間裡的每個人來說都顯而易見。

examples.en: Barring any delays, the flight will arrive at noon.
examples.zh: 除非有任何延誤，否則航班將在中午抵達。

examples.en: Everyone was invited, barring those who had already left.
examples.zh: 每個人都被邀請了，除了那些已經離開的人。

examples.en: The inexorable rise in prices has made life difficult for many.
examples.zh: 物價無情的上漲讓許多人的生活變得困難。

examples.en: Despite their pleas, the judge remained inexorable and imposed the fine.
examples.zh: 儘管他們懇求，法官仍不為所動並處以罰款。

examples.en: The fluctuating temperatures in spring make it hard to choose clothes.
examples.zh: 春天波動的氣溫讓人很難選擇衣服。

examples.en: His fluctuating mood worried his friends and family.
examples.zh: 他起伏不定的情緒讓朋友和家人擔心。

examples.en: The disappearance of the ship remains an enigma to this day.
examples.zh: 那艘船的失蹤至今仍是個謎。

examples.en: Her sudden change of career was an enigma to her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她突然轉行對同事來說是個謎。

examples.en: The two countries agreed to a cessation of hostilities.
examples.zh: 兩國同意停止敵對行動。

examples.en: The cessation of funding forced the program to close.
examples.zh: 資金停止導致該計畫被迫關閉。

examples.en: The caterpillar spun a cocoon around itself before transforming.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲在蛻變前將自己包裹在繭裡。

examples.en: After the breakup, he cocooned himself in his apartment for weeks.
examples.zh: 分手後，他把自己關在公寓裡好幾週。

examples.en: The butchers at the market cut the meat fresh every morning.
examples.zh: 市場的屠夫每天早上現切肉品。

examples.en: Local butchers often know their customers by name.
examples.zh: 當地的肉商通常能叫出顧客的名字。

examples.en: The community showed an outpouring of support after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水過後，社區展現了大量的支持。

examples.en: Her poem was an outpouring of grief for her lost friend.
examples.zh: 她的詩是對失去朋友的悲痛流露。

examples.en: The army's firepower overwhelmed the enemy's defenses.
examples.zh: 軍隊的火力壓制了敵人的防禦。

examples.en: The team's offensive firepower proved too much for the opponents.
examples.zh: 該隊的進攻火力對對手來說太過強大。

examples.en: During peacetime, the military often assists with disaster relief.
examples.zh: 在和平時期，軍隊經常協助救災。

examples.en: The factory switched from making weapons to peacetime products.
examples.zh: 這家工廠從製造武器轉為生產和平時期的產品。

examples.en: The new policy will materially affect the way we handle customer data.
examples.zh: 新政策將實質上影響我們處理客戶資料的方式。

examples.en: Her living conditions improved materially after she found a better job.
examples.zh: 找到更好的工作後，她的生活條件在物質上有所改善。

examples.en: She held her rosary tightly and whispered a prayer.
examples.zh: 她緊握玫瑰念珠，低聲祈禱。

examples.en: The old woman's rosary had been passed down through generations.
examples.zh: 這位老婦人的玫瑰念珠是世代相傳的。

examples.en: He conspicuously avoided making eye contact during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議中顯著地避免眼神接觸。

examples.en: The sign was conspicuously placed at the entrance so everyone could see it.
examples.zh: 那個標誌顯眼地放在入口處，讓每個人都能看到。

examples.en: The scientist's conjecture about the origin of the universe remains unproven.
examples.zh: 這位科學家關於宇宙起源的推測仍未得到證實。

examples.en: We can only conjecture what happened after the lights went out.
examples.zh: 我們只能推測燈熄滅後發生了什麼事。

examples.en: The artist's stylized portraits often feature exaggerated facial expressions.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家的程式化肖像畫常以誇張的面部表情為特色。

examples.en: The dance was a stylized version of traditional folk movements.
examples.zh: 這支舞蹈是傳統民俗動作的程式化版本。

examples.en: The interminable meeting finally ended after three hours.
examples.zh: 那場冗長的會議終於在三個小時後結束。

examples.en: Waiting for the bus felt interminable in the freezing rain.
examples.zh: 在冰冷的雨中等待公車感覺無限漫長。

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed as terminally ill and chose to spend his remaining days at home.
examples.zh: 這位病人被診斷為絕症末期，選擇在家度過餘生。

examples.en: The project was terminally delayed due to lack of funding.
examples.zh: 該專案因缺乏資金而最終延誤。

examples.en: The outfielder caught the fly ball just before it hit the ground.
examples.zh: 外野手在球落地前接住了高飛球。

examples.en: He prefers playing in the outfield because he enjoys tracking long hits.
examples.zh: 他比較喜歡守外野，因為他享受追蹤長打的樂趣。

examples.en: The upshot of the negotiations was a new trade agreement between the two countries.
examples.zh: 談判的結果是兩國達成了新的貿易協定。

examples.en: What's the upshot of all these changes for ordinary employees?
examples.zh: 這些改變對一般員工的最終結果是什麼？

examples.en: The washing machine makes a loud noise when the load is unbalanced.
examples.zh: 洗衣機在負載不平衡時會發出很大的噪音。

examples.en: His unbalanced diet lacked essential vitamins and minerals.
examples.zh: 他不均衡的飲食缺乏必需的維生素和礦物質。

examples.en: The medieval castle had a tall turret at each corner.
examples.zh: 這座中世紀城堡的每個角落都有一座高塔樓。

examples.en: The tank's turret rotated to aim at the target.
examples.zh: 坦克的炮塔旋轉以瞄準目標。

examples.en: She politely rebuffed his offer of help, saying she could manage on her own.
examples.zh: 她禮貌地拒絕了他的幫助提議，說她自己可以應付。

examples.en: His attempt to apologize met with a cold rebuff.
examples.zh: 他試圖道歉卻遭到冷淡的拒絕。

examples.en: Financial prudence is essential when planning for retirement.
examples.zh: 在規劃退休時，財務上的審慎是必要的。

examples.en: She had the prudence to save a portion of her salary each month.
examples.zh: 她很有遠見，每個月都存下一部分薪水。

examples.en: The company invested profitably in renewable energy projects.
examples.zh: 該公司有利地投資了可再生能源項目。

examples.en: You can spend your time profitably by learning a new skill.
examples.zh: 你可以透過學習新技能來有益地利用時間。

examples.en: Plants draw nourishment from the soil through their roots.
examples.zh: 植物透過根部從土壤中吸取養分。

examples.en: The soup provided warm nourishment on a cold winter night.
examples.zh: 在寒冷的冬夜，這碗湯提供了溫暖的營養。

examples.en: He suffered the indignity of being searched at the airport.
examples.zh: 他在機場遭受了被搜查的侮辱。

examples.en: The workers endured the indignity of having their bags checked every day.
examples.zh: 工人們每天忍受被檢查包包的侮辱。

examples.en: Climate change poses a serious threat to the entire biosphere.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷對整個生物圈構成嚴重威脅。

examples.en: Scientists study how human activities affect the biosphere.
examples.zh: 科學家研究人類活動如何影響生物圈。

examples.en: This jacket is impervious to rain, so you can wear it in any weather.
examples.zh: 這件夾克防水，所以任何天氣都可以穿。

examples.en: She seemed impervious to criticism and continued with her plan.
examples.zh: 她似乎對批評無動於衷，繼續執行她的計劃。

examples.en: Phosphorus is an essential element for plant growth.
examples.zh: 磷是植物生長必需的要素。

examples.en: The match head contains phosphorus, which ignites when struck.
examples.zh: 火柴頭含有磷，摩擦時會點燃。

examples.en: A quasar can emit more energy than an entire galaxy.
examples.zh: 一個類星體發出的能量可能超過整個星系。

examples.en: Astronomers discovered a distant quasar using a powerful telescope.
examples.zh: 天文學家使用強大的望遠鏡發現了一個遙遠的類星體。

examples.en: The streetlight flickered and then went out completely.
examples.zh: 路燈閃了一下，然後就完全熄滅了。

examples.en: Under the streetlight, the old man was reading a newspaper.
examples.zh: 在路燈下，那位老人正在看報紙。

examples.en: Despite her diminutive size, she is a fierce competitor.
examples.zh: 儘管她身材嬌小，卻是個兇猛的競爭者。

examples.en: In English, the suffix '-let' often forms a diminutive, as in 'booklet'.
examples.zh: 在英文中，後綴 '-let' 常用來形成指小詞，例如 'booklet'。

examples.en: Her explanation was so lucid that everyone understood immediately.
examples.zh: 她的解釋非常清晰，每個人都立刻明白了。

examples.en: After a good night's sleep, he felt lucid and ready to work.
examples.zh: 好好睡了一覺後，他覺得頭腦清醒，準備好工作了。

examples.en: The two species are distinguishable by the color of their feathers.
examples.zh: 這兩個物種可以透過羽毛的顏色來區別。

examples.en: His voice was barely distinguishable over the noise of the crowd.
examples.zh: 在人群的噪音中，他的聲音幾乎無法辨別。

examples.en: He bought a sporty red car to celebrate his promotion.
examples.zh: 他買了一輛跑車風格的紅色汽車來慶祝升職。

examples.en: She wore a sporty outfit that was perfect for hiking.
examples.zh: 她穿了一套非常適合健行的運動裝。

examples.en: The museum displayed several sculptural works made of marble.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了幾件大理石雕刻作品。

examples.en: Her cheekbones were high and sculptural, giving her a striking look.
examples.zh: 她的顴骨高而立體，讓她看起來很出眾。

examples.en: They distil seawater to make it drinkable.
examples.zh: 他們蒸餾海水以使其可飲用。

examples.en: The book distils years of research into a few clear principles.
examples.zh: 這本書將多年的研究提煉成幾個清晰的原則。

examples.en: As a jazz aficionado, he owns hundreds of records.
examples.zh: 作為一名爵士樂迷，他擁有數百張唱片。

examples.en: The film festival attracted aficionados from all over the world.
examples.zh: 這個影展吸引了來自世界各地的狂熱愛好者。

examples.en: The toast was completely charred and tasted bitter.
examples.zh: 吐司完全燒焦了，吃起來很苦。

examples.en: After the fire, only charred remains of the house were left.
examples.zh: 火災過後，房子只剩下燒焦的殘骸。

examples.en: The vociferous protests outside the factory could be heard for miles.
examples.zh: 工廠外喧嚷的抗議聲幾英里外都聽得到。

examples.en: She was a vociferous critic of the new policy.
examples.zh: 她是這項新政策的大聲批評者。

examples.en: His fears about the exam turned out to be completely unjustified.
examples.zh: 他對考試的恐懼結果證明完全沒有根據。

examples.en: The company faced criticism for its unjustified price increase.
examples.zh: 該公司因不合理的漲價而面臨批評。

examples.en: The movie presents an idealized version of country life.
examples.zh: 這部電影呈現了理想化的鄉村生活。

examples.en: She had an idealized image of the city before she moved there.
examples.zh: 在搬去那座城市之前，她對它有一個理想化的印象。

examples.en: The monolithic skyscraper dominated the city skyline.
examples.zh: 這座巨大的摩天大樓主宰了城市的天際線。

examples.en: Critics described the organization as monolithic and resistant to change.
examples.zh: 批評者形容該組織鐵板一塊，抗拒改變。

examples.en: The rocket carried a payload of scientific instruments.
examples.zh: 火箭搭載了科學儀器的有效載荷。

examples.en: The truck's payload was limited to five tons.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車的載重限制為五噸。

examples.en: She affectionately patted her dog on the head.
examples.zh: 她親切地拍拍狗的頭。

examples.en: He spoke affectionately about his grandmother's cooking.
examples.zh: 他深情地談起祖母的廚藝。

examples.en: It took her an hour to disentangle the knots in the yarn.
examples.zh: 她花了一小時才解開毛線上的結。

examples.en: The lawyer tried to disentangle the facts from the rumors.
examples.zh: 律師試圖從謠言中理清事實。

examples.en: The cafe provided a congenial atmosphere for conversation.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館提供了適合交談的愉快氛圍。

examples.en: He found his new colleagues congenial and easy to work with.
examples.zh: 他發現新同事很投緣，容易共事。

examples.en: His husky voice made him a popular radio host.
examples.zh: 他沙啞的嗓音使他成為受歡迎的廣播主持人。

examples.en: The husky pulled the sled across the snow.
examples.zh: 哈士奇拉著雪橇穿越雪地。

examples.en: The stumbling block in the negotiation was the price.
examples.zh: 談判中的障礙是價格。

examples.en: He made a stumbling attempt to explain his mistake.
examples.zh: 他結結巴巴地試圖解釋自己的錯誤。

examples.en: She was asked to choreograph the opening dance for the school musical.
examples.zh: 她被邀請為學校音樂劇編排開場舞。

examples.en: The director carefully choreographed every move of the final scene.
examples.zh: 導演精心設計了最後一幕的每一個動作。

examples.en: We spotted a large gator sunbathing on the bank of the river.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻大短吻鱷在河岸上曬太陽。

examples.en: Visitors are warned not to feed the gators in the pond.
examples.zh: 遊客被警告不要餵池塘裡的短吻鱷。

examples.en: The teacher arbitrarily assigned seats without considering students' preferences.
examples.zh: 老師任意分配座位，沒有考慮學生的偏好。

examples.en: Prices were raised arbitrarily, causing frustration among customers.
examples.zh: 價格被任意調漲，引起顧客的不滿。

examples.en: After weighing all the options, they decided to postpone the trip.
examples.zh: 在仔細考慮所有選項後，他們決定延期旅行。

examples.en: The committee is still weighing the pros and cons of the proposal.
examples.zh: 委員會仍在權衡該提案的利弊。

examples.en: He has struggled with a stammer since childhood.
examples.zh: 他從小就為口吃所苦。

examples.en: Nervously, she began to stammer an apology.
examples.zh: 她緊張地結結巴巴地道歉。

examples.en: Critics derided the movie as shallow and predictable.
examples.zh: 評論家嘲笑這部電影膚淺且老套。

examples.en: Don't deride others for their mistakes; everyone learns at their own pace.
examples.zh: 不要嘲笑別人的錯誤；每個人都有自己的學習步調。

examples.en: Please make a photocopy of your ID card for the application.
examples.zh: 請為申請表影印一份你的身分證。

examples.en: The library charges a small fee to photocopy articles.
examples.zh: 圖書館影印文章會收取少許費用。

examples.en: The theory has a solid underpinning of experimental data.
examples.zh: 該理論有堅實的實驗數據作為基礎。

examples.en: Trust is the underpinning of any healthy relationship.
examples.zh: 信任是任何健康關係的基礎。

examples.en: The descending elevator stopped at every floor.
examples.zh: 下降的電梯每一層都停。

examples.en: We sorted the numbers in descending order.
examples.zh: 我們將數字按遞減順序排列。

examples.en: The teacher's admonition to study hard stayed with me.
examples.zh: 老師用功讀書的勸告一直留在我心中。

examples.en: He ignored the admonition and continued to drive fast.
examples.zh: 他忽視了警告，繼續快速行駛。

examples.en: The court invalidated the contract because it was not signed properly.
examples.zh: 法院宣布該合約無效，因為它沒有正確簽署。

examples.en: Missing the deadline will invalidate your application.
examples.zh: 錯過截止日期將使你的申請失效。

examples.en: The soldiers were interred in a cemetery near the battlefield.
examples.zh: 士兵們被埋葬在戰場附近的公墓。

examples.en: They decided to inter the ashes in the family plot.
examples.zh: 他們決定將骨灰葬在家族墓地。

examples.en: She worked for three uninterrupted hours to finish the report.
examples.zh: 她連續工作了三個小時才完成報告。

examples.en: The power supply has been uninterrupted since the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，電力供應一直沒有中斷。

examples.en: The loud noise snapped him out of his reverie.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音把他從沉思中驚醒。

examples.en: She sat by the window, lost in a pleasant reverie.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗邊，陷入愉快的幻想中。

examples.en: The defunct factory was finally torn down last year.
examples.zh: 那座廢棄的工廠去年終於被拆除了。

examples.en: He tried to call the defunct phone number.
examples.zh: 他試圖撥打那個已停用的電話號碼。

examples.en: He went fishing with his old chum from college.
examples.zh: 他和大學時代的老友一起去釣魚。

examples.en: The fishermen scattered chum into the water to attract more fish.
examples.zh: 漁民把誘餌撒入水中以吸引更多的魚。

examples.en: The raven perched on the branch and cawed loudly.
examples.zh: 渡鴉停在樹枝上大聲叫。

examples.en: After the long fast, he ravened his meal in minutes.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的禁食，他幾分鐘內就狼吞虎嚥地吃完了飯。

examples.en: He belatedly realized that he had forgotten his wallet.
examples.zh: 他遲遲才意識到自己忘了帶錢包。

examples.en: The company belatedly apologized for the delay.
examples.zh: 該公司為延誤遲來地道歉。

examples.en: The new product has made significant inroads into the Asian market.
examples.zh: 該新產品已成功打入亞洲市場，取得重大進展。

examples.en: Social media has made inroads into our daily communication.
examples.zh: 社群媒體已侵入我們的日常溝通。

examples.en: The signpost pointed us toward the nearest gas station.
examples.zh: 路標指向最近的加油站。

examples.en: The government signposted the new bike route clearly.
examples.zh: 政府清楚地為新的自行車路線設置了路標。

examples.en: The critic's searing review destroyed the young author's confidence.
examples.zh: 那位評論家嚴厲的評論摧毀了這位年輕作家的信心。

examples.en: She felt the searing heat of the pan as she touched it accidentally.
examples.zh: 她不小心碰到鍋子時，感受到鍋子灼熱的高溫。

examples.en: Scientists conducted experiments to disprove the theory that the earth is flat.
examples.zh: 科學家進行實驗以反駁地球是平的這個理論。

examples.en: Can you disprove the claim that he was at the scene of the crime?
examples.zh: 你能證明他在犯罪現場的說法不成立嗎？

examples.en: The audience gaped in amazement as the magician made the elephant disappear.
examples.zh: 當魔術師讓大象消失時，觀眾驚訝地張大了嘴。

examples.en: He gaped at the huge dent in his car after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，他目瞪口呆地看著車上的大凹痕。

examples.en: The diaphragm plays a crucial role in breathing by contracting and relaxing.
examples.zh: 橫隔膜透過收縮和放鬆，在呼吸中扮演關鍵角色。

examples.en: Adjust the diaphragm to control the amount of light entering the camera lens.
examples.zh: 調整光圈以控制進入相機鏡頭的光量。

examples.en: Test scores are often used as a yardstick to measure student performance.
examples.zh: 考試分數常被用作衡量學生表現的標準。

examples.en: The carpenter reached for a yardstick to measure the length of the board.
examples.zh: 木匠伸手拿碼尺來量木板的長度。

examples.en: She seemed completely unconcerned about the deadline, which worried her team.
examples.zh: 她似乎完全不在乎截止日期，這讓她的團隊很擔心。

examples.en: He remained unconcerned with the gossip and focused on his work.
examples.zh: 他對流言蜚語漠不關心，專注於自己的工作。

examples.en: My grandmother is very superstitious and believes that black cats bring bad luck.
examples.zh: 我奶奶非常迷信，相信黑貓會帶來厄運。

examples.en: Even superstitious people sometimes ignore their fears and walk under ladders.
examples.zh: 即使是迷信的人有時也會忽略恐懼，從梯子下走過。

examples.en: The doctor inserted a shunt to divert blood away from the blocked vein.
examples.zh: 醫生置入分流管，將血液從阻塞的靜脈引流開。

examples.en: The company decided to shunt the project to a different department.
examples.zh: 公司決定將該專案轉移到另一個部門。

examples.en: The goats grazed peacefully on the steep mountainside.
examples.zh: 山羊在陡峭的山腰上平靜地吃草。

examples.en: A landslide swept away several trees on the mountainside after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，土石流沖走了山腰上的幾棵樹。

examples.en: The doctor examined the X-ray and found a fracture in one vertebra.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查X光片，發現其中一節脊椎骨折。

examples.en: Each vertebra in the spine protects the spinal cord.
examples.zh: 脊柱中的每一節椎骨都保護著脊髓。

examples.en: The astronauts waited in the airlock before stepping onto the lunar surface.
examples.zh: 太空人在氣密艙等待，然後踏上月球表面。

examples.en: The laboratory uses an airlock to keep contaminants out of the clean room.
examples.zh: 實驗室使用氣閘來防止污染物進入無塵室。

examples.en: The lightness of the feather made it float gently in the breeze.
examples.zh: 羽毛的輕盈讓它在微風中輕輕飄浮。

examples.en: She danced with a lightness that captivated everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她跳舞時輕盈優美，迷住了房間裡的每個人。

examples.en: The modern glass building looked incongruous among the old brick houses.
examples.zh: 這棟現代玻璃建築在舊磚房之間顯得極不協調。

examples.en: His loud laughter seemed incongruous at the solemn ceremony.
examples.zh: 在莊嚴的儀式上，他的大聲笑聲顯得很不合適。

examples.en: The renter must pay a security deposit before moving into the apartment.
examples.zh: 租客在搬進公寓前必須支付押金。

examples.en: As a renter, she is responsible for minor repairs in the house.
examples.zh: 作為承租人，她負責房子的小型維修。

examples.en: The workers loaded the boxes onto a wooden pallet for shipping.
examples.zh: 工人們將箱子裝上木棧板以便運輸。

examples.en: The artist mixed colors on her pallet before starting the painting.
examples.zh: 藝術家在開始作畫前在調色盤上混合顏料。

examples.en: The erstwhile friends met again after years of silence.
examples.zh: 昔日的好友在多年沉默後再次相遇。

examples.en: He visited his erstwhile hometown and found it completely changed.
examples.zh: 他拜訪了昔日的家鄉，發現它完全變了樣。

examples.en: Discerning shoppers compare prices and quality before making a purchase.
examples.zh: 有辨別力的購物者會在購買前比較價格和品質。

examples.en: The critic had a discerning eye for detail in the paintings.
examples.zh: 評論家對畫作的細節有敏銳的眼力。

examples.en: In the early morning, dew covered the grass in the garden.
examples.zh: 清晨時分，露水覆蓋了花園裡的草地。

examples.en: The spider web sparkled with dew in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛網在陽光下因露水而閃閃發光。

examples.en: The beluga whale is known for its white color and distinctive forehead.
examples.zh: 白鯨以其白色和獨特的額頭而聞名。

examples.en: Fishermen caught a large beluga sturgeon in the Caspian Sea.
examples.zh: 漁夫在裡海捕獲了一條巨大的大白鰉。

examples.en: You should not ingest any food or drink before the surgery.
examples.zh: 手術前不應攝取任何食物或飲料。

examples.en: Students need time to ingest the new information from the lecture.
examples.zh: 學生需要時間吸收講座中的新資訊。

examples.en: The land remained undeveloped for decades due to legal disputes.
examples.zh: 由於法律糾紛，這塊土地數十年來一直未開發。

examples.en: Her undeveloped talents in music surprised everyone when she finally took lessons.
examples.zh: 當她終於開始上課時，她未開發的音樂才華讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: The refugees were forced to live in squalor for months.
examples.zh: 難民們被迫在骯髒的環境中生活了好幾個月。

examples.en: He grew up in squalor but eventually became a successful businessman.
examples.zh: 他在貧困髒亂的環境中長大，但最終成為一名成功的商人。

examples.en: The squalid conditions in the factory violated basic safety standards.
examples.zh: 工廠裡汙穢的環境違反了基本的安全標準。

examples.en: They were shocked by the squalid living quarters of the workers.
examples.zh: 他們對工人們骯髒的居住環境感到震驚。

examples.en: She studied all night for her midterm exam in biology.
examples.zh: 她為了生物期中考試熬夜苦讀。

examples.en: The midterm elections will be held in November.
examples.zh: 期中選舉將在十一月舉行。

examples.en: In the past, a spinster was often pitied by society.
examples.zh: 在過去，未婚女子常常受到社會的同情。

examples.en: She resented being called a spinster and preferred to be known as an independent woman.
examples.zh: 她討厭被稱為老處女，寧願被視為獨立女性。

examples.en: The two problems are closely interrelated and must be solved together.
examples.zh: 這兩個問題密切相關，必須一起解決。

examples.en: Researchers found that diet and exercise are interrelated factors in maintaining health.
examples.zh: 研究人員發現飲食和運動是維持健康的相關因素。

examples.en: She drizzled caramel sauce over the ice cream.
examples.zh: 她在冰淇淋上淋了焦糖醬。

examples.en: The candy store sells a variety of caramels and chocolates.
examples.zh: 這家糖果店販售各種焦糖糖果和巧克力。

examples.en: The company removed the objectionable content from its website after complaints.
examples.zh: 在接到投訴後，該公司從網站上移除了令人反感的內容。

examples.en: His objectionable remarks offended many people at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議上令人反感的言論冒犯了許多人。

examples.en: The squatter built a small shack on the empty lot.
examples.zh: 擅自佔地者在空地上搭建了一間小棚屋。

examples.en: Authorities evicted the squatters who had occupied the building for years.
examples.zh: 當局驅逐了佔據該建築物多年的擅自佔用者。

examples.en: To add fractions, you need a common denominator.
examples.zh: 要相加分數，你需要一個共同分母。

examples.en: In the fraction 3/4, the denominator is 4.
examples.zh: 在分數 3/4 中，分母是 4。

examples.en: The oscillation of the pendulum gradually slowed down.
examples.zh: 鐘擺的擺動逐漸減慢。

examples.en: Scientists measured the oscillation of the bridge during the earthquake.
examples.zh: 科學家測量了地震期間橋樑的振動。

examples.en: Many investors jumped on the bandwagon after the stock price soared.
examples.zh: 股價飆升後，許多投資者紛紛跟風。

examples.en: The bandwagon rolled down the street during the parade.
examples.zh: 遊行期間，樂隊彩車沿街行進。

examples.en: A sedentary lifestyle and inactivity can lead to health problems.
examples.zh: 久坐的生活型態和不活動可能導致健康問題。

examples.en: The period of inactivity in the market worried many traders.
examples.zh: 市場的獃滯期讓許多交易員感到擔憂。

examples.en: She was diagnosed with an ovarian cyst during a routine checkup.
examples.zh: 她在例行檢查中被診斷出卵巢囊腫。

examples.en: Ovarian cancer is often called a silent killer because symptoms appear late.
examples.zh: 卵巢癌常被稱為沉默的殺手，因為症狀出現得晚。

examples.en: Genetics can create a predisposition to certain diseases.
examples.zh: 基因可能使人易患某些疾病。

examples.en: His predisposition to argue made meetings difficult.
examples.zh: 他好爭辯的習性讓會議變得困難。

examples.en: The region is sparsely populated, with only a few small villages.
examples.zh: 該地區人口稀少，只有幾個小村莊。

examples.en: He sparsely decorated the room with just a few posters.
examples.zh: 他只用了幾張海報稀疏地裝飾房間。

examples.en: The author created a fictitious town as the setting for her novel.
examples.zh: 作者創造了一個虛構的城鎮作為她小說的背景。

examples.en: He used a fictitious name to avoid being recognized.
examples.zh: 他使用假名以避免被認出。

examples.en: The wedding cake was elaborately decorated with sugar flowers.
examples.zh: 婚禮蛋糕用糖花精巧地裝飾著。

examples.en: They elaborately planned every detail of the surprise party.
examples.zh: 他們精心策劃了驚喜派對的每一個細節。

examples.en: The shaggy dog wagged its tail happily.
examples.zh: 那隻毛髮蓬亂的狗開心地搖著尾巴。

examples.en: He has shaggy hair that always looks messy.
examples.zh: 他有一頭總是看起來很亂的蓬鬆頭髮。

examples.en: The accident left him with a deformed leg.
examples.zh: 那場事故使他的一條腿變形了。

examples.en: The tree had a deformed trunk due to years of strong winds.
examples.zh: 由於多年的強風，這棵樹的樹幹變形了。

examples.en: The roof is made of corrugated metal sheets.
examples.zh: 屋頂是用波狀金屬板製成的。

examples.en: She cut her finger on the edge of a corrugated cardboard box.
examples.zh: 她被瓦楞紙箱的邊緣割傷了手指。

examples.en: He dunked the cookie into his coffee.
examples.zh: 他把餅乾浸入咖啡裡。

examples.en: The player dunked the ball with one hand.
examples.zh: 那名球員單手灌籃。

examples.en: The invaders were known for their barbaric treatment of prisoners.
examples.zh: 入侵者以野蠻對待囚犯而聞名。

examples.en: Critics called the building's design barbaric and overdone.
examples.zh: 評論家稱這棟建築的設計粗俗又過度。

examples.en: She snipped the thread with a pair of scissors.
examples.zh: 她用剪刀剪斷線。

examples.en: He gave the hedge a quick snip here and there.
examples.zh: 他在樹籬上到處快速修剪了一下。

examples.en: The workers riveted the steel beams together.
examples.zh: 工人們用鉚釘將鋼樑固定在一起。

examples.en: The documentary riveted the audience from start to finish.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片從頭到尾都吸引住觀眾的目光。

examples.en: The government's inaction on climate change has drawn criticism.
examples.zh: 政府在氣候變遷問題上的不作為招致批評。

examples.en: After months of inaction, the committee finally met.
examples.zh: 在數個月無所作為之後，委員會終於開會了。

examples.en: The factory still uses antiquated machinery from the 1950s.
examples.zh: 這家工廠仍在使用1950年代的陳舊機器。

examples.en: His views on marriage are considered antiquated by many.
examples.zh: 他對婚姻的看法被許多人認為過時。

examples.en: The paint is still tacky, so don't touch the wall.
examples.zh: 油漆還沒乾，所以別碰牆壁。

examples.en: She thought the decorations were tacky and overdone.
examples.zh: 她覺得那些裝飾俗麗又過頭。

examples.en: The conference ended with a roundtable on education reform.
examples.zh: 會議以一場關於教育改革的圓桌討論作結。

examples.en: Experts from various fields participated in the roundtable.
examples.zh: 來自各領域的專家參加了這場圓桌會議。

examples.en: She answered all the questions truthfully.
examples.zh: 她誠實地回答了所有問題。

examples.en: Truthfully, I don't think the plan will work.
examples.zh: 老實說，我認為這個計畫行不通。

examples.en: They enjoyed an uncomplicated friendship for years.
examples.zh: 他們多年來享受著一段單純的友誼。

examples.en: The recipe is uncomplicated and perfect for beginners.
examples.zh: 這份食譜很簡單，非常適合初學者。

examples.en: The coach chastised the players for their careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 教練責罵球員們粗心的失誤。

examples.en: She was chastised by her boss for arriving late.
examples.zh: 她因為遲到而被老闆責罵。

examples.en: The sharpness of the knife made cutting easy.
examples.zh: 這把刀的銳利讓切割變得容易。

examples.en: His sharpness of mind impressed everyone at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他敏銳的頭腦讓會議上的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: The company decided to headquarter its operations in Taipei.
examples.zh: 公司決定將總部設在台北。

examples.en: They headquartered the new division in Taichung.
examples.zh: 他們將新部門的總部設在台中。

examples.en: The puzzle pieces have interlocking shapes.
examples.zh: 拼圖的碎片有連鎖的形狀。

examples.en: The interlocking gears ensure smooth movement.
examples.zh: 咬合的齒輪確保了平穩的運動。

examples.en: The factory produced munitions during the war.
examples.zh: 這家工廠在戰爭期間生產軍火。

examples.en: They stored munitions in a secure bunker.
examples.zh: 他們將軍需品儲存在安全的掩體中。

examples.en: The balding man wore a hat to protect his scalp.
examples.zh: 那位禿頭的男子戴帽子保護頭皮。

examples.en: He started balding in his early thirties.
examples.zh: 他三十出頭就開始禿頭了。

examples.en: The film's iconography draws heavily on classic Westerns.
examples.zh: 這部電影的影像符號大量借鑒經典西部片。

examples.en: Scholars study the religious iconography of the region.
examples.zh: 學者研究該地區的宗教圖像。

examples.en: The drawer was filled with miscellaneous items like batteries and pens.
examples.zh: 抽屜裡塞滿了電池和筆等各種雜物。

examples.en: She has miscellaneous talents, from cooking to coding.
examples.zh: 她有多方面的才華，從烹飪到寫程式都有。

examples.en: The philanthropist donated millions to build schools in rural areas.
examples.zh: 這位慈善家捐贈數百萬在鄉村地區興建學校。

examples.en: She became a philanthropist after retiring from her successful business.
examples.zh: 她在成功的職業生涯退休後成為一名慈善家。

examples.en: Ranching has been a major industry in this region for over a century.
examples.zh: 經營大牧場在這個地區已經是一個主要產業超過一個世紀了。

examples.en: They decided to try ranching after inheriting a large piece of land.
examples.zh: 他們在繼承一大片土地後決定嘗試經營大牧場。

examples.en: The lake's surface began to shimmer as the sun set.
examples.zh: 夕陽西下時，湖面開始閃爍。

examples.en: A faint shimmer of light came through the curtains.
examples.zh: 一道微弱的閃光從窗簾透進來。

examples.en: Employees with more seniority often get priority for vacation days.
examples.zh: 資歷較深的員工通常有優先選擇休假的權利。

examples.en: Promotions should be based on merit, not just seniority.
examples.zh: 升遷應該基於績效，而不只是資歷。

examples.en: Despite their differences, the two cultures share a commonality in family values.
examples.zh: 儘管有差異，這兩種文化在家庭價值觀上有共同點。

examples.en: The mayor spoke about the commonality of interests among all residents.
examples.zh: 市長談到所有居民之間利益的共同性。

examples.en: After the harvest, the field was left with only stubble.
examples.zh: 收割後，田裡只剩下殘株。

examples.en: He had three days of stubble on his face.
examples.zh: 他臉上有三天沒刮的鬍茬。

examples.en: Her elegant style made her the epitome of sophistication.
examples.zh: 她優雅的風格使她成為精緻的縮影。

examples.en: The small café is the epitome of a cozy neighborhood spot.
examples.zh: 這家小咖啡館是舒適社區場所的典型代表。

examples.en: The gallery features representational art, including portraits and landscapes.
examples.zh: 這家畫廊展出具象藝術，包括肖像和風景畫。

examples.en: Many critics prefer representational paintings over abstract ones.
examples.zh: 許多評論家更喜歡具象繪畫而非抽象繪畫。

examples.en: The boat was caught in a powerful vortex and spun around.
examples.zh: 船被捲入強大的漩渦中並旋轉。

examples.en: Leaves swirled in a vortex of wind before falling to the ground.
examples.zh: 樹葉在風的漩渦中旋轉，然後落到地上。

examples.en: The mayoral election will be held next month.
examples.zh: 市長選舉將於下個月舉行。

examples.en: She has been involved in mayoral campaigns for years.
examples.zh: 她多年來一直參與市長競選活動。

examples.en: The old dog began to wheeze after running up the hill.
examples.zh: 老狗跑上山坡後開始喘氣。

examples.en: His wheeze was so loud that we could hear it across the room.
examples.zh: 他的喘氣聲大到我們在房間另一頭都能聽到。

examples.en: The chef's latest concoction combined mango and chili.
examples.zh: 廚師最新的調合物結合了芒果和辣椒。

examples.en: The story was a concoction of lies and half-truths.
examples.zh: 這個故事是謊言和半真半假的混合物。

examples.en: The committee will apportion the funds among the various departments.
examples.zh: 委員會將在各部門之間分配資金。

examples.en: It's difficult to apportion blame when both sides are at fault.
examples.zh: 當雙方都有錯時，很難分攤責任。

examples.en: The walls were textured with a rough plaster finish.
examples.zh: 牆壁用粗糙的石膏飾面使其有質感。

examples.en: She chose a textured fabric for the sofa to add visual interest.
examples.zh: 她為沙發選擇了一種有質感的布料以增加視覺趣味。

examples.en: He perused the document carefully before signing it.
examples.zh: 他在簽署文件前仔細閱讀了它。

examples.en: She likes to peruse the newspaper while drinking her morning coffee.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在喝早晨咖啡時瀏覽報紙。

examples.en: The house has been unoccupied for months.
examples.zh: 這棟房子已經空置了好幾個月。

examples.en: We found an unoccupied table near the window.
examples.zh: 我們在窗邊找到一張空著的桌子。

examples.en: The host gave us a cordial welcome.
examples.zh: 主人熱忱地歡迎我們。

examples.en: Despite their rivalry, they remained cordial to each other.
examples.zh: 儘管是競爭對手，他們仍保持誠懇友好。

examples.en: The investigation revealed a pattern of dishonesty in the company.
examples.zh: 調查揭露了公司內一連串的不誠實行為。

examples.en: His dishonesty cost him the trust of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他的不誠實使他失去了同事的信任。

examples.en: The experience was a salutary lesson in humility.
examples.zh: 這次經歷是謙遜的有益教訓。

examples.en: Regular exercise has a salutary effect on both body and mind.
examples.zh: 規律運動對身心都有益處。

examples.en: I love the crispy skin on roasted chicken.
examples.zh: 我喜歡烤雞的酥脆外皮。

examples.en: The bacon should be cooked until it's crispy.
examples.zh: 培根應該煮到酥脆為止。

examples.en: She handled the crisis with remarkable firmness and calm.
examples.zh: 她以非凡的堅定和冷靜處理了這場危機。

examples.en: The firmness of the mattress supports your back well.
examples.zh: 這張床墊的堅固度能很好地支撐你的背部。

examples.en: The teacher extolled the benefits of reading every day.
examples.zh: 老師頌揚了每天閱讀的好處。

examples.en: Critics extol her latest novel as a masterpiece.
examples.zh: 評論家稱讚她的最新小說是傑作。

examples.en: The caterpillar's metamorphosis into a butterfly takes weeks.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲蛻變成蝴蝶需要數週時間。

examples.en: The old factory underwent a metamorphosis into an art gallery.
examples.zh: 這座舊工廠經歷了蛻變，成為一家藝廊。

examples.en: The crowd clamoured for the singer to return to the stage.
examples.zh: 群眾大聲要求歌手回到舞台上。

examples.en: There was a clamour of voices outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 體育場外一片喧鬧的人聲。

examples.en: Birds flit from branch to branch in the garden.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在花園裡從一根樹枝掠過另一根。

examples.en: A smile flitted across her face when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 當她聽到這個消息時，一抹微笑掠過她的臉龐。

examples.en: Parenthood brings both joy and sleepless nights.
examples.zh: 為人父母帶來歡樂，也帶來不眠之夜。

examples.en: They attended a class to prepare for parenthood.
examples.zh: 他們參加了一個為人父母做準備的課程。

examples.en: Could you turn the music down just a tad?
examples.zh: 你能把音樂關小一點點嗎？

examples.en: I'm feeling a tad tired after the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後我覺得有點累。

examples.en: The federalist argued for a stronger central government.
examples.zh: 聯邦制擁護者主張建立更強大的中央政府。

examples.en: As a federalist, she supported sharing power between states and the nation.
examples.zh: 作為聯邦制擁護者，她支持州與國家之間權力共享。

examples.en: He spent a sleepless night worrying about the exam.
examples.zh: 他度過了一個不眠之夜，擔心著考試。

examples.en: The city is known as the city that never sleeps, full of sleepless energy.
examples.zh: 這座城市被稱為不夜城，充滿不眠的活力。

examples.en: Police arrested a looter who was taking goods from the damaged store.
examples.zh: 警方逮捕了一名從受損商店拿走商品的掠奪者。

examples.en: The looters fled when they heard the sirens.
examples.zh: 掠奪者聽到警報聲就逃走了。

examples.en: A sickening smell came from the garbage bin.
examples.zh: 垃圾桶散發出一股令人作嘔的氣味。

examples.en: It was sickening to watch him treat his dog so cruelly.
examples.zh: 看他如此殘忍地對待他的狗，真令人厭惡。

examples.en: The presumed cause of the fire was faulty wiring.
examples.zh: 火災的推定原因是電線故障。

examples.en: She is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
examples.zh: 在證明有罪之前，她被推定為無罪。

examples.en: They installed hardwood flooring throughout the house.
examples.zh: 他們在整棟房子裡安裝了硬木地板。

examples.en: The flooring in the kitchen is easy to clean.
examples.zh: 廚房的地板材料很容易清潔。

examples.en: When she gave me a gift, I wanted to reciprocate.
examples.zh: 當她送我禮物時，我想要回報。

examples.en: The machine's arm reciprocates rapidly between the two positions.
examples.zh: 機器手臂在兩個位置之間快速往復運動。

examples.en: The office has a backlog of paperwork to process.
examples.zh: 辦公室積壓了一批待處理的文件。

examples.en: We need to clear the backlog of orders before the holiday.
examples.zh: 我們需要在假期前清理積壓的訂單。

examples.en: The film was criticized for its orgy of violence.
examples.zh: 這部電影因無節制的暴力而受到批評。

examples.en: They indulged in an orgy of shopping during the sale.
examples.zh: 他們在拍賣期間縱情購物。

examples.en: Be careful not to splatter paint on the carpet.
examples.zh: 小心不要把油漆濺到地毯上。

examples.en: The rain splattered against the window all night.
examples.zh: 雨整夜噼裡啪啦地打在窗戶上。

examples.en: A brawl broke out among the fans after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，球迷之間爆發了爭吵。

examples.en: The two men brawled in the street until police arrived.
examples.zh: 兩名男子在街上爭吵，直到警察到來。

examples.en: A whitetail darted across the road at dusk.
examples.zh: 一隻白尾鹿在黃昏時衝過馬路。

examples.en: Whitetails are common in the forests of North America.
examples.zh: 白尾鹿在北美森林中很常見。

examples.en: The farmer sprayed insecticide on his crops to control the pests.
examples.zh: 農夫在作物上噴灑殺蟲劑來控制害蟲。

examples.en: You should wear gloves when handling this strong insecticide.
examples.zh: 處理這種強效殺蟲劑時，你應該戴上手套。

examples.en: After staying up all night, my thoughts were completely muddled.
examples.zh: 熬夜一整晚後，我的思緒完全混亂了。

examples.en: Her muddled explanation left everyone even more confused.
examples.zh: 她混亂的解釋讓大家更加困惑了。

examples.en: The integrative approach combines knowledge from different fields.
examples.zh: 這種綜合性的方法結合了不同領域的知識。

examples.en: They designed an integrative curriculum that connects science and art.
examples.zh: 他們設計了一套連結科學與藝術的整合課程。

examples.en: During the meeting, she would often interject with helpful suggestions.
examples.zh: 會議期間，她經常插話提出有用的建議。

examples.en: He couldn't help but interject a joke into the serious discussion.
examples.zh: 他忍不住在嚴肅的討論中插進一個笑話。

examples.en: She added salt and pepper from the shaker on the table.
examples.zh: 她從桌上的調味罐加了鹽和胡椒。

examples.en: The bartender used a cocktail shaker to mix the drink.
examples.zh: 酒保用雞尾酒搖杯來調製飲料。

examples.en: My forebears came to this island over two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 我的祖先在兩百多年前來到這座島上。

examples.en: Traditions passed down from our forebears are still important today.
examples.zh: 從祖先流傳下來的傳統至今仍然很重要。

examples.en: He lost one eyeglass and had to wear a patch over that eye.
examples.zh: 他掉了一片鏡片，只好在那隻眼睛上戴眼罩。

examples.en: The optician adjusted the eyeglass to fit her face better.
examples.zh: 眼鏡行調整了鏡片，讓它更貼合她的臉型。

examples.en: The strange noise outside caused her great disquiet.
examples.zh: 外面奇怪的聲響讓她非常不安。

examples.en: His sudden silence began to disquiet the whole team.
examples.zh: 他突然的沉默開始讓整個團隊感到憂慮。

examples.en: She has an abiding interest in classical music.
examples.zh: 她對古典音樂有持久的興趣。

examples.en: Their abiding friendship lasted through all the hardships.
examples.zh: 他們持久的友誼歷經所有艱難而長存。

examples.en: The factory was fined for being a major polluter of the river.
examples.zh: 那家工廠因是河流的主要污染者而被罰款。

examples.en: Environmental groups are pressuring the polluter to clean up the site.
examples.zh: 環保團體正施壓污染者清理該場地。

examples.en: He was accused of aiding and abetting the criminal's escape.
examples.zh: 他被控協助並教唆罪犯逃脫。

examples.en: She refused to abet his plan to cheat on the exam.
examples.zh: 她拒絕慫恿他考試作弊的計畫。

examples.en: The small village is a microcosm of the whole country.
examples.zh: 這個小村莊是整個國家的縮影。

examples.en: The classroom can be seen as a microcosm of society.
examples.zh: 教室可以被視為社會的縮影。

examples.en: The workmanship on this wooden chair is truly excellent.
examples.zh: 這把木椅的工藝確實非常出色。

examples.en: Visitors admired the fine workmanship of the ancient pottery.
examples.zh: 遊客們讚賞這件古代陶器的精細手藝。

examples.en: The company's profits quadrupled in just three years.
examples.zh: 公司的利潤在短短三年內成長為四倍。

examples.en: They plan to quadruple the size of the parking lot.
examples.zh: 他們計劃將停車場的面積擴大到四倍。

examples.en: She applied a soothing balm to her dry, cracked lips.
examples.zh: 她在乾裂的嘴唇上塗了舒緩的香膏。

examples.en: The good news was a balm to his worried mind.
examples.zh: 這個好消息是對他焦慮心靈的慰藉。

examples.en: The penultimate chapter of the novel reveals the big secret.
examples.zh: 小說倒數第二章揭露了重大秘密。

examples.en: In the word 'computer', the penultimate syllable is stressed.
examples.zh: 在「computer」這個字中，倒數第二個音節要重讀。

examples.en: I had no inkling that they were planning a surprise party.
examples.zh: 我完全不知道他們在計劃一個驚喜派對。

examples.en: She gave an inkling of her true feelings in that brief smile.
examples.zh: 她在那一抹短暫的微笑中微微透露了真實的感受。

examples.en: The child treated the inanimate doll as if it were alive.
examples.zh: 那孩子把沒有生命的洋娃娃當成活的一樣對待。

examples.en: Rocks and rivers are examples of inanimate objects in nature.
examples.zh: 岩石和河流是自然界中無生命物體的例子。

examples.en: He put a coin in the jukebox to play his favorite song.
examples.zh: 他投了一枚硬幣到自動唱機裡播放他最喜歡的歌。

examples.en: The old diner still has a jukebox in the corner.
examples.zh: 那家老餐館的角落裡還有一台自動唱機。

examples.en: Scientists study causality to understand how events are connected.
examples.zh: 科學家研究因果關係以了解事件是如何連結的。

examples.en: The concept of causality is central to many philosophical debates.
examples.zh: 因果關係的概念是許多哲學辯論的核心。

examples.en: The reigning champion will defend her title next month.
examples.zh: 本屆冠軍將於下個月衛冕她的頭銜。

examples.en: At that time, the reigning monarch rarely appeared in public.
examples.zh: 當時，在位的君主很少公開露面。

examples.en: The clinic offers specialized care for women of childbearing age.
examples.zh: 該診所為育齡婦女提供專門的照護。

examples.en: In some cultures, childbearing is surrounded by many rituals.
examples.zh: 在某些文化中，分娩伴隨著許多儀式。

examples.en: Yoga can help relieve somatic symptoms of stress.
examples.zh: 瑜伽有助於緩解壓力的身體症狀。

examples.en: The patient reported both somatic and psychological complaints.
examples.zh: 病人同時描述了身體和心理上的不適。

examples.en: The dancer moved with surprising agility across the stage.
examples.zh: 那位舞者以驚人的敏捷度穿過舞台。

examples.en: Training improves a dog's agility and obedience.
examples.zh: 訓練能提升狗的敏捷度和服從性。

examples.en: She remained unmoved by their emotional appeals.
examples.zh: 她對他們的情感訴求依然不為所動。

examples.en: The heavy statue stood unmoved for centuries.
examples.zh: 那座沉重的雕像數百年來屹立不搖。

examples.en: She wore a veiled hat to the formal event.
examples.zh: 她戴了一頂蒙著面紗的帽子參加正式活動。

examples.en: His veiled criticism was difficult to interpret.
examples.zh: 他含蓄的批評令人難以解讀。

examples.en: Regular stretching keeps your muscles supple.
examples.zh: 定期伸展能保持肌肉柔軟。

examples.en: The supple leather of the jacket felt luxurious.
examples.zh: 那件夾克的柔軟皮革觸感奢華。

examples.en: After the party, the living room was a shambles.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，客廳一片凌亂。

examples.en: The project turned into a shambles due to poor planning.
examples.zh: 由於規劃不周，該專案變得一團糟。

examples.en: The garden has a woody fragrance after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨後花園散發著木質的香氣。

examples.en: This plant develops woody stems as it matures.
examples.zh: 這種植物成熟時會長出木質莖。

examples.en: He received hateful messages online and felt threatened.
examples.zh: 他在網路上收到仇恨訊息，感到受到威脅。

examples.en: It was hateful of them to spread such rumors.
examples.zh: 他們散布這種謠言真是可惡。

examples.en: The rigidity of the metal frame makes it very durable.
examples.zh: 金屬框架的剛性使其非常耐用。

examples.en: His rigidity on the issue prevented any compromise.
examples.zh: 他在這個問題上的僵化態度阻礙了任何妥協。

examples.en: They laughed heartily at the comedian's jokes.
examples.zh: 他們對喜劇演員的笑話開懷大笑。

examples.en: I heartily recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting the area.
examples.zh: 我衷心向任何到訪該地區的人推薦這家餐廳。

examples.en: The choreography for the musical was both complex and beautiful.
examples.zh: 這部音樂劇的編舞既複雜又優美。

examples.en: She studied choreography at a prestigious dance academy.
examples.zh: 她在一所著名的舞蹈學院學習編舞。

examples.en: He stared absently out the window during the meeting.
examples.zh: 會議期間他心不在焉地盯著窗外。

examples.en: She absently played with her hair while thinking.
examples.zh: 她思考時心不在焉地撥弄頭髮。

examples.en: Their relationship was built on lies and deceit.
examples.zh: 他們的關係建立在謊言和欺騙之上。

examples.en: He was accused of deceit in his business dealings.
examples.zh: 他被指控在商業交易中進行詐騙。

examples.en: The manager made a conciliatory gesture by offering a refund.
examples.zh: 經理提出退款作為安撫的姿態。

examples.en: Her conciliatory tone helped calm the angry customer.
examples.zh: 她安撫的語氣有助於平息憤怒的顧客。

examples.en: The dog followed the trailing scent of the rabbit.
examples.zh: 狗循著兔子留下的氣味追蹤。

examples.en: She wore a long trailing dress to the wedding.
examples.zh: 她在婚禮上穿了一件長長的拖尾禮服。

examples.en: The infield was freshly mowed before the game.
examples.zh: 比賽前內野剛修剪過。

examples.en: He hit a ground ball that stayed in the infield.
examples.zh: 他擊出一個留在內野的滾地球。

examples.en: Her silence was taken as acquiescence to the plan.
examples.zh: 她的沉默被視為對該計畫的默許。

examples.en: The government's acquiescence to the demands surprised many.
examples.zh: 政府對這些要求的默許讓許多人感到驚訝。

examples.en: The title of the book should be written in italics.
examples.zh: 書名應該用斜體字書寫。

examples.en: She italicized the key terms to make them stand out.
examples.zh: 她將關鍵術語用斜體標示，讓它們更醒目。

examples.en: The drumming from the apartment upstairs kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 樓上公寓傳來的擊鼓聲讓我整夜睡不著。

examples.en: He has been drumming since he was a child and now plays in a band.
examples.zh: 他從小就開始打鼓，現在在一個樂團裡演奏。

examples.en: Please enunciate clearly so everyone in the audience can understand you.
examples.zh: 請清楚地發音，讓觀眾每個人都能聽懂你的話。

examples.en: The teacher enunciated the new vocabulary words slowly and carefully.
examples.zh: 老師緩慢而仔細地唸出新的單字。

examples.en: She sat by the window and brooded over her recent failure.
examples.zh: 她坐在窗邊，沉思著自己最近的失敗。

examples.en: The hen broods her eggs for about three weeks before they hatch.
examples.zh: 母雞孵蛋大約三週後小雞才會破殼。

examples.en: I like to add fresh mozzarella to my salad for extra creaminess.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在沙拉裡加入新鮮的莫札瑞拉起司，增添滑順口感。

examples.en: The pizza was topped with tomato sauce, basil, and melted mozzarella.
examples.zh: 這份披薩上鋪了番茄醬、羅勒和融化的莫札瑞拉起司。

examples.en: The custodian unlocked the school building early in the morning.
examples.zh: 管理員一大早就打開了學校大樓的門。

examples.en: As the custodian of the museum's collection, she ensures everything is properly stored.
examples.zh: 身為博物館收藏的保管人，她確保所有物品都妥善保存。

examples.en: She took copious notes during the lecture to prepare for the exam.
examples.zh: 她在講座中做了大量筆記，為考試做準備。

examples.en: The region receives copious rainfall during the summer months.
examples.zh: 這個地區在夏季月份降雨量豐沛。

examples.en: We took a ferry from Dover to Calais and continued our journey by car.
examples.zh: 我們從多佛搭渡輪到加來，然後繼續開車旅行。

examples.en: Calais is a major port city in northern France, close to the English Channel.
examples.zh: 加來是法國北部的主要港口城市，靠近英吉利海峽。

examples.en: Whether he meant to offend you is immaterial; his words were still hurtful.
examples.zh: 他是否有意冒犯你並不重要；他的話仍然傷人。

examples.en: The philosopher argued that the soul is immaterial and separate from the body.
examples.zh: 這位哲學家主張靈魂是非物質的，與身體分離。

examples.en: After the accident, she started seeing a psychotherapist to cope with anxiety.
examples.zh: 事故之後，她開始看心理治療師來應對焦慮。

examples.en: The psychotherapist helped him understand the root causes of his stress.
examples.zh: 心理治療師幫助他了解壓力的根本原因。

examples.en: He found fatherhood more rewarding than he had ever imagined.
examples.zh: 他發現為人父的喜悅遠超過他的想像。

examples.en: The book explores the challenges and joys of fatherhood in modern society.
examples.zh: 這本書探討現代社會中父親身分的挑戰與喜悅。

examples.en: The lawyer asked for a retainer before taking on the case.
examples.zh: 律師在接下案件前要求先支付聘請費。

examples.en: In the past, a wealthy family would often employ a retainer to manage their household.
examples.zh: 過去，富裕家庭常雇用侍從管理家務。

examples.en: The manager finally acceded to the employees' request for flexible hours.
examples.zh: 經理終於同意了員工彈性工時的請求。

examples.en: She acceded to the throne after her father's death.
examples.zh: 她在父親去世後繼承了王位。

examples.en: The water seethed in the pot as it reached a rolling boil.
examples.zh: 水在鍋中沸騰翻滾，達到完全沸騰的狀態。

examples.en: He was seething with anger after hearing the unfair decision.
examples.zh: 聽到不公平的決定後，他怒火中燒。

examples.en: The final exam was mentally taxing and left everyone exhausted.
examples.zh: 期末考在精神上很費力，讓每個人都筋疲力盡。

examples.en: Caring for three young children can be a taxing job.
examples.zh: 照顧三個年幼的孩子可能是一項繁重的工作。

examples.en: Outwardly, she seemed calm, but inside she was panicking.
examples.zh: 表面上她看起來很冷靜，但內心卻驚慌失措。

examples.en: The house looked outwardly charming, but it needed major repairs.
examples.zh: 這棟房子外觀上看起來很迷人，但需要大幅整修。

examples.en: The company was sold for an undisclosed amount last week.
examples.zh: 該公司上週以未公開的金額被出售。

examples.en: For security reasons, the location of the meeting remains undisclosed.
examples.zh: 出於安全考量，會議地點仍未公開。

examples.en: The scientists made a groundbreaking discovery about how cells communicate.
examples.zh: 科學家們在細胞如何溝通方面做出了開創性的發現。

examples.en: The groundbreaking ceremony for the new library will be held next month.
examples.zh: 新圖書館的動土典禮將於下個月舉行。

examples.en: He refused to be embroiled in the argument between his two friends.
examples.zh: 他拒絕捲入兩個朋友之間的爭吵。

examples.en: The country was embroiled in a lengthy trade dispute.
examples.zh: 該國捲入了一場曠日持久的貿易爭端。

examples.en: They bought a luxurious penthouse with a panoramic view of the city.
examples.zh: 他們買了一間能俯瞰城市全景的豪華頂層公寓。

examples.en: The party was held in a penthouse on the 30th floor.
examples.zh: 派對在30樓的頂層公寓舉行。

examples.en: She reached the upper echelon of the company after years of hard work.
examples.zh: 經過多年的努力，她進入了公司的高層。

examples.en: The troops marched in echelon along the road.
examples.zh: 部隊沿著道路以梯隊隊形行進。

examples.en: As a child, he spent every afternoon with his playmate from next door.
examples.zh: 小時候，他每天下午都和隔壁的玩伴一起玩。

examples.en: The puppy found a playful playmate in the mirror.
examples.zh: 小狗在鏡子裡找到了一個愛玩的玩伴。

examples.en: Her efforts to help the community were highly commendable.
examples.zh: 她幫助社區的努力非常值得讚揚。

examples.en: It is commendable that you finished the project ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 你能提前完成專案，值得讚美。

examples.en: The old castle is an archetypal example of medieval architecture.
examples.zh: 這座古堡是中世紀建築的原型範例。

examples.en: He played the archetypal hero in the movie.
examples.zh: 他在電影中扮演典型的英雄角色。

examples.en: The logistic challenges of the event required careful planning.
examples.zh: 這項活動的後勤挑戰需要仔細規劃。

examples.en: They discussed the logistic details of the shipment.
examples.zh: 他們討論了貨運的後勤細節。

examples.en: The upkeep of the garden takes a lot of time and effort.
examples.zh: 花園的維護需要花費很多時間和精力。

examples.en: They share the upkeep costs of the building equally.
examples.zh: 他們平均分攤這棟建築的維修費用。

examples.en: Children are often too trusting of strangers.
examples.zh: 孩子們往往太容易相信陌生人。

examples.en: She gave him a trusting smile and handed over the keys.
examples.zh: 她對他露出信任的微笑，並交出了鑰匙。

examples.en: He built a strange contraption in his garage to water the plants automatically.
examples.zh: 他在車庫裡組裝了一個奇怪的裝置，用來自動澆水。

examples.en: The old contraption finally broke down after years of use.
examples.zh: 那個舊玩意兒用了多年後終於壞了。

examples.en: The sky darkened ominously before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，天空不祥地變暗了。

examples.en: He spoke ominously about the challenges ahead.
examples.zh: 他預示性地談到了未來的挑戰。

examples.en: She swatted the fly with a rolled-up newspaper.
examples.zh: 她用捲起的報紙用力打那隻蒼蠅。

examples.en: He gave the ball a powerful swat, sending it over the fence.
examples.zh: 他用力一擊，把球打過了圍欄。

examples.en: Good planning can obviate the need for last-minute changes.
examples.zh: 良好的規劃可以避免最後一刻的變更。

examples.en: The new software obviates the tedious manual entry of data.
examples.zh: 新軟體免除了繁瑣的手動資料輸入。

examples.en: The dog pushed its wet snout against my hand.
examples.zh: 狗把濕濕的鼻子湊到我的手上。

examples.en: The anteater uses its long snout to reach insects.
examples.zh: 食蟻獸用長長的鼻口部來搆到昆蟲。

examples.en: The children dabbled their feet in the cool stream.
examples.zh: 孩子們把腳伸進涼爽的小溪裡玩水。

examples.en: She dabbled in painting for a few years before focusing on sculpture.
examples.zh: 她涉獵繪畫幾年後，才專注於雕塑。

examples.en: The hot pan seared the steak to perfection.
examples.zh: 熱鍋把牛排煎得恰到好處。

examples.en: The intense sun seared the grass in the yard.
examples.zh: 烈日把院子裡的草曬焦了。

examples.en: The nesting of conditional statements can make code hard to read.
examples.zh: 條件語句的巢狀結構會讓程式碼難以閱讀。

examples.en: Proper nesting of tables improves the layout of the webpage.
examples.zh: 表格的適當巢狀可以改善網頁的版面。

examples.en: With hard work, your goals are achievable.
examples.zh: 只要努力，你的目標是可以達成的。

examples.en: The deadline seems achievable if we stay focused.
examples.zh: 如果我們保持專注，這個截止日期似乎可以完成。

examples.en: Winning the award was the highest accolade of her career.
examples.zh: 贏得這個獎項是她職業生涯中最大的榮譽。

examples.en: The chef received accolades from food critics around the world.
examples.zh: 這位廚師獲得了世界各地美食評論家的讚美。

examples.en: The evidence absolved him of any wrongdoing.
examples.zh: 證據證明他沒有犯任何錯。

examples.en: The priest absolved the penitent of his sins.
examples.zh: 神父赦免了懺悔者的罪。

examples.en: His nationalistic views often sparked heated debates.
examples.zh: 他的國家主義觀點經常引發激烈的爭論。

examples.en: The propaganda was highly nationalistic and ignored international concerns.
examples.zh: 那場宣傳帶有強烈的國家主義色彩，忽略了國際關切。

examples.en: The charing of wood produces charcoal for the grill.
examples.zh: 木材的炭化過程可產生燒烤用的木炭。

examples.en: Proper charing requires controlled temperature and limited oxygen.
examples.zh: 適當的炭化需要控制溫度和限制氧氣。

examples.en: The bug zapper zapped the mosquito instantly.
examples.zh: 捕蚊燈瞬間電死了那隻蚊子。

examples.en: She zapped through her homework in just twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 她只花了二十分鐘就迅速完成了作業。

examples.en: The stocky wrestler moved with surprising agility.
examples.zh: 那位矮壯的摔角選手動作靈活得令人驚訝。

examples.en: He is short and stocky, but very strong.
examples.zh: 他個子矮小、體格結實，但非常強壯。

examples.en: She adopted a bohemian lifestyle, living in a small apartment and painting all day.
examples.zh: 她採取了波希米亞式的生活方式，住在小公寓裡整天畫畫。

examples.en: The café attracts bohemians, artists, and writers from all over the city.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館吸引了來自全市的放浪藝術家和作家。

examples.en: The chef added spices to make the dish more palatable.
examples.zh: 廚師加了香料讓這道菜更美味。

examples.en: The manager tried to make the new policy palatable to the staff.
examples.zh: 經理試圖讓新政策更容易被員工接受。

examples.en: Water spurted from the broken pipe.
examples.zh: 水從破裂的管子噴射出來。

examples.en: He put on a spurt in the last lap and won the race.
examples.zh: 他在最後一圈衝刺，贏得了比賽。

examples.en: The meeting has been provisionally scheduled for next Friday.
examples.zh: 會議暫時定在下週五。

examples.en: She was provisionally accepted into the program pending her final transcript.
examples.zh: 她暫時被錄取進入該計畫，尚待最終成績單。

examples.en: The city's downtown revitalization project has attracted new businesses.
examples.zh: 該市市中心的復興計畫吸引了新企業。

examples.en: Community leaders discussed the revitalization of the old neighborhood.
examples.zh: 社區領袖討論了老舊社區的復興。

examples.en: The jewelry was exquisitely crafted by a local artisan.
examples.zh: 這件珠寶由當地工匠精巧地製作而成。

examples.en: Her performance was exquisitely sensitive and moving.
examples.zh: 她的表演細膩敏銳且感人。

examples.en: The country is an archipelago of more than 7,000 islands.
examples.zh: 這個國家是由七千多個島嶼組成的群島。

examples.en: We spent a week sailing around the archipelago.
examples.zh: 我們花了一週時間在群島周圍航行。

examples.en: As a connoisseur of fine art, he could spot a forgery instantly.
examples.zh: 作為一名藝術鑑賞家，他立刻就能看出偽作。

examples.en: She is a connoisseur of French wines.
examples.zh: 她是法國葡萄酒的鑑賞家。

examples.en: My fingers began to tingle in the cold.
examples.zh: 我的手指在寒冷中開始刺痛。

examples.en: She felt a tingle of excitement before the performance.
examples.zh: 表演前她感到一陣興奮的顫抖。

examples.en: The children played in the inflatable pool in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在後院的充氣泳池裡玩耍。

examples.en: They brought an inflatable mattress for camping.
examples.zh: 他們帶了充氣床墊去露營。

examples.en: The war left a scene of utter desolation.
examples.zh: 戰爭留下了徹底荒蕪的景象。

examples.en: A feeling of desolation washed over her after the loss.
examples.zh: 失去之後，一股孤寂感湧上她心頭。

examples.en: The optic nerve carries signals from the eye to the brain.
examples.zh: 視神經將訊號從眼睛傳送到大腦。

examples.en: He suffered from an optic disorder that affected his vision.
examples.zh: 他患有影響視力的視覺障礙。

examples.en: She traced her genealogy back to the 18th century.
examples.zh: 她將家譜追溯至十八世紀。

examples.en: He is studying genealogy to learn about his ancestors.
examples.zh: 他正在研究系譜學以了解他的祖先。

examples.en: The room was painted in cheery yellow tones.
examples.zh: 房間漆成令人愉快的黃色調。

examples.en: Despite the rain, she remained cheery and optimistic.
examples.zh: 儘管下雨，她依然愉快樂觀。

examples.en: The constitution establishes a system of federalism.
examples.zh: 憲法建立了聯邦制體系。

examples.en: Debates over federalism often center on the balance of power.
examples.zh: 關於聯邦制的辯論通常集中在權力平衡上。

examples.en: The team's logo was emblazoned on the jersey.
examples.zh: 球隊的標誌裝飾在球衣上。

examples.en: Her name was emblazoned in gold letters on the trophy.
examples.zh: 她的名字以金色字母頌揚在獎盃上。

examples.en: The articulated bus bends in the middle to turn corners.
examples.zh: 鉸接式公車在中間彎曲以轉彎。

examples.en: She gave an articulated explanation of the complex process.
examples.zh: 她對這個複雜過程做出了清晰的解釋。

examples.en: The hunter set a noose to catch small animals.
examples.zh: 獵人設下套索來捕捉小動物。

examples.en: He tightened the noose around the package to secure it.
examples.zh: 他拉緊包裹上的套索將其固定。

examples.en: We spotted a grouse hiding in the bushes.
examples.zh: 我們發現一隻松雞躲在灌木叢中。

examples.en: Stop grousing about the weather and enjoy the trip.
examples.zh: 別再抱怨天氣了，好好享受旅程吧。

examples.en: I often misplace my keys when I'm in a hurry.
examples.zh: 我匆忙時常常把鑰匙放錯地方。

examples.en: She misplaced the file in the wrong cabinet.
examples.zh: 她把檔案放錯了櫃子。

examples.en: He proffered his hand to help her up.
examples.zh: 他伸出手扶她起來。

examples.en: The company proffered a generous settlement to the workers.
examples.zh: 公司向工人提出優厚的和解方案。

examples.en: Her likable personality makes her popular among colleagues.
examples.zh: 她討人喜歡的個性讓她在同事間很受歡迎。

examples.en: The protagonist is a likable character with a good heart.
examples.zh: 主角是個心地善良、討人喜歡的角色。

examples.en: His pretentious remarks about art annoyed everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 他對藝術自命不凡的言論讓派對上所有人都不悅。

examples.en: They live in a pretentious mansion filled with expensive decorations.
examples.zh: 他們住在一棟充滿昂貴裝飾、自命不凡的豪宅裡。

examples.en: He was fined for a minor misdemeanour.
examples.zh: 他因輕微的輕罪而被罰款。

examples.en: Shoplifting is considered a misdemeanour in many places.
examples.zh: 在許多地方，商店盜竊被視為輕罪。

examples.en: The newspaper published lurid details of the scandal.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了醜聞的聳動細節。

examples.en: A lurid red glow came from the burning building.
examples.zh: 燃燒的建築物散發出火紅的詭異光芒。

examples.en: I bought a magazine at the newsstand on the corner.
examples.zh: 我在街角的報攤買了一本雜誌。

examples.en: The newsstand sells newspapers, snacks, and lottery tickets.
examples.zh: 那個報攤賣報紙、零食和彩券。

examples.en: The rotating fan kept the room cool.
examples.zh: 旋轉的風扇讓房間保持涼爽。

examples.en: They installed a rotating display stand for the products.
examples.zh: 他們為產品安裝了一個旋轉展示架。

examples.en: The inquisitive child asked endless questions about space.
examples.zh: 那個好問的孩子問了無數關於太空的問題。

examples.en: She gave him an inquisitive look, wondering what he meant.
examples.zh: 她好奇地看了他一眼，想知道他是什麼意思。

examples.en: His speech was incoherent after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，他的言語變得語無倫次。

examples.en: The essay was criticized for its incoherent arguments.
examples.zh: 這篇文章因論點不連貫而受到批評。

examples.en: The incessant noise from the construction site drove us crazy.
examples.zh: 建築工地不斷的噪音讓我們快瘋了。

examples.en: Her incessant complaints made everyone tired.
examples.zh: 她不停的抱怨讓大家都累了。

examples.en: A black panther was spotted in the jungle.
examples.zh: 有人在叢林裡發現一隻黑豹。

examples.en: The panther moved silently through the tall grass.
examples.zh: 那隻豹無聲地穿過高草叢。

examples.en: She felt bereft after her best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 最好的朋友搬走後，她感到失落。

examples.en: The team seemed bereft of ideas in the second half.
examples.zh: 球隊在下半場似乎缺乏想法。

examples.en: The birds flew westwards as winter approached.
examples.zh: 冬天逼近時，鳥兒向西飛去。

examples.en: They drove westwards along the coast for hours.
examples.zh: 他們沿著海岸向西開了幾個小時。

examples.en: The ten commandments are central to many religious teachings.
examples.zh: 十誡是許多宗教教義的核心。

examples.en: He followed his father's commandment to always be honest.
examples.zh: 他遵循父親的戒律，永遠誠實。

examples.en: The story of his martyrdom inspired many followers.
examples.zh: 他殉教的故事激勵了許多追隨者。

examples.en: She endured months of martyrdom caring for her sick husband.
examples.zh: 她照顧生病的丈夫，忍受了數月的磨難。

examples.en: We plodded through the deep snow to reach the cabin.
examples.zh: 我們在深雪中沉重地走著，終於到達小屋。

examples.en: He plods away at his homework every evening.
examples.zh: 他每天晚上孜孜不倦地寫作業。

examples.en: She wears a small silver crucifix around her neck.
examples.zh: 她脖子上戴著一個小銀十字架。

examples.en: A wooden crucifix hung above the altar in the old church.
examples.zh: 老教堂的祭壇上方掛著一個木製十字架。

examples.en: The marathon was a gruelling test of endurance for every runner.
examples.zh: 這場馬拉松對每位跑者來說都是折磨人的耐力考驗。

examples.en: After a gruelling day of hiking, they collapsed into their tents.
examples.zh: 經過一整天累人的健行後，他們癱倒在帳篷裡。

examples.en: Drivers who contravene the speed limit will receive a heavy fine.
examples.zh: 違反速限的駕駛將收到高額罰款。

examples.en: The company denied that its actions contravened any environmental regulations.
examples.zh: 該公司否認其行為違反了任何環保法規。

examples.en: The couple remained childless despite years of trying.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻儘管努力多年，仍然沒有孩子。

examples.en: Many childless adults choose to volunteer with youth programs.
examples.zh: 許多沒有子女的成年人選擇到青年計畫擔任志工。

examples.en: We waited in the vestibule until the auditorium doors opened.
examples.zh: 我們在前廳等候，直到禮堂的門打開。

examples.en: The vestibule of the ear contains the organs of balance.
examples.zh: 耳朵的前庭含有平衡器官。

examples.en: A bright fireball streaked across the night sky.
examples.zh: 一顆明亮的火球劃過夜空。

examples.en: The explosion sent a fireball high into the air.
examples.zh: 爆炸將一團火球送上高空。

examples.en: Cut the cucumber lengthwise into thin slices.
examples.zh: 將小黃瓜縱切成長薄片。

examples.en: The fabric has a lengthwise stripe pattern.
examples.zh: 這塊布料有縱向的條紋圖案。

examples.en: Her speech was so uplifting that the audience gave a standing ovation.
examples.zh: 她的演講如此振奮人心，以至於觀眾起立鼓掌。

examples.en: Listening to uplifting music can improve your mood.
examples.zh: 聽振奮人心的音樂可以改善你的心情。

examples.en: We had dinner at a cozy bistro near the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊一家舒適的小酒館吃晚餐。

examples.en: The bistro serves simple French dishes and wine.
examples.zh: 這家小餐館供應簡單的法國菜和葡萄酒。

examples.en: The proposal was rejected by a vote of 30 yea to 20 nay.
examples.zh: 該提案以三十票贊成對二十票反對被否決。

examples.en: It was a long, nay, exhausting journey.
examples.zh: 那是一段漫長，不僅如此，還令人疲憊的旅程。

examples.en: The ancient amphitheater could hold thousands of spectators.
examples.zh: 這座古老的圓形劇場可容納數千名觀眾。

examples.en: Students gathered in the outdoor amphitheater for the concert.
examples.zh: 學生們聚集在戶外圓形劇場參加音樂會。

examples.en: Whether the new policy will help is still a moot point.
examples.zh: 新政策是否有幫助仍是個未定的問題。

examples.en: Law students often participate in moot court competitions.
examples.zh: 法律系學生經常參加模擬法庭競賽。

examples.en: The slowness of the internet connection frustrated everyone.
examples.zh: 網路連線緩慢讓每個人都感到沮喪。

examples.en: He was criticized for the slowness of his response to the crisis.
examples.zh: 他因對危機反應遲鈍而受到批評。

examples.en: Coffee contains caffeine, a natural stimulant.
examples.zh: 咖啡含有咖啡因，一種天然的興奮劑。

examples.en: The doctor warned him against taking stimulants before bed.
examples.zh: 醫生警告他睡前不要服用興奮劑。

examples.en: The garden was filled with a profusion of colorful flowers.
examples.zh: 花園裡開滿了大量色彩繽紛的花朵。

examples.en: She offered a profusion of apologies for being late.
examples.zh: 她為遲到連連道歉。

examples.en: She performed impressively in her first piano recital.
examples.zh: 她在第一次鋼琴獨奏會上表現得令人印象深刻。

examples.en: The team finished the project impressively ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 團隊令人難忘地提前完成了專案。

examples.en: The study examines sociocultural factors affecting language learning.
examples.zh: 這項研究探討影響語言學習的社會文化因素。

examples.en: Sociocultural differences can lead to misunderstandings in business.
examples.zh: 社會文化差異可能導致商業上的誤解。

examples.en: The new department subsumes several smaller units under one director.
examples.zh: 新部門將幾個較小的單位歸入一位主管之下。

examples.en: These cases can be subsumed under a general rule.
examples.zh: 這些案例可以歸入一條通則之下。

examples.en: Her tenacious grip on the rope saved her from falling.
examples.zh: 她緊緊抓住繩子，才沒有摔下去。

examples.en: He is a tenacious negotiator who never gives up easily.
examples.zh: 他是個不屈不撓的談判者，從不輕易放棄。

examples.en: She made a batch of chocolate fudge for the party.
examples.zh: 她為派對做了一批巧克力軟糖。

examples.en: The accountant tried to fudge the numbers to avoid taxes.
examples.zh: 會計師試圖捏造數字以逃稅。

examples.en: The checker at the coat counter handed me a numbered ticket.
examples.zh: 衣帽間的服務員遞給我一張有編號的票。

examples.en: She moved her checker to the last square and won the game.
examples.zh: 她將棋子移到最後一格，贏得了比賽。

examples.en: To my grandfather, a smartphone is anathema.
examples.zh: 對我祖父來說，智慧型手機是令人厭惡的東西。

examples.en: The council pronounced an anathema against the disobedient priest.
examples.zh: 議會宣布對不服從的神父處以絕罰。

examples.en: The social worker's caseload has doubled this year.
examples.zh: 這位社工的案件量今年增加了一倍。

examples.en: With such a heavy caseload, the lawyer often works late.
examples.zh: 案件量如此繁重，這位律師經常工作到很晚。

examples.en: He let out an agonising cry when he twisted his ankle.
examples.zh: 他扭傷腳踝時發出一聲痛苦的叫喊。

examples.en: The wait for the test results was agonising.
examples.zh: 等待檢驗結果的過程十分煎熬。

examples.en: The chimney was covered with thick black soot.
examples.zh: 煙囪上覆蓋著厚厚的黑色煤煙。

examples.en: Factory smoke had sooted the windows of the old house.
examples.zh: 工廠的煙霧把老房子的窗戶燻黑了。

examples.en: The territory applied for statehood after a long debate.
examples.zh: 該領地在長期辯論後申請成為州。

examples.en: Many residents celebrated the anniversary of their statehood.
examples.zh: 許多居民慶祝他們的建州紀念日。

examples.en: The prices at that restaurant are ridiculously high.
examples.zh: 那家餐廳的價格高得荒謬。

examples.en: He was ridiculously proud of his tiny garden.
examples.zh: 他對自己小小的花園感到荒謬地自豪。

examples.en: She played a lively tune on her accordion at the party.
examples.zh: 她在派對上用她的手風琴演奏了一首輕快的曲子。

examples.en: The accordion door can be folded to save space.
examples.zh: 這扇摺疊門可以收起來以節省空間。

examples.en: Drinking enough water helps prevent dehydration during exercise.
examples.zh: 運動時喝足夠的水有助於預防脫水。

examples.en: The doctor treated the hiker for severe dehydration.
examples.zh: 醫生治療了那名登山客的嚴重脫水。

examples.en: He packed his clothes into a large duffel bag.
examples.zh: 他把衣服塞進一個大行李袋裡。

examples.en: The duffel coat is warm and perfect for winter.
examples.zh: 這件粗呢大衣很保暖，非常適合冬天。

examples.en: The company streamlined its approval process to save time.
examples.zh: 公司精簡了審核流程以節省時間。

examples.en: The new car has a sleek, streamlined design.
examples.zh: 這輛新車擁有時尚的流線型設計。

examples.en: Only a few copies of the original book are extant.
examples.zh: 原版書僅存少數幾本。

examples.en: The museum displays the oldest extant map of the region.
examples.zh: 博物館展示該地區現存最古老的地圖。

examples.en: The captain ordered the ship to turn to starboard.
examples.zh: 船長命令船向右舷轉向。

examples.en: From the starboard window, we could see the lighthouse.
examples.zh: 從右舷的窗戶，我們可以看到燈塔。

examples.en: The Concorde was known for its incredible speed.
examples.zh: 協和式客機以其驚人的速度聞名。

examples.en: People once gathered to watch the Concorde take off.
examples.zh: 人們曾經聚集起來觀看協和式客機起飛。

examples.en: The freighter carried thousands of containers across the ocean.
examples.zh: 貨船載運數千個貨櫃橫越海洋。

examples.en: A large freighter docked at the port this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一艘大型貨船停靠在港口。

examples.en: She jokingly said she could eat a whole pizza by herself.
examples.zh: 她開玩笑地說她可以自己吃掉一整塊披薩。

examples.en: He jokingly called his little brother a monster.
examples.zh: 他開玩笑地叫他的弟弟小怪物。

examples.en: Snow in April is atypical for this region.
examples.zh: 四月下雪對這個地區來說並不典型。

examples.en: The doctor noted an atypical reaction to the medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生注意到對該藥物有非典型的反應。

examples.en: The sailors were punished for their mutiny against the captain.
examples.zh: 水手們因對船長叛變而受到懲罰。

examples.en: The crew planned to mutiny if their demands were ignored.
examples.zh: 如果他們的要求被忽視，船員們計劃叛變。

examples.en: She tied a red sash around her waist.
examples.zh: 她在腰間繫了一條紅色腰帶。

examples.en: He painted the window sash white to match the walls.
examples.zh: 他把窗框漆成白色以搭配牆壁。

examples.en: The park is a protected area for many avian species.
examples.zh: 這座公園是許多鳥類物種的保護區。

examples.en: Avian flu can spread quickly among poultry.
examples.zh: 禽流感可以在家禽之間迅速傳播。

examples.en: The building was so nondescript that I walked past it twice.
examples.zh: 那棟建築物平淡無奇，我走過去兩次都沒注意到。

examples.en: He wore a nondescript gray suit to the interview.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套不起眼的灰色西裝去面試。
