examples.en: The hero's journey is a common archetype in literature.
examples.zh: 英雄之旅是文學中常見的原型。

examples.en: This building served as the archetype for many modern libraries.
examples.zh: 這棟建築成為許多現代圖書館的原型。

examples.en: The unsold tickets were offered at a discount the next day.
examples.zh: 未售出的門票隔天以折扣價出售。

examples.en: Many unsold houses remained on the market for months.
examples.zh: 許多未售出的房屋在市場上停留了數月。

examples.en: The company decided to standardise its software across all offices.
examples.zh: 該公司決定在所有辦公室統一其軟體。

examples.en: Efforts to standardise testing procedures have improved reliability.
examples.zh: 使測試程序標準化的努力提高了可靠性。

examples.en: The reclamation of the old industrial site turned it into a public park.
examples.zh: 這塊老工業用地的開墾使其變成了一座公園。

examples.en: Her reclamation from a life of crime inspired many in the community.
examples.zh: 她從犯罪生活中教化歸正，激勵了社區裡的許多人。

examples.en: The heiress donated a large portion of her fortune to charity.
examples.zh: 這位女繼承人將大部分財產捐給了慈善機構。

examples.en: As the only child, she became the heiress to the family estate.
examples.zh: 作為獨生女，她成了家族莊園的女繼承人。

examples.en: Filming of the new movie will begin next month in Taipei.
examples.zh: 這部新電影的拍攝將於下個月在台北開始。

examples.en: The director insisted on filming all the outdoor scenes at dawn.
examples.zh: 導演堅持所有戶外場景都要在黎明時拍攝。

examples.en: He noticed a hairline crack in the ceiling after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震後他注意到天花板上有條極細的裂縫。

examples.en: Her hairline was visible as she pulled her hair back tightly.
examples.zh: 當她把頭髮緊緊向後拉時，髮際線清晰可見。

examples.en: The river serves as a natural demarcation between the two counties.
examples.zh: 這條河是兩個縣之間的天然分界線。

examples.en: There is a clear demarcation between their professional and personal lives.
examples.zh: 他們的職業生活和個人生活之間有明確的界限。

examples.en: The dark clouds foreshadow a heavy storm later this evening.
examples.zh: 烏雲預示著今晚晚些時候會有場大風暴。

examples.en: The early chapters foreshadow the tragic ending of the novel.
examples.zh: 小說的早期章節預示了悲劇性的結局。

examples.en: The enormity of the crime shocked the entire nation.
examples.zh: 這起罪行的極惡程度震驚了全國。

examples.en: She was overwhelmed by the enormity of the task ahead.
examples.zh: 她被眼前任務的巨大規模所震懾。

examples.en: The survey measured attitudinal changes among young voters.
examples.zh: 這項調查測量了年輕選民態度的變化。

examples.en: Attitudinal barriers often prevent people from seeking help.
examples.zh: 態度上的障礙往往阻止人們尋求幫助。

examples.en: The workers protested against the unfairness of the new policy.
examples.zh: 工人們抗議新政策的不公平。

examples.en: She spoke out against the unfairness she had experienced at work.
examples.zh: 她公開反對自己在工作中經歷的不公正。

examples.en: The lab tested the water for fecal contamination.
examples.zh: 實驗室檢測了水中的糞便污染。

examples.en: Fecal matter can carry harmful bacteria if not properly disposed of.
examples.zh: 如果處理不當，糞便物質可能攜帶有害細菌。

examples.en: She adamantly refused to change her mind despite the pressure.
examples.zh: 儘管有壓力，她仍固執地拒絕改變主意。

examples.en: The manager adamantly denied any wrongdoing in the deal.
examples.zh: 經理堅決否認交易中有任何不當行為。

examples.en: The globular shape of the vase made it difficult to pack.
examples.zh: 這個花瓶的球狀外形使其難以包裝。

examples.en: Under the microscope, the cells appeared globular and transparent.
examples.zh: 在顯微鏡下，細胞呈現球狀且透明。

examples.en: He was diagnosed with acute bronchitis and told to rest.
examples.zh: 他被診斷出患有急性支氣管炎，並被要求休息。

examples.en: Chronic bronchitis can make breathing difficult, especially in winter.
examples.zh: 慢性支氣管炎會使呼吸困難，尤其是在冬天。

examples.en: The poet's work is deeply influenced by Eastern mysticism.
examples.zh: 這位詩人的作品深受東方神秘主義的影響。

examples.en: Some people turn to mysticism in search of spiritual meaning.
examples.zh: 有些人轉向神秘主義以尋求精神意義。

examples.en: The inflow of tourists boosted the local economy.
examples.zh: 遊客的流入促進了當地經濟。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall caused a sudden inflow of water into the reservoir.
examples.zh: 強降雨導致水庫突然進水。

examples.en: The dogwood tree blooms with beautiful white flowers in spring.
examples.zh: 山茱萸樹在春天開出美麗的白花。

examples.en: He carved a small bowl from a piece of dogwood wood.
examples.zh: 他用一塊山茱萸木刻了一個小碗。

examples.en: Chapter XIV of the book discusses the French Revolution.
examples.zh: 該書第十四章討論法國大革命。

examples.en: The clock face had Roman numerals, with XIV marking the hour.
examples.zh: 鐘面上有羅馬數字，XIV標示著那個小時。

examples.en: Her quickness in solving problems impressed the entire team.
examples.zh: 她解決問題的敏捷讓整個團隊印象深刻。

examples.en: The quickness of the cheetah allows it to catch fast prey.
examples.zh: 獵豹的迅速使它能夠捕捉快速的獵物。

examples.en: The statue stood on a marble plinth in the center of the square.
examples.zh: 雕像矗立在廣場中央的大理石底座上。

examples.en: Workers carefully lifted the column onto its stone plinth.
examples.zh: 工人們小心地將柱子抬到石製柱基上。

examples.en: The plates were stacked neatly in the cupboard.
examples.zh: 盤子整齊地疊放在櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: She has a stacked figure that turns heads.
examples.zh: 她體態豐滿，引人注目。

examples.en: Noncompliance with the safety rules may result in a fine.
examples.zh: 不遵守安全規則可能會導致罰款。

examples.en: The company was penalized for noncompliance with environmental regulations.
examples.zh: 該公司因不遵守環保法規而受到處罰。

examples.en: Bacteria help decompose dead plants and animals.
examples.zh: 細菌幫助分解死去的動植物。

examples.en: The old battery began to decompose and leak acid.
examples.zh: 舊電池開始分解並漏酸。

examples.en: The athlete faced disqualification for using a banned substance.
examples.zh: 這名運動員因使用違禁物質而面臨取消資格。

examples.en: His disqualification from the tournament surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 他被取消參賽資格讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: Her neurosis made it difficult for her to socialize.
examples.zh: 她的神經症使她難以社交。

examples.en: The therapist specializes in treating anxiety and neurosis.
examples.zh: 這位治療師專門治療焦慮和神經症。

examples.en: The street performer used mime to tell a story without words.
examples.zh: 街頭藝人用啞劇講述了一個無聲的故事。

examples.en: He likes to mime his teachers to make his friends laugh.
examples.zh: 他喜歡模仿老師來逗朋友笑。

examples.en: High absenteeism at the factory has reduced production.
examples.zh: 工廠的高曠職率導致產量下降。

examples.en: The school is trying to reduce absenteeism among students.
examples.zh: 學校正試圖減少學生的曠課現象。

examples.en: The captain allowed for leeway when plotting the course.
examples.zh: 船長在規劃航線時考慮了風壓差。

examples.en: The budget has some leeway for unexpected expenses.
examples.zh: 預算有一些餘地應付意外開支。

examples.en: The biology class performed a dissection of a frog.
examples.zh: 生物課上進行了青蛙解剖。

examples.en: Her dissection of the novel revealed hidden themes.
examples.zh: 她對這本小說的分析揭示了隱藏的主題。

examples.en: He enjoys angling in the river on weekends.
examples.zh: 他喜歡週末在河裡釣魚。

examples.en: Angling requires patience and the right equipment.
examples.zh: 釣魚需要耐心和合適的裝備。

examples.en: There is a preponderance of evidence supporting his innocence.
examples.zh: 有大量證據支持他的清白。

examples.en: The preponderance of the committee voted in favor of the proposal.
examples.zh: 委員會的多數成員投票贊成該提案。

examples.en: The hiker suffered a deep gash on his leg from a sharp rock.
examples.zh: 登山者被尖銳的石頭在腿上劃出一道很深的傷口。

examples.en: She gashed her hand while chopping vegetables.
examples.zh: 她切菜時割傷了手。

examples.en: Lithium is used in rechargeable batteries for electronics.
examples.zh: 鋰被用於電子產品的可充電電池中。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed lithium to stabilize his mood.
examples.zh: 醫生開鋰鹽來穩定他的情緒。

examples.en: I made a cheese omelette for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐做了起司煎蛋捲。

examples.en: She flipped the omelette perfectly in the pan.
examples.zh: 她在鍋裡完美地翻轉了煎蛋捲。

examples.en: The restaurant offers a sampler of its most popular dishes.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳提供最受歡迎菜餚的樣品拼盤。

examples.en: He works as a sampler at the winery, tasting each batch.
examples.zh: 他在酒廠擔任品酒師，品嚐每一批酒。

examples.en: The author wrote a foreword explaining the book's purpose.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一篇前言解釋這本書的目的。

examples.en: You should read the foreword before starting the novel.
examples.zh: 你應該在開始讀小說之前先讀前言。

examples.en: She had a foreboding that something terrible would happen.
examples.zh: 她有一種預感，覺得會發生可怕的事。

examples.en: The dark clouds filled him with a sense of foreboding.
examples.zh: 烏雲讓他充滿了不祥的預感。

examples.en: The ancient Greeks believed in a pantheon of gods and goddesses.
examples.zh: 古希臘人信仰一個由男女神祇組成的萬神殿。

examples.en: The building was designed as a pantheon to honor national heroes.
examples.zh: 這座建築被設計成紀念國家英雄的萬神殿。

examples.en: The guitarist played a catchy riff that everyone recognized.
examples.zh: 吉他手彈了一段大家都認得的動聽連復段。

examples.en: He riffed through the pages of the magazine while waiting.
examples.zh: 他等待時翻閱了雜誌的頁面。

examples.en: She tactfully pointed out the error without embarrassing him.
examples.zh: 她得體地指出錯誤，沒有讓他難堪。

examples.en: He tactfully declined the invitation to avoid conflict.
examples.zh: 他委婉地拒絕了邀請以避免衝突。

examples.en: The salmon hatchery releases thousands of young fish into the river each spring.
examples.zh: 這座鮭魚孵卵場每年春天都會將數千條幼魚放流到河裡。

examples.en: Visitors can watch chicks emerge from their shells at the hatchery.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在孵卵場觀看小雞破殼而出。

examples.en: The government accused the group of subversion after they called for a general strike.
examples.zh: 該團體呼籲全面罷工後，政府指控他們從事顛覆活動。

examples.en: Constant subversion of the company's values eventually led to its collapse.
examples.zh: 對公司價值觀的不斷破壞最終導致了它的崩潰。

examples.en: The chairwoman opened the meeting by welcoming all the new members.
examples.zh: 女主席以歡迎所有新成員來為會議揭開序幕。

examples.en: After the vote, the chairwoman announced the final decision to the board.
examples.zh: 投票結束後，女主席向董事會宣布了最終決定。

examples.en: He wrapped his fingers tightly around the hilt of the sword.
examples.zh: 他手指緊緊握住劍柄。

examples.en: The ancient dagger's hilt was decorated with tiny gold stars.
examples.zh: 這把古老匕首的刀柄上裝飾著小小的金星。

examples.en: The dentist noticed that one of my canine teeth was slightly crooked.
examples.zh: 牙醫注意到我的一顆犬齒有點歪。

examples.en: Wolves and foxes are both members of the canine family.
examples.zh: 狼和狐狸都屬於犬科動物。

examples.en: She let out a mournful sigh as she looked at the old photographs.
examples.zh: 她看著舊照片時，發出了一聲悲傷的嘆息。

examples.en: The mournful sound of the cello filled the empty hall.
examples.zh: 大提琴哀傷的聲音充滿了空蕩的大廳。

examples.en: The cloud took on an amorphous shape that resembled a giant blob.
examples.zh: 那朵雲呈現出無定形的形狀，像一個巨大的團塊。

examples.en: Without clear leadership, the group remained amorphous and ineffective.
examples.zh: 由於缺乏明確的領導，這個團體始終鬆散而無效率。

examples.en: His careless remarks drew the ire of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他輕率的言論引起了同事們的憤怒。

examples.en: She tried to calm her father's ire by apologizing sincerely.
examples.zh: 她試圖透過真誠的道歉來平息父親的怒火。

examples.en: The cook checked the larder to see if there was enough flour for bread.
examples.zh: 廚師檢查了食物儲藏室，看看是否有足夠的麵粉做麵包。

examples.en: During the storm, we relied on the well-stocked larder for our meals.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，我們靠著儲備充足的食物儲藏室來解決三餐。

examples.en: We took a streetcar downtown to visit the museum.
examples.zh: 我們搭有軌電車到市中心參觀博物館。

examples.en: The old streetcar rattled along the tracks, making a loud noise.
examples.zh: 老舊的有軌電車沿著軌道嘎嘎作響，發出很大的噪音。

examples.en: The soprano's aria brought tears to the eyes of many audience members.
examples.zh: 那位女高音的詠嘆調讓許多觀眾感動落淚。

examples.en: He practiced the difficult aria for months before the performance.
examples.zh: 他在演出前花了幾個月練習那首困難的詠嘆調。

examples.en: The teacher kept a close eye on the known troublemaker during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間，老師密切注意那個出了名的麻煩製造者。

examples.en: Don't be a troublemaker; just follow the rules and get along with others.
examples.zh: 不要當個惹麻煩的人；只要遵守規則並與他人和睦相處就好。

examples.en: They stayed at a famous ritz in Paris during their honeymoon.
examples.zh: 他們度蜜月時住在巴黎一家著名的豪華旅館。

examples.en: The party was full of glitz and ritz, with champagne and live music.
examples.zh: 那場派對充滿了浮華與奢華，有香檳和現場音樂。

examples.en: The old man's unsteady hands made it hard for him to write.
examples.zh: 那位老人不穩定的手讓他很難寫字。

examples.en: She felt unsteady on her feet after the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，她覺得腳步不穩。

examples.en: After ten years at the university, she took a sabbatical to travel.
examples.zh: 在大學任教十年後，她休了休假去旅行。

examples.en: He used his sabbatical to write a book about his research.
examples.zh: 他利用休假寫了一本關於他研究的書。

examples.en: Her operatic voice filled the theater without a microphone.
examples.zh: 她的歌劇嗓音不用麥克風就充滿了整個劇院。

examples.en: The director gave the scene an operatic intensity that surprised the cast.
examples.zh: 導演賦予這場戲歌劇般的張力，讓演員們感到驚訝。

examples.en: The doctor examined him for pain in his left testicle.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查他左側睪丸的疼痛。

examples.en: Testicular cancer is a serious disease that affects the testicles.
examples.zh: 睪丸癌是一種影響睪丸的嚴重疾病。

examples.en: Stereotyping people based on their nationality is unfair and inaccurate.
examples.zh: 根據國籍將人模式化是不公平且不準確的。

examples.en: The workshop aimed to reduce stereotyping in the workplace.
examples.zh: 這個工作坊旨在減少職場中的刻板印象。

examples.en: He opened the door for her, a small act of chivalry.
examples.zh: 他為她開門，這是個小小的騎士風度表現。

examples.en: The knights swore to uphold the code of chivalry.
examples.zh: 騎士們發誓要維護騎士精神準則。

examples.en: We rode a gondola through the canals of Venice.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘狹長小船遊覽威尼斯運河。

examples.en: The cable car's gondola swayed gently as it climbed the mountain.
examples.zh: 纜車的吊艙在爬山時輕輕搖晃。

examples.en: She left her salaried job to start her own business.
examples.zh: 她辭去領薪水的工作，自己創業。

examples.en: Most salaried workers receive their pay at the end of each month.
examples.zh: 大多數受薪員工在每月月底領薪水。

examples.en: Engineers worked hard to optimise the engine's fuel efficiency.
examples.zh: 工程師努力讓引擎的燃油效率達到最佳。

examples.en: You can optimise your sleep by keeping a regular schedule.
examples.zh: 你可以藉由維持規律作息來優化睡眠。

examples.en: The fallen tree was obstructive to traffic on the narrow road.
examples.zh: 倒下的樹阻礙了窄路上的交通。

examples.en: His obstructive attitude made the meeting last far too long.
examples.zh: 他處處阻撓的態度讓會議拖得太久。

examples.en: In the old novel, the femme fatale lured the hero into danger.
examples.zh: 在那本舊小說裡，那位致命女郎引誘男主角陷入危險。

examples.en: He introduced the woman beside him as his femme.
examples.zh: 他介紹身旁的女子是他的妻子。

examples.en: The farmer sheared the fleece from the sheep in early spring.
examples.zh: 農夫在初春時剪下羊身上的羊毛。

examples.en: Scammers fleeced elderly people out of their savings.
examples.zh: 詐騙集團騙光了老年人的積蓄。

examples.en: The lab tests showed a small amount of impurity in the water.
examples.zh: 實驗室檢驗顯示水中含有少量雜質。

examples.en: Filtering removes impurities that can damage the machine.
examples.zh: 過濾可以去除會損壞機器的雜質。

examples.en: The documentary about deep-sea life was absolutely riveting.
examples.zh: 那部關於深海生物的紀錄片實在引人入勝。

examples.en: Her riveting speech held the audience's attention for an hour.
examples.zh: 她那場引人入勝的演講讓聽眾專注了一小時。

examples.en: The defector crossed the border under cover of darkness.
examples.zh: 那名叛逃者在夜色掩護下越過邊界。

examples.en: Officials questioned the defector about conditions in his homeland.
examples.zh: 官員詢問這名變節者有關他祖國的情況。

examples.en: The storm threatened the annihilation of the tiny coastal village.
examples.zh: 那場風暴恐將徹底摧毀這座濱海小村。

examples.en: Scientists studied the annihilation of particles in the accelerator.
examples.zh: 科學家研究粒子在加速器中湮滅的現象。

examples.en: They used a pulley to lift the heavy box to the top floor.
examples.zh: 他們用滑輪把沉重的箱子吊到頂樓。

examples.en: A simple pulley changes the direction of the force you apply.
examples.zh: 簡單的滑輪會改變你所施力的方向。

examples.en: The professor deconstructed the poem line by line in class.
examples.zh: 教授在課堂上逐行拆解分析這首詩。

examples.en: Critics often deconstruct advertisements to reveal their hidden messages.
examples.zh: 評論家常解構廣告，以揭露其中隱藏的訊息。

examples.en: In the story, the hero makes a sacrificial choice to save his friends.
examples.zh: 故事中，英雄為了救朋友做出犧牲的抉擇。

examples.en: Ancient people placed sacrificial offerings at the altar.
examples.zh: 古人把祭品放在祭壇上。

examples.en: The besieged soldiers made a daring sortie at dawn.
examples.zh: 被圍困的士兵在黎明時發動大膽突擊。

examples.en: Each aircraft completed three sorties before returning to base.
examples.zh: 每架飛機在返回基地前完成了三次出擊任務。

examples.en: The villagers prayed for deliverance from the long drought.
examples.zh: 村民祈求能從長期乾旱中解脫。

examples.en: Their deliverance came when a rescue boat finally appeared.
examples.zh: 當救援船終於出現時，他們獲救了。

examples.en: The coach berated the players for their careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 教練嚴厲責罵球員們粗心的失誤。

examples.en: Don't berate yourself over one small error.
examples.zh: 別為了一個小錯誤就嚴厲責備自己。

examples.en: We set up our encampment near the river that evening.
examples.zh: 那天傍晚我們在河邊紮營。

examples.en: Soldiers returned to the encampment after the training exercise.
examples.zh: 士兵們在演習後回到營地。

examples.en: Fear of failure can live deep in the subconscious.
examples.zh: 對失敗的恐懼可能深藏在潛意識裡。

examples.en: She made a subconscious decision to avoid the busy street.
examples.zh: 她下意識地決定避開那條繁忙的街道。

examples.en: The judge's ruling brought a sense of finality to the case.
examples.zh: 法官的裁定讓這起案件有了定局的感覺。

examples.en: There was a note of finality in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的語氣中帶著一種不容再議的決斷。

examples.en: The reform was pushed by a small group of passionate ideologues.
examples.zh: 這項改革是由一小群熱情的理論家推動的。

examples.en: As a lifelong ideologue, he rarely changed his views.
examples.zh: 身為終身的空想家，他很少改變自己的看法。

examples.en: She bought a packaged salad for lunch because she was in a hurry.
examples.zh: 她因為趕時間，買了一份包裝好的沙拉當午餐。

examples.en: Packaged foods often contain more salt than fresh ones.
examples.zh: 包裝食品通常比新鮮食品含有更多鹽分。

examples.en: The medieval guildhall now serves as a museum for local history.
examples.zh: 這座中世紀的同業工會會所現在作為展示當地歷史的博物館。

examples.en: Members of the guild gathered in the guildhall to discuss the annual fair.
examples.zh: 工會成員聚集在會所裡討論年度市集的事宜。

examples.en: His disordered thoughts made it hard for him to concentrate on the exam.
examples.zh: 他思緒混亂，難以專心考試。

examples.en: After the party, the living room was disordered with cups and plates everywhere.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，客廳一片凌亂，杯盤散落各處。

examples.en: Each frond of the fern unfurled slowly as spring arrived.
examples.zh: 春天來臨時，蕨類的每一片葉子都慢慢展開。

examples.en: The palm tree's fronds swayed gently in the ocean breeze.
examples.zh: 棕櫚樹的葉子在海洋微風中輕輕搖曳。

examples.en: The swirling water in the whirlpool looked dangerous to swimmers.
examples.zh: 漩渦中翻攪的水流對游泳者來說似乎很危險。

examples.en: Leaves were swirling in the air during the windy autumn day.
examples.zh: 在多風的秋日裡，葉子在空氣中打轉。

examples.en: The team was woefully unprepared for the final match.
examples.zh: 這支球隊對決賽的準備嚴重不足。

examples.en: She woefully admitted that she had forgotten his birthday.
examples.zh: 她悲傷地承認自己忘了他的生日。

examples.en: The old viaduct carries the railway across the wide river valley.
examples.zh: 這座古老的高架橋讓鐵路橫跨寬闊的河谷。

examples.en: We stopped to admire the arches of the stone viaduct.
examples.zh: 我們停下來欣賞這座石造高架橋的拱門。

examples.en: The villain in the story had a demonic laugh that scared the children.
examples.zh: 故事中的反派發出惡魔般的笑聲，嚇壞了孩子們。

examples.en: Her demonic energy seemed to fill the room during the performance.
examples.zh: 表演期間，她那股惡魔般的能量似乎充滿了整個房間。

examples.en: As penance for his mistake, he volunteered at the shelter every weekend.
examples.zh: 為了彌補過錯，他每個週末都在收容所當志工。

examples.en: The priest assigned him a simple penance after confession.
examples.zh: 神父在告解後給他一個簡單的懺悔儀式。

examples.en: The school held a fundraising event to build a new library.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦募款活動來蓋一座新圖書館。

examples.en: Her fundraising efforts helped the charity reach its goal.
examples.zh: 她的募款努力幫助慈善機構達成目標。

examples.en: There is an old adage that says practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 有句古老的諺語說熟能生巧。

examples.en: My grandmother often quoted the adage about saving for a rainy day.
examples.zh: 我祖母常引用那句關於未雨綢繆的格言。

examples.en: He bought a warm pretzel from the street vendor.
examples.zh: 他從街頭小販那裡買了一個熱騰騰的椒鹽捲餅。

examples.en: The bakery sells pretzels in different shapes and sizes.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店賣各種形狀和大小的椒鹽捲餅。

examples.en: A new superstore opened on the edge of town last month.
examples.zh: 上個月鎮郊新開了一家超級商店。

examples.en: You can find almost anything you need at the superstore.
examples.zh: 在超級商店裡你幾乎可以找到任何需要的東西。

examples.en: She prefers a cordless vacuum for cleaning the stairs.
examples.zh: 她比較喜歡用無線吸塵器打掃樓梯。

examples.en: The cordless phone needs to be recharged every night.
examples.zh: 這支無線電話每天晚上都需要充電。

examples.en: The museum carefully researched the provenance of the ancient vase.
examples.zh: 博物館仔細研究這個古瓶的來源。

examples.en: Buyers often ask about the provenance of the artwork.
examples.zh: 買家經常詢問這件藝術品的出處。

examples.en: His hurtful comments made her cry.
examples.zh: 他傷人的評論讓她哭了。

examples.en: Spreading hurtful rumors can damage friendships.
examples.zh: 散布傷人的謠言會破壞友誼。

examples.en: The software crashed due to an incompatibility with the operating system.
examples.zh: 由於與作業系統不相容，軟體當掉了。

examples.en: Their incompatibility became obvious after they moved in together.
examples.zh: 他們同居後，彼此的不合變得顯而易見。

examples.en: He was offered a paltry sum for his old car.
examples.zh: 他的舊車只被出價一筆微薄的金額。

examples.en: The team's paltry effort led to a disappointing loss.
examples.zh: 這支球隊微不足道的努力導致了一場令人失望的敗仗。

examples.en: The island remains unspoilt by tourism.
examples.zh: 這座島嶼仍未受觀光業破壞。

examples.en: We hiked through unspoilt countryside for hours.
examples.zh: 我們在未受破壞的鄉間健行了數小時。

examples.en: The thief ran faster, but his pursuer was gaining on him.
examples.zh: 小偷跑得更快，但追趕者正逐漸逼近他。

examples.en: As a pursuer of knowledge, she never stops asking questions.
examples.zh: 作為知識的追求者，她從不停止提問。

examples.en: She gave birth to triplets last week.
examples.zh: 她上週生下了三胞胎。

examples.en: The band performed a triplet of songs from their new album.
examples.zh: 樂團表演了他們新專輯中的三首歌曲。

examples.en: The company decided to downgrade the product's quality to cut costs.
examples.zh: 公司決定降低產品品質以削減成本。

examples.en: After the scandal, the hotel was downgraded from five stars to three.
examples.zh: 醜聞發生後，這家飯店從五星級被降為三星級。

examples.en: The unending noise from the construction site drove her crazy.
examples.zh: 建築工地無止境的噪音讓她快瘋了。

examples.en: They faced an unending stream of problems during the project.
examples.zh: 他們在專案期間面臨源源不絕的問題。

examples.en: The bard sang tales of ancient heroes.
examples.zh: 吟遊詩人唱著古代英雄的故事。

examples.en: Shakespeare is often called the Bard of Avon.
examples.zh: 莎士比亞常被稱為埃文河畔的詩人。

examples.en: She reclined on the sofa and closed her eyes.
examples.zh: 她斜靠在沙發上閉目養神。

examples.en: The dentist reclined the chair to examine my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙醫把椅子放斜以檢查我的牙齒。

examples.en: A cougar was spotted near the hiking trail.
examples.zh: 在登山步道附近發現了一隻美洲獅。

examples.en: Cougars are solitary animals that roam large territories.
examples.zh: 美洲獅是獨居動物，活動範圍廣大。

examples.en: The crowd dispersed quickly after the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會結束後，人群迅速散去。

examples.en: Seeds are dispersed by the wind.
examples.zh: 種子隨風散佈。

examples.en: He felt puny compared to the professional athletes.
examples.zh: 和職業運動員相比，他覺得自己很弱小。

examples.en: The company made a puny profit this quarter.
examples.zh: 公司這季的利潤微薄。

examples.en: The cannon fired a projectile at the enemy ship.
examples.zh: 大砲向敵艦發射了一枚砲彈。

examples.en: The projectile motion of the ball can be calculated using physics.
examples.zh: 球的拋射運動可以用物理學計算。

examples.en: They took a walk along the quayside at sunset.
examples.zh: 他們在日落時沿著碼頭區散步。

examples.en: The quayside was crowded with tourists waiting for the ferry.
examples.zh: 碼頭區擠滿了等渡輪的遊客。

examples.en: The mechanic reassembled the engine after cleaning it.
examples.zh: 技師清潔引擎後重新組裝。

examples.en: The students will reassemble in the auditorium after lunch.
examples.zh: 學生們午餐後將在禮堂重新集合。

examples.en: I always treat myself to a nice dinner on payday.
examples.zh: 我總是在發薪日犒賞自己一頓美好的晚餐。

examples.en: Payday is the busiest day at the bank.
examples.zh: 發薪日是銀行最忙的日子。

examples.en: She added fresh dill to the soup for extra flavor.
examples.zh: 她在湯裡加入新鮮蒔蘿以增添風味。

examples.en: Dill is commonly used in pickling cucumbers.
examples.zh: 蒔蘿常用於醃製黃瓜。

examples.en: Momma always said to be kind to others.
examples.zh: 媽咪總是說要善待他人。

examples.en: The little boy ran to his momma when he got scared.
examples.zh: 小男孩害怕時跑向他的媽咪。

examples.en: She wore black leggings to the gym.
examples.zh: 她穿黑色綁腿褲去健身房。

examples.en: The dancer's leggings were torn during rehearsal.
examples.zh: 舞者的綁腿褲在排練時破了。

examples.en: The derivation of the word 'etymology' is from Greek.
examples.zh: 「etymology」這個字的來源是希臘文。

examples.en: His derivation of the formula was too complex for beginners.
examples.zh: 他對這個公式的推導對初學者來說太複雜了。

examples.en: The sun reached its zenith at noon.
examples.zh: 太陽在正午時到達天頂。

examples.en: Her career was at its zenith in the 1990s.
examples.zh: 她的事業在1990年代達到頂峰。

examples.en: The restaurateur greeted every guest personally at the door.
examples.zh: 這位餐館老闆在門口親自迎接每一位客人。

examples.en: After years of hard work, she became a successful restaurateur.
examples.zh: 經過多年的努力，她成為一位成功的餐館老闆。

examples.en: She wore a stylish jumpsuit to the evening party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件時尚的連衣褲去參加晚會。

examples.en: The mechanic put on a blue jumpsuit before starting work.
examples.zh: 技工在開始工作前穿上了藍色連衣褲。

examples.en: We played Scrabble all night and laughed a lot.
examples.zh: 我們整晚玩拼字遊戲，笑聲不斷。

examples.en: He scrabbled in his bag for the keys.
examples.zh: 他在袋子裡翻找鑰匙。

examples.en: The company was placed into receivership after failing to pay its debts.
examples.zh: 該公司因無力償還債務而被接管。

examples.en: During receivership, a receiver manages the company's assets.
examples.zh: 在破產管理期間，破產管理人管理公司資產。

examples.en: Despite his fame, he remained unassuming and friendly.
examples.zh: 儘管成名，他仍然謙遜友善。

examples.en: She lives in an unassuming house on the edge of town.
examples.zh: 她住在城鎮邊緣一棟不起眼的房子裡。

examples.en: The trapper checked his traps early every morning.
examples.zh: 設陷阱捕獸者每天清晨都會檢查他的陷阱。

examples.en: In the past, a trapper could make a living from selling furs.
examples.zh: 過去，設陷阱捕獸者可以靠賣毛皮維生。

examples.en: She arrived unannounced and surprised everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 她未經宣布就到來，讓派對上的每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The inspector made an unannounced visit to the factory.
examples.zh: 檢查員對工廠進行了突擊訪問。

examples.en: The farmer used a machete to clear the thick bushes.
examples.zh: 農夫用大砍刀清除茂密的灌木叢。

examples.en: He kept a machete in the shed for cutting branches.
examples.zh: 他在棚子裡放了一把大砍刀用來砍樹枝。

examples.en: The faceless corporation seemed to care only about profits.
examples.zh: 這家匿名的大企業似乎只關心利潤。

examples.en: Protesters criticized the faceless bureaucracy for ignoring their needs.
examples.zh: 抗議者批評這個沒有個性的官僚體系忽視他們的需求。

examples.en: He was a cavalier who supported the king during the war.
examples.zh: 他是戰爭期間支持國王的騎士。

examples.en: Her cavalier attitude toward safety worried her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她對安全的輕率態度讓同事們擔心。

examples.en: They stayed in a seedy hotel that smelled of smoke.
examples.zh: 他們住進一家瀰漫煙味、破爛的旅館。

examples.en: The seedy neighborhood made her feel unsafe at night.
examples.zh: 這個破舊的社區讓她在晚上感到不安全。

examples.en: Technology is not a panacea for all social problems.
examples.zh: 科技並非所有社會問題的萬靈丹。

examples.en: Some people believe that money is a panacea for unhappiness.
examples.zh: 有些人相信金錢是解決不快樂的萬能藥。

examples.en: They attended a masquerade ball wearing elegant masks.
examples.zh: 他們戴著優雅的面具參加化裝舞會。

examples.en: His kindness was just a masquerade to gain our trust.
examples.zh: 他的善意只是為了贏得我們信任的偽裝。

examples.en: The knight wore a padded acton under his armor.
examples.zh: 騎士在盔甲下穿著一件襯墊的鎧衣。

examples.en: Museum visitors can see a well-preserved acton from the 14th century.
examples.zh: 博物館參觀者可以看到一件保存完好的十四世紀鎧衣。

examples.en: Environmentalism has led to stricter laws on pollution.
examples.zh: 環境保護主義促成了更嚴格的污染法規。

examples.en: Her commitment to environmentalism inspired the whole community.
examples.zh: 她對環境保護的投入激勵了整個社區。

examples.en: The chef added chopped anchovy to the pasta sauce.
examples.zh: 廚師在義大利麵醬中加入切碎的鯷魚。

examples.en: I ordered a pizza topped with anchovies and olives.
examples.zh: 我點了一份加鯷魚和橄欖的披薩。

examples.en: The ship was repaired at the dockyard near the harbor.
examples.zh: 這艘船在港口附近的造船廠修理。

examples.en: Workers at the dockyard build and maintain large vessels.
examples.zh: 造船廠的工人建造和維護大型船隻。

examples.en: The country suffered under decades of authoritarianism.
examples.zh: 這個國家在數十年的獨裁統治下受苦。

examples.en: Citizens protested against the rise of authoritarianism.
examples.zh: 公民抗議獨裁主義的興起。

examples.en: The manning of the new office will begin next month.
examples.zh: 新辦公室的人員配備將於下個月開始。

examples.en: Proper manning of the lifeboats is essential for safety.
examples.zh: 救生艇的適當人員配備對安全至關重要。

examples.en: The team faced insurmountable obstacles but never gave up.
examples.zh: 團隊面臨難以克服的障礙，但從未放棄。

examples.en: To a determined person, few problems are truly insurmountable.
examples.zh: 對意志堅定的人來說，很少有問題是真正無法克服的。

examples.en: The court found that the company had made wrongful use of the funds.
examples.zh: 法院認定該公司不當使用了這些資金。

examples.en: She sued her former employer for wrongful dismissal.
examples.zh: 她控告前僱主不當解僱。

examples.en: A smudge of chocolate was on the corner of his mouth.
examples.zh: 他嘴角有一塊巧克力汙漬。

examples.en: Don't smudge the ink before it dries.
examples.zh: 墨水還沒乾之前不要弄髒它。

examples.en: She pulled on her wellies before stepping into the muddy garden.
examples.zh: 她穿上長筒雨靴，才踏進泥濘的花園。

examples.en: A pair of green wellies stood by the back door.
examples.zh: 後門旁放著一雙綠色的長筒雨靴。

examples.en: The outbreak of salmonella was traced to contaminated eggs.
examples.zh: 這次沙門氏菌疫情被追溯到受汙染的雞蛋。

examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly to avoid spreading salmonella.
examples.zh: 徹底洗手以避免傳播沙門氏菌。

examples.en: The overseer made sure the workers finished their tasks on time.
examples.zh: 工頭確保工人按時完成工作。

examples.en: As an overseer of the project, she reported directly to the board.
examples.zh: 身為該專案的監督人，她直接向董事會報告。

examples.en: The thieves burgled the house while the family was on vacation.
examples.zh: 小偷趁這家人度假時破門盜竊了那棟房子。

examples.en: He was arrested for trying to burgle a nearby shop.
examples.zh: 他因試圖破門盜竊附近一家商店而被逮捕。

examples.en: She always tries to outdo her classmates in every subject.
examples.zh: 她總是試圖在每個科目上超越同學。

examples.en: The new model outdoes the old one in both speed and efficiency.
examples.zh: 新機型在速度和效率上都勝過舊機型。

examples.en: The first responder at the scene was a trained paramedic.
examples.zh: 現場的第一位應變人員是一名受過訓練的救護員。

examples.en: As a quick responder, he always answers emails within an hour.
examples.zh: 他回覆迅速，總是在一小時內回覆電子郵件。

examples.en: The team gathered for a pregame meeting before the final match.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽前集合開賽前會議。

examples.en: Fans enjoyed a pregame concert outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 球迷們在體育場外享受了一場賽前演唱會。

examples.en: The spleen helps filter blood and fight certain infections.
examples.zh: 脾臟有助於過濾血液和對抗某些感染。

examples.en: He vented his spleen by writing an angry letter to the editor.
examples.zh: 他寫了一封憤怒的信給編輯來發洩怨氣。

examples.en: The resale value of the car dropped after the accident.
examples.zh: 這輛車在事故後轉售價值下降了。

examples.en: She buys vintage clothes for resale on her online store.
examples.zh: 她購買復古服裝，在自己的網路商店轉售。

examples.en: The river deposited silt along its banks after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水過後，河流在兩岸沉積了淤泥。

examples.en: Over time, the harbor silted up and became too shallow for ships.
examples.zh: 隨著時間過去，港口淤塞了，變得對船隻來說太淺了。

examples.en: The fragility of the old manuscript required careful handling.
examples.zh: 這份古老手稿的脆弱性需要小心處理。

examples.en: Her fragility after the illness worried her family.
examples.zh: 她病後的虛弱讓家人擔心。

examples.en: The prince consort attended the ceremony with the queen.
examples.zh: 親王配偶與女王一同出席了典禮。

examples.en: He was accused of consorting with known criminals.
examples.zh: 他被指控與已知的罪犯結交。

examples.en: Her dedication to teaching made her an exemplar for new teachers.
examples.zh: 她對教學的奉獻使她成為新教師的模範。

examples.en: The museum displayed an exemplar of early printing.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了一件早期印刷的標本。

examples.en: The course is assessed entirely by coursework, not exams.
examples.zh: 這門課完全以作業來評分，而不是考試。

examples.en: She spent the weekend finishing her coursework for the semester.
examples.zh: 她利用週末完成這學期的作業。

examples.en: The singer learned to modulate her voice to express emotion.
examples.zh: 這位歌手學會了調整嗓音來表達情感。

examples.en: The device modulates the signal to reduce interference.
examples.zh: 這個裝置調變訊號以減少干擾。

examples.en: Epidemiological studies help identify risk factors for disease.
examples.zh: 流行病學研究有助於找出疾病的危險因子。

examples.en: The team conducted an epidemiological survey of the outbreak area.
examples.zh: 團隊在疫情爆發地區進行了流行病學調查。

examples.en: She determinedly pursued her goal despite many setbacks.
examples.zh: 儘管遭遇許多挫折，她仍堅定地追求目標。

examples.en: He walked determinedly toward the stage to give his speech.
examples.zh: 他堅決地走向舞台發表演說。

examples.en: The bridesmaid wore a pale blue dress and carried a small bouquet.
examples.zh: 女儐相穿著淺藍色禮服，手持一小束花。

examples.en: As a bridesmaid, she helped the bride prepare for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 身為女儐相，她協助新娘準備婚禮。

examples.en: In every superhero movie, the hero has a loyal sidekick.
examples.zh: 在每部超級英雄電影中，主角都有一個忠誠的夥伴。

examples.en: My little brother has been my sidekick since we were kids.
examples.zh: 我弟弟從小就是我的夥伴。

examples.en: The evaluator gave the project a high score for creativity.
examples.zh: 評估者因為創造力而給了這個專案高分。

examples.en: As an evaluator, she must remain objective when reviewing applications.
examples.zh: 作為評估者，她在審查申請時必須保持客觀。

examples.en: The old vicarage at the end of the lane is now a bed and breakfast.
examples.zh: 巷子盡頭那棟舊牧師住宅現在是一家民宿。

examples.en: They invited the new vicar and his family to move into the vicarage.
examples.zh: 他們邀請新牧師和他的家人搬進牧師住宅。

examples.en: His deafness was caused by a childhood infection.
examples.zh: 他的耳聾是童年感染造成的。

examples.en: The doctor tested her for deafness after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故後醫生檢查她是否有耳聾。

examples.en: Proper refrigeration keeps food fresh for a longer time.
examples.zh: 適當的冷藏能讓食物保鮮更久。

examples.en: The truck uses refrigeration to transport fresh produce.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車使用冷凍設備來運送新鮮農產品。

examples.en: Hancock is the name of a famous movie starring Will Smith.
examples.zh: 《全民超人》是一部由威爾·史密斯主演的著名電影。

examples.en: My neighbor, Mr. Hancock, grows beautiful roses.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居漢考克先生種了美麗的玫瑰。

examples.en: The tight straps began to chafe against his skin.
examples.zh: 緊繃的帶子開始摩擦他的皮膚。

examples.en: She chafed at the delay and kept checking her watch.
examples.zh: 她對延誤感到惱火，不斷看手錶。

examples.en: We ordered a pitcher of margarita to share at the party.
examples.zh: 我們在派對上點了一壺瑪格麗塔來分享。

examples.en: The bartender garnished the margarita with a slice of lime.
examples.zh: 酒保在瑪格麗塔上放了一片萊姆作裝飾。

examples.en: He's been in the music biz for over twenty years.
examples.zh: 他在音樂界已經超過二十年了。

examples.en: She learned the ropes of the fashion biz quickly.
examples.zh: 她很快學會了時尚行業的竅門。

examples.en: A cold often causes a buildup of mucus in the nose.
examples.zh: 感冒常常導致鼻子裡黏液積聚。

examples.en: The body produces mucus to protect the lining of the throat.
examples.zh: 身體產生黏液來保護喉嚨內壁。

examples.en: The commercialization of the festival has changed its original spirit.
examples.zh: 這個節日的商業化改變了它原本的精神。

examples.en: Many people worry about the commercialization of children's toys.
examples.zh: 許多人擔心兒童玩具的商業化。

examples.en: The feisty little dog barked at everyone who passed by.
examples.zh: 那隻好鬥的小狗對每個經過的人吠叫。

examples.en: She's a feisty grandmother who still runs her own business.
examples.zh: 她是一位精力充沛的祖母，仍然經營自己的事業。

examples.en: A baboon sat on the rock, grooming its fur.
examples.zh: 一隻狒狒坐在岩石上梳理毛髮。

examples.en: Baboons live in large troops in the African savanna.
examples.zh: 狒狒在非洲大草原上成群結隊地生活。

examples.en: The British began to colonise Australia in the late 18th century.
examples.zh: 英國人在18世紀末開始在澳洲建立殖民地。

examples.en: Weeds quickly colonise the empty field.
examples.zh: 雜草很快佔據了這片空地。

examples.en: She decided to study botany because she loves plants.
examples.zh: 她因為熱愛植物而決定攻讀植物學。

examples.en: The botany of this island includes many rare species.
examples.zh: 這個島嶼的植物生態包含許多稀有物種。

examples.en: His clumsy attempts to dance were endearing.
examples.zh: 他笨拙的跳舞嘗試很可愛。

examples.en: The child's endearing smile won everyone's heart.
examples.zh: 那孩子可愛的笑容贏得了每個人的心。

examples.en: The target consists of several concentric circles.
examples.zh: 靶子由幾個同心圓組成。

examples.en: Concentric rings in the tree trunk show its age.
examples.zh: 樹幹中的同心環顯示了它的年齡。

examples.en: The shop has a wide frontage on the main street.
examples.zh: 這家商店在大街上有寬闊的臨街面。

examples.en: They bought a lot with 50 feet of frontage on the lake.
examples.zh: 他們買了一塊在湖邊有50英尺臨水面的地。

examples.en: Please use a disinfectant to clean the bathroom.
examples.zh: 請使用消毒劑清潔浴室。

examples.en: The hospital smells strongly of disinfectant.
examples.zh: 醫院有很濃的消毒劑味道。

examples.en: He loaded the bricks into a wheelbarrow and pushed it to the backyard.
examples.zh: 他把磚頭裝進手推車，推到後院去。

examples.en: Our old wheelbarrow has a flat tire, so we can't move the soil today.
examples.zh: 我們那台舊手推車輪胎沒氣了，所以今天沒辦法搬土。

examples.en: The tall alamo trees along the river turn golden every autumn.
examples.zh: 河邊那些高大的白楊樹每到秋天就轉為金黃色。

examples.en: A row of alamos provides welcome shade on hot summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 一整排白楊樹在炎熱的夏日午後提供涼爽的遮蔭。

examples.en: She became a full-time blogger after her travel stories went viral.
examples.zh: 她的旅遊故事爆紅之後，就成了全職部落客。

examples.en: Many bloggers earn money by recommending products they truly use.
examples.zh: 許多部落客靠推薦自己真正使用的產品來賺錢。

examples.en: Without enough water, the leaves began to shrivel and turn brown.
examples.zh: 水分不足，葉子開始枯萎變褐。

examples.en: My confidence shrivelled the moment I saw the huge crowd.
examples.zh: 我一看到大批群眾，信心就瞬間萎縮了。

examples.en: Drivers on the hot highway often mistake a mirage for a pool of water.
examples.zh: 在炎熱公路上開車的人常把海市蜃樓誤認成一灘水。

examples.en: The promise of easy money turned out to be a mirage.
examples.zh: 輕鬆賺錢的承諾結果只是一場妄想。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread tantalized everyone waiting outside the bakery.
examples.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味讓在麵包店外等候的人個個垂涎。

examples.en: Don't tantalize the dog with a treat and then refuse to give it.
examples.zh: 別拿零食逗那隻狗，最後又不給牠。

examples.en: The chairs are moulded from a single piece of strong plastic.
examples.zh: 這些椅子是用一整塊堅固塑膠模製而成的。

examples.en: Her early experiences moulded the way she treats other people.
examples.zh: 她早年的經歷塑造了她對待他人的方式。

examples.en: Cook the peppers over high heat until the skin begins to char.
examples.zh: 用大火烤甜椒，直到表皮開始燒焦。

examples.en: The hotel hires a char to clean the rooms every morning.
examples.zh: 這家旅館每天早上雇用一名雜工打掃房間。

examples.en: He arrived at the meeting looking tired and rather dishevelled.
examples.zh: 他來開會時看起來很累，而且相當衣冠不整。

examples.en: Strong wind left her hair completely dishevelled.
examples.zh: 強風把她的頭髮吹得亂蓬蓬的。

examples.en: What ails you? You've looked pale all morning.
examples.zh: 你哪裡不舒服？你整個早上臉色都很蒼白。

examples.en: Economic problems continue to ail the small coastal town.
examples.zh: 經濟問題持續困擾這座沿海小鎮。

examples.en: Researchers questioned the applicability of these results to older patients.
examples.zh: 研究人員質疑這些結果對年長病患的適用性。

examples.en: The lawyer explained the applicability of the new rule to our case.
examples.zh: 律師說明了這條新規定對我們案件的適用性。

examples.en: As a freelancer, she enjoys unfettered freedom to choose her projects.
examples.zh: 身為自由工作者，她享有不受拘束的自由來挑選案子。

examples.en: Scientists need unfettered access to data in order to verify results.
examples.zh: 科學家需要不受限制地取得資料，才能驗證結果。

examples.en: The soup had gone tepid by the time we sat down to eat.
examples.zh: 我們坐下來吃飯時，湯已經變微溫了。

examples.en: The proposal received only tepid support from the committee.
examples.zh: 這項提案只得到委員會冷淡的支持。

examples.en: She gave her brother a disapproving look when he interrupted.
examples.zh: 弟弟插嘴時，她給了他一個不贊同的眼神。

examples.en: Several disapproving voices rose from the back of the hall.
examples.zh: 禮堂後方傳來幾個反對的聲音。

examples.en: The tight bandage may constrict blood flow to the injured finger.
examples.zh: 這條緊繃的繃帶可能會阻礙受傷手指的血液循環。

examples.en: Her throat constricted with fear as she stepped onto the stage.
examples.zh: 她走上舞台時，喉嚨因恐懼而緊縮。

examples.en: The tiny bird looked completely defenseless against the strong wind.
examples.zh: 那隻小鳥在強風中看起來完全無力抵擋。

examples.en: Leaving your laptop unlocked makes your data defenseless against thieves.
examples.zh: 筆電不上鎖會讓你的資料毫無防備地暴露在竊賊面前。

examples.en: A seagull swooped down and snatched a piece of bread from the sand.
examples.zh: 一隻海鷗俯衝而下，從沙灘上叼走一塊麵包。

examples.en: Seagulls followed the fishing boat, hoping for an easy meal.
examples.zh: 海鷗跟著漁船，盼望能輕鬆飽餐一頓。

examples.en: It's unkind to belittle someone's efforts just because they failed.
examples.zh: 只因為別人失敗就貶低人家的努力，是很不厚道的。

examples.en: He tends to belittle his own achievements when talking to others.
examples.zh: 他與人交談時常會貶低自己的成就。

examples.en: Every ratepayer in the district received a notice about the new fee.
examples.zh: 這個地區的每位地方稅納稅人都收到新費用的通知。

examples.en: Local ratepayers complained that the streetlights were never repaired.
examples.zh: 當地納稅人抱怨路燈一直沒人修。

examples.en: Young children often mimick the way their parents speak.
examples.zh: 幼童常模仿父母說話的方式。

examples.en: Some birds can mimick human speech with surprising accuracy.
examples.zh: 有些鳥能出奇精確地模仿人類說話。

examples.en: Secularism ensures that the government treats all religions equally.
examples.zh: 現世主義確保政府平等對待所有宗教。

examples.en: The country's constitution is based on the principle of secularism.
examples.zh: 該國憲法建立在政教分離的原則上。

examples.en: She meekly accepted the criticism without saying a word.
examples.zh: 她溫順地接受批評，一句話也沒說。

examples.en: He meekly followed his boss's orders, afraid to speak up.
examples.zh: 他溫順地聽從老闆的命令，不敢開口。

examples.en: The zealous fans camped outside the stadium for days.
examples.zh: 熱情的粉絲在體育場外露營了好幾天。

examples.en: She is zealous about protecting the environment and volunteers every weekend.
examples.zh: 她熱衷於環境保護，每個週末都去當志工。

examples.en: This café is a popular hangout for local students.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館是當地學生常去的聚集處。

examples.en: The park became our favorite hangout after school.
examples.zh: 那個公園成了我們放學後最愛的聚集處。

examples.en: The sterilization of medical equipment is essential to prevent infections.
examples.zh: 醫療器材的消毒對於預防感染至關重要。

examples.en: Animal shelters often require sterilization of adopted pets.
examples.zh: 動物收容所通常要求對領養的寵物進行絕育。

examples.en: The storm uprooted several large trees in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 暴風雨把社區裡的幾棵大樹連根拔起。

examples.en: The war uprooted thousands of families from their homes.
examples.zh: 戰爭迫使數千個家庭逃離家園。

examples.en: The boisterous crowd cheered loudly at the concert.
examples.zh: 喧鬧的人群在音樂會上大聲歡呼。

examples.en: Their boisterous laughter could be heard from across the street.
examples.zh: 從對街就能聽到他們喧鬧的笑聲。

examples.en: The intensification of the storm forced residents to evacuate.
examples.zh: 暴風雨的增強迫使居民撤離。

examples.en: There has been an intensification of efforts to reduce pollution.
examples.zh: 減少污染的努力已經加強。

examples.en: The coastguard rescued the sailors stranded on the sinking boat.
examples.zh: 海岸警備隊救出了困在沉船上的水手。

examples.en: A coastguard officer inspected our boat before we set sail.
examples.zh: 在我們啟航前，一名海岸警備隊隊員檢查了我們的船。

examples.en: The task seemed deceptively simple, but it took hours to complete.
examples.zh: 這項任務看似簡單，卻花了好幾個小時才完成。

examples.en: The deceptively calm sea hid a strong undercurrent.
examples.zh: 看似平靜的海面下隱藏著強勁的暗流。

examples.en: The nuns spent their days in the peaceful cloister.
examples.zh: 修女們在寧靜的修道院裡度日。

examples.en: After retirement, he cloistered himself in a small village.
examples.zh: 退休後，他隱居在一個小村莊裡。

examples.en: The bacon began to sizzle in the hot pan.
examples.zh: 培根在熱鍋裡開始發出嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: You could hear the steak sizzle on the grill.
examples.zh: 你可以聽到牛排在烤架上發出嘶嘶聲。

examples.en: The photographer angled the camera to capture the sunset.
examples.zh: 攝影師調整相機角度以捕捉日落。

examples.en: The table has angled legs that give it a modern look.
examples.zh: 這張桌子有傾斜的桌腳，賦予它現代感。

examples.en: Feral cats roam the streets at night, searching for food.
examples.zh: 野貓在夜晚漫遊街頭尋找食物。

examples.en: The feral dog growled fiercely when we approached.
examples.zh: 當我們靠近時，那隻野狗兇猛地咆哮。

examples.en: She found the joke demeaning and refused to laugh.
examples.zh: 她覺得那個笑話有損人格，拒絕笑。

examples.en: Being asked to clean up after everyone felt demeaning to him.
examples.zh: 被要求清理大家留下的東西讓他覺得降低身分。

examples.en: The old tradition is still holden by the villagers.
examples.zh: 這個古老傳統仍被村民們保留著。

examples.en: The belief was holden by many generations before it faded.
examples.zh: 這個信仰在被遺忘之前被許多世代抱持著。

examples.en: The judge scheduled a pretrial conference to discuss the case.
examples.zh: 法官安排了一次審前會議來討論案件。

examples.en: During the pretrial phase, both sides exchange evidence.
examples.zh: 在審前階段，雙方交換證據。

examples.en: In the novel, the antagonist tries to ruin the hero's reputation.
examples.zh: 在小說中，對手試圖毀壞英雄的名譽。

examples.en: The drug acts as an antagonist to block the receptor.
examples.zh: 這種藥物作為拮抗劑阻斷受體。

examples.en: She bought a box of toffee as a gift for her friend.
examples.zh: 她買了一盒太妃糖作為送給朋友的禮物。

examples.en: The toffee stuck to my teeth and was hard to chew.
examples.zh: 太妃糖黏在我的牙齒上，很難咀嚼。

examples.en: The garden was decorated with terracotta pots full of flowers.
examples.zh: 花園裡裝飾著裝滿花的赤陶花盆。

examples.en: The ancient statues were made of terracotta and have survived for centuries.
examples.zh: 這些古代雕像由赤陶製成，已保存了數百年。

examples.en: The tang of fresh ginger gave the soup a pleasant kick.
examples.zh: 新鮮薑的強烈味道讓湯喝起來很過癮。

examples.en: I could detect a tang of smoke in the air after the fireworks.
examples.zh: 煙火施放後，我可以聞到空氣中有一股煙味。

examples.en: The charity provides free meals to indigent families in the area.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構提供免費餐點給該地區的貧困家庭。

examples.en: After losing his job, he found himself indigent and had to ask for help.
examples.zh: 失業後，他發現自己一貧如洗，不得不求助。

examples.en: His rationalization for being late was that the traffic was unusually heavy.
examples.zh: 他對遲到的合理化說法是交通異常擁擠。

examples.en: She used rationalization to justify buying an expensive bag she didn't need.
examples.zh: 她用合理化來解釋自己為何買了一個不需要的昂貴包包。

examples.en: The storm roiled the sea, making it dangerous for small boats.
examples.zh: 暴風雨攪動了海面，讓小船航行變得危險。

examples.en: News of the scandal roiled the usually calm office.
examples.zh: 醜聞的消息讓一向平靜的辦公室人心惶惶。

examples.en: “That went well,” she remarked dryly after the disastrous meeting.
examples.zh: 「進行得真順利。」她在災難性的會議後冷淡地說。

examples.en: He answered dryly that he had no interest in the proposal.
examples.zh: 他冷淡地回答說他對那個提案沒興趣。

examples.en: A magpie perched on the fence and chattered loudly.
examples.zh: 一隻喜鵲停在籬笆上大聲叫個不停。

examples.en: My aunt is a magpie who collects shiny buttons and old coins.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是個愛收集亮晶晶鈕扣和舊硬幣的人。

examples.en: She is studying Flemish painting at the university.
examples.zh: 她在大學研究佛蘭德繪畫。

examples.en: The museum has a fine collection of Flemish tapestries.
examples.zh: 這座博物館收藏了精美的佛蘭德掛毯。

examples.en: There was a mismatch between the job description and the actual duties.
examples.zh: 職缺描述和實際職責之間有落差。

examples.en: The two players were mismatched in skill, making the game boring.
examples.zh: 這兩名球員技巧懸殊，讓比賽很無聊。

examples.en: The police have only a sketchy description of the suspect.
examples.zh: 警方對嫌犯只有概略的描述。

examples.en: His knowledge of history is sketchy at best.
examples.zh: 他對歷史的了解充其量只是皮毛。

examples.en: The army trained local forces in counterinsurgency tactics.
examples.zh: 軍隊訓練當地部隊反叛亂戰術。

examples.en: Counterinsurgency requires winning the trust of the civilian population.
examples.zh: 反叛亂行動需要贏得平民的信任。

examples.en: The ancient temple was decorated with a frieze of warriors.
examples.zh: 這座古老神廟裝飾著一條戰士飾帶。

examples.en: A carved frieze ran along the top of the wall.
examples.zh: 牆的頂端有一條雕刻飾帶。

examples.en: The government's protectionism hurt consumers by raising prices.
examples.zh: 政府的保護主義提高價格，傷害了消費者。

examples.en: Economists warned that protectionism could lead to a trade war.
examples.zh: 經濟學家警告保護主義可能引發貿易戰。

examples.en: She spent months campaigning for stricter environmental laws.
examples.zh: 她花了幾個月時間推動更嚴格的環保法規。

examples.en: Campaigning in rural areas can be exhausting for candidates.
examples.zh: 在鄉村地區競選對候選人來說可能很累人。

examples.en: He has a fetish for collecting vintage watches.
examples.zh: 他對收集復古手錶有種狂熱。

examples.en: Some cultures treat certain stones as fetishes with magical powers.
examples.zh: 有些文化把某些石頭視為具有魔力的神物。

examples.en: A scab formed over the cut on his knee.
examples.zh: 他膝蓋上的傷口結了痂。

examples.en: The strikers shouted at the scab who crossed the picket line.
examples.zh: 罷工者對著跨越糾察線的工賊大喊。

examples.en: His taste in music is a throwback to the 1980s.
examples.zh: 他的音樂品味是八零年代的復古風。

examples.en: The new phone is a throwback to simpler designs.
examples.zh: 這款新手機回歸了較簡單的設計。

examples.en: The two devices are functionally identical, though they look different.
examples.zh: 這兩個裝置功能上完全相同，雖然外觀不同。

examples.en: Functionally, the old system still works well for our needs.
examples.zh: 就功能而言，舊系統仍能滿足我們的需求。

examples.en: Her assertiveness helped her negotiate a better salary.
examples.zh: 她的自信幫助她談到更好的薪水。

examples.en: The workshop teaches assertiveness skills for the workplace.
examples.zh: 這個工作坊教授職場上的自信表達技巧。

examples.en: Nanotechnology could revolutionize how we treat cancer.
examples.zh: 奈米技術可能徹底改變我們治療癌症的方式。

examples.en: Researchers are using nanotechnology to create stronger materials.
examples.zh: 研究人員正利用奈米技術製造更堅固的材料。

examples.en: The author wrote under a pseudonym to protect her privacy.
examples.zh: 這位作家用筆名寫作以保護隱私。

examples.en: He used a pseudonym when posting on the forum.
examples.zh: 他在論壇發文時使用假名。

examples.en: The belligerent man shouted at everyone who tried to help him.
examples.zh: 那個好鬥的男子對每個想幫他的人都大吼大叫。

examples.en: During the war, both belligerent nations refused to negotiate a cease-fire.
examples.zh: 戰爭期間，兩個交戰國都拒絕協商停火。

examples.en: The concert was a complete sellout, with every seat taken.
examples.zh: 那場演唱會完全客滿，每個座位都坐滿了人。

examples.en: Some fans called him a sellout after he signed with the rival team.
examples.zh: 他與敵隊簽約後，一些球迷稱他為背叛者。

examples.en: We should reach the campsite before sundown.
examples.zh: 我們應該在日落前抵達營地。

examples.en: The farmers always finish their work by sundown.
examples.zh: 農夫們總是在日落前完成工作。

examples.en: The purported evidence turned out to be a fake document.
examples.zh: 所謂的證據結果是一份偽造的文件。

examples.en: She denied the purported link between her company and the scandal.
examples.zh: 她否認她的公司與那樁醜聞之間有傳聞中的關聯。

examples.en: He practiced temperance in eating, avoiding rich desserts and too much coffee.
examples.zh: 他在飲食上節制，避免油膩的甜點和過量的咖啡。

examples.en: The temperance movement encouraged people to give up alcohol completely.
examples.zh: 禁酒運動鼓勵人們完全戒酒。

examples.en: The queen granted him a peerage for his years of public service.
examples.zh: 女王因他多年的公共服務而授予他貴族頭銜。

examples.en: Members of the peerage gathered in the House of Lords for the debate.
examples.zh: 貴族成員聚集在上議院進行辯論。

examples.en: The little café had a homey atmosphere with soft lights and warm colors.
examples.zh: 那間小咖啡館有柔和的燈光和溫暖的色調，氣氛很舒適。

examples.en: After a long trip, it felt homey to sleep in my own bed again.
examples.zh: 長途旅行後，能再睡在自己的床上感覺很自在。

examples.en: Instant messaging has replaced phone calls for many young people.
examples.zh: 對許多年輕人來說，即時訊息傳送已經取代了打電話。

examples.en: The company improved its messaging app to send notifications faster.
examples.zh: 該公司改良了它的訊息傳送應用程式，以更快發送通知。

examples.en: The mayor took a lot of flak for raising parking fees.
examples.zh: 市長因為調高停車費而受到很多嚴厲批評。

examples.en: During the air raid, the soldiers fired flak at the enemy planes.
examples.zh: 空襲期間，士兵們向敵機發射高射炮火。

examples.en: The boy used a catapult to launch small stones at a tin can.
examples.zh: 那個男孩用彈弓向鐵罐發射小石子。

examples.en: The steam catapult on the aircraft carrier launched jets quickly.
examples.zh: 航空母艦上的蒸汽彈射器迅速發射噴射機。

examples.en: The storyteller managed to enthrall the children with tales of dragons.
examples.zh: 說故事的人用龍的故事迷住了孩子們。

examples.en: Her beautiful singing enthralled the entire audience.
examples.zh: 她美妙的歌聲迷住了全場觀眾。

examples.en: A large branch overhangs the path, so watch your head.
examples.zh: 一根大樹枝懸垂在小徑上方，所以要小心你的頭。

examples.en: The cliff overhang provided shelter from the rain.
examples.zh: 懸崖的突出部分提供了避雨的地方。

examples.en: The maximum allowable weight for checked baggage is twenty-three kilograms.
examples.zh: 託運行李的最大允許重量是二十三公斤。

examples.en: Are these expenses allowable under the new tax rules?
examples.zh: 這些費用在新的稅務規定下可以扣除嗎？

examples.en: The captain stood aft, watching the waves behind the ship.
examples.zh: 船長站在船尾，看著船後的波浪。

examples.en: Passengers in the aft section of the plane felt more turbulence.
examples.zh: 飛機後段的乘客感受到更多亂流。

examples.en: The molding along the ceiling gave the room an elegant look.
examples.zh: 沿著天花板的線板讓房間看起來很優雅。

examples.en: He learned the art of molding clay into beautiful pots.
examples.zh: 他學會了將黏土模塑成美麗陶罐的技藝。

examples.en: The dog barked viciously at the stranger approaching the gate.
examples.zh: 那隻狗兇惡地對靠近大門的陌生人吠叫。

examples.en: She was viciously criticized online for her harmless mistake.
examples.zh: 她因為一個無傷大雅的錯誤在網路上遭到惡意批評。

examples.en: The airline added a fuel surcharge to every ticket.
examples.zh: 航空公司對每張機票加收了燃油附加費。

examples.en: They surcharge customers who pay by credit card instead of cash.
examples.zh: 他們對使用信用卡而非現金付款的顧客加收費用。

examples.en: Yoga helped her find a sense of wholeness and inner peace.
examples.zh: 瑜伽幫助她找到完整感和內心的平靜。

examples.en: The wholeness of the team depended on every member's contribution.
examples.zh: 團隊的完整性取決於每位成員的貢獻。

examples.en: The museum displays nautical charts from the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了十八世紀的航海圖。

examples.en: He enjoys reading nautical novels about life at sea.
examples.zh: 他喜歡閱讀關於海上生活的航海小說。

examples.en: He clumsily dropped the tray, spilling coffee everywhere.
examples.zh: 他笨拙地掉落了托盤，把咖啡灑得到處都是。

examples.en: She clumsily tried to fix the broken vase with tape.
examples.zh: 她笨拙地試圖用膠帶修補破掉的花瓶。

examples.en: The feathered headdress was worn by the tribal chief during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 部落酋長在儀式中戴著那頂有羽毛的頭飾。

examples.en: She bought a feathered pillow to make her bed more comfortable.
examples.zh: 她買了一個羽毛枕頭，讓床睡起來更舒服。

examples.en: He felt a twinge of pain in his knee as he climbed the stairs.
examples.zh: 他爬樓梯時感到膝蓋一陣刺痛。

examples.en: She experienced a twinge of guilt for not calling her mother.
examples.zh: 她因為沒打電話給母親而感到一絲內疚。

examples.en: The fuller used a wooden hammer to beat the cloth and make it thicker.
examples.zh: 漂洗工用木槌敲打布料，使其變厚。

examples.en: In the medieval town, the fuller was an important craftsman.
examples.zh: 在中世紀的城鎮裡，漂洗工是重要的工匠。

examples.en: The extrinsic rewards of the job, such as money, were not enough to keep her motivated.
examples.zh: 這份工作的外在獎勵，例如金錢，不足以讓她保持動力。

examples.en: His extrinsic motivation for studying was to please his parents.
examples.zh: 他讀書的外在動機是為了讓父母高興。

examples.en: She placed the vase on the sideboard in the dining room.
examples.zh: 她把花瓶放在餐廳的餐具櫃上。

examples.en: The antique sideboard has several drawers and shelves for storing dishes.
examples.zh: 這個古董餐具櫃有幾個抽屜和層架，用來存放盤子。

examples.en: The racecourse was crowded with spectators cheering for their favorite horses.
examples.zh: 賽馬場擠滿了為他們最愛的馬匹歡呼的觀眾。

examples.en: They walked along the racecourse to watch the runners train.
examples.zh: 他們沿著跑道走，觀看跑者訓練。

examples.en: The ancient fortification consisted of thick stone walls and a deep moat.
examples.zh: 這座古老的防禦工事由厚石牆和深壕溝組成。

examples.en: The army built a fortification to protect the city from attack.
examples.zh: 軍隊建造了一座要塞來保護城市免受攻擊。

examples.en: She looked at the cheap gift contemptuously and tossed it aside.
examples.zh: 她輕蔑地看了那個廉價禮物一眼，就把它丟到一邊。

examples.en: He spoke contemptuously of their efforts, saying they were useless.
examples.zh: 他輕蔑地談論他們的努力，說那些都是徒勞。

examples.en: You can leave your coat in the cloakroom near the entrance.
examples.zh: 你可以把外套放在入口附近的寄物間。

examples.en: The theater's cloakroom was full of umbrellas and jackets.
examples.zh: 劇院的寄物間裡放滿了雨傘和夾克。

examples.en: The alder trees along the riverbank provide shade and prevent erosion.
examples.zh: 河岸邊的榿木樹提供遮蔭並防止侵蝕。

examples.en: He carved a small boat out of alder wood.
examples.zh: 他用榿木雕刻了一艘小船。

examples.en: The military junta seized power in a coup and suspended the constitution.
examples.zh: 軍事執政團在政變中奪取政權並中止憲法。

examples.en: Citizens protested against the junta's oppressive policies.
examples.zh: 公民抗議執政團的壓迫性政策。

examples.en: The band's bassist played a steady rhythm that kept the song together.
examples.zh: 樂團的低音提琴手演奏穩定的節奏，讓歌曲保持完整。

examples.en: She is a talented bassist who has performed with several jazz groups.
examples.zh: 她是一位才華橫溢的低音提琴手，曾與幾個爵士樂團合作演出。

examples.en: The hookup between the generator and the building was completed by an electrician.
examples.zh: 發電機與建築物之間的連線由電工完成。

examples.en: They arranged a hookup for the concert to be broadcast live on radio.
examples.zh: 他們安排了連線，讓音樂會在廣播中現場直播。

examples.en: The quilt on the bed is her handiwork, made over several months.
examples.zh: 床上的被子是她的手工，花了幾個月製成。

examples.en: The wooden toys displayed in the shop are local handiwork.
examples.zh: 店裡展示的木製玩具是當地的手工藝品。

examples.en: We sat on the verandah, enjoying the cool evening breeze.
examples.zh: 我們坐在陽臺上，享受涼爽的晚風。

examples.en: The old house has a wide verandah with rocking chairs.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有一個寬敞的走廊，上面放著搖椅。

examples.en: The baseball player caught the ball with his mitt.
examples.zh: 棒球運動員用手套接住了球。

examples.en: She put on her mitts to protect her hands from the cold.
examples.zh: 她戴上連指手套，保護雙手免受寒冷。

examples.en: The ticket is transferable, so you can give it to a friend.
examples.zh: 這張票是可轉讓的，所以你可以給朋友。

examples.en: Skills learned in this course are transferable to many jobs.
examples.zh: 從這門課程學到的技能可以轉移到許多工作上。

examples.en: The untrained staff made several mistakes during the busy period.
examples.zh: 未經訓練的員工在忙碌時段犯了幾個錯誤。

examples.en: An untrained eye might not notice the subtle differences in the paintings.
examples.zh: 未經訓練的眼睛可能不會注意到畫作中的細微差異。

examples.en: The steel mill produces large amounts of slag as a byproduct.
examples.zh: 鋼鐵廠產生大量熔渣作為副產品。

examples.en: Workers removed the slag from the surface of the molten metal.
examples.zh: 工人從熔融金屬表面去除熔渣。

examples.en: She baked a batch of scones for the afternoon tea.
examples.zh: 她烤了一批烤餅，準備下午茶。

examples.en: He spread butter and jam on his scone.
examples.zh: 他在烤餅上塗了奶油和果醬。

examples.en: She polished the silverware until it gleamed.
examples.zh: 她把銀器擦得閃閃發亮。

examples.en: The restaurant uses real silverware, not plastic.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳使用真正的銀器，而不是塑膠餐具。

examples.en: The crew had to jettison some cargo to keep the ship afloat.
examples.zh: 船員必須拋棄一些貨物以保持船隻浮在水面。

examples.en: They jettisoned the old plan and started fresh.
examples.zh: 他們拋棄了舊計畫，重新開始。

examples.en: The farmer put a yoke on the oxen to plow the field.
examples.zh: 農夫給牛套上軛來耕田。

examples.en: The people struggled under the yoke of oppression.
examples.zh: 人民在壓迫的束縛下掙扎。

examples.en: The letter was addressed to John Smith, Esquire.
examples.zh: 這封信寄給約翰·史密斯先生。

examples.en: In medieval times, an esquire served a knight.
examples.zh: 在中世紀，一位紳士服侍騎士。

examples.en: A buzzard circled high above the field.
examples.zh: 一隻禿鷹在田野上空盤旋。

examples.en: The old buzzard sat on the fence all afternoon.
examples.zh: 那隻老鷹整個下午都停在籬笆上。

examples.en: The pronoun must agree with its antecedent.
examples.zh: 代名詞必須與其先行詞一致。

examples.en: Historians study the antecedents of the war.
examples.zh: 歷史學家研究戰爭的前因。

examples.en: Much to her chagrin, she failed the exam.
examples.zh: 令她非常懊惱的是，她考試不及格。

examples.en: He was chagrined by his mistake.
examples.zh: 他因自己的錯誤而感到懊惱。

examples.en: The parasitic worm lives in the host's intestine.
examples.zh: 這種寄生蟲生活在宿主的腸道裡。

examples.en: He had a parasitic relationship with his wealthy relatives.
examples.zh: 他與富有的親戚保持著寄生般的關係。

examples.en: The dragon is a mythological creature.
examples.zh: 龍是神話中的生物。

examples.en: She studied mythological stories from ancient Greece.
examples.zh: 她研究古希臘的神話故事。

examples.en: An observant reader will notice the clue.
examples.zh: 觀察力敏銳的讀者會注意到這個線索。

examples.en: They are observant of the rules.
examples.zh: 他們嚴格遵守規則。

examples.en: His gruff voice scared the children.
examples.zh: 他粗啞的聲音嚇到了孩子們。

examples.en: She gave a gruff reply and walked away.
examples.zh: 她粗魯地回答後就走開了。

examples.en: The interrelationship between the two species is complex.
examples.zh: 這兩個物種之間的相互關係很複雜。

examples.en: We studied the interrelationship of mind and body.
examples.zh: 我們研究了身心之間的相互關係。

examples.en: The boat glided slowly through the bayou.
examples.zh: 小船緩緩滑過支流。

examples.en: Cypress trees grow along the bayou.
examples.zh: 柏樹沿著支流生長。

examples.en: The child began to pout when told no.
examples.zh: 孩子被拒絕時開始撅嘴。

examples.en: She had a pout on her face after the argument.
examples.zh: 爭吵後她臉上帶著撅嘴的表情。

examples.en: The villain gave a malevolent smile.
examples.zh: 反派露出惡意的微笑。

examples.en: A malevolent force seemed to haunt the house.
examples.zh: 一股邪惡的力量似乎縈繞著這棟房子。

examples.en: The city has a multiracial population.
examples.zh: 這座城市有多種族的人口。

examples.en: They promote multiracial harmony in schools.
examples.zh: 他們在學校推廣多種族和諧。

examples.en: The fairground was filled with rides and games.
examples.zh: 露天市場裡滿是遊樂設施和遊戲。

examples.en: We walked around the fairground all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在露天市場閒逛。

examples.en: Mix the oil and water to form an emulsion.
examples.zh: 將油和水混合形成乳狀液。

examples.en: The film is coated with a light-sensitive emulsion.
examples.zh: 底片上塗有感光乳劑。

examples.en: The fullback scored the winning touchdown.
examples.zh: 後衛達陣得分，贏得了比賽。

examples.en: He plays fullback on the school team.
examples.zh: 他在校隊中擔任後衛。

examples.en: Her determination to finish the marathon seemed unstoppable.
examples.zh: 她完成馬拉松的決心似乎無法阻擋。

examples.en: The team's unstoppable offense led them to victory.
examples.zh: 那支球隊無法阻擋的攻勢帶領他們走向勝利。

examples.en: A small copse of trees provided shade for the picnic.
examples.zh: 一小片矮林為野餐提供了陰涼。

examples.en: They walked through the copse, listening to birds singing.
examples.zh: 他們走過矮林，聽著鳥兒歌唱。

examples.en: The philosopher pondered the nature of nothingness and existence.
examples.zh: 哲學家思考著虛無與存在的本質。

examples.en: His promises turned out to be nothingness; he never intended to help.
examples.zh: 他的承諾結果只是空話；他從未打算幫忙。

examples.en: The young pianist is a virtuoso who performs with incredible skill.
examples.zh: 這位年輕鋼琴家是一位技藝精湛的大師，表演技巧令人難以置信。

examples.en: Her virtuoso performance on the violin left the audience in awe.
examples.zh: 她精湛的小提琴表演讓觀眾驚嘆不已。

examples.en: The child pasted a cutout of a star onto the card.
examples.zh: 孩子把一顆星星的剪紙貼在卡片上。

examples.en: The electrician replaced the cutout to prevent a short circuit.
examples.zh: 電工更換了保險開關以防止短路。

examples.en: The employee sought reinstatement after being unfairly dismissed.
examples.zh: 該員工在被不公平解僱後尋求復職。

examples.en: The reinstatement of the old policy surprised many people.
examples.zh: 舊政策的恢復讓許多人感到驚訝。

examples.en: The bishop consecrated the new church in a solemn ceremony.
examples.zh: 主教在莊嚴的儀式中將新教堂奉獻給神。

examples.en: She consecrated her life to helping the poor.
examples.zh: 她將一生奉獻給幫助窮人。

examples.en: Convection currents in the ocean help distribute heat around the globe.
examples.zh: 海洋中的對流有助於在全球範圍內分配熱量。

examples.en: The pot of water heated quickly due to convection.
examples.zh: 由於對流，那鍋水很快就熱了。

examples.en: She felt hurt when he snubbed her at the party.
examples.zh: 當他在派對上冷落她時，她感到受傷。

examples.en: His snub of the invitation was considered rude.
examples.zh: 他對邀請的怠慢被認為是無禮的。

examples.en: The dispersion of seeds by the wind is common in many plants.
examples.zh: 風傳播種子在許多植物中很常見。

examples.en: The dispersion of light through a prism creates a rainbow.
examples.zh: 光通過稜鏡的色散會產生彩虹。

examples.en: The foursome played golf together every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 這四人組每個星期六早上一起打高爾夫球。

examples.en: A foursome of friends rented a car for the road trip.
examples.zh: 四個朋友租了一輛車去公路旅行。

examples.en: The subtext of their conversation suggested they were hiding something.
examples.zh: 他們談話的潛台詞暗示他們在隱瞞什麼。

examples.en: There was a political subtext in the movie that many missed.
examples.zh: 電影中有一個許多人沒注意到的政治潛台詞。

examples.en: The company was criticized for using sweatshops to produce cheap clothes.
examples.zh: 該公司因使用血汗工廠生產廉價服裝而受到批評。

examples.en: Workers in the sweatshop labored long hours for very low pay.
examples.zh: 血汗工廠的工人以極低的工資長時間勞動。

examples.en: The bank threatened to foreclose on the house if payments were not made.
examples.zh: 銀行威脅如果不付款就要取消房屋的抵押品贖回權。

examples.en: They foreclosed on the property after months of missed payments.
examples.zh: 在數月未付款後，他們取消了該房產的抵押品贖回權。

examples.en: The unanticipated delay caused us to miss our flight.
examples.zh: 意外的延誤導致我們錯過了航班。

examples.en: Her unanticipated visit was a pleasant surprise.
examples.zh: 她意想不到的來訪是一個愉快的驚喜。

examples.en: The government planned the resettlement of families affected by the flood.
examples.zh: 政府計劃重新安置受洪水影響的家庭。

examples.en: The resettlement of the refugees took several months.
examples.zh: 難民的重新定居花了幾個月的時間。

examples.en: The incandescent bulb gave off a warm, bright light.
examples.zh: 白熾燈泡發出溫暖明亮的光。

examples.en: Her incandescent smile lit up the room.
examples.zh: 她燦爛的笑容照亮了整個房間。

examples.en: A tiny wren perched on the branch, singing cheerfully.
examples.zh: 一隻小小的鷦鷯停在樹枝上，歡快地唱著歌。

examples.en: We spotted a wren building its nest in the hedge.
examples.zh: 我們發現一隻鷦鷯在樹籬中築巢。

examples.en: The normalization of relations between the two countries took years.
examples.zh: 兩國關係的正常化花了數年時間。

examples.en: Data normalization is an important step in database design.
examples.zh: 資料正規化是資料庫設計中的重要步驟。

examples.en: The gestation period for elephants is about 22 months.
examples.zh: 大象的妊娠期約為22個月。

examples.en: The project was in gestation for two years before it launched.
examples.zh: 該項目在推出前醞釀了兩年。

examples.en: The braking subsystem must be tested before the entire vehicle is approved.
examples.zh: 在整輛車獲得核准之前，必須先測試煞車子系統。

examples.en: Engineers found a minor error in one subsystem of the satellite.
examples.zh: 工程師在衛星的其中一個子系統中發現了一個小錯誤。

examples.en: A wild primrose bloomed beside the forest path in early spring.
examples.zh: 初春時，一朵野生報春花在森林小徑旁綻放。

examples.en: She planted primroses along the garden border for a splash of yellow.
examples.zh: 她在花園邊界種了報春花，增添一抹黃色。

examples.en: The novel is an allegorical tale about the struggle between good and evil.
examples.zh: 這本小說是關於善惡鬥爭的寓言故事。

examples.en: His paintings often contain allegorical figures representing virtues and vices.
examples.zh: 他的畫作常包含代表美德與惡習的寓言人物。

examples.en: The group's militancy worried moderate members who preferred dialogue.
examples.zh: 該團體的戰鬥性讓偏好對話的溫和成員感到擔憂。

examples.en: Rising militancy among workers led to more frequent strikes.
examples.zh: 工人之間日益高漲的戰鬥性導致罷工更加頻繁。

examples.en: His teasing remarks made her laugh, but she knew he was joking.
examples.zh: 他逗弄的話讓她笑了，但她知道他在開玩笑。

examples.en: The teasing itch of a mosquito bite kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 蚊子咬的惱人癢感讓我整夜睡不著。

examples.en: Dammit, I forgot my keys again!
examples.zh: 該死，我又忘了帶鑰匙！

examples.en: Turn down the music, dammit; I'm trying to study.
examples.zh: 把音樂關小，該死；我正在試著讀書。

examples.en: The foregoing chapters have explained the basic principles of physics.
examples.zh: 前述章節已經解釋了物理學的基本原理。

examples.en: Based on the foregoing evidence, the committee reached its conclusion.
examples.zh: 根據前述證據，委員會達成了結論。

examples.en: A jogger passed by the park every morning at six.
examples.zh: 一位慢跑者每天早上六點經過公園。

examples.en: The jogger stopped to tie his shoelace during the run.
examples.zh: 慢跑者在跑步途中停下來綁鞋帶。

examples.en: The hiker's legs were scratched by brambles along the trail.
examples.zh: 登山客的腿被小徑旁的荊棘刮傷了。

examples.en: Blackberries grow on brambles that can quickly take over a garden.
examples.zh: 黑莓長在荊棘上，而荊棘可能很快佔據整個花園。

examples.en: The city was under leaguer for months before it finally surrendered.
examples.zh: 這座城市被圍攻數月後終於投降。

examples.en: As a longtime leaguer, she attended every meeting and event.
examples.zh: 作為長期的盟員，她參加了每一次會議和活動。

examples.en: She asked the stylist to marcel her hair for the party.
examples.zh: 她請造型師為派對把她的頭髮燙成波浪形鬈髮。

examples.en: The old photograph showed her with a perfect marcel.
examples.zh: 那張舊照片顯示她留著完美的波浪形鬈髮。

examples.en: After a week at the beach, he returned with deeply tanned skin.
examples.zh: 在海灘待了一週後，他回來時皮膚曬得很黑。

examples.en: The tanned leather felt soft and durable.
examples.zh: 鞣製過的皮革摸起來柔軟又耐用。

examples.en: The Zealander shared stories about growing up on the island.
examples.zh: 這位西蘭島民分享了在島上長大的故事。

examples.en: As a proud Zealander, he often visited the coastal towns.
examples.zh: 身為驕傲的西蘭島民，他經常造訪沿海城鎮。

examples.en: The toddler tottered across the room toward her mother.
examples.zh: 學步的孩子蹣跚地穿過房間走向媽媽。

examples.en: The old fence tottered in the strong wind but did not fall.
examples.zh: 舊籬笆在強風中搖搖欲墜，但沒有倒下。

examples.en: She folded the pushchair and put it in the car trunk.
examples.zh: 她折疊好嬰兒車，放進汽車後車廂。

examples.en: A father pushed a sleeping baby in a pushchair through the mall.
examples.zh: 一位父親推著嬰兒車，載著熟睡的嬰兒穿過購物中心。

examples.en: We hiked to the top of the tor to enjoy the view.
examples.zh: 我們健行到石山山頂欣賞風景。

examples.en: The ancient tor stood alone on the windswept hill.
examples.zh: 古老的石山孤零零地矗立在受風吹拂的山丘上。

examples.en: I received an unsolicited email offering a free vacation.
examples.zh: 我收到一封未經請求的電子郵件，提供免費假期。

examples.en: She gave me some unsolicited advice about my career.
examples.zh: 她給了我一些關於我職業生涯的主動建議。

examples.en: The embattled CEO faced tough questions from the board.
examples.zh: 這位受圍攻的執行長面臨董事會的嚴厲質詢。

examples.en: The embattled castle walls showed signs of repeated attacks.
examples.zh: 嚴陣以待的城牆顯示出多次攻擊的痕跡。

examples.en: The referee disallowed the goal because of an offside call.
examples.zh: 裁判因越位判決而駁回進球。

examples.en: The court disallowed the evidence obtained illegally.
examples.zh: 法院拒絕接受非法取得的證據。

examples.en: The soldier opened the breech of the rifle to check for any remaining cartridges.
examples.zh: 士兵打開步槍的後膛，檢查是否有殘留的子彈。

examples.en: In older firearms, the breech had to be cleaned carefully after each use.
examples.zh: 在較舊的槍械中，每次使用後都必須仔細清潔後膛。

examples.en: Please check the expiration date on the milk before you buy it.
examples.zh: 購買牛奶前，請檢查上面的有效期限。

examples.en: The expiration of the contract means we need to negotiate a new one.
examples.zh: 合約到期意味著我們需要協商一份新合約。

examples.en: He accidentally belched during the quiet dinner, which embarrassed him.
examples.zh: 他在安靜的晚餐中不小心打了嗝，這讓他很尷尬。

examples.en: The volcano began to belch smoke and ash into the sky.
examples.zh: 火山開始向天空噴出煙霧和火山灰。

examples.en: She muttered an expletive when she realized she had forgotten her keys.
examples.zh: 當她發現忘了帶鑰匙時，她低聲咒罵了一句。

examples.en: In poetry, an expletive can be used to maintain the meter without adding meaning.
examples.zh: 在詩歌中，語助詞可以用來維持格律而不增加意義。

examples.en: Always wear gloves when handling corrosive chemicals like strong acids.
examples.zh: 處理強酸等腐蝕性化學品時，一定要戴手套。

examples.en: His corrosive remarks slowly damaged the team's morale.
examples.zh: 他尖酸刻薄的言論慢慢損害了團隊的士氣。

examples.en: Raleigh is the capital city of North Carolina in the United States.
examples.zh: 羅利是美國北卡羅萊納州的首府。

examples.en: Many tourists visit Raleigh to explore its museums and parks.
examples.zh: 許多遊客造訪羅利，探索它的博物館和公園。

examples.en: She had to slog through the heavy rain to get to work on time.
examples.zh: 她不得不冒著大雨跋涉，才能準時上班。

examples.en: The team slogged away at the project for weeks before seeing results.
examples.zh: 團隊為這個專案苦幹了好幾週才看到成果。

examples.en: He wore a comfortable tracksuit for his morning jog in the park.
examples.zh: 他穿著舒適的運動服在公園晨跑。

examples.en: Athletes often wear a tracksuit to stay warm before a race.
examples.zh: 運動員經常穿著運動服，在比賽前保持溫暖。

examples.en: He was awarded a knighthood for his services to science.
examples.zh: 他因對科學的貢獻而被授予騎士爵位。

examples.en: In medieval times, a knighthood was granted after years of training.
examples.zh: 在中世紀，騎士身分是在多年訓練後授予的。

examples.en: I unintentionally deleted the important file while cleaning up my computer.
examples.zh: 我在清理電腦時無意中刪除了那個重要檔案。

examples.en: She unintentionally hurt his feelings with her honest comment.
examples.zh: 她誠實的評論無意中傷了他的感情。

examples.en: The two companies decided to formalize their partnership with a written agreement.
examples.zh: 兩家公司決定以書面協議正式確立他們的合作關係。

examples.en: We need to formalize the procedures so everyone follows the same rules.
examples.zh: 我們需要將程序正式化，以便每個人都遵循相同的規則。

examples.en: The tainted meat was recalled from stores due to health concerns.
examples.zh: 由於健康顧慮，受汙染的肉品已從商店召回。

examples.en: His reputation was tainted by the scandal, even though he was innocent.
examples.zh: 儘管他是無辜的，他的名譽仍因醜聞而受損。

examples.en: She studied poetics to better understand the structure of classical poems.
examples.zh: 她研究詩學，以更了解古典詩的結構。

examples.en: The professor's lecture on poetics explored the rhythm and imagery of modern verse.
examples.zh: 教授關於詩學的講座探討了現代詩的節奏和意象。

examples.en: After the long hike, a deep weariness settled over the group.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，一股深深的疲倦籠罩了整個隊伍。

examples.en: The weariness in her eyes showed how hard she had been working.
examples.zh: 她眼中的疲倦顯示出她工作有多麼辛苦。

examples.en: The authorship of the anonymous novel remains a mystery to this day.
examples.zh: 那本匿名小說的作者身分至今仍是個謎。

examples.en: She claimed authorship of the idea, but others disputed it.
examples.zh: 她聲稱這個想法是她提出的，但其他人對此有爭議。

examples.en: Try not to be judgmental about other people's choices without knowing their situation.
examples.zh: 在不了解他人處境的情況下，盡量不要對他們的選擇妄加評判。

examples.en: His judgmental tone made it difficult for others to share their opinions.
examples.zh: 他評判性的語氣讓其他人難以分享意見。

examples.en: The midpoint of the line segment is exactly halfway between the two endpoints.
examples.zh: 線段的中點正好在兩個端點之間的一半位置。

examples.en: We reached the midpoint of our journey after driving for five hours.
examples.zh: 開了五小時車後，我們到達了旅程的中點。

examples.en: His renunciation of the throne shocked the entire kingdom.
examples.zh: 他放棄王位震驚了整個王國。

examples.en: The monk's renunciation of worldly possessions brought him inner peace.
examples.zh: 那位僧侶放棄世俗財物，為他帶來了內心的平靜。

examples.en: The artist used geometrical shapes like circles and triangles in her painting.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家在畫作中使用了圓形和三角形等幾何圖形。

examples.en: The building's geometrical design features sharp angles and clean lines.
examples.zh: 這棟建築的幾何設計以銳角和簡潔線條為特色。

examples.en: The tracker followed the deer's footprints through the forest.
examples.zh: 追蹤者循著鹿的足跡穿越森林。

examples.en: Using a satellite tracker, scientists monitored the bird's migration route.
examples.zh: 科學家利用衛星追蹤器監測這隻鳥的遷徙路線。

examples.en: The country ended conscription and moved to an all-volunteer military.
examples.zh: 該國廢除徵兵制，改為全志願役軍隊。

examples.en: During the war, conscription forced many young men to leave their families.
examples.zh: 戰爭期間，徵兵迫使許多年輕人離開家人。

examples.en: The festival attracted a motley crowd of artists, tourists, and locals.
examples.zh: 慶典吸引了由藝術家、遊客和當地人組成的混雜人群。

examples.en: The jester wore a motley costume of red, yellow, and green patches.
examples.zh: 小丑穿著由紅、黃、綠布塊拼成的雜色服裝。

examples.en: The slaughterhouse is inspected regularly to ensure humane treatment of animals.
examples.zh: 屠宰場定期接受檢查，以確保動物受到人道對待。

examples.en: Residents complained about the smell coming from the slaughterhouse nearby.
examples.zh: 居民抱怨附近屠宰場傳來的氣味。

examples.en: The pilgrims traveled for days to reach the site known for its holiness.
examples.zh: 朝聖者旅行數日，以抵達以神聖著稱的聖地。

examples.en: His Holiness will address the crowd from the balcony at noon.
examples.zh: 教宗將於中午從陽台向群眾發表談話。

examples.en: Adaptability is crucial for survival in rapidly changing environments.
examples.zh: 在快速變化的環境中，適應性對生存至關重要。

examples.en: Employers value adaptability when hiring for dynamic roles.
examples.zh: 雇主在招聘動態職位時重視適應能力。

examples.en: The gymnast performed a flawless routine on the balance beam.
examples.zh: 體操運動員在平衡木上表演了一套完美的動作。

examples.en: As a young gymnast, she practiced for hours every day.
examples.zh: 作為一名年輕的體操運動員，她每天練習數小時。

examples.en: The textbook includes a glossary of key terms at the end.
examples.zh: 這本教科書在末尾附有關鍵術語的詞彙表。

examples.en: Please refer to the glossary if you encounter unfamiliar vocabulary.
examples.zh: 如果你遇到不熟悉的詞彙，請參考詞彙表。

examples.en: The prisoners were kept in a dark dungeon beneath the castle.
examples.zh: 囚犯被關在城堡下方黑暗的地牢裡。

examples.en: Exploring the old dungeon was the highlight of our castle tour.
examples.zh: 探索古老的地牢是我們城堡之旅的亮點。

examples.en: Koalas feed almost exclusively on eucalyptus leaves.
examples.zh: 無尾熊幾乎只以桉樹葉為食。

examples.en: The scent of eucalyptus filled the spa room.
examples.zh: 水療室裡充滿了桉樹的香氣。

examples.en: The annal records the major events of the kingdom year by year.
examples.zh: 這部編年史逐年記錄了王國的重大事件。

examples.en: Historians studied the annal for clues about the ancient battle.
examples.zh: 歷史學家研究這部編年史，以尋找關於古代戰役的線索。

examples.en: The model strutted down the catwalk in a stunning red gown.
examples.zh: 模特兒穿著一件驚豔的紅色禮服，昂首闊步走過伸展台。

examples.en: Workers used the narrow catwalk to access the bridge's support beams.
examples.zh: 工人利用狹窄的通道到達橋樑的支撐樑。

examples.en: It was disingenuous of him to claim he had no prior knowledge of the plan.
examples.zh: 他聲稱事先不知道這個計畫，這樣說很不誠實。

examples.en: Her disingenuous smile made me doubt her true intentions.
examples.zh: 她虛偽的笑容讓我懷疑她的真實意圖。

examples.en: The machine granulates the plastic waste into small pellets.
examples.zh: 這台機器將塑膠廢料粉碎成小顆粒。

examples.en: As the wound heals, the tissue begins to granulate.
examples.zh: 傷口癒合時，組織開始形成肉芽。

examples.en: The company raised prices to forestall a hostile takeover.
examples.zh: 該公司提高價格以預先阻止惡意收購。

examples.en: She tried to forestall criticism by explaining her decision early.
examples.zh: 她試圖提早解釋她的決定，以先發制人地阻止批評。

examples.en: The gumbo recipe calls for fresh okra and shrimp.
examples.zh: 這道秋葵濃湯的食譜需要新鮮秋葵和蝦子。

examples.en: Okra can be slimy when cooked, but frying makes it crispy.
examples.zh: 秋葵烹煮後可能會有黏液，但油炸會讓它變脆。

examples.en: The library's annexe houses its rare book collection.
examples.zh: 圖書館的附屬建築存放著它的珍本書籍。

examples.en: They built a small annexe to accommodate growing staff.
examples.zh: 他們建造了一個小型附屬建築，以容納不斷增加的員工。

examples.en: She felt a sense of pride as she entered womanhood.
examples.zh: 當她步入成年女子的階段時，她感到一種自豪。

examples.en: The ceremony celebrates the transition from girlhood to womanhood.
examples.zh: 這個儀式慶祝從少女時期到成年女子的轉變。

examples.en: The hydroelectric plant supplies power to thousands of homes.
examples.zh: 水力發電廠為數千戶家庭供電。

examples.en: Building a hydroelectric dam can have significant environmental impacts.
examples.zh: 建造水力發電水壩可能會對環境產生重大影響。

examples.en: The kaiser ruled the empire with absolute authority until the revolution.
examples.zh: 皇帝以絕對權威統治帝國，直到革命爆發。

examples.en: Historians still debate how the kaiser's decisions shaped modern Europe.
examples.zh: 歷史學家仍在爭論皇帝的決策如何形塑現代歐洲。

examples.en: She topped the lemon tart with a cloud of toasted meringue.
examples.zh: 她在檸檬塔上擠了一大團烤過的蛋白霜。

examples.en: Whipping the egg whites to stiff peaks is essential for a perfect meringue.
examples.zh: 將蛋白打發至硬性發泡是做出完美蛋白霜的關鍵。

examples.en: The cliffs are slowly eroding because of constant wave action.
examples.zh: 由於海浪不斷拍打，懸崖正慢慢被侵蝕。

examples.en: Public trust in the institution has been eroding for years.
examples.zh: 民眾對該機構的信任多年來一直在削弱。

examples.en: The poet wrote an ode to the beauty of the changing seasons.
examples.zh: 詩人寫了一首頌詩，讚美四季變換之美。

examples.en: In English class, we analyzed Keats's ode to a nightingale.
examples.zh: 在英文課上，我們分析了濟慈的〈夜鶯頌〉。

examples.en: He's always been touchy about his height, so don't bring it up.
examples.zh: 他對自己的身高一直很敏感，所以別提這件事。

examples.en: Negotiating the contract turned out to be a touchy process.
examples.zh: 協商這份合約的過程結果相當棘手。

examples.en: She added a natural sweetener to her coffee instead of sugar.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡裡加了天然代糖，而不是砂糖。

examples.en: The company offered a cash bonus as a sweetener to attract new employees.
examples.zh: 公司提供現金獎金作為誘因，以吸引新員工。

examples.en: People born under Aires are often described as energetic and bold.
examples.zh: 白羊座出生的人常被形容為精力充沛且大膽。

examples.en: My best friend is an Aires, and she loves starting new projects.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友是白羊座，她熱愛展開新計畫。

examples.en: For breakfast, I had a bowl of yogurt with fresh papaya.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了一碗優格配新鮮番木瓜。
