examples.en: The protein consists of several subunits that assemble into a complex.
examples.zh: 這個蛋白質由幾個次單元組成，組合成一個複合體。

examples.en: Each subunit of the enzyme plays a specific role in catalysis.
examples.zh: 該酶的每個次單元在催化作用中扮演特定角色。

examples.en: A standard light bulb emits about 800 lumens.
examples.zh: 一個標準燈泡發出約800流明的光。

examples.en: The doctor examined the lumen of the artery for any blockages.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查動脈的管腔是否有任何阻塞。

examples.en: The orator captivated the audience with her powerful speech.
examples.zh: 這位演說家以她有力的演講迷住了聽眾。

examples.en: He was known as a skilled orator who could persuade any crowd.
examples.zh: 他被認為是一位技巧高超的演說家，能說服任何群眾。

examples.en: Prostaglandins play a key role in inflammation and pain.
examples.zh: 攝護腺素在發炎和疼痛中扮演關鍵角色。

examples.en: The drug works by blocking the production of prostaglandin.
examples.zh: 這種藥物透過阻斷攝護腺素的產生來發揮作用。

examples.en: Scientists are still investigating the pathogenesis of the disease.
examples.zh: 科學家仍在研究這種疾病的發病機制。

examples.en: Understanding pathogenesis is crucial for developing effective treatments.
examples.zh: 了解發病機制對於開發有效治療至關重要。

examples.en: She wore a pleated skirt that swayed as she walked.
examples.zh: 她穿著一條百褶裙，走路時裙擺搖曳。

examples.en: The curtains were pleated to give the room an elegant look.
examples.zh: 窗簾打了褶，讓房間看起來更優雅。

examples.en: The jacquard loom revolutionized the textile industry in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 提花機在19世紀徹底改變了紡織業。

examples.en: This jacquard fabric features an intricate floral pattern.
examples.zh: 這塊提花織物有精緻的花卉圖案。

examples.en: They moved to suburbia to raise their children in a quieter environment.
examples.zh: 他們搬到郊區，在更安靜的環境中養育孩子。

examples.en: Suburbia often represents a lifestyle centered around family and community.
examples.zh: 郊區生活通常代表以家庭和社區為中心的生活方式。

examples.en: The company decided to litigate rather than settle the dispute.
examples.zh: 公司決定提起訴訟，而不是和解。

examples.en: They are litigating over the ownership of the property.
examples.zh: 他們正在為財產所有權打官司。

examples.en: The assignee will receive all rights to the patent.
examples.zh: 受讓人將獲得該專利的所有權利。

examples.en: As the assignee of the contract, she is responsible for its obligations.
examples.zh: 作為合同的受讓人，她負責履行其義務。

examples.en: He placed the vinyl record on the turntable and lowered the needle.
examples.zh: 他把黑膠唱片放在唱盤上，然後放下唱針。

examples.en: The DJ skillfully scratched on the turntable to hype up the crowd.
examples.zh: DJ技巧性地在唱盤上刮擦，讓群眾嗨起來。

examples.en: The children waited expectantly for the magician to pull a rabbit from his hat.
examples.zh: 孩子們期待地等著魔術師從帽子裡變出一隻兔子。

examples.en: She looked at him expectantly, hoping he would say yes.
examples.zh: 她期待地看著他，希望他會答應。

examples.en: Investing in that startup is a dicey proposition.
examples.zh: 投資那家新創公司是個冒險的提議。

examples.en: Driving in the fog can be dicey, so please be careful.
examples.zh: 在霧中開車可能很危險，所以請小心。

examples.en: The medial nerve runs down the center of the arm.
examples.zh: 正中神經沿著手臂中央向下延伸。

examples.en: In this word, the stress falls on the medial syllable.
examples.zh: 在這個字中，重音落在中間的音節。

examples.en: She sewed a tiny sequin onto each star in the costume.
examples.zh: 她在戲服的每顆星星上縫了一小片亮片。

examples.en: A single sequin fell off her dress and glittered on the floor.
examples.zh: 一片亮片從她的洋裝上掉落，在地板上閃閃發光。

examples.en: His reticence about his past made everyone curious.
examples.zh: 他對自己的過去保持沉默，讓大家都很好奇。

examples.en: She listened with polite reticence, offering no opinion.
examples.zh: 她禮貌地沉默聆聽，沒有發表意見。

examples.en: She wore a sleeveless dress to the summer party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件無袖洋裝去參加夏日派對。

examples.en: This sleeveless top is perfect for hot weather.
examples.zh: 這件無袖上衣非常適合炎熱的天氣。

examples.en: The rebels agreed to capitulate after a long siege.
examples.zh: 叛軍在長期圍困後同意投降。

examples.en: Don't capitulate to their demands without a fight.
examples.zh: 不要未經抗爭就向他們的要求屈服。

examples.en: Aargh! I forgot my keys again.
examples.zh: 啊！我又忘記帶鑰匙了。

examples.en: Aargh, this traffic is driving me crazy!
examples.zh: 啊，這交通快把我逼瘋了！

examples.en: The botched repair job made the leak even worse.
examples.zh: 搞砸的修理工作讓漏水變得更嚴重。

examples.en: His botched attempt at baking a cake was a disaster.
examples.zh: 他烤蛋糕的失敗嘗試真是一場災難。

examples.en: She felt vengeful after her colleague took credit for her work.
examples.zh: 同事搶了她的功勞後，她心生報復之意。

examples.en: A vengeful person often finds it hard to forgive.
examples.zh: 復仇心重的人往往難以原諒別人。

examples.en: Their meeting at the airport was purely coincidental.
examples.zh: 他們在機場相遇純屬巧合。

examples.en: It was coincidental that both teams wore the same colors.
examples.zh: 兩隊穿相同顏色的球衣只是巧合。

examples.en: The apical bud of the plant produces new leaves.
examples.zh: 植物的頂芽會長出新葉。

examples.en: Dentists often examine the apical region of the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫經常檢查牙齒的根尖區域。

examples.en: She joined a workgroup to improve office communication.
examples.zh: 她加入了一個工作組來改善辦公室溝通。

examples.en: The workgroup meets every Monday to discuss progress.
examples.zh: 工作組每週一開會討論進度。

examples.en: The embalmer carefully prepared the body for the funeral.
examples.zh: 屍體防腐師仔細地為葬禮準備遺體。

examples.en: An embalmer needs steady hands and a strong stomach.
examples.zh: 屍體防腐師需要穩定的手和強健的腸胃。

examples.en: The novel humanizes the soldiers by showing their daily struggles.
examples.zh: 這本小說透過描寫士兵的日常掙扎來賦予他們人性。

examples.en: Good leaders humanize the workplace by listening to employees.
examples.zh: 好的領導者會傾聽員工的心聲，讓職場更有人情味。

examples.en: The collie herded the sheep into the pen.
examples.zh: 柯利牧羊犬把羊群趕進圍欄裡。

examples.en: Our neighbor's collie is friendly and very smart.
examples.zh: 我們鄰居的柯利牧羊犬很友善，而且非常聰明。

examples.en: A canyon is a dramatic landform created by erosion.
examples.zh: 峽谷是侵蝕作用形成的壯觀地形。

examples.en: Students learned about different landforms in geography class.
examples.zh: 學生在地理課上認識了各種不同的地形。

examples.en: The capacitance of this capacitor is measured in microfarads.
examples.zh: 這個電容器的電容以微法拉為單位。

examples.en: Changing the distance between the plates affects capacitance.
examples.zh: 改變板極之間的距離會影響電容。

examples.en: The forecast warned of sleet and icy roads overnight.
examples.zh: 天氣預報警告夜間會有雨夾雪和道路結冰。

examples.en: It started to sleet just as we left the house.
examples.zh: 我們才剛出門就開始下起雨夾雪。

examples.en: Grandma used lard to make the pie crust flaky.
examples.zh: 奶奶用豬油讓派皮變得酥脆。

examples.en: The recipe calls for two tablespoons of lard.
examples.zh: 這個食譜需要兩大匙豬油。

examples.en: According to Freud, the superego acts as our conscience.
examples.zh: 根據佛洛伊德的理論，超自我扮演我們良心的角色。

examples.en: A strong superego can make a person feel guilty easily.
examples.zh: 強烈的超自我會讓人容易感到內疚。

examples.en: Allergies cause the body to release histamine.
examples.zh: 過敏會使身體釋放組織胺。

examples.en: Antihistamines block the effects of histamine.
examples.zh: 抗組織胺藥物會阻斷組織胺的作用。

examples.en: She carefully unwrapped the gift and found a beautiful scarf inside.
examples.zh: 她小心地拆開禮物，發現裡面是一條漂亮的圍巾。

examples.en: The children left their unwrapped presents under the tree until Christmas morning.
examples.zh: 孩子們把未拆封的禮物留在樹下，直到聖誕節早上。

examples.en: Cubism, pioneered by Picasso and Braque, revolutionized the way artists represented form and space.
examples.zh: 立體主義由畢卡索和布拉克開創，徹底改變了藝術家表現形式和空間的方式。

examples.en: The museum's new exhibit features several works of cubism from the early 20th century.
examples.zh: 博物館的新展覽展出了幾件二十世紀初的立體主義作品。

examples.en: Learning common collocations like "make a decision" can help you sound more natural in English.
examples.zh: 學習像「make a decision」這樣的常見搭配詞，能讓你的英文聽起來更自然。

examples.en: The teacher asked students to find the best collocation for each verb in the exercise.
examples.zh: 老師要學生在練習中為每個動詞找出最恰當的搭配詞。

examples.en: She felt a tightness in her chest and decided to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 她感到胸口緊繃，決定去看醫生。

examples.en: The tightness of the budget forced the team to cancel several planned activities.
examples.zh: 預算的緊縮迫使團隊取消了好幾項計畫中的活動。

examples.en: Scientists used radiocarbon dating to determine the age of the ancient wooden artifact.
examples.zh: 科學家利用放射性碳定年法來判定這件古代木製工藝品的年齡。

examples.en: The level of radiocarbon in the atmosphere can be affected by human activities.
examples.zh: 大氣中的放射性碳含量會受到人類活動的影響。

examples.en: His unintentional comment hurt her feelings, though he didn't mean to.
examples.zh: 他無心的評論傷了她的感情，儘管他並非故意。

examples.en: Many unintentional injuries at home can be prevented with simple safety measures.
examples.zh: 許多在家中發生的非故意傷害，可以透過簡單的安全措施來預防。

examples.en: The neutralisation of the acid with a base produced water and a salt.
examples.zh: 酸與鹼的中和作用產生了水和鹽。

examples.en: The country's neutralisation was guaranteed by a treaty signed by several major powers.
examples.zh: 該國的中立地位由幾個大國簽署的條約保障。

examples.en: The police launched a manhunt for the suspect who escaped from custody.
examples.zh: 警方對逃脫拘留的嫌犯展開搜捕。

examples.en: After a three-day manhunt, the fugitive was finally caught near the border.
examples.zh: 經過三天的搜捕，逃犯終於在邊境附近被捕。

examples.en: Each person inherits one allele for eye color from each parent.
examples.zh: 每個人從父母各遺傳一個眼睛顏色的等位基因。

examples.en: A dominant allele can mask the expression of a recessive one.
examples.zh: 顯性等位基因會掩蓋隱性等位基因的表現。

examples.en: In hemoglobin, the iron ion acts as a binding site for the oxygen ligand.
examples.zh: 在血紅蛋白中，鐵離子作為氧配體的結合位點。

examples.en: The ligand binds to the receptor and triggers a cellular response.
examples.zh: 配體與受體結合，並引發細胞反應。

examples.en: The dog ran amok through the garden, knocking over flower pots and scattering tools.
examples.zh: 那隻狗在花園裡橫衝直撞，撞倒花盆、弄散工具。

examples.en: After the announcement, the crowd went amok, shouting and pushing in all directions.
examples.zh: 宣布之後，群眾失控了，四處叫喊推擠。

examples.en: The dog sat on its haunches and waited patiently for a treat.
examples.zh: 那隻狗蹲坐在後腿上，耐心地等著點心。

examples.en: The chef roasted a haunch of venison for the special dinner.
examples.zh: 主廚為特別晚餐烤了一隻鹿腿肉。

examples.en: The cytoplasmic membrane controls what enters and exits the cell.
examples.zh: 細胞質膜控制物質進出細胞。

examples.en: Certain proteins are transported to the cytoplasmic side of the organelle.
examples.zh: 某些蛋白質會被運送到胞器的細胞質側。

examples.en: The hen clucked softly to call her chicks back to the coop.
examples.zh: 母雞輕聲咯咯叫，叫小雞回到雞舍。

examples.en: He clucked his tongue in disapproval when he saw the mess.
examples.zh: 他看到一團亂時，不贊同地嘖了一聲。

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with ventricular arrhythmia after the heart test.
examples.zh: 心臟檢查後，病人被診斷出心室心律不整。

examples.en: Ventricular enlargement can be a sign of certain neurological conditions.
examples.zh: 腦室擴大可能是某些神經系統疾病的徵兆。

examples.en: The material's high reflectance makes it suitable for use in solar panels.
examples.zh: 這種材料的高反射率使其適合用於太陽能板。

examples.en: Scientists measured the reflectance of the surface to determine its composition.
examples.zh: 科學家測量表面的反射率，以判定其成分。

examples.en: She likes to strum her guitar on the porch in the evening.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在傍晚時在門廊上隨意彈彈吉他。

examples.en: He strummed a few chords before starting the song.
examples.zh: 他先彈了幾個和弦，然後開始唱這首歌。

examples.en: The parietal bones form the sides and roof of the skull.
examples.zh: 頂骨構成頭骨的兩側和頂部。

examples.en: The parietal pleura lines the inner surface of the chest cavity.
examples.zh: 壁層胸膜襯在胸腔的內表面。

examples.en: Some people turn to homoeopathy for chronic conditions when conventional medicine fails.
examples.zh: 當傳統醫學無效時，有些人會轉向順勢療法來治療慢性病。

examples.en: The principle of homoeopathy is that like cures like.
examples.zh: 順勢療法的原則是「以同治同」。

examples.en: The wrecked ship was found near the rocky coast.
examples.zh: 那艘失事的船在岩石海岸附近被發現。

examples.en: After the accident, his car was completely wrecked.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，他的車子完全報廢了。

examples.en: He was puffing on a cigar while reading the newspaper.
examples.zh: 他一邊看報紙，一邊抽著雪茄。

examples.en: The puffing of the old engine could be heard from afar.
examples.zh: 老引擎的噴氣聲從遠處就能聽到。

examples.en: The cropped field was ready for the next planting season.
examples.zh: 這片種過作物的田地已準備好迎接下一個播種季。

examples.en: She wore a cropped jacket that matched her jeans.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件短版外套，和她的牛仔褲很搭。

examples.en: You can try the shareware version before buying the full software.
examples.zh: 你可以先試用試用版軟體，再決定是否購買完整版。

examples.en: Many shareware programs ask for a small fee to unlock extra features.
examples.zh: 許多試用軟體會要求支付小額費用來解鎖額外功能。

examples.en: The project was carried out under the aegis of the local government.
examples.zh: 該計畫在地方政府的贊助下進行。

examples.en: She felt safe under the aegis of her mentor.
examples.zh: 在導師的庇護下，她感到安全。

examples.en: Don't scuff your new shoes on the rough pavement.
examples.zh: 不要在人行道上磨損你的新鞋。

examples.en: He scuffed his feet as he walked, making a scraping sound.
examples.zh: 他走路時拖著腳，發出刮擦聲。

examples.en: Hybridization of different plant species can produce stronger offspring.
examples.zh: 不同植物物種的雜交可以產生更強壯的後代。

examples.en: Scientists studied the hybridization of these two bird species.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了這兩種鳥類的雜交。

examples.en: She used a magnifying glass to read the tiny print.
examples.zh: 她用放大鏡來閱讀微小的字體。

examples.en: The magnifying effect of the lens made the insect look huge.
examples.zh: 鏡頭的放大效果讓昆蟲看起來很大。

examples.en: The reverb in the concert hall made the music sound richer.
examples.zh: 音樂廳的混響讓音樂聽起來更豐富。

examples.en: You can adjust the reverb to create a sense of space.
examples.zh: 你可以調整混響來營造空間感。

examples.en: As is his wont, he arrived early to the meeting.
examples.zh: 一如他的習慣，他提早到達會議。

examples.en: She was wont to take a walk after dinner.
examples.zh: 她習慣在晚餐後散步。

examples.en: The picture on the wall was hanging askew.
examples.zh: 牆上的畫歪斜地掛著。

examples.en: He straightened his tie, which had gone askew.
examples.zh: 他把歪掉的領帶扶正。

examples.en: The insulating material helps keep the house warm in winter.
examples.zh: 隔熱材料有助於在冬天保持室內溫暖。

examples.en: They installed insulating tape around the pipes to prevent heat loss.
examples.zh: 他們在管道周圍安裝了絕緣膠帶以防止熱量流失。

examples.en: She was heartbroken when her pet dog passed away.
examples.zh: 她的寵物狗過世時，她心碎了。

examples.en: He looked heartbroken after hearing the bad news.
examples.zh: 聽到壞消息後，他看起來心碎不已。

examples.en: Her vindictive comments hurt everyone at the table.
examples.zh: 她懷恨的評論傷害了餐桌上的每個人。

examples.en: He was known for his vindictive nature and never forgave a slight.
examples.zh: 他以報復心強著稱，從不原諒任何輕蔑。

examples.en: The jubilant crowd celebrated the team's victory in the streets.
examples.zh: 歡欣鼓舞的人群在街上慶祝球隊的勝利。

examples.en: She felt jubilant after passing her final exams.
examples.zh: 通過期末考後，她感到喜洋洋的。

examples.en: The scrolled iron gate had beautiful curved designs.
examples.zh: 那扇有渦卷裝飾的鐵門有美麗的曲線設計。

examples.en: She admired the scrolled edges of the antique mirror.
examples.zh: 她欣賞那面古董鏡子的彎曲邊緣。

examples.en: After weeks at sea, they finally made landfall on a small island.
examples.zh: 在海上數週後，他們終於在一個小島登陸。

examples.en: The captain announced that landfall would be at dawn.
examples.zh: 船長宣布將在黎明時看到陸地。

examples.en: The two teams worked cooperatively to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊合作無間，按時完成了專案。

examples.en: Please play cooperatively with your classmates during group activities.
examples.zh: 在小組活動中，請與同學合作。

examples.en: Genomic research has led to new treatments for rare diseases.
examples.zh: 基因體研究為罕見疾病帶來了新的治療方法。

examples.en: The lab focuses on genomic analysis of crop plants.
examples.zh: 該實驗室專注於農作物的基因體分析。

examples.en: He was accused of being unfaithful to his wife.
examples.zh: 他被指控對妻子不忠。

examples.en: The movie is an unfaithful adaptation of the novel.
examples.zh: 這部電影是對小說不忠實的改編。

examples.en: The mesquite trees in the desert provide shade and food for many animals.
examples.zh: 沙漠中的豆科灌木為許多動物提供遮蔭和食物。

examples.en: Ranchers often use mesquite wood to flavor grilled meat.
examples.zh: 牧場主人常用豆科灌木的木材來為烤肉增添風味。

examples.en: They opened a magnum of champagne to celebrate the victory.
examples.zh: 他們開了一瓶大瓶裝的香檳來慶祝勝利。

examples.en: A magnum holds twice as much as a standard wine bottle.
examples.zh: 大瓶裝的容量是標準葡萄酒瓶的兩倍。

examples.en: She decided to study geomorphology because she was fascinated by how rivers shape valleys.
examples.zh: 她決定攻讀地形學，因為她對河流如何塑造山谷深感著迷。

examples.en: Geomorphology helps scientists understand the evolution of landscapes over time.
examples.zh: 地形學幫助科學家了解地景隨時間的演變。

examples.en: Many bird species are monogamous and stay with the same partner for life.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類是一夫一妻制的，並與同一個伴侶廝守終生。

examples.en: In a monogamous relationship, both partners agree to be faithful to each other.
examples.zh: 在一夫一妻的關係中，雙方都同意對彼此忠誠。

examples.en: The new bridge will improve connectivity between the two towns.
examples.zh: 這座新橋將改善兩個城鎮之間的連通性。

examples.en: Poor internet connectivity can make online meetings frustrating.
examples.zh: 網路連線品質不佳會讓線上會議令人沮喪。

examples.en: Phosphorylation plays a key role in regulating protein activity within cells.
examples.zh: 磷酸化在調節細胞內蛋白質活性方面扮演關鍵角色。

examples.en: The researcher studied how phosphorylation affects signal transmission in neurons.
examples.zh: 研究人員研究磷酸化如何影響神經元中的訊號傳遞。

examples.en: All passengers escaped unharmed from the accident.
examples.zh: 所有乘客都從事故中安然無恙地逃脫。

examples.en: Despite the earthquake, the old temple remained unharmed.
examples.zh: 儘管發生地震，這座古廟依然毫髮無傷。

examples.en: The monk struck the gong to signal the start of meditation.
examples.zh: 僧人敲鑼以表示冥想開始。

examples.en: A loud gong sounded, announcing the end of the ceremony.
examples.zh: 一聲響亮的鑼聲響起，宣布儀式結束。

examples.en: This book is a compendium of traditional herbal remedies.
examples.zh: 這本書是傳統草藥療法的綱要。

examples.en: She published a compendium of her research on climate change.
examples.zh: 她出版了一本關於氣候變遷研究的概略。

examples.en: The pons connects the brainstem to the cerebellum and helps regulate breathing.
examples.zh: 腦橋連接腦幹與小腦，並協助調節呼吸。

examples.en: Damage to the pons can cause problems with sleep and facial movement.
examples.zh: 腦橋受損可能導致睡眠和臉部運動的問題。

examples.en: Water exists in solid, liquid, and gaseous states.
examples.zh: 水以固態、液態和氣態存在。

examples.en: The factory released a gaseous substance into the air, prompting an investigation.
examples.zh: 工廠排放了一種氣態物質到空氣中，引發了調查。

examples.en: The symbol Ne stands for the element neon on the periodic table.
examples.zh: 符號 Ne 在元素週期表上代表元素氖。

examples.en: Neon lights glow with a reddish-orange color because of the Ne gas inside.
examples.zh: 霓虹燈因內含氖氣而發出紅橙色的光。

examples.en: As a preservationist, she fought to protect the historic district from development.
examples.zh: 作為一名保護主義者，她努力保護歷史街區免於開發。

examples.en: The preservationist argued that the old forest should remain untouched.
examples.zh: 這位自然保護主義者主張這片古老森林應保持原狀。

examples.en: Plantain is a common weed found in lawns and gardens.
examples.zh: 車前草是草坪和花園中常見的雜草。

examples.en: Fried plantain is a popular side dish in many tropical countries.
examples.zh: 炸大蕉在許多熱帶國家是受歡迎的配菜。

examples.en: The butter had gone rancid after being left out of the fridge.
examples.zh: 奶油放在冰箱外後已經酸敗了。

examples.en: A rancid smell came from the old cooking oil.
examples.zh: 一股腐臭的氣味從舊食用油中散發出來。

examples.en: She prepared a cheese souffle for dinner, and it rose beautifully.
examples.zh: 她晚餐準備了起司舒芙蕾，而且膨脹得很漂亮。

examples.en: The doctor listened to the patient's heart and detected a souffle.
examples.zh: 醫生聽了病人的心臟，並偵測到一個雜音。

examples.en: The company indiscriminately laid off workers without considering their performance.
examples.zh: 公司不分青紅皂白地解僱員工，沒有考慮他們的表現。

examples.en: He indiscriminately threw away old papers and photos.
examples.zh: 他任意地丟棄舊文件和照片。

examples.en: Her authority as team leader was unquestioned by everyone.
examples.zh: 她作為團隊領導的權威受到所有人無異議的認可。

examples.en: The fact that he is the best candidate remains unquestioned.
examples.zh: 他是最佳候選人的事實仍然不容置疑。

examples.en: The farmer kept a biddy and a rooster in the coop.
examples.zh: 農夫在雞舍裡養了一隻母雞和一隻公雞。

examples.en: A biddy scratched the ground looking for seeds.
examples.zh: 一隻母雞在地上啄食，尋找種子。

examples.en: The undersecretary will represent the department at the international conference.
examples.zh: 次長將代表該部門出席國際會議。

examples.en: After years of service, she was promoted to undersecretary.
examples.zh: 在多年服務後，她被晉升為副部長。

examples.en: The lamina of the leaf is thin and green.
examples.zh: 葉子的葉片薄而綠。

examples.en: Surgeons carefully removed a thin lamina of bone from the skull.
examples.zh: 外科醫生小心地從顱骨移除一片薄薄的骨板。

examples.en: The stock market fell precipitously after the announcement.
examples.zh: 宣布之後，股市暴跌。

examples.en: The path descends precipitously toward the river.
examples.zh: 這條小徑陡峭地向下延伸至河邊。

examples.en: The doctor monitored the perfusion of blood through the patient's kidneys.
examples.zh: 醫生監測病人腎臟的血液灌注。

examples.en: Adequate perfusion is essential for tissue survival.
examples.zh: 充分的灌注對組織存活至關重要。

examples.en: As a star player, he seemed untouchable on the court.
examples.zh: 作為明星球員，他在球場上似乎無人能敵。

examples.en: The ancient vase is untouchable and kept behind glass.
examples.zh: 這個古董花瓶碰不得，被保存在玻璃後面。

examples.en: Fabio is a common Italian name.
examples.zh: 法比奧是一個常見的義大利名字。

examples.en: I met a friendly guy named Fabio at the conference.
examples.zh: 我在會議上遇到一位名叫法比奧的友善男士。

examples.en: After centrifugation, the supernatant was carefully collected.
examples.zh: 離心後，上層清液被小心地收集。

examples.en: The supernatant liquid was clear and free of particles.
examples.zh: 上層液體清澈且沒有顆粒。

examples.en: Pieces of driftwood were scattered along the beach.
examples.zh: 浮木散落在海灘上。

examples.en: She collected driftwood to make a rustic picture frame.
examples.zh: 她收集浮木來做一個鄉村風的相框。

examples.en: The exon contains the coding sequence for the protein.
examples.zh: 外顯子包含蛋白質的編碼序列。

examples.en: Mutations in this exon can lead to genetic disorders.
examples.zh: 這個外顯子的突變可能導致遺傳疾病。

examples.en: The inductance of the coil is measured in henries.
examples.zh: 線圈的電感以亨利為單位測量。

examples.en: Changing current induces a voltage due to inductance.
examples.zh: 變化的電流由於電感而感應出電壓。

examples.en: The radio station's sched lists the times of each broadcast.
examples.zh: 電台的固定播送時間表列出了每次廣播的時間。

examples.en: According to the sched, the program airs at 9 PM.
examples.zh: 根據固定播送時間，節目在晚上9點播出。

examples.en: He suffered a minor abrasion on his knee after falling.
examples.zh: 他摔倒後膝蓋受到輕微擦傷。

examples.en: The abrasion of the rocks by the river created smooth pebbles.
examples.zh: 河流對岩石的磨蝕形成了光滑的鵝卵石。

examples.en: The curving road followed the coastline.
examples.zh: 彎曲的道路沿著海岸線延伸。

examples.en: She drew a curving line on the paper.
examples.zh: 她在紙上畫了一條彎曲的線。

examples.en: Words like 'here' and 'now' are deictic expressions.
examples.zh: 像「這裡」和「現在」這樣的詞是直接指示的表達。

examples.en: The deictic nature of pronouns depends on context.
examples.zh: 代詞的直接指示性質取決於上下文。

examples.en: Cyclosporin is used to prevent organ rejection after transplantation.
examples.zh: 環孢菌素用於預防移植後的器官排斥。

examples.en: Patients taking cyclosporin need regular blood tests.
examples.zh: 服用環孢菌素的患者需要定期驗血。

examples.en: Under the tutelage of a famous pianist, she improved rapidly.
examples.zh: 在一位著名鋼琴家的指導下，她進步很快。

examples.en: The child was placed under the tutelage of a guardian.
examples.zh: 這個孩子被置於監護人的監護之下。

examples.en: The company became a juggernaut in the tech industry.
examples.zh: 這家公司成為科技業的巨頭。

examples.en: The juggernaut of globalization seems unstoppable.
examples.zh: 全球化的巨輪似乎不可阻擋。

examples.en: Neutrophils are the most abundant type of white blood cells.
examples.zh: 嗜中性白血球是最豐富的白血球類型。

examples.en: The doctor checked the neutrophil count in the blood sample.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了血液樣本中的嗜中性白血球數量。

examples.en: Caffeine can increase alertness and reduce fatigue.
examples.zh: 咖啡因可以提高警覺性並減少疲勞。

examples.en: The guard maintained high alertness throughout the night.
examples.zh: 警衛整夜保持高度警戒。

examples.en: The lithosphere is broken into tectonic plates.
examples.zh: 岩石圈破裂成構造板塊。

examples.en: Earthquakes occur in the lithosphere due to plate movement.
examples.zh: 地震由於板塊運動而發生在岩石圈中。

examples.en: Doctors must be careful when prescribing opioids for chronic pain.
examples.zh: 醫生為慢性疼痛開立類鴉片藥物時必須謹慎。

examples.en: The opioid crisis has affected many communities across the country.
examples.zh: 類鴉片危機已影響全國許多社區。

examples.en: He wore a priestly robe during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 他在儀式中穿著祭司的長袍。

examples.en: Her priestly duties included blessing the congregation.
examples.zh: 她的祭司職責包括為會眾祝福。

examples.en: They took a weekend jaunt to the mountains.
examples.zh: 他們週末去山區遠足。

examples.en: We jaunted around the city, visiting small shops and cafes.
examples.zh: 我們在城市裡徒步旅遊，參觀小店和咖啡館。

examples.en: The two scholars disagreed theologically on the nature of salvation.
examples.zh: 這兩位學者在救贖的本質上神學觀點不同。

examples.en: She argued theologically that the text had been misinterpreted.
examples.zh: 她從神學上論證該文本被誤解了。

examples.en: They walked along the moonlit beach, listening to the waves.
examples.zh: 他們沿著月光照耀的海灘散步，聆聽海浪聲。

examples.en: The garden looked magical in the moonlit night.
examples.zh: 在月光照耀的夜晚，花園看起來很夢幻。

examples.en: The novel's villain was a fagin who trained children to steal.
examples.zh: 小說中的反派是一個教唆兒童偷竊的教唆犯。

examples.en: Authorities arrested the fagin who had been exploiting runaways.
examples.zh: 當局逮捕了那個一直在剝削離家出走兒童的教唆犯。

examples.en: The designer showed us a swatch of the fabric for the sofa.
examples.zh: 設計師給我們看了一塊沙發面料的樣品。

examples.en: Can I take a swatch of this paint color home?
examples.zh: 我可以把這個油漆顏色的樣品帶回家嗎？

examples.en: The mujaheddin fought against the invading forces in the mountains.
examples.zh: 穆斯林游擊隊員在山區對抗入侵的軍隊。

examples.en: Reports described the mujaheddin as skilled guerrilla fighters.
examples.zh: 報導描述這些穆斯林游擊隊員為熟練的游擊戰士。

examples.en: He fell headlong down the stairs and hurt his arm.
examples.zh: 他頭向前地摔下樓梯，傷了手臂。

examples.en: She rushed headlong into the project without reading the details.
examples.zh: 她輕率地投入這個計畫，沒有閱讀細節。

examples.en: The presidium met to discuss the upcoming party congress.
examples.zh: 主席團開會討論即將召開的黨代表大會。

examples.en: Decisions were made by the presidium when the legislature was not in session.
examples.zh: 當立法機構休會時，決策由主席團做出。

examples.en: The plot of the movie was so convoluted that I got lost.
examples.zh: 這部電影的情節太複雜，我搞糊塗了。

examples.en: The shell has a convoluted shape that spirals inward.
examples.zh: 這個貝殼呈盤繞的形狀，向內螺旋。

examples.en: The patient underwent a resection of the tumor last week.
examples.zh: 病人上週接受了腫瘤切除術。

examples.en: Surgeons performed a bowel resection to remove the damaged tissue.
examples.zh: 外科醫生進行了腸切除術以移除受損組織。

examples.en: His immune system was compromised after the long illness.
examples.zh: 長期生病後，他的免疫系統受損了。

examples.en: The compromised data may have been accessed by hackers.
examples.zh: 遭洩露的資料可能已被駭客存取。

examples.en: The word "here" is an example of deixis in English.
examples.zh: 「here」這個詞是英語中直示的一個例子。

examples.en: Linguists study deixis to understand how context affects meaning.
examples.zh: 語言學家研究直示，以了解語境如何影響意義。

examples.en: The dress had elaborate embellishments along the neckline.
examples.zh: 這件洋裝的領口有精緻的裝飾。

examples.en: He added a few embellishments to the story to make it more exciting.
examples.zh: 他為故事增添了一些潤色，使其更精彩。

examples.en: The revolution was surprisingly bloodless, with few casualties.
examples.zh: 這場革命出人意料地不流血，傷亡很少。

examples.en: His face was bloodless and pale after the shock.
examples.zh: 震驚之後，他的臉毫無血色、十分蒼白。

examples.en: The mineralisation of the soil affects what crops can grow.
examples.zh: 土壤的礦化作用影響能種植哪些作物。

examples.en: Scientists studied the mineralisation process in fossilized bones.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了化石骨骼中的礦化過程。

examples.en: His hands were scarred from years of working with machinery.
examples.zh: 他的雙手因多年操作機械而傷痕累累。

examples.en: The war left the city scarred but determined to rebuild.
examples.zh: 戰爭讓這座城市傷痕累累，但決心重建。

examples.en: She needed reconstructive surgery after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故後她需要接受重建手術。

examples.en: The charity funds reconstructive operations for children with cleft lips.
examples.zh: 該慈善機構資助唇裂兒童的重建手術。

examples.en: The vastness of the desert made travelers feel small.
examples.zh: 沙漠的廣大讓旅人感到渺小。

examples.en: We were awed by the vastness of the night sky.
examples.zh: 我們對夜空的廣闊感到敬畏。

examples.en: She gave an unabashed smile after winning the contest.
examples.zh: 她贏得比賽後露出毫不掩飾的微笑。

examples.en: His unabashed enthusiasm for the project inspired the whole team.
examples.zh: 他對這個計畫毫不掩飾的熱情激勵了整個團隊。

examples.en: The verdant hills stretched as far as the eye could see.
examples.zh: 翠綠的山丘一直延伸到視線盡頭。

examples.en: After the rain, the garden looked especially verdant and fresh.
examples.zh: 下雨過後，花園看起來格外翠綠清新。

examples.en: The novel explores the otherness of immigrants in a new society.
examples.zh: 這本小說探討移民在新社會中的差異性。

examples.en: Children often react to otherness with curiosity rather than fear.
examples.zh: 孩子們面對差異性時，往往出於好奇而非恐懼。

examples.en: The manager's dictatorial style made employees afraid to speak up.
examples.zh: 經理獨斷的作風讓員工不敢發言。

examples.en: They resisted the dictatorial rule that limited their freedom.
examples.zh: 他們反抗限制自由的獨裁統治。

examples.en: The bank acts as a clearinghouse for interbank transactions.
examples.zh: 這家銀行擔任銀行間交易的票據交換所。

examples.en: The website serves as a clearinghouse for information on local events.
examples.zh: 這個網站作為當地活動資訊的交換中心。

examples.en: The new software ensures interoperability between different devices.
examples.zh: 新軟體確保不同裝置之間的互操作性。

examples.en: Engineers are working to improve the interoperability of the systems.
examples.zh: 工程師正致力於提升這些系統的互用性。

examples.en: We enjoyed a refreshing lemon sorbet after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們享用了清爽的檸檬雪酪。

examples.en: She made mango sorbet by blending fruit and freezing it.
examples.zh: 她將水果攪拌後冷凍，做成芒果雪酪。

examples.en: He published a novella about a small town mystery.
examples.zh: 他出版了一本關於小鎮謎團的中篇小說。

examples.en: The novella was later adapted into a film.
examples.zh: 這篇中篇小說後來被改編成電影。

examples.en: The dentist used a pneumatic drill to clean the tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫使用氣動鑽頭清潔牙齒。

examples.en: The bicycle's pneumatic tires provide a smooth ride.
examples.zh: 腳踏車的充氣輪胎提供平穩的騎乘感。

examples.en: They had a picnic in the gazebo at the park.
examples.zh: 他們在公園的涼亭裡野餐。

examples.en: The garden gazebo is a perfect place to read.
examples.zh: 花園裡的涼亭是閱讀的絕佳地點。

examples.en: The doctor examined the ileal region for signs of inflammation.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查迴腸區域是否有發炎跡象。

examples.en: Ileal diseases can affect nutrient absorption.
examples.zh: 迴腸疾病可能影響營養吸收。

examples.en: The festival was the brainchild of a local artist.
examples.zh: 這個節慶是當地一位藝術家的創意產物。

examples.en: This app is the brainchild of two college students.
examples.zh: 這款應用程式是兩名大學生的智慧結晶。

examples.en: They bought a duplex and rent out the other unit.
examples.zh: 他們買了一棟雙併房屋，並將另一戶出租。

examples.en: The printer supports duplex printing to save paper.
examples.zh: 這台印表機支援雙面列印以節省紙張。

examples.en: In the expression 3 + 5, both 3 and 5 are operands.
examples.zh: 在算式 3 + 5 中，3 和 5 都是運算元。

examples.en: The program failed because an operand was missing.
examples.zh: 程式失敗是因為缺少了一個運算元。

examples.en: He felt like a misfit at the new school.
examples.zh: 他在新學校覺得自己格格不入。

examples.en: The jacket misfit him, so he returned it.
examples.zh: 這件外套不合他的身，所以他退貨了。

examples.en: She sat astride the horse and rode into the field.
examples.zh: 她跨坐在馬背上，騎進田野。

examples.en: The child stood astride the fallen log.
examples.zh: 那孩子跨站在倒下的原木上。

examples.en: The police obtained a warrant to wiretap the suspect's phone.
examples.zh: 警方取得令狀，對嫌犯的電話進行竊聽。

examples.en: Illegal wiretaps are a serious violation of privacy.
examples.zh: 非法竊聽是對隱私的嚴重侵犯。

examples.en: His joke was met with derision from the audience.
examples.zh: 他的笑話引來觀眾的嘲笑。

examples.en: She ignored the derision and continued her speech.
examples.zh: 她不理會嘲笑，繼續演講。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed omeprazole for her stomach ulcer.
examples.zh: 醫生為她的胃潰瘍開了奧美拉唑。

examples.en: Omeprazole reduces acid production in the stomach.
examples.zh: 奧美拉唑能減少胃酸分泌。

examples.en: The timbre of her voice made the song unforgettable.
examples.zh: 她的音色讓這首歌令人難忘。

examples.en: Each instrument has a unique timbre.
examples.zh: 每種樂器都有獨特的音色。

examples.en: The librarian classified the novel under a subcategory of historical fiction.
examples.zh: 圖書館員將這本小說歸類在歷史小說的子類別下。

examples.en: Within the main category of sports, swimming is a popular subcategory.
examples.zh: 在運動這個主分類中，游泳是一個受歡迎的子類別。

examples.en: The army commandeered several private vehicles to transport supplies.
examples.zh: 軍方徵用了幾輛私人車輛來運送補給品。

examples.en: During the emergency, officials commandeered the school as a shelter.
examples.zh: 緊急狀況期間，官員霸佔了學校作為避難所。

examples.en: The doctor found a small adenoma during the routine checkup.
examples.zh: 醫生在例行檢查中發現了一個小腺瘤。

examples.en: Most cases of this type of adenoma are benign and treatable.
examples.zh: 這類腺瘤大多為良性且可治療。

examples.en: The loader lifted the heavy boxes onto the truck with ease.
examples.zh: 裝貨工人輕鬆地將重箱子搬上卡車。

examples.en: A skilled loader can speed up the shipping process significantly.
examples.zh: 熟練的裝載人員能大幅加快出貨流程。

examples.en: The children drew chalk pictures on the blacktop in the playground.
examples.zh: 孩子們在遊樂場的柏油路面上用粉筆畫圖。

examples.en: Workers will blacktop the damaged section of the road next week.
examples.zh: 工人下週將在道路損壞的部分鋪上柏油。

examples.en: In the story, a genie grants the fisherman three wishes.
examples.zh: 故事中，妖怪給了漁夫三個願望。

examples.en: She rubbed the lamp, and a genie appeared in a puff of smoke.
examples.zh: 她擦了擦油燈，一陣煙霧中出現了一個精靈。

examples.en: The femur is the longest and strongest bone in the human body.
examples.zh: 股骨是人體中最長且最強壯的骨頭。

examples.en: He fractured his femur while skiing down the steep slope.
examples.zh: 他在陡坡滑雪時股骨骨折了。

examples.en: After the snowstorm, the streets were covered in dirty slush.
examples.zh: 暴風雪過後，街道上覆蓋著髒兮兮的雪泥。

examples.en: The children splashed through the slush on their way to school.
examples.zh: 孩子們在上學途中踩著雪泥濺起水花。

examples.en: She nodded approvingly when she saw the finished project.
examples.zh: 她看到完成的專案時讚許地點了點頭。

examples.en: The teacher smiled approvingly at the student's correct answer.
examples.zh: 老師對學生的正確答案讚許地微笑。

examples.en: The pizza was cut into twelfths so everyone could have a slice.
examples.zh: 披薩被切成十二等份，這樣每個人都能分到一片。

examples.en: Five twelfths of the students voted for the new club name.
examples.zh: 有十二分之五的學生投票支持新的社團名稱。

examples.en: The affordability of housing is a major concern for young families.
examples.zh: 住房的負擔能力是年輕家庭的主要擔憂。

examples.en: They discussed the affordability of the new healthcare plan.
examples.zh: 他們討論了新的醫療保健計畫的可負擔性。

examples.en: The practice of circumcision varies among different cultures and religions.
examples.zh: 割禮的習俗因文化和宗教而異。

examples.en: Medical circumcision is sometimes performed to prevent certain infections.
examples.zh: 醫療性包皮環切術有時是為了預防某些感染而進行。

examples.en: She stored the homemade pickles in a large ceramic crock.
examples.zh: 她把自製的醃黃瓜存放在一個大陶瓷罐裡。

examples.en: Don't believe that story; it's just a crock.
examples.zh: 別相信那個故事，那只是一派胡言。

examples.en: He managed to parlay his small investment into a fortune.
examples.zh: 他成功地將小額投資變成了一筆財富。

examples.en: She decided to parlay her winnings from the first race into a bigger bet.
examples.zh: 她決定把第一場比賽的獎金連本帶利地押在更大的賭注上。

examples.en: The ribber machine produces fabric with a ribbed texture.
examples.zh: 羅紋機生產具有羅紋質地的布料。

examples.en: He operates the ribber to create stretchy cuffs for sweaters.
examples.zh: 他操作羅紋機來製作毛衣的彈性袖口。

examples.en: The presentation included stunning visuals to engage the audience.
examples.zh: 簡報中包含了令人驚豔的視覺資料來吸引觀眾。

examples.en: She added visuals such as charts and photos to the report.
examples.zh: 她在報告中加入了圖表和照片等視覺資料。

examples.en: Indomethacin is often prescribed to reduce inflammation and pain.
examples.zh: 消炎痛常被用來減輕發炎和疼痛。

examples.en: The doctor warned about potential side effects of indomethacin.
examples.zh: 醫生警告了消炎痛可能的副作用。

examples.en: She wore a beautiful silk sari to the wedding ceremony.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件美麗的絲質莎麗參加婚禮。

examples.en: The vibrant colors of her sari caught everyone's attention.
examples.zh: 她的莎麗鮮豔的色彩吸引了所有人的目光。

examples.en: The doctor examined the antral region of the patient's stomach.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了病人胃部的竇區。

examples.en: Antral inflammation can cause discomfort after eating.
examples.zh: 竇部發炎可能導致進食後不適。

examples.en: The senatorial committee reviewed the proposed bill carefully.
examples.zh: 參議院委員會仔細審查了擬議的法案。

examples.en: He gave a senatorial speech that impressed both parties.
examples.zh: 他發表了一場參議員式的演講，讓兩黨都印象深刻。

examples.en: The assistant was asked to tabulate the survey results by age group.
examples.zh: 助理被要求按年齡層將問卷結果製成表格。

examples.en: Before the meeting, please tabulate all the expenses so we can review them quickly.
examples.zh: 開會前，請將所有支出做成表格，以便我們快速檢視。

examples.en: The farmers began harvesting the rice early this morning.
examples.zh: 農民今天一大早就開始收割稻米。

examples.en: Harvesting by hand is slow, but it often preserves the fruit better.
examples.zh: 人工採收雖然慢，但通常更能保持水果完好。

examples.en: The students calculated the eigenvalue of the matrix using a computer program.
examples.zh: 學生們用電腦程式計算出該矩陣的特徵值。

examples.en: Each eigenvalue corresponds to at least one eigenvector in this system.
examples.zh: 在這個系統中，每個特徵值至少對應一個特徵向量。

examples.en: The therapist tried to hypnotize the patient to help him relax.
examples.zh: 治療師試圖催眠病人，幫助他放鬆。

examples.en: Her calm voice seemed to hypnotize the audience into silence.
examples.zh: 她平靜的聲音似乎讓觀眾著迷得安靜下來。

examples.en: The doctor used drops to dilate the patient's pupils before the eye exam.
examples.zh: 眼科檢查前，醫生點眼藥水讓病人的瞳孔放大。

examples.en: She began to dilate on the topic, adding many details and examples.
examples.zh: 她開始詳述這個主題，補充了許多細節和例子。

examples.en: The professor warned the class that plagiarism would result in a failing grade.
examples.zh: 教授警告全班，抄襲會導致該科不及格。

examples.en: His paper was rejected because it contained obvious plagiarism.
examples.zh: 他的論文被退回，因為有明顯的抄襲。

examples.en: I have to finish my prep for tomorrow's history quiz tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚必須完成明天歷史小考的預習。

examples.en: She attended a prep school before entering university.
examples.zh: 她進大學前就讀於一所預備學校。

examples.en: The sky turned a yellowish color just before the storm arrived.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，天空轉為淡黃色。

examples.en: He noticed a yellowish stain on the old map.
examples.zh: 他注意到舊地圖上有一塊微黃的汙漬。

examples.en: The dishes were still soapy, so she rinsed them again.
examples.zh: 碗盤上還有肥皂，所以她又沖洗了一遍。

examples.en: His soapy compliments made everyone feel uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他諂媚的讚美讓大家覺得不自在。

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with acute cholangitis and needed immediate treatment.
examples.zh: 病人被診斷出急性膽管炎，需要立即治療。

examples.en: Cholangitis often causes fever and pain in the upper abdomen.
examples.zh: 膽管炎常引起發燒和上腹部疼痛。

examples.en: She has been living with lupus for over ten years.
examples.zh: 她罹患狼瘡已經超過十年了。

examples.en: Lupus can affect the skin, joints, and internal organs.
examples.zh: 狼瘡可能影響皮膚、關節和內臟器官。

examples.en: A walk in the cool morning air is truly invigorating.
examples.zh: 在涼爽的早晨空氣中散步，真的讓人精神振奮。

examples.en: The team found the coach's speech invigorating before the big game.
examples.zh: 隊員們覺得教練在重要比賽前的談話令人振奮。

examples.en: He pressed his fingers firmly against the guitar's fingerboard.
examples.zh: 他將手指緊緊按在吉他的指板上。

examples.en: The violin's fingerboard was worn from years of playing.
examples.zh: 這把小提琴的指板因多年演奏而磨損。

examples.en: They stayed in a small, unpretentious hotel near the beach.
examples.zh: 他們住在海灘附近一間樸實的小旅館。

examples.en: Despite his fame, the chef remained unpretentious and friendly.
examples.zh: 儘管名氣很大，這位主廚依然謙遜友善。

examples.en: A short nap can have a restorative effect on your energy.
examples.zh: 小睡片刻能讓你的精力恢復。

examples.en: The herbal tea is known as a gentle restorative for tired bodies.
examples.zh: 這種草本茶被認為是溫和的補品，能滋補疲憊的身體。

examples.en: I felt groggy after waking up from a long nap.
examples.zh: 睡了很久午覺醒來後，我覺得昏昏沉沉的。

examples.en: The boxer was still groggy when the referee stopped the fight.
examples.zh: 裁判停止比賽時，那位拳擊手仍然搖搖晃晃。

examples.en: The bakery sells a delectable variety of chocolate cakes.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店販售多種美味的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: We enjoyed a delectable meal at the new restaurant downtown.
examples.zh: 我們在市中心的新餐廳享用了一頓美味的大餐。

examples.en: The biopsy showed intestinal metaplasia in the stomach lining.
examples.zh: 切片檢查顯示胃黏膜出現腸化生。

examples.en: Chronic irritation can lead to metaplasia of the cells.
examples.zh: 長期刺激可能導致細胞化生。

examples.en: The stomach lining secretes pepsinogen, which becomes pepsin in acid.
examples.zh: 胃黏膜分泌胃蛋白酶原，在酸性環境中轉變為胃蛋白酶。

examples.en: Doctors measured the pepsinogen level to assess stomach function.
examples.zh: 醫生測量胃蛋白酶原濃度來評估胃功能。

examples.en: In civics class, we learned about the rights and duties of citizens.
examples.zh: 在公民課上，我們學習了公民的權利與義務。

examples.en: She finds civics more interesting than history.
examples.zh: 她覺得公民學比歷史更有趣。

examples.en: After the scandal, the community decided to ostracize the dishonest merchant.
examples.zh: 醜聞發生後，社區決定排斥那位不誠實的商人。

examples.en: She felt ostracized by her classmates when they stopped inviting her to parties.
examples.zh: 當同學不再邀請她參加派對時，她感到被排擠。

examples.en: The old mine used a jinny to haul coal up the steep slope.
examples.zh: 那座老礦場用固定絞車將煤炭拉上陡坡。

examples.en: Workers built a jinny to transport materials down the gravity incline.
examples.zh: 工人們建造了一條自重滑行坡道來運送材料。

examples.en: The antislavery movement gained strength in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 反奴隸制運動在十九世紀逐漸壯大。

examples.en: She wrote an antislavery pamphlet that was widely distributed.
examples.zh: 她寫了一本反奴隸制的小冊子，被廣泛發放。

examples.en: Doctors immunize children against measles before they start school.
examples.zh: 醫生在孩子入學前為他們接種麻疹疫苗。

examples.en: The new law will immunize witnesses from prosecution if they testify truthfully.
examples.zh: 新法律將賦予如實作證的證人免於起訴的權利。

examples.en: The bartender was quite matey with all the regular customers.
examples.zh: 那位酒保對所有常客都很親切。

examples.en: He greeted his old matey from school with a warm hug.
examples.zh: 他熱情地擁抱了學校的老夥伴。

examples.en: The traffic jam turned into a nightmarish experience that lasted hours.
examples.zh: 那場交通堵塞變成了一場持續數小時的噩夢般經歷。

examples.en: She described the haunted house as a nightmarish place full of strange noises.
examples.zh: 她形容那棟鬼屋是個充滿怪聲的可怕地方。

examples.en: The sculptor hewed a beautiful statue from a block of marble.
examples.zh: 雕塑家從一塊大理石中砍鑿出一座美麗的雕像。

examples.en: They hewed down the old tree to make room for the new road.
examples.zh: 他們砍倒了那棵老樹，為新道路騰出空間。

examples.en: The seal used its flipper to push itself onto the rock.
examples.zh: 海豹用牠的鰭狀肢把自己推上岩石。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your flippers for the snorkeling trip.
examples.zh: 別忘了帶上你的腳蹼去浮潛。

examples.en: The farmer left the field fallow for a year to restore its nutrients.
examples.zh: 農夫讓田地休耕一年，以恢復地力。

examples.en: Her artistic talent remained fallow until she took a painting class.
examples.zh: 她的藝術才華一直未被開發，直到她參加了繪畫課。

examples.en: The company hired a firm specializing in headhunting for executive positions.
examples.zh: 公司聘請了一家專門為高階主管職位進行獵才的公司。

examples.en: Headhunting is common in the tech industry for finding top engineers.
examples.zh: 在科技業，獵才來尋找頂尖工程師是很常見的。

examples.en: Medieval fabliaux often featured clever peasants tricking greedy nobles.
examples.zh: 中世紀的法國故事詩常以聰明的農民捉弄貪婪的貴族為題材。

examples.en: Scholars study these fabliaux for their humorous and satirical tone.
examples.zh: 學者研究這些故事詩的幽默與諷刺語氣。

examples.en: A fabliau is a short comic tale in verse, popular in medieval France.
examples.zh: 故事詩是一種短篇喜劇詩，在中世紀法國很流行。

examples.en: Chaucer's 'The Miller's Tale' is influenced by the fabliau tradition.
examples.zh: 喬叟的《磨坊主的故事》受到故事詩傳統的影響。

examples.en: In the story, the evil king ordered his soldiers to behead the hero.
examples.zh: 故事中，邪惡的國王命令士兵將英雄斬首。

examples.en: The rebels threatened to behead anyone who opposed them.
examples.zh: 叛軍威脅要將任何反對他們的人斬首。

examples.en: Without new investments, the local economy began to stagnate.
examples.zh: 沒有新的投資，當地經濟開始停滯。

examples.en: The water in the pond stagnated and became a breeding ground for mosquitoes.
examples.zh: 池塘的水停滯不流，成了蚊子的滋生地。

examples.en: The hijacking of the plane ended peacefully after negotiations.
examples.zh: 經過談判，飛機劫持事件和平落幕。

examples.en: He was arrested for the hijacking of a truck carrying electronics.
examples.zh: 他因劫持一輛載有電子產品的卡車而被捕。

examples.en: The children played charades at the birthday party.
examples.zh: 孩子們在生日派對上玩比手畫腳的猜字遊戲。

examples.en: Their so-called friendship was just a charade to hide their rivalry.
examples.zh: 他們所謂的友誼只是掩飾彼此競爭的假象。

examples.en: I like to have a croissant and coffee for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我喜歡早餐吃可頌配咖啡。

examples.en: The bakery sells fresh croissants every morning.
examples.zh: 那家麵包店每天早上都賣新鮮的可頌。

examples.en: His inscrutable expression made it hard to tell what he was thinking.
examples.zh: 他莫測高深的表情讓人很難看出他在想什麼。

examples.en: The ancient text remains inscrutable to modern scholars.
examples.zh: 那篇古代文獻對現代學者來說仍然難以理解。

examples.en: The title of the book should be printed in italics.
examples.zh: 書名應該用斜體字印刷。

examples.en: She used italics to emphasize the key points in her report.
examples.zh: 她用斜體字來強調報告中的重點。

examples.en: His stubbornness prevented him from admitting that he was wrong.
examples.zh: 他的固執讓他無法承認自己錯了。

examples.en: The stubbornness of the stain required a special cleaning solution.
examples.zh: 那個污漬很頑固，需要用特殊的清潔劑才能去除。

examples.en: The old car is temperamental and often refuses to start on cold mornings.
examples.zh: 那輛舊車性能不穩定，常常在寒冷的早晨發不動。

examples.en: As an artist, she is known for her temperamental moods and sudden bursts of creativity.
examples.zh: 作為藝術家，她以情緒多變和突然湧現的創造力聞名。

examples.en: Please mark the required fields with an asterisk on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上用星號標示必填欄位。

examples.en: The footnote is indicated by a small asterisk next to the word.
examples.zh: 腳註由單詞旁邊的小星號表示。

examples.en: She wet a washcloth with warm water and gently wiped the baby's face.
examples.zh: 她用溫水弄濕毛巾，輕輕擦拭嬰兒的臉。

examples.en: After gardening, he used a washcloth to clean the dirt off his hands.
examples.zh: 園藝工作後，他用毛巾清潔手上的污垢。

examples.en: The roast beef is often served with a sharp horseradish sauce.
examples.zh: 烤牛肉通常搭配辛辣的辣根醬。

examples.en: Growing horseradish in your garden can be rewarding but requires patience.
examples.zh: 在花園裡種植辣根可能很有回報，但需要耐心。

examples.en: The postmodernist novel challenges traditional narrative structures and linear timelines.
examples.zh: 後現代主義小說挑戰傳統的敘事結構和線性時間線。

examples.en: Critics praised the building as a fine example of postmodernist architecture.
examples.zh: 評論家稱讚這棟建築是後現代主義建築的典範。

examples.en: Several corporate bigwigs attended the charity gala last night.
examples.zh: 幾位企業大亨出席了昨晚的慈善晚會。

examples.en: The local bigwig donated a large sum to the new library project.
examples.zh: 當地要人向新圖書館項目捐贈了一大筆錢。

examples.en: The nakedness of the landscape was striking, with no trees or buildings in sight.
examples.zh: 這片風景的荒涼令人震驚，看不到任何樹木或建築物。

examples.en: He felt a sense of nakedness when asked to share his personal struggles.
examples.zh: 當被要求分享個人掙扎時，他感到一種赤裸裸的暴露感。

examples.en: The mother gently cooed to her newborn baby to soothe him.
examples.zh: 母親輕聲細語地對新生兒咕咕說話以安撫他。

examples.en: Pigeons cooed softly on the windowsill every morning.
examples.zh: 鴿子每天早上在窗台上輕聲咕咕叫。

examples.en: The storm left a line of wrack along the beach, mostly seaweed and debris.
examples.zh: 暴風雨在海灘上留下一排漂積物，主要是海藻和碎片。

examples.en: Years of neglect had wracked the old mansion, leaving it in ruins.
examples.zh: 多年的忽視嚴重損壞了這座老宅，使它成為廢墟。

examples.en: Gold is a highly malleable metal that can be hammered into thin sheets.
examples.zh: 金是一種高度延展的金屬，可以錘打成薄片。

examples.en: Young children's minds are malleable and easily influenced by their surroundings.
examples.zh: 幼兒的心智可塑性強，容易受到周圍環境的影響。

examples.en: The governor's actions were deemed impeachable by the state legislature.
examples.zh: 州立法機構認為州長的行為可被彈劾。

examples.en: His testimony was impeachable because of several inconsistencies.
examples.zh: 由於多處不一致，他的證詞可信度受到質疑。

examples.en: Dark clouds on the horizon often portend a heavy storm.
examples.zh: 地平線上的烏雲通常預示著一場大風暴。

examples.en: The sudden drop in sales may portend trouble for the company.
examples.zh: 銷售額突然下降可能預示著公司有麻煩。

examples.en: After saving for months, they decided to splurge on a luxury vacation.
examples.zh: 存了幾個月的錢後，他們決定揮霍一番去豪華度假。

examples.en: She rarely splurges, but when she does, it's on high-quality shoes.
examples.zh: 她很少揮霍，但一旦揮霍，就是買高品質的鞋子。

examples.en: The hiker managed to climb the steep trail unaided.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者設法在沒有幫助的情況下爬上了陡峭的小徑。

examples.en: Without glasses, she cannot read the text unaided.
examples.zh: 沒有眼鏡，她無法在沒有幫助的情況下閱讀文本。

examples.en: The angler caught a large smallmouth bass in the clear lake.
examples.zh: 釣魚者在清澈的湖中釣到一條大魚。

examples.en: Smallmouth bass are known for their fighting spirit when hooked.
examples.zh: 小口黑鱸以被釣上鉤時的搏鬥精神而聞名。

examples.en: The tortuous mountain road required careful driving at every turn.
examples.zh: 蜿蜒的山路每個轉彎都需要小心駕駛。

examples.en: The negotiations followed a tortuous path before reaching an agreement.
examples.zh: 談判經歷了曲折的過程才達成協議。

examples.en: She unabashedly admitted that she had never read the book.
examples.zh: 她毫不掩飾地承認自己從未讀過那本書。

examples.en: He is unabashedly enthusiastic about his favorite band.
examples.zh: 他對自己最喜歡的樂隊毫不掩飾地熱情。

examples.en: The bride wore a pearly white gown that shimmered under the lights.
examples.zh: 新娘穿著一件在燈光下閃閃發光的珍珠白色禮服。

examples.en: Her pearly teeth were the result of years of careful dental care.
examples.zh: 她珍珠般的牙齒是多年細心護理的結果。

examples.en: The new watch is watertight up to 50 meters, making it suitable for swimming.
examples.zh: 這款新手錶防水深度達50米，適合游泳時佩戴。

examples.en: The lawyer presented a watertight argument that left no room for doubt.
examples.zh: 律師提出了一個無懈可擊的論點，沒有留下任何疑問。

examples.en: She made a gutsy decision to start her own business despite the risks.
examples.zh: 儘管有風險，她仍做出勇敢的決定，開始自己創業。

examples.en: It was a gutsy move to challenge the champion in the final round.
examples.zh: 在最後一輪挑戰冠軍是一項大膽的舉動。

examples.en: The old seer predicted that a great change would come to the village.
examples.zh: 那位老先知預言村莊將會有巨大的變化。

examples.en: In ancient times, people often consulted a seer before making important decisions.
examples.zh: 在古代，人們在做重要決定前經常諮詢先知。

examples.en: The politician hired a talented speechwriter to craft his campaign speeches.
examples.zh: 那位政治人物聘請了一位才華洋溢的演講稿撰寫人來撰寫競選演說。

examples.en: As a speechwriter, she spends hours researching to make every word count.
examples.zh: 身為演講稿撰寫人，她花好幾個小時研究，讓每個字都發揮作用。

examples.en: The cathedral was magnificently decorated for the royal wedding.
examples.zh: 大教堂為了皇家婚禮裝飾得富麗堂皇。

examples.en: She performed magnificently in the final round and won the gold medal.
examples.zh: 她在決賽中表現出色，贏得了金牌。

examples.en: The tracer followed the shipment across three countries to find the missing goods.
examples.zh: 追蹤者跨越三個國家追查貨物，以尋找遺失的貨品。

examples.en: Doctors injected a radioactive tracer to monitor the patient's organ function.
examples.zh: 醫生注射放射性追蹤劑來監測病人的器官功能。

examples.en: She puckered her lips to whistle a cheerful tune.
examples.zh: 她噘起嘴唇吹奏一首輕快的曲子。

examples.en: The fabric began to pucker after it was washed in hot water.
examples.zh: 布料用熱水洗過後開始起皺。

examples.en: Her likeable personality makes her popular among her colleagues.
examples.zh: 她討人喜歡的個性讓她在同事間很受歡迎。

examples.en: The novel's protagonist is a likeable character with a good sense of humor.
examples.zh: 這本小說的主角是個討喜的角色，很有幽默感。

examples.en: The machinist carefully adjusted the lathe to produce precise parts.
examples.zh: 機械技師仔細調整車床，以生產精密的零件。

examples.en: After years of training, he became a skilled machinist in the factory.
examples.zh: 經過多年訓練，他成為工廠裡技術嫻熟的機械技師。

examples.en: The scoundrel cheated innocent people out of their savings.
examples.zh: 那個惡棍騙走了無辜民眾的積蓄。

examples.en: Everyone in town knew him as a scoundrel who never kept his promises.
examples.zh: 鎮上每個人都知道他是一個從不守承諾的惡棍。

examples.en: The novel has an episodic structure, with each chapter telling a separate story.
examples.zh: 這本小說採用插曲式的結構，每一章講述一個獨立的故事。

examples.en: His migraines are episodic and occur only a few times a year.
examples.zh: 他的偏頭痛是偶發性的，一年只發生幾次。

examples.en: The lawyer explained the nicety of the contract clause to her client.
examples.zh: 律師向客戶解釋合約條款的微妙差異。

examples.en: He observed the social niceties at the dinner party with great care.
examples.zh: 他在晚宴上非常注意社交禮儀的細節。

examples.en: She was staggered by the amount of work she had to finish in one day.
examples.zh: 她對一天內必須完成的工作量感到吃驚。

examples.en: The shelves were arranged in a staggered pattern to fit more books.
examples.zh: 書架以錯列的方式排列，以容納更多書籍。

examples.en: The meat was so stringy that it was difficult to chew.
examples.zh: 那塊肉筋太多，很難咀嚼。

examples.en: His stringy hair hung down over his eyes after the long run.
examples.zh: 長跑之後，他纖細的頭髮垂在眼前。

examples.en: The mistake was of such insignificance that no one even noticed it.
examples.zh: 這個錯誤如此微不足道，以至於沒有人注意到。

examples.en: He felt a sense of insignificance when looking at the vast ocean.
examples.zh: 望著浩瀚的海洋，他感到自己的渺小。

examples.en: The strapping young man easily lifted the heavy box onto the truck.
examples.zh: 那個魁梧的年輕人輕鬆地把沉重的箱子抬上卡車。

examples.en: She married a strapping farmer who could work all day in the fields.
examples.zh: 她嫁給了一位強壯的農夫，能在田裡工作一整天。

examples.en: The success of the project depended on the thoroughness of the planning.
examples.zh: 專案的成功取決於規劃的徹底程度。

examples.en: Her thoroughness in checking every detail saved the company from a costly error.
examples.zh: 她徹底檢查每個細節，使公司免於付出高昂的代價。

examples.en: He looked dapper in his new suit and polished shoes.
examples.zh: 他穿著新西裝和擦亮的鞋子，看起來整潔帥氣。

examples.en: The dapper gentleman tipped his hat as he passed by.
examples.zh: 那位衣著整潔的紳士經過時輕抬帽沿致意。

examples.en: The task is challenging but doable if we work together.
examples.zh: 這項任務具有挑戰性，但如果我們合作，是可行的。

examples.en: Is the schedule doable, or should we ask for more time?
examples.zh: 這個時程可行嗎，還是我們應該要求更多時間？

examples.en: A tall divider separated the living room from the dining area.
examples.zh: 一個高大的隔板將客廳與用餐區隔開。

examples.en: The teacher used a divider to split the students into two groups.
examples.zh: 老師用分隔物將學生分成兩組。

examples.en: He used a chainsaw to cut the fallen tree into smaller pieces.
examples.zh: 他用鏈鋸把倒下的樹切成小塊。

examples.en: The sound of a chainsaw echoed through the quiet forest.
examples.zh: 鏈鋸的聲音在安靜的森林中迴盪。

examples.en: She was in the throes of a painful migraine when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 電話響起時，她正飽受劇烈偏頭痛的折磨。

examples.en: The country was in the throes of an economic crisis.
examples.zh: 這個國家正處於經濟危機的陣痛之中。

examples.en: His calm voice evinced no sign of the panic he felt inside.
examples.zh: 他平靜的聲音並未顯露出內心的恐慌。

examples.en: Did she evince any interest in the project during the meeting?
examples.zh: 她在會議中對這個專案表現出任何興趣嗎？

examples.en: The old tires had become hard and rubbery after years in the sun.
examples.zh: 這些舊輪胎在陽光下曝曬多年後，變得又硬又有彈性。

examples.en: The squid was so overcooked that it felt rubbery in my mouth.
examples.zh: 這隻魷魚煮得太過頭，吃起來像橡膠一樣難嚼。

examples.en: They attended a glitzy award ceremony full of flashing cameras.
examples.zh: 他們參加了一場閃光燈不斷的耀眼頒獎典禮。

examples.en: Behind the glitzy facade, the hotel was actually quite ordinary.
examples.zh: 在光鮮亮麗的外表背後，這家飯店其實相當普通。

examples.en: The herder guided his sheep across the wide, grassy plain.
examples.zh: 牧人引導他的羊群穿越寬闊的草原。

examples.en: In the mountains, a herder must protect the animals from wolves.
examples.zh: 在山區，牧人必須保護牲畜免受狼群攻擊。

examples.en: A teenaged boy offered to help carry the heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 一個十幾歲的男孩主動幫忙搬那些沉重的箱子。

examples.en: Her teenaged daughter spends hours chatting with friends online.
examples.zh: 她青少年的女兒花好幾個小時在網路上和朋友聊天。

examples.en: The waiter was unobtrusive, appearing only when we needed him.
examples.zh: 那位服務生不引人注目，只在我們需要時才出現。

examples.en: She wore unobtrusive jewelry that matched her simple dress.
examples.zh: 她戴著不張揚的珠寶，與她樸素的洋裝很相襯。

examples.en: He referred only obliquely to the scandal during his speech.
examples.zh: 他在演講中只是間接地提到那樁醜聞。

examples.en: The sun shone obliquely through the narrow window.
examples.zh: 陽光斜斜地穿過那扇窄窗。

examples.en: Assistive technology helps people with disabilities use computers more easily.
examples.zh: 輔助科技幫助身心障礙者更輕鬆地使用電腦。

examples.en: The center provides assistive devices such as wheelchairs and walkers.
examples.zh: 該中心提供輪椅和助行器等輔助器具。

examples.en: In the budget, entertainment is often seen as expendable.
examples.zh: 在預算中，娛樂支出常被視為可削減的項目。

examples.en: The company treated its temporary workers as expendable.
examples.zh: 公司把臨時工視為可犧牲的人力。

examples.en: The microbiologist examined the water sample under a powerful microscope.
examples.zh: 微生物學家在強力顯微鏡下檢驗水樣本。

examples.en: As a microbiologist, she studies how bacteria develop resistance to drugs.
examples.zh: 身為微生物學家，她研究細菌如何產生抗藥性。

examples.en: He was arrested for trying to impersonate a police officer.
examples.zh: 他因試圖冒充警察而被逮捕。

examples.en: The comedian can impersonate several famous actors perfectly.
examples.zh: 那位喜劇演員能完美模仿幾位知名演員。

examples.en: The detonation of the old bomb could be heard miles away.
examples.zh: 那枚舊炸彈的爆炸聲幾英里外都聽得到。

examples.en: Engineers monitored the detonation from a safe distance.
examples.zh: 工程師從安全距離監控引爆過程。

examples.en: She jealously guarded her private diary from her siblings.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地防著兄弟姊妹，不讓他們看她的私人日記。

examples.en: He watched jealously as his colleague received the promotion.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒地看著同事獲得升遷。

examples.en: Vaccinate your pets against rabies to keep them safe.
examples.zh: 讓你的寵物接種狂犬病疫苗以確保安全。

examples.en: Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear.
examples.zh: 狂犬病一旦出現症狀，幾乎總是致命的。

examples.en: The docile horse allowed the child to ride it without fear.
examples.zh: 那匹溫順的馬讓孩子毫無畏懼地騎乘。

examples.en: Teachers prefer docile students who listen carefully.
examples.zh: 老師比較喜歡聽話、專心聽講的學生。

examples.en: This multipurpose tool can open bottles, cut rope, and tighten screws.
examples.zh: 這款多用途工具可以開瓶、割繩和鎖緊螺絲。

examples.en: They converted the garage into a multipurpose room for guests and exercise.
examples.zh: 他們把車庫改造成多功能室，供客人住宿和運動使用。

examples.en: The dress had a low neckline that required a special bra.
examples.zh: 那件洋裝的領口很低，需要搭配特殊的內衣。

examples.en: She preferred shirts with a simple round neckline.
examples.zh: 她偏愛簡單圓領的襯衫。

examples.en: The lake was startlingly clear, revealing every stone on the bottom.
examples.zh: 湖水清澈得驚人，湖底的每顆石頭都看得見。

examples.en: His conclusion was startlingly different from what everyone expected.
examples.zh: 他的結論與大家預期的截然不同，令人吃驚。

examples.en: She sounded perky and energetic on the phone this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上在電話裡聽起來精神抖擻、活力充沛。

examples.en: The perky waitress greeted every customer with a bright smile.
examples.zh: 那位活潑的服務生用燦爛的笑容問候每位客人。

examples.en: The two companies are cooperating on a new software project.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司正在合作開發一個新的軟體專案。

examples.en: Without cooperating with each other, the team would never finish on time.
examples.zh: 如果團隊不互相合作，就絕對無法準時完成。

examples.en: Rainwater percolates slowly through the sandy soil.
examples.zh: 雨水慢慢地滲透過沙質土壤。

examples.en: News of the merger began to percolate through the office.
examples.zh: 合併的消息開始在辦公室裡傳開。

examples.en: The police found the suspect's hideout in an abandoned warehouse.
examples.zh: 警方在一座廢棄倉庫裡找到了嫌犯的藏身處。

examples.en: They used the cave as a hideout during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，他們把那個洞穴當作藏身處。

examples.en: The new apartment is small but very livable.
examples.zh: 這間新公寓雖然小，但非常適合居住。

examples.en: After the renovations, the old house became livable again.
examples.zh: 翻修之後，這棟老房子又變得可以住人了。

examples.en: The headwaters of the river are located in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這條河的源頭位於山區。

examples.en: Pollution near the headwaters affects the entire river downstream.
examples.zh: 上游源頭附近的汙染會影響整條下游的河水。

examples.en: She has a predilection for spicy food.
examples.zh: 她特別偏愛辛辣的食物。

examples.en: His predilection for classical music developed at an early age.
examples.zh: 他對古典音樂的偏愛在很小的時候就培養出來了。

examples.en: It took superhuman effort to finish the marathon in that heat.
examples.zh: 在那樣的酷熱下跑完馬拉松需要超人的努力。

examples.en: The rescue team showed superhuman courage during the disaster.
examples.zh: 救難隊在災難中展現了超人的勇氣。

examples.en: The museum uses a hologram to display the ancient artifact.
examples.zh: 博物館用全息圖來展示這件古代文物。

examples.en: A hologram of the singer appeared on stage during the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會上，歌手的全息影像出現在舞台上。

examples.en: Wearing socks with sandals is considered unfashionable by many.
examples.zh: 許多人認為穿涼鞋配襪子很不時尚。

examples.en: She refused to throw away her unfashionable but comfortable shoes.
examples.zh: 她拒絕丟掉那雙過時但舒適的鞋子。

examples.en: He unknowingly left his phone on the train.
examples.zh: 他不知不覺地把手機留在火車上了。

examples.en: She unknowingly hurt her friend's feelings with that joke.
examples.zh: 她無意中因為那個玩笑傷害了朋友的感情。

examples.en: After years of hard work, she finally became a tenured professor.
examples.zh: 經過多年的努力，她終於成為終身職教授。

examples.en: Tenured employees enjoy greater job security.
examples.zh: 長期聘用的員工享有更高的工作保障。

examples.en: Passengers began to disembark as soon as the ferry docked.
examples.zh: 渡輪一靠岸，乘客們就開始下船。

examples.en: Please wait until the plane has stopped completely before you disembark.
examples.zh: 請等飛機完全停穩後再下機。

examples.en: The accountant scrupulously checked every figure in the report.
examples.zh: 會計師一絲不苟地核對報告中的每一個數字。

examples.en: She scrupulously avoided any appearance of favoritism.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地避免任何偏袒的嫌疑。

examples.en: The teacher squelched the argument before it got out of hand.
examples.zh: 老師在爭論失控之前就把它壓制下來了。

examples.en: My boots squelched as I walked through the wet mud.
examples.zh: 我走過濕泥巴時，靴子發出咯吱咯吱的聲音。

examples.en: The company decided to divest its unprofitable divisions.
examples.zh: 公司決定處置掉不賺錢的部門。

examples.en: He divested himself of all unnecessary possessions before moving abroad.
examples.zh: 出國前，他擺脫了所有不必要的財產。

examples.en: The old gravestone was covered with moss and ivy.
examples.zh: 那塊古老的墓碑上長滿了青苔和常春藤。

examples.en: Someone had placed fresh flowers on the gravestone.
examples.zh: 有人在墓碑上放了鮮花。

examples.en: His opening gambit was to ask about her family.
examples.zh: 他的開場白是詢問她的家庭狀況。

examples.en: The chess player used a risky gambit to gain an advantage.
examples.zh: 這位棋手採用冒險的開局棋法來取得優勢。

examples.en: Arthritis is a degenerative disease that worsens over time.
examples.zh: 關節炎是一種會隨時間惡化的退化性疾病。

examples.en: The doctor explained that the condition is degenerative but manageable.
examples.zh: 醫生解釋說這種病是退化性的，但可以控制。

examples.en: The canny investor bought the stock before prices soared.
examples.zh: 這位精明的投資者在股價飆漲前就買進了股票。

examples.en: She is too canny to fall for such an obvious trick.
examples.zh: 她太精明了，不會上這種明顯的當。

examples.en: The beach was covered with detritus after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後，海灘上佈滿了碎石和殘骸。

examples.en: Detritus from the collapsed building blocked the road.
examples.zh: 倒塌建築物的碎屑堵住了道路。

examples.en: The artist cleaned her brushes with turpentine after finishing the oil painting.
examples.zh: 藝術家完成油畫後，用松節油清洗畫筆。

examples.en: Workers collected turpentine from the pine trees to use in various products.
examples.zh: 工人從松樹收集松脂，用來製作各種產品。

examples.en: The dancers moved rhythmically to the beat of the drum.
examples.zh: 舞者隨著鼓聲有節奏地移動。

examples.en: He tapped his foot rhythmically while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 他等公車時有節奏地輕踏腳。

examples.en: The meeting proceeded without any untoward incidents.
examples.zh: 會議進行順利，沒有發生任何麻煩的事。

examples.en: She apologized for her untoward behavior at the party.
examples.zh: 她為自己在派對上不恰當的行為道歉。

examples.en: After the renovation, the old house became habitable again.
examples.zh: 翻修後，這棟老房子又變得適合居住了。

examples.en: Scientists are searching for habitable planets outside our solar system.
examples.zh: 科學家正在太陽系外尋找適合居住的行星。

examples.en: They tacitly agreed not to discuss the matter in public.
examples.zh: 他們默許不在公開場合討論這件事。

examples.en: The manager tacitly approved the plan by not objecting to it.
examples.zh: 經理沒有反對，等於默許了這項計畫。

examples.en: He has a proclivity for taking risks in his investments.
examples.zh: 他在投資上有冒險的傾向。

examples.en: Her proclivity to gossip often got her into trouble.
examples.zh: 她愛說閒話的癖性常為她惹來麻煩。

examples.en: This nontoxic paint is safe for use in children's rooms.
examples.zh: 這種無毒油漆用在兒童房很安全。

examples.en: The company claims that all its packaging materials are nontoxic.
examples.zh: 該公司聲稱所有包裝材料都是無毒的。

examples.en: His speech was so slurred that it was almost unintelligible.
examples.zh: 他說話含糊不清，幾乎難以理解。

examples.en: The instructions were written in unintelligible technical jargon.
examples.zh: 說明書是用難以理解的技術術語寫成的。

examples.en: The film's use of modern slang in a medieval setting felt anachronistic.
examples.zh: 這部電影在中世紀背景中使用現代俚語，顯得時代錯誤。

examples.en: Some critics consider the law anachronistic and in need of reform.
examples.zh: 一些批評者認為這條法律不合時宜，需要改革。

examples.en: Despite his protestations of innocence, the evidence was against him.
examples.zh: 儘管他聲稱自己無罪，證據卻對他不利。

examples.en: She ignored his protestations and continued with her plan.
examples.zh: 她不理會他的抗議，繼續執行她的計畫。

examples.en: The villain hired a couple of goons to intimidate his rivals.
examples.zh: 那個壞人僱了幾個打手來恐嚇他的對手。

examples.en: Don't act like a goon; use your manners.
examples.zh: 別像個呆子一樣，要有禮貌。

examples.en: His prosaic writing style lacked the flair of a great novelist.
examples.zh: 他平淡無奇的寫作風格缺乏偉大小說家的才氣。

examples.en: The job was prosaic but paid well.
examples.zh: 這份工作單調乏味，但待遇不錯。

examples.en: In ancient times, people used divination to predict the future.
examples.zh: 在古代，人們用占卜來預測未來。

examples.en: She dismissed astrology as a form of divination rather than science.
examples.zh: 她認為占星術只是一種占卜，而非科學。

examples.en: The police use criminal profiling to narrow down suspects.
examples.zh: 警方利用犯罪側寫來縮小嫌疑犯範圍。

examples.en: Some argue that racial profiling is a form of discrimination.
examples.zh: 有些人認為種族歸納是一種歧視。

examples.en: They walked along a mossy path through the forest.
examples.zh: 他們沿著長滿青苔的小徑穿過森林。

examples.en: The old stone wall was covered in mossy growth.
examples.zh: 那面古老的石牆上長滿了青苔。

examples.en: His kindness and humor endeared him to everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 他的善良和幽默讓辦公室裡的每個人都喜歡他。

examples.en: The teacher's patience endeared her to her students.
examples.zh: 老師的耐心使學生們都喜愛她。

examples.en: The smoothness of the silk fabric felt luxurious against her skin.
examples.zh: 絲綢布料的光滑觸感在她肌膚上感覺很奢華。

examples.en: He admired the smoothness of the car's ride on the highway.
examples.zh: 他欣賞這輛車在高速公路上行駛的平穩性。

examples.en: The coach castigated the players for their lack of effort.
examples.zh: 教練嚴厲批評球員們不夠努力。

examples.en: The newspaper castigated the government for its slow response.
examples.zh: 報紙嚴厲抨擊政府反應遲緩。

examples.en: They danced romantically under the moonlight.
examples.zh: 他們在月光下浪漫地跳舞。

examples.en: She often daydreams romantically about living in a castle.
examples.zh: 她常常浪漫地幻想住在城堡裡。

examples.en: The team's performance was abysmal; they lost every game.
examples.zh: 這支球隊的表現糟透了，他們輸掉了每場比賽。

examples.en: The abysmal depths of the ocean are still largely unexplored.
examples.zh: 海洋深不可測的深處仍有大部分未被探索。

examples.en: She spoke in a quiet undertone so no one else could hear.
examples.zh: 她用低聲細語說話，以免其他人聽到。

examples.en: The painting's pale blue undertone gives it a calming effect.
examples.zh: 這幅畫的淡藍色底色給人一種平靜的感覺。

examples.en: The rapidity of the changes caught everyone by surprise.
examples.zh: 變化的迅速讓所有人都感到驚訝。

examples.en: He completed the task with surprising rapidity.
examples.zh: 他以驚人的速度完成了任務。

examples.en: Her inadvertent remark hurt his feelings.
examples.zh: 她不經意的話傷了他的感情。

examples.en: The error was inadvertent, not deliberate.
examples.zh: 這個錯誤是無意的，不是故意的。

examples.en: The governor granted clemency to the prisoner.
examples.zh: 州長對囚犯給予了寬恕。

examples.en: The pleasant clemency of the weather made the picnic enjoyable.
examples.zh: 宜人的溫和天氣讓野餐很愉快。

examples.en: They found the old car parts at a junkyard.
examples.zh: 他們在廢車場找到了舊汽車零件。

examples.en: The junkyard was filled with rusted metal and broken machines.
examples.zh: 廢品場堆滿了生鏽的金屬和損壞的機器。

examples.en: The coins rolled into a cranny between the floorboards.
examples.zh: 硬幣滾進了地板之間的裂縫裡。

examples.en: Every cranny of the old house was filled with dust.
examples.zh: 老房子的每個縫隙都積滿了灰塵。

examples.en: The movie's plot was dull and unimaginative.
examples.zh: 這部電影的情節枯燥且缺乏想像力。

examples.en: His unimaginative approach to problem-solving rarely yields creative solutions.
examples.zh: 他缺乏想像力的解決問題方式很少產生創造性的解決方案。

examples.en: The protesters burned an effigy of the dictator.
examples.zh: 抗議者焚燒了獨裁者的肖像。

examples.en: A stone effigy of the king stands in the courtyard.
examples.zh: 國王的石像矗立在庭院中。

examples.en: The novel's disjointed narrative confused many readers.
examples.zh: 這本小說不連貫的敘事讓許多讀者感到困惑。

examples.en: After the accident, his disjointed memories slowly returned.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，他支離破碎的記憶慢慢恢復了。

examples.en: The overzealous fan waited for hours to get an autograph.
examples.zh: 那位過分熱心的粉絲等了幾個小時只為得到簽名。

examples.en: Her overzealous cleaning ruined the antique finish.
examples.zh: 她過度熱心的清潔毀了古董的表面。

examples.en: I ordered a chicken tamale for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐點了一份雞肉玉米粉蒸肉。

examples.en: Making tamales from scratch takes a lot of time.
examples.zh: 從頭製作玉米粉蒸肉需要很多時間。

examples.en: She assiduously practiced the piano every day.
examples.zh: 她每天勤勉地練習鋼琴。

examples.en: He assiduously studied the documents for any errors.
examples.zh: 他刻苦地研究文件，尋找任何錯誤。

examples.en: The soiled dishes were piled in the sink.
examples.zh: 髒盤子堆在水槽裡。

examples.en: He changed his soiled shirt after the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行後，他換掉了髒襯衫。

examples.en: Education should be a birthright, not a privilege.
examples.zh: 教育應該是與生俱來的權利，而不是特權。

examples.en: As the eldest son, he inherited the estate as his birthright.
examples.zh: 作為長子，他繼承了莊園作為長子繼承權。

examples.en: She was vehement in her denial of the accusation.
examples.zh: 她激烈地否認了這項指控。

examples.en: The vehement wind blew down several trees.
examples.zh: 猛烈的風吹倒了幾棵樹。

examples.en: The soldiers formed a phalanx to protect the king.
examples.zh: 士兵們組成方陣來保護國王。

examples.en: A phalanx of reporters waited outside the courthouse.
examples.zh: 一群記者等在法院外面。

examples.en: The medicine had an unpalatable bitter taste.
examples.zh: 這藥有一種令人難以下嚥的苦味。

examples.en: He had to accept the unpalatable truth about his failure.
examples.zh: 他不得不接受關於自己失敗的難以接受的事實。

examples.en: She subconsciously bit her nails during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試時她潛意識地咬指甲。

examples.en: He subconsciously avoided making eye contact with her.
examples.zh: 他潛意識地避免與她眼神接觸。

examples.en: The painting hung skewed on the wall.
examples.zh: 畫歪掛在牆上。

examples.en: The survey results were skewed by a small sample size.
examples.zh: 調查結果因樣本量小而被扭曲。

examples.en: The doctor was concerned about the metastasis of the cancer.
examples.zh: 醫生擔心癌症的轉移。

examples.en: Early detection can prevent metastasis to other organs.
examples.zh: 早期發現可以防止轉移到其他器官。

examples.en: The museum honored the liberator who freed the prisoners of war.
examples.zh: 博物館表揚了那位釋放戰俘的解放者。

examples.en: She was seen as a liberator by the villagers trapped in the flood.
examples.zh: 她被受困於洪水的村民視為解放者。

examples.en: He gave a grudging nod of approval after the presentation.
examples.zh: 簡報結束後，他勉強地點頭表示認可。

examples.en: Her grudging acceptance of the plan showed she still had doubts.
examples.zh: 她勉強接受這個計畫，顯示她仍有疑慮。

examples.en: The trucking industry has grown rapidly due to online shopping.
examples.zh: 由於網購盛行，貨車運輸業迅速成長。

examples.en: He works in trucking, coordinating deliveries across the country.
examples.zh: 他從事貨車運輸業，負責協調全國的配送。

examples.en: Critics argue that the new tax policy is regressive and hurts low-income families.
examples.zh: 批評者認為新的稅收政策是累退的，會傷害低收入家庭。

examples.en: The country's regressive laws have rolled back women's rights.
examples.zh: 該國倒退的法律已使女性權利大幅退步。

examples.en: She gave a creditable performance in the school play.
examples.zh: 她在學校話劇中的表現值得讚許。

examples.en: His creditable effort to help the community earned him respect.
examples.zh: 他對社區的幫助值得稱譽，為他贏得尊重。

examples.en: The directed study program allows students to focus on specific topics.
examples.zh: 定向學習計畫讓學生能專注於特定主題。

examples.en: Under directed supervision, the trainees quickly learned the safety rules.
examples.zh: 在指導監督下，受訓者很快學會了安全規則。

examples.en: The battering of the old building continued for hours.
examples.zh: 對這棟老建築的連續猛擊持續了好幾個小時。

examples.en: The storm's battering left the coastal town in ruins.
examples.zh: 暴風雨的猛烈襲擊讓這座沿海城鎮成為廢墟。

examples.en: The dusky sky signaled that evening was approaching.
examples.zh: 微暗的天空預告夜晚即將來臨。

examples.en: Her dusky complexion glowed under the summer sun.
examples.zh: 她微黑的膚色在夏日陽光下閃耀。

examples.en: He had no scruple about taking credit for others' work.
examples.zh: 他對於把別人的功勞據為己有毫無顧忌。

examples.en: She did not scruple to tell the truth, even if it hurt.
examples.zh: 她毫不猶豫地說出真相，即使那會傷人。

examples.en: They made an unholy mess in the kitchen while cooking.
examples.zh: 他們煮飯時把廚房弄得亂七八糟。

examples.en: The unholy alliance between the two companies raised concerns.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司邪惡的結盟引發了擔憂。

examples.en: Teachers should inculcate good study habits in their students.
examples.zh: 老師應該向學生反覆灌輸良好的讀書習慣。

examples.en: The coach inculcated a sense of teamwork through daily practice.
examples.zh: 教練透過每日練習諄諄教誨團隊合作的精神。

examples.en: The pain was bearable thanks to the medicine.
examples.zh: 多虧了藥物，疼痛還算可以忍受。

examples.en: Living in the small apartment became bearable after they decorated it.
examples.zh: 他們裝飾過後，住在小公寓裡變得可以忍受了。

examples.en: The ticker showed a sharp decline in stock prices.
examples.zh: 股票行情顯示器顯示股價大幅下跌。

examples.en: His ticker raced as he waited for the exam results.
examples.zh: 等待考試結果時，他的心臟跳得飛快。

examples.en: She grabbed a fistful of sand and let it slip through her fingers.
examples.zh: 她抓起一把沙子，讓它從指縫間滑落。

examples.en: He paid a fistful of cash for the rare book.
examples.zh: 他花了一大把現金買下那本珍本書。

examples.en: The city's nightlife attracts tourists from all over the world.
examples.zh: 這座城市的夜生活吸引了世界各地的遊客。

examples.en: They explored the vibrant nightlife of the harbor area.
examples.zh: 他們探索了港區充滿活力的夜生活。

examples.en: The dish is popular regionally but rarely seen elsewhere.
examples.zh: 這道菜在當地很受歡迎，但在其他地方很少見。

examples.en: Regionally, the weather varies greatly from north to south.
examples.zh: 在區域範圍內，天氣從北到南差異很大。

examples.en: Sighted people often take their vision for granted.
examples.zh: 有視力的人常常把視力視為理所當然。

examples.en: The guide dog helps her navigate the city like a sighted person.
examples.zh: 導盲犬幫助她像有視力的人一樣在城市中行走。

examples.en: Regular exercise is essential for your mental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 規律運動對你的心理健康至關重要。

examples.en: The company introduced wellness programs to improve employee wellbeing.
examples.zh: 公司推出健康計畫來增進員工的幸福。

examples.en: He humbly accepted the award and thanked his team.
examples.zh: 他謙遜地接受獎項並感謝他的團隊。

examples.en: She humbly asked for forgiveness after the misunderstanding.
examples.zh: 誤會之後，她低聲下氣地請求原諒。

examples.en: He wilfully ignored the warnings and went ahead with his plan.
examples.zh: 他固執地無視警告，逕自執行他的計畫。

examples.en: The company wilfully violated safety regulations.
examples.zh: 該公司蓄意違反安全法規。

examples.en: A mysterious monolith stood in the middle of the field.
examples.zh: 一塊神秘的巨石矗立在田野中央。

examples.en: Tourists gathered to take photos of the ancient monolith.
examples.zh: 遊客們聚集在一起，拍攝這塊古老的巨石。

examples.en: She used a duster to clean the shelves.
examples.zh: 她用撣子清潔架子。

examples.en: The duster picked up all the dust from the furniture.
examples.zh: 撣子把家具上的灰塵都吸走了。

examples.en: The extermination of the pests required professional help.
examples.zh: 消滅這些害蟲需要專業協助。

examples.en: They discussed the extermination of invasive species on the island.
examples.zh: 他們討論了島上入侵物種的根絕問題。

examples.en: He wore a jaunty hat that made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 他戴著一頂活潑的帽子，讓大家都笑了。

examples.en: Her jaunty walk showed she was in a great mood.
examples.zh: 她輕快的步伐顯示她心情很好。

examples.en: The paintwork on the old house was peeling.
examples.zh: 老房子上的油漆表面正在剝落。

examples.en: He carefully cleaned the paintwork of the car.
examples.zh: 他小心地清潔汽車的油漆表面。

examples.en: The lawyer objected to the irrelevance of the question.
examples.zh: 律師反對這個問題的不相關性。

examples.en: His comments were full of irrelevance and confusion.
examples.zh: 他的評論充滿了不相關的內容和混亂。

examples.en: The revelers danced until the early morning.
examples.zh: 狂歡者們跳舞直到清晨。

examples.en: A reveler shouted with joy when the music started.
examples.zh: 音樂開始時，一名狂歡者高興地大喊。

examples.en: The excitable puppy jumped on everyone who visited.
examples.zh: 這隻易興奮的小狗撲向每個來訪的人。

examples.en: She is excitable and often gets carried away.
examples.zh: 她很易興奮，經常失去控制。

examples.en: They drove along the superhighway to reach the city.
examples.zh: 他們沿著超級高速公路開車前往城市。

examples.en: The superhighway was busy with trucks and cars.
examples.zh: 超級高速公路上擠滿了卡車和汽車。

examples.en: The project ended disastrously when the funding was cut.
examples.zh: 當資金被削減時，這個專案悲慘地結束了。

examples.en: He disastrously forgot to save his work before the power outage.
examples.zh: 他在停電前悲慘地忘了儲存他的工作。

examples.en: The horse chomped on the apple noisily.
examples.zh: 馬大聲地嚼著蘋果。

examples.en: Please don't chomp your food so loudly.
examples.zh: 請不要這麼大聲地嚼食物。

examples.en: The old toy ran on clockwork and needed winding.
examples.zh: 這個舊玩具靠發條裝置運轉，需要上發條。

examples.en: The clockwork mechanism was beautifully crafted.
examples.zh: 這個鐘錶裝置製作精美。

examples.en: The papers were in a welter of confusion on the desk.
examples.zh: 文件在桌上混亂地堆成一團。

examples.en: He weltered in self-pity after losing the game.
examples.zh: 輸掉比賽後，他沉溺於自憐之中。

examples.en: She served the curry with a side of mango chutney.
examples.zh: 她端上咖哩，並附上一份芒果酸辣醬。

examples.en: The chutney added a sweet and spicy flavor to the dish.
examples.zh: 酸辣醬為這道菜增添了甜辣的味道。

examples.en: He wore a starched shirt to the formal dinner.
examples.zh: 他穿著一件漿硬的襯衫去參加正式晚宴。

examples.en: The starched tablecloth felt stiff and crisp.
examples.zh: 漿硬的桌布摸起來僵硬而清脆。

examples.en: The cake was deliciously moist and chocolatey.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕美味地濕潤且充滿巧克力味。

examples.en: She smiled deliciously as she tasted the soup.
examples.zh: 她品嚐湯時美味地笑了。

examples.en: He spoke offensively to the waiter and was asked to leave.
examples.zh: 他對服務生說話冒犯，被要求離開。

examples.en: The graffiti was offensively drawn on the historic wall.
examples.zh: 塗鴉被冒犯地畫在歷史牆上。

examples.en: The insurance adjuster assessed the damage to the house.
examples.zh: 保險理賠員評估了房屋的損壞情況。

examples.en: She works as a claims adjuster for a large company.
examples.zh: 她在一家大公司擔任理賠調整員。

examples.en: The company underwent a reappraisal of its marketing strategy.
examples.zh: 公司對其行銷策略進行了重新評估。

examples.en: A reappraisal of the evidence led to a new conclusion.
examples.zh: 對證據的重新評價導致了新的結論。

examples.en: She specializes in oncology and treats cancer patients.
examples.zh: 她專攻腫瘤學，治療癌症患者。

examples.en: The hospital opened a new oncology department last month.
examples.zh: 醫院上個月開設了一個新的腫瘤科。

examples.en: The hikers balanced perilously on the narrow ridge.
examples.zh: 登山客在狹窄的山脊上危險地保持平衡。

examples.en: She drove perilously close to the edge of the cliff.
examples.zh: 她開車危險地靠近懸崖邊緣。

examples.en: It is unconscionable to charge such high fees for basic services.
examples.zh: 對基本服務收取如此高的費用是不合理的。

examples.en: The company's unconscionable delay left customers without help for weeks.
examples.zh: 該公司過度的延誤讓客戶數週得不到幫助。

examples.en: One of his idiosyncrasies is always wearing mismatched socks.
examples.zh: 他的一個特點是總是穿不成對的襪子。

examples.en: The artist's idiosyncrasy made her work instantly recognizable.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家的獨特風格使她的作品一眼就能被認出。

examples.en: The acrid smell of burnt toast filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 烤焦吐司的辛辣味瀰漫整個廚房。

examples.en: His acrid remarks during the meeting upset everyone.
examples.zh: 他在會議中刻薄的言論讓大家都很不高興。

examples.en: The breakaway group formed its own political party.
examples.zh: 脫離的團體組成了自己的政黨。

examples.en: The region's breakaway from the country was peaceful.
examples.zh: 該地區從該國脫離是和平的。

examples.en: The thief sought concealment behind the thick curtains.
examples.zh: 小偷在厚窗簾後面尋求隱蔽。

examples.en: Her concealment of the truth surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她隱瞞真相讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: The centrifugal force pushed the passengers outward on the spinning ride.
examples.zh: 離心力在旋轉的遊樂設施上將乘客向外推。

examples.en: A centrifugal pump moves water away from its center.
examples.zh: 離心泵將水從中心向外輸送。
